<subsection changed="added" id="H3310E9812CC54D258671CAB9F1BAB25D" class="indent0"><num value="i">(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Withholding of Funds</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under titles III and IV that are withheld from obligation or otherwise not programmed as a result of application of a provision of law in this or any other Act shall, if reprogrammed, be subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</content></subsection>
<subsection changed="added" id="H7E7348EE7611432099A224D35F66990B" class="indent0"><num value="j">(j) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Foreign Assistance Review or Realignment</inline>.—</heading><content>Programmatic, funding, and organizational changes resulting from implementation of any foreign assistance review or realignment shall be subject to prior consultation with, and the regular notification procedures of, the Committees on Appropriations: <proviso><i> Provided</i>, That such notifications may be submitted in classified form, if necessary.</proviso></content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="HD444BD1E002445949B7DF26D874491D7"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">document requests, records management, and related cybersecurity protections</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section changed="added" id="H3466DCFB2EC8453DB0029FB35FBF22A9"><num value="7016"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7016. </inline></num><subsection id="H78E85294067F483DA864F2C768AE9B93" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Document Requests</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated or made available pursuant to titles III through VI of this Act shall be available to a nongovernmental organization, including any contractor, which fails to provide upon timely request any document, file, or record necessary to the auditing requirements of the Department of State and the United States Agency for International Development.</content></subsection>
<subsection changed="added" id="HEEF6E39C567C457CB5C9D22BDB905620" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Records Management and Related Cybersecurity Protections</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Secretary of State and USAID Administrator shall—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HC3BD93F33EC34A1A858A123E68D0FC49" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>regularly review and update the policies, directives, and oversight necessary to comply with Federal statutes, regulations, and presidential executive orders and memoranda concerning the preservation of all records made or received in the conduct of official business, including record emails, instant messaging, and other online tools;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HB09C36A3192D4500820EA01BA1467322" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>use funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Diplomatic Programs” and “Capital Investment Fund” in title I, and “Operating Expenses” and “Capital Investment Fund” in title II, as appropriate, to improve Federal records management pursuant to the Federal Records Act (44 U.S.C. Chapters 21, 29, 31, and 33) and other applicable Federal records management statutes, regulations, or policies for the Department of State and USAID;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H507F5644B0DF4A9BA0EE7BBBEB2505BB" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>direct departing employees, including senior officials, that all Federal records generated by such employees belong to the Federal Government;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H02F981821A94453D9B165301011168B8" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>improve the response time for identifying and retrieving Federal records, including requests made pursuant to section 552 of title 5, United States Code (commonly known as the “Freedom of Information Act”); and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HE1377791E3844160B691BDE905A059F1" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><content>strengthen cybersecurity measures to mitigate vulnerabilities, including those resulting from the use of personal email accounts or servers outside the .gov domain, improve the process to identify and remove inactive user accounts, update and enforce guidance related to the control of national security information, and implement the recommendations of the applicable reports of the cognizant Office of Inspector General.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H324CD2F3187E44A28BA406CED65FADC9"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">use of funds in contravention of this act</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section changed="added" id="H149EA2C0C1734E5C97E2E4A3F0BA9242"><num value="7017"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7017. </inline></num><chapeau class="inline">If the President makes a determination not to comply with any provision of this Act on constitutional grounds, the head of the relevant Federal agency shall notify the Committees on Appropriations in writing within 5 days of such determination, the basis for such determination and any resulting changes to program or policy.</chapeau>
<appropriations level="small" id="HD077918350474EF5A86FB36645C09635"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">prohibition on funding for abortions and involuntary sterilization</inline></heading></appropriations></section>
<section changed="added" id="HAD4C1BEC49DA47F9A3047D0EA90A3D8E"><num value="7018"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7018. </inline></num><chapeau class="inline">None of the funds made available to carry out part I of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, as amended, may be used to pay for the performance of abortions as a method of family planning or to motivate or coerce any person to practice abortions. None of the funds made available to carry out part I of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, as amended, may be used to pay for the performance of involuntary sterilization as a method of family planning or to coerce or provide any financial incentive to any person to undergo sterilizations. None of the funds made available to carry out part I of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, as amended, may be used to pay for any biomedical research which relates in whole or in part, to methods of, or the performance of, abortions or involuntary sterilization as a means of family planning. None of the funds made available to carry out part I of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, as amended, may be obligated or expended for any country or organization if the President certifies that the use of these funds by any such country or organization would violate any of the above provisions related to abortions and involuntary sterilizations.</chapeau>
<appropriations level="small" id="H56545DCE98984643B7B7F58B59EDE54B"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">allocations and reports</inline></heading></appropriations></section>
<section changed="added" id="H5083BB57763B427F91A1D6DFCF163759"><num value="7019"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7019. </inline></num><subsection id="H80E499DE941242DEB90A5D26381065B9" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Allocation Tables</inline>.—</heading><content>Subject to subsection (b), funds appropriated by this Act under titles III through V shall be made available at not less than the amounts specifically designated in the respective tables included in the explanatory statement described in section 4 (in the matter preceding division A of this consolidated Act): <proviso><i> Provided</i>, That such designated amounts for foreign countries and international organizations shall serve as the amounts for such countries and international organizations transmitted to Congress in the report required by section 653(a) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, and shall be made available for such foreign countries and international organizations notwithstanding the date of the transmission of such report.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection changed="added" id="H6D1C6EEB9F674BFB8F5C0373A9BC0627" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authorized Deviations Below Minimum Levels</inline>.—</heading><content>Unless otherwise provided for by this Act, the Secretary of State and the Administrator of the United States Agency for International Development, as applicable, may deviate by not more than 10 percent below the minimum amounts specifically designated in the respective tables in the explanatory statement described in section 4 (in the matter preceding division A of this consolidated Act): <proviso><i> Provided</i>, That deviations pursuant to this subsection shall be subject to prior consultation with the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection changed="added" id="HC9CE2CD45AE441BC80AF7E4C7261240C" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation</inline>.—</heading><content>For specifically designated amounts that are included, pursuant to subsection (a), in the report required by section 653(a) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, deviations authorized by subsection (b) may only take place after submission of such report.</content></subsection>
<subsection changed="added" id="H0A27292409BA4B7CAD6DC6865F146B72" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exceptions</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HF954FD8747CE4CC9B089D3A57EC5A1A8" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><chapeau>Subsections (a) and (b) shall not apply to—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H9FACAA0474F6436BBD8E44BDB39477F8" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>amounts designated for “International Military Education and Training” in the respective tables included in the explanatory statement described in section 4 (in the matter preceding division A of this consolidated Act);</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H285728C962B6433F9C8AF134BDDE699E" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>funds for which the initial period of availability has expired; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HEEB6CA56DA994A4AB80F14CCDAD2801D" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>amounts designated by this Act as minimum funding requirements.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H36E4B7F2563548A0B20E9E248B23C9A0" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>The authority in subsection (b) to deviate below amounts designated in the respective tables included in the explanatory statement described in section 4 (in the matter preceding division A of this consolidated Act) shall not apply to the table included under the heading “Global Health Programs” in such statement.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H4F31EA4A4139430AA53CEB11A9A5F6EA" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>With respect to the amounts designated for “Global Programs” in the table under the heading “Economic Support Fund” included in the explanatory statement described in section 4 (in the matter preceding division A of this consolidated Act), subsection (b) shall be applied by substituting “5 percent” for “10 percent”.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection changed="added" id="H0C0B87229CA04DD19681FA38857387F0" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reports</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of State, USAID Administrator, and other designated officials, as appropriate, shall submit the reports required, in the manner described, in House Report 116–78, Senate Report 116–126, and the explanatory statement described in section 4 (in the matter preceding division A of this consolidated Act), unless directed otherwise in such explanatory statement.</content></subsection>
<subsection changed="added" id="HCA890F90F27B4AE7ACB4CF92A58C1629" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Clarification</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act and the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2019 (division F of Public Law 116–6) under the headings “International Disaster Assistance” and “Migration and Refugee Assistance” shall not be included for purposes of meeting amounts designated for countries in this Act or the explanatory statement described in section 4 (in the matter preceding division A of this consolidated Act), or such prior Act or accompanying joint explanatory statement, unless such headings are specifically designated as the source of funds.</content></subsection></section>

<appropriations level="small" id="H27F6606070E74F299A5767872C6D05EA"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">prohibition on assistance to governments supporting international terrorism</inline></heading></appropriations></section>
<section changed="added" id="H65079CF2241F4488A462797B4E33B02C"><num value="7021"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7021. </inline></num><subsection id="H67BE500B23964F48B186DB39D40FE6BA" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Lethal Military Equipment Exports</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph changed="added" id="H2EDB731051FB47D884691045016A4E79" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made available under titles III through VI of this Act may be made available to any foreign government which provides lethal military equipment to a country the government of which the Secretary of State has determined supports international terrorism for purposes of section 1754(c) of the Export Reform Control Act of 2018 (50 U.S.C. 4813(c)): <proviso><i> Provided</i>, That the prohibition under this section with respect to a foreign government shall terminate 12 months after that government ceases to provide such military equipment: </proviso><proviso><i> Provided further</i>, That this section applies with respect to lethal military equipment provided under a contract entered into after October 1, 1997.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph changed="added" id="H4CBEC4F26DB54D7DB409F5C741A5DC3A" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Determination</inline>.—</heading><content>Assistance restricted by paragraph (1) or any other similar provision of law, may be furnished if the President determines that to do so is important to the national interest of the United States.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph changed="added" id="H4C19DFC07E7541198BCF770DCEC47DCD" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Report</inline>.—</heading><content>Whenever the President makes a determination pursuant to paragraph (2), the President shall submit to the Committees on Appropriations a report with respect to the furnishing of such assistance, including a detailed explanation of the assistance to be provided, the estimated dollar amount of such assistance, and an explanation of how the assistance furthers United States national interest.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection changed="added" id="H143842A262104FA89762EDF9A2E54B01" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Bilateral Assistance</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HAB1B485C17764B59AA5E2814E8BBFB5A" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitations</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Funds appropriated for bilateral assistance in titles III through VI of this Act and funds appropriated under any such title in prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs, shall not be made available to any foreign government which the President determines—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HFC913FE2A84A4DDF92977A4B8F0C956F" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>grants sanctuary from prosecution to any individual or group which has committed an act of international terrorism;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H2C69F0A6E7F54BB9AD29FFCB3EE02CF7" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>otherwise supports international terrorism; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H98A31E1A21C840C18841ACF7D30D17C2" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>is controlled by an organization designated as a terrorist organization under section 219 of the Immigration and Nationality Act (8 U.S.C. 1189).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HBE185E6828AF40F0BDD722CDE1AD432F" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>The President may waive the application of paragraph (1) to a government if the President determines that national security or humanitarian reasons justify such waiver: <proviso><i> Provided</i>, That the President shall publish each such waiver in the Federal Register and, at least 15 days before the waiver takes effect, shall notify the Committees on Appropriations of the waiver (including the justification for the waiver) in accordance with the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection></section>
