<section id="H3EFCC5576B964F678AEAD03F1EDACFF3" styleType="OLC"><num value="610">SEC. 610. </num><heading>ACTIONS FOR DELAYS OF GENERIC DRUGS AND BIOSIMILAR BIOLOGICAL PRODUCTS.</heading>
<subsection id="H2999F4EA2A8C498E9EB4174089DA4F16" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definitions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In this section—</chapeau>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H77952B10668645E0B8A1672ED756E41B" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><chapeau>the term “<term>commercially reasonable, market-based terms</term>” means—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H1B8627A078DF43D5A0B3F274630F91CB" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>a nondiscriminatory price for the sale of the covered product at or below, but not greater than, the most recent wholesale acquisition cost for the drug, as defined in section 1847A(c)(6)(B) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395w–3a(c)(6)(B));</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H451AEE78B2DC477FAD101CC86E7EF25E" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>a schedule for delivery that results in the transfer of the covered product to the eligible product developer consistent with the timing under subsection (b)(2)(A)(iv); and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H62C767212CBA4286A927F17970A8DF32" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>no additional conditions are imposed on the sale of the covered product;</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="HDBD6CA1AC84B4A2D9C36459731E01A59" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><chapeau>the term “<term>covered product</term>”—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HA093E467827F4CE28270F7A79C489B87" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><chapeau>means—</chapeau>
<clause id="HE0E6C03DED7D4CB596BF5D294D982371" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>any drug approved under subsection (c) or (j) of section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355) or biological product licensed under subsection (a) or (k) of section 351 of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 262);</content></clause>
<clause id="H443E3B34A7504C49BAEF3AEC10762940" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>any combination of a drug or biological product described in clause (i); or</content></clause>
<clause id="H4AFDFBAAE15C4E5389E24C6371289546" class="indent3"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><content>when reasonably necessary to support approval of an application under section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355), or section 351 of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 262), as applicable, or otherwise meet the requirements for approval under either such section, any product, including any device, that is marketed or intended for use with such a drug or biological product; and</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H0E923152558B4D99902F14CCBDCA8D69" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><chapeau>does not include any drug or biological product that appears on the drug shortage list in effect under section 506E of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 356e), unless—</chapeau>
<clause id="HAE5809A8E2A1458BA4246E2FAAF4CDB6" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>the drug or biological product has been on the drug shortage list in effect under such section 506E continuously for more than 6 months; or</content></clause>
<clause id="HD2CAAD56ED6E40D9A7613AD116DE8106" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>the Secretary determines that inclusion of the drug or biological product as a covered product is likely to contribute to alleviating or preventing a shortage.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H7BB4359724F14153B5B076C0568151E7" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>the term “<term>device</term>” has the meaning given the term in section 201 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 321);</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H2A95DBB5A3E54700A58A1B2ABBBC2369" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>the term “<term>eligible product developer</term>” means a person that seeks to develop a product for approval pursuant to an application for approval under subsection (b)(2) or (j) of section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355) or for licensing pursuant to an application under section 351(k) of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 262(k));</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H21BCA967946B4250833CE87B70D3586E" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><content>the term “<term>license holder</term>” means the holder of an application approved under subsection (c) or (j) of section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355) or the holder of a license under subsection (a) or (k) of section 351 of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 262) for a covered product;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H51342D5D295E4B399D50E9EC14EF404E" class="indent1"><num value="6">(6) </num><content>the term “<term>REMS</term>” means a risk evaluation and mitigation strategy under section 505–1 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355–1);</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H8A4BC417C3054E8E8807394CACD69E46" class="indent1"><num value="7">(7) </num><content>the term “<term>REMS with ETASU</term>” means a REMS that contains elements to assure safe use under section 505–1(f) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355–1(f));</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H75ED3DEB00424C53B530ABD0840141D2" class="indent1"><num value="8">(8) </num><content>the term “<term>Secretary</term>” means the Secretary of Health and Human Services;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H2D531926D28C46B5AAD8E5C19FEEE4B8" class="indent1"><num value="9">(9) </num><content>the term “<term>single, shared system of elements to assure safe use</term>” means a single, shared system of elements to assure safe use under section 505–1(f) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355–1(f)); and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H885273DAF6794751B98B6DA7D29C9722" class="indent1"><num value="10">(10) </num><chapeau>the term “<term>sufficient quantities</term>” means an amount of a covered product that the eligible product developer determines allows it to—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H38D26A8BB09F42B8915C26F52ADC3D53" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><chapeau>conduct testing to support an application under—</chapeau>
<clause id="H2E8641BF788C42F19229AD749BB2CCCE" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>subsection (b)(2) or (j) of section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355); or</content></clause>
<clause id="HACC25425AA7E443180988BCFFF8AFE23" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>section 351(k) of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 262(k)); and</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H935F38FCF59B44C4BA6438C7152E6BCA" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>fulfill any regulatory requirements relating to approval of such an application.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H3D529088A5804CEDBBF7396FDC616084" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Civil Action for Failure To Provide Sufficient Quantities of a Covered Product</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HDA34B33DA1D04C81BB107323C5EB45E6" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>An eligible product developer may bring a civil action against the license holder for a covered product seeking relief under this subsection in an appropriate district court of the United States alleging that the license holder has declined to provide sufficient quantities of the covered product to the eligible product developer on commercially reasonable, market-based terms.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC27E86D744C9477FA927DBA74A2594C8" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Elements</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H7A3F15E3280B4E089EAB85E905A179C9" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>To prevail in a civil action brought under paragraph (1), an eligible product developer shall prove, by a preponderance of the evidence—</chapeau>
<clause id="H3217B5CE3FE548E598318E2D1BE81F93" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><chapeau>that—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H0C5AFC1EEA8946FDA3E1257CC6FA06F0" class="indent4"><num value="I">(I) </num><content>the covered product is not subject to a REMS with ETASU; or</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HA8A8BC8940744EABA6BE1EBC5B6F8F9A" class="indent4"><num value="II">(II) </num><chapeau>if the covered product is subject to a REMS with ETASU—</chapeau>
<item id="H0CF68E3444314A61A5F160F15F18FF03" class="indent5"><num value="aa">(aa) </num><content>the eligible product developer has obtained a covered product authorization from the Secretary in accordance with subparagraph (B); and</content></item>
<item id="H7C2833C76E4F4BEBBF03648C1D669F9A" class="indent5"><num value="bb">(bb) </num><content>the eligible product developer has provided a copy of the covered product authorization to the license holder;</content></item></subclause></clause>
<clause id="H6BB29708C0E949A6AAA8BC2E8275EE7A" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>that, as of the date on which the civil action is filed, the eligible product developer has not obtained sufficient quantities of the covered product on commercially reasonable, market-based terms;</content></clause>
<clause id="HA6F0163E5D2B4FE2AD65FCCE70EB1AE7" class="indent3"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><chapeau>that the eligible product developer has submitted a written request to purchase sufficient quantities of the covered product to the license holder, and such request—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H1D22BC2012AE440B998663F9C49D20DD" class="indent4"><num value="I">(I) </num><content>was sent to a named corporate officer of the license holder;</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H63D75A9808BD4DFEAD15B28BEB7EB373" class="indent4"><num value="II">(II) </num><content>was made by certified or registered mail with return receipt requested;</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H5E8E3BC6D91E46AC84A2EAC42A10EC5D" class="indent4"><num value="III">(III) </num><content>specified an individual as the point of contact for the license holder to direct communications related to the sale of the covered product to the eligible product developer and a means for electronic and written communications with that individual; and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H96649E895A744F868996D09B2B0B1884" class="indent4"><num value="IV">(IV) </num><content>specified an address to which the covered product was to be shipped upon reaching an agreement to transfer the covered product; and</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="H775313AFF441414EA74C830FC254A0F7" class="indent3"><num value="iv">(iv) </num><chapeau>that the license holder has not delivered to the eligible product developer sufficient quantities of the covered product on commercially reasonable, market-based terms—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HCE5E8A2794614AF9B646F8FCBCD9D6AF" class="indent4"><num value="I">(I) </num><content>for a covered product that is not subject to a REMS with ETASU, by the date that is 31 days after the date on which the license holder received the request for the covered product; and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HE5521FCAA1984A5692E478C10B217D8D" class="indent4"><num value="II">(II) </num><chapeau>for a covered product that is subject to a REMS with ETASU, by 31 days after the later of—</chapeau>
<item id="HD05C99B959FC4C75A4971CBF76F5CFD5" class="indent5"><num value="aa">(aa) </num><content>the date on which the license holder received the request for the covered product; or</content></item>
<item id="H77324499868A4B2FBC07A8C082AA01C8" class="indent5"><num value="bb">(bb) </num><content>the date on which the license holder received a copy of the covered product authorization issued by the Secretary in accordance with subparagraph (B).</content></item></subclause></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H89F305134D68437680D8A5A6CD58BCF7" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authorization for covered product subject to a rems with etasu</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="H8AAB746BAA14406F970BB5AE932F4C07" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Request</inline>.—</heading><content>An eligible product developer may submit to the Secretary a written request for the eligible product developer to be authorized to obtain sufficient quantities of an individual covered product subject to a REMS with ETASU.</content></clause>
<clause id="HD4B3E4BABEAA4B52881E92DB9FFA67CE" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authorization</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Not later than 120 days after the date on which a request under clause (i) is received, the Secretary shall, by written notice, authorize the eligible product developer to obtain sufficient quantities of an individual covered product subject to a REMS with ETASU for purposes of—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H0C8A5788457A46EEA89D62554FCD5EBE" class="indent4"><num value="I">(I) </num><content>development and testing that does not involve human clinical trials, if the eligible product developer has agreed to comply with any conditions the Secretary determines necessary; or</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HB7949E6B35614C77A6791FD502856F82" class="indent4"><num value="II">(II) </num><chapeau>development and testing that involves human clinical trials, if the eligible product developer has—</chapeau>
<item id="H3274AB287C2F40B0BB6A26646C4229FE" class="indent5"><num value="aa">(aa)</num><subitem id="H7C2A205E0A194784901CD6430B0FFBD6" class="inline"><num value="AA">(AA) </num><content>submitted protocols, informed consent documents, and informational materials for testing that include protections that provide safety protections comparable to those provided by the REMS for the covered product; or</content></subitem>
<subitem id="HFC7D65FEC8114201B64E6A323C197DAE" class="indent5"><num value="BB">(BB) </num><content>otherwise satisfied the Secretary that such protections will be provided; and</content></subitem></item>
<item id="H004B087A7B844F1FBC1AF62566EDCA53" class="indent5"><num value="bb">(bb) </num><content>met any other requirements the Secretary may establish.</content></item></subclause></clause>
<clause id="H71BDC555E1714AC9B95F9F7E7A7E6890" class="indent3"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notice</inline>.—</heading><content>A covered product authorization issued under this subparagraph shall state that the provision of the covered product by the license holder under the terms of the authorization will not be a violation of the REMS for the covered product.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF4AD457AEE044C89AB9EB97588C6E46F" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Affirmative defense</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In a civil action brought under paragraph (1), it shall be an affirmative defense, on which the defendant has the burden of persuasion by a preponderance of the evidence—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HA9954B5DD0A44460876070D151872C0A" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><chapeau>that, on the date on which the eligible product developer requested to purchase sufficient quantities of the covered product from the license holder—</chapeau>
<clause id="H526BEAC98A6945AE8B1960AE4A123D89" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>neither the license holder nor any of its agents, wholesalers, or distributors was engaged in the manufacturing or commercial marketing of the covered product; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H3D4B0321C8B14B7B8905588F9C1B6F3D" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>neither the license holder nor any of its agents, wholesalers, or distributors otherwise had access to inventory of the covered product to supply to the eligible product developer on commercially reasonable, market-based terms;</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H794691A7B3B04282B09E77D107230B1C" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><chapeau>that—</chapeau>
<clause id="HAE85FC7FCF1A4213857A4253B9B9900F" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>the license holder sells the covered product through agents, distributors, or wholesalers;</content></clause>
<clause id="HE6EF7AA8627345B881A4F3C21111F55D" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>the license holder has placed no restrictions, explicit or implicit, on its agents, distributors, or wholesalers to sell covered products to eligible product developers; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H7A66104DB91D48EEA8047040650AB219" class="indent3"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><content>the covered product can be purchased by the eligible product developer in sufficient quantities on commercially reasonable, market-based terms from the agents, distributors, or wholesalers of the license holder; or</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H3C54A780C7F04ACC8E2F5A632BB8989B" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><chapeau>that the license holder made an offer to the individual specified pursuant to paragraph (2)(A)(iii)(III), by a means of communication (electronic, written, or both) specified pursuant to such paragraph, to sell sufficient quantities of the covered product to the eligible product developer at commercially reasonable market-based terms—</chapeau>
<clause id="HB9D3C76E47254D84BFA95537B9E96889" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>for a covered product that is not subject to a REMS with ETASU, by the date that is 14 days after the date on which the license holder received the request for the covered product, and the eligible product developer did not accept such offer by the date that is 7 days after the date on which the eligible product developer received such offer from the license holder; or</content></clause>
<clause id="HAE0CD238B3454AD0828B6D3C3592F191" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>for a covered product that is subject to a REMS with ETASU, by the date that is 20 days after the date on which the license holder received the request for the covered product, and the eligible product developer did not accept such offer by the date that is 10 days after the date on which the eligible product developer received such offer from the license holder.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H460CD151D71340CF83B3FC24E070A9ED" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Remedies</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="HFEF4F499E3054E5F98B5DDDDF71C4EAA" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>If an eligible product developer prevails in a civil action brought under paragraph (1), the court shall—</chapeau>
<clause id="HBE07185F981F4D9BBB3F19FACED0681D" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>order the license holder to provide to the eligible product developer without delay sufficient quantities of the covered product on commercially reasonable, market-based terms;</content></clause>
<clause id="H5BB22135AABA48A88954AD3BF08E3793" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>award to the eligible product developer reasonable attorney’s fees and costs of the civil action; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H155399E0A66E407E905035EDE75DDF0A" class="indent3"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><chapeau>award to the eligible product developer a monetary amount sufficient to deter the license holder from failing to provide eligible product developers with sufficient quantities of a covered product on commercially reasonable, market-based terms, if the court finds, by a preponderance of the evidence—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HA4D0C58E1F18407AAB010798B6798E08" class="indent4"><num value="I">(I) </num><content>that the license holder delayed providing sufficient quantities of the covered product to the eligible product developer without a legitimate business justification; or</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H0CAAB27703BA4728BE5334E05FA612CF" class="indent4"><num value="II">(II) </num><content>that the license holder failed to comply with an order issued under clause (i).</content></subclause></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB34E5DE0A77A40958630305A3BE18062" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Maximum monetary amount</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A monetary amount awarded under subparagraph (A)(iii) shall not be greater than the revenue that the license holder earned on the covered product during the period—</chapeau>
<clause id="H9F3C84F84B544996962EFCA51626ADB1" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><chapeau>beginning on—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HAB627C8BCF554E76834C22EC096B2D4A" class="indent4"><num value="I">(I) </num><content>for a covered product that is not subject to a REMS with ETASU, the date that is 31 days after the date on which the license holder received the request; or</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HD0E334B770C2475084852496FA9EAE3D" class="indent4"><num value="II">(II) </num><chapeau>for a covered product that is subject to a REMS with ETASU, the date that is 31 days after the later of—</chapeau>
<item id="HB4DD84B9F49C4FAC870AA427015620A8" class="indent5"><num value="aa">(aa) </num><content>the date on which the license holder received the request; or</content></item>
<item id="H1F095B4A08B8425A93253031F042F81D" class="indent5"><num value="bb">(bb) </num><content>the date on which the license holder received a copy of the covered product authorization issued by the Secretary in accordance with paragraph (2)(B); and</content></item></subclause></clause>
<clause id="HAA59A9EE48B54A0B8B335BE6D35957C7" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>ending on the date on which the eligible product developer received sufficient quantities of the covered product.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H3863C6A60D5C4D80807F8474A7FD2602" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Avoidance of delay</inline>.—</heading><content>The court may issue an order under subparagraph (A)(i) before conducting further proceedings that may be necessary to determine whether the eligible product developer is entitled to an award under clause (ii) or (iii) of subparagraph (A), or the amount of any such award.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H70D10DD26BBC4726865EA5637751D034" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation of Liability</inline>.—</heading><content>A license holder for a covered product shall not be liable for any claim under Federal, State, or local law arising out of the failure of an eligible product developer to follow adequate safeguards to assure safe use of the covered product during development or testing activities described in this section, including transportation, handling, use, or disposal of the covered product by the eligible product developer.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HFDAEE1A45AAB426C93CD49C96973B512" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No Violation of REMS</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 505–1 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355–1) is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection:
<quotedContent id="H51CDA87A218743E8B263080B6EB9E55A" styleType="OLC">
<subsection id="H3476110DEBCF4103AA2865EE3B048B23" class="indent0"><num value="l">“(l) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Provision of Samples Not a Violation of Strategy</inline>.—</heading><content>The provision of samples of a covered product to an eligible product developer (as those terms are defined in section 610(a) of division N of the Further Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2020) shall not be considered a violation of the requirements of any risk evaluation and mitigation strategy that may be in place under this section for such drug.”</content></subsection></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection>
<subsection id="HB71696FC968541E78AD1CA41F8C0B3D9" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Rule of Construction</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H0CD012BC48864AA68E0A55FF02B02067" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definition</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In this subsection, the term “<term>antitrust laws</term>”—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H8ADDC5323F8B435E93D1C6BD575FE6D7" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>has the meaning given the term in subsection (a) of the first section of the Clayton Act (15 U.S.C. 12); and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HDE62B5748DEA4104828B04E513C88E77" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>includes section 5 of the Federal Trade Commission Act (15 U.S.C. 45) to the extent that such section applies to unfair methods of competition.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H1ACA7C1E40074759A5ECFAF96611B373" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Antitrust laws</inline>.—</heading><content>Nothing in this section shall be construed to limit the operation of any provision of the antitrust laws.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H44FF2B99B8D4427FAD9303173EC808CD" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">REMS Approval Process for Subsequent Filers</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Section 505–1 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355–1), as amended by subsection (d), is further amended—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HC8F9E3B67EED436F9DC829ADDF2EA84B" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><chapeau>in subsection (g)(4)(B)—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HD72C8BC5697A400BBED625C344A7190B" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>in clause (i) by striking “or” after the semicolon;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H7DA751AE10CC42BFA141C7E540D1D248" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>in clause (ii) by striking the period at the end and inserting “; or”; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H75EDE7BB853D492AA99B2ACF2A44ACC7" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>by adding at the end the following:
<quotedContent id="H03AEBADF7D6C48A49FA39FFD26F75110" styleType="OLC">
<clause id="HE40DC459E745429DBE4F7141C5903DA0" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><content>accommodate different, comparable aspects of the elements to assure safe use for a drug that is the subject of an application under section 505(j), and the applicable listed drug.”</content></clause></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">;</inline></content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H77C0E0422F6C4DF4A2F76F29C7614654" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>in subsection (i)(1), by striking subparagraph (C) and inserting the following:
<quotedContent id="HF577663BD5B64DF381A8D91BD062653F" styleType="OLC">
<subparagraph id="HCA3AE46419054F64A2C6992675EA228B" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C)</num><clause id="H00C6F58C766745BF83C5D247479C99E3" class="inline"><num value="i">(i) </num><chapeau>Elements to assure safe use, if required under subsection (f) for the listed drug, which, subject to clause (ii), for a drug that is the subject of an application under section 505(j) may use—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HF0415579DF164981BE7389BEF2A436A3" class="indent3"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>a single, shared system with the listed drug under subsection (f); or</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HA7F0779223FE4D8DA369D678666AECD5" class="indent3"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>a different, comparable aspect of the elements to assure safe use under subsection (f).</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="H133A2F93F5EE4833AB0B90910F593C65" class="indent2"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>The Secretary may require a drug that is the subject of an application under section 505(j) and the listed drug to use a single, shared system under subsection (f), if the Secretary determines that no different, comparable aspect of the elements to assure safe use could satisfy the requirements of subsection (f).”</content></clause></subparagraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">; </inline></content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H61F331E5F7534E659BB76C41A7708822" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>in subsection (i), by adding at the end the following:
<quotedContent id="H3AD3AC5FCAF84E9998FBF1A776AA899A" styleType="OLC">
<paragraph id="HAD33F200DE9F4F3C8965575D3DDCAAEB" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Shared rems</inline>.—</heading><content>If the Secretary approves, in accordance with paragraph (1)(C)(i)(II), a different, comparable aspect of the elements to assure safe use under subsection (f) for a drug that is the subject of an abbreviated new drug application under section 505(j), the Secretary may require that such different comparable aspect of the elements to assure safe use can be used with respect to any other drug that is the subject of an application under section 505(j) or 505(b) that references the same listed drug.”</content></paragraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">; and</inline></content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H99BC78A7246E4477A76D3D67D02F8DF4" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>by adding at the end the following:
<quotedContent id="H71DDE7844F764AD3995ABF2BFC458130" styleType="OLC">
<subsection id="H25E9316064354D5096500F7E4F0AEB07" class="indent0"><num value="m">“(m) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Separate REMS</inline>.—</heading><content>When used in this section, the term ‘different, comparable aspect of the elements to assure safe use’ means a risk evaluation and mitigation strategy for a drug that is the subject of an application under section 505(j) that uses different methods or operational means than the strategy required under subsection (a) for the applicable listed drug, or other application under section 505(j) with the same such listed drug, but achieves the same level of safety as such strategy.”</content></subsection></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H29A9EE3A6CA046B8BE6A7B800CCECCD9" class="indent0"><num value="g">(g) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Rule of Construction</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Nothing in this section, the amendments made by this section, or in section 505–1 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355–1), shall be construed as—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HD252FB925F7C41FAAA60F39A57DABA9B" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>prohibiting a license holder from providing an eligible product developer access to a covered product in the absence of an authorization under this section; or</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H961B4C0415C44C6DA8A74A5E92707358" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>in any way negating the applicability of a REMS with ETASU, as otherwise required under such section 505–1, with respect to such covered product.</content></paragraph></subsection></section></subtitle></title></division>

<title id="HF0E72F2E88AF486E9E663F2DDB163871" styleType="OLC"><num value="I">TITLE I—</num><heading class="inline">EXPANDING AND PRESERVING RETIREMENT SAVINGS</heading>
<section id="H3BAA5981B4AD4EC9840D154898528640" styleType="OLC"><num value="101">SEC. 101. </num><heading>MULTIPLE EMPLOYER PLANS; POOLED EMPLOYER PLANS.</heading>
<subsection id="H24178F6F21CB418298A0E5A074192671" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Qualification Requirements</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HAA1F45AAE7BE42DFAF4D36377A7FBCE0" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 413 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection:
<quotedContent id="H13AB6261DC1C4447A4DC99B47D4B9A7D" styleType="OLC">
<subsection id="H8CEFA8A2A8334CE1ACBE2B590A4ABE5C" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Application of Qualification Requirements for Certain Multiple Employer Plans With Pooled Plan Providers</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HAD48C40B689446D8AC4596128726FDE0" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Except as provided in paragraph (2), if a defined contribution plan to which subsection (c) applies—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H5CA98BB792AE438FA2CD3ED8B806BE9D" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>is maintained by employers which have a common interest other than having adopted the plan, or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H953D8E9535D04F47A18A26C890CC49B6" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>in the case of a plan not described in subparagraph (A), has a pooled plan provider,</content></subparagraph>
<continuation class="indent0" role="paragraph">then the plan shall not be treated as failing to meet the requirements under this title applicable to a plan described in section 401(a) or to a plan that consists of individual retirement accounts described in section 408 (including by reason of subsection (c) thereof), whichever is applicable, merely because one or more employers of employees covered by the plan fail to take such actions as are required of such employers for the plan to meet such requirements.</continuation></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HB61478577D894A14BDB6099268AB2A08" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitations</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="HCEC07F5F673348C6AE965EB67ED02F23" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Paragraph (1) shall not apply to any plan unless the terms of the plan provide that in the case of any employer in the plan failing to take the actions described in paragraph (1)—</chapeau>
<clause id="HE8416335B53A4522A2BC148CE6F3229C" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>the assets of the plan attributable to employees of such employer (or beneficiaries of such employees) will be transferred to a plan maintained only by such employer (or its successor), to an eligible retirement plan as defined in section 402(c)(8)(B) for each individual whose account is transferred, or to any other arrangement that the Secretary determines is appropriate, unless the Secretary determines it is in the best interests of the employees of such employer (and the beneficiaries of such employees) to retain the assets in the plan, and</content></clause>
<clause id="HA06382D4B64F4E9C8CB126ACE3AE90FE" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>such employer (and not the plan with respect to which the failure occurred or any other employer in such plan) shall, except to the extent provided by the Secretary, be liable for any liabilities with respect to such plan attributable to employees of such employer (or beneficiaries of such employees).</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H75711953C59B482189B4700E8F2970FD" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Failures by pooled plan providers</inline>.—</heading><content>If the pooled plan provider of a plan described in paragraph (1)(B) does not perform substantially all of the administrative duties which are required of the provider under paragraph (3)(A)(i) for any plan year, the Secretary may provide that the determination as to whether the plan meets the requirements under this title applicable to a plan described in section 401(a) or to a plan that consists of individual retirement accounts described in section 408 (including by reason of subsection (c) thereof), whichever is applicable, shall be made in the same manner as would be made without regard to paragraph (1).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HB6A006BE426A4F07B626D3E8392C80ED" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Pooled plan provider</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="H84A0C176982849CD92B5412B068150CF" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of this subsection, the term ‘<term>pooled plan provider</term>’ means, with respect to any plan, a person who—</chapeau>
<clause id="H7C9B7E74EEFF44DB980087460FA9F3A6" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><chapeau>is designated by the terms of the plan as a named fiduciary (within the meaning of section 402(a)(2) of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974), as the plan administrator, and as the person responsible to perform all administrative duties (including conducting proper testing with respect to the plan and the employees of each employer in the plan) which are reasonably necessary to ensure that—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HF58735ACCFC84DE1B057C50ABF79892D" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>the plan meets any requirement applicable under the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 or this title to a plan described in section 401(a) or to a plan that consists of individual retirement accounts described in section 408 (including by reason of subsection (c) thereof), whichever is applicable, and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HBFC59A000AC9489F8AF65E8DD4D3AB8F" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>each employer in the plan takes such actions as the Secretary or such person determines are necessary for the plan to meet the requirements described in subclause (I), including providing to such person any disclosures or other information which the Secretary may require or which such person otherwise determines are necessary to administer the plan or to allow the plan to meet such requirements,</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="HF5E4795E4DD843B68459B66FA4A707D4" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>registers as a pooled plan provider with the Secretary, and provides such other information to the Secretary as the Secretary may require, before beginning operations as a pooled plan provider,</content></clause>
<clause id="HA9DAF05E45154B2D996395CC0D3CDC4F" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><content>acknowledges in writing that such person is a named fiduciary (within the meaning of section 402(a)(2) of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974), and the plan administrator, with respect to the plan, and</content></clause>
<clause id="H059016F4C9DE40F7BEB1AB1161F1BA1C" class="indent3"><num value="iv">“(iv) </num><content>is responsible for ensuring that all persons who handle assets of, or who are fiduciaries of, the plan are bonded in accordance with section 412 of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HAF60209CDA9642ACB60EA886B02469D8" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Audits, examinations and investigations</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary may perform audits, examinations, and investigations of pooled plan providers as may be necessary to enforce and carry out the purposes of this subsection.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC783738F138845A89B3CE24C0D0E28B3" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Aggregation rules</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of this paragraph, in determining whether a person meets the requirements of this paragraph to be a pooled plan provider with respect to any plan, all persons who perform services for the plan and who are treated as a single employer under subsection (b), (c), (m), or (o) of section 414 shall be treated as one person.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H5402CC0B280542E78FD15CC4FB191B81" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment of employers as plan sponsors</inline>.—</heading><content>Except with respect to the administrative duties of the pooled plan provider described in subparagraph (A)(i), each employer in a plan which has a pooled plan provider shall be treated as the plan sponsor with respect to the portion of the plan attributable to employees of such employer (or beneficiaries of such employees).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HFC7FE3BF213747F2B43DF5368C33C4D8" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Guidance</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H11E4B72BCDE948698883A02B0B96D1B0" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Secretary shall issue such guidance as the Secretary determines appropriate to carry out this subsection, including guidance—</chapeau>
<clause id="H7ECD865C10894D639B817E6660F3A697" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>to identify the administrative duties and other actions required to be performed by a pooled plan provider under this subsection,</content></clause>
<clause id="HD70F53FD38644F6B964280406A294E9A" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>which describes the procedures to be taken to terminate a plan which fails to meet the requirements to be a plan described in paragraph (1), including the proper treatment of, and actions needed to be taken by, any employer in the plan and the assets and liabilities of the plan attributable to employees of such employer (or beneficiaries of such employees), and</content></clause>
<clause id="H7AC11654D3444AB3B1B02B6CCF902524" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><content>identifying appropriate cases to which the rules of paragraph (2)(A) will apply to employers in the plan failing to take the actions described in paragraph (1).</content></clause>
<continuation class="indent0" role="subparagraph">The Secretary shall take into account under clause (iii) whether the failure of an employer or pooled plan provider to provide any disclosures or other information, or to take any other action, necessary to administer a plan or to allow a plan to meet requirements applicable to the plan under section 401(a) or 408, whichever is applicable, has continued over a period of time that demonstrates a lack of commitment to compliance.</continuation></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H4089DA5DBCC542888C339CB813694DB3" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Good faith compliance with law before guidance</inline>.—</heading><content>An employer or pooled plan provider shall not be treated as failing to meet a requirement of guidance issued by the Secretary under this paragraph if, before the issuance of such guidance, the employer or pooled plan provider complies in good faith with a reasonable interpretation of the provisions of this subsection to which such guidance relates.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HD5EEEEA6CBDD4311B994ABA75889AA23" class="indent1"><num value="5">“(5) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Model plan</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary shall publish model plan language which meets the requirements of this subsection and of paragraphs (43) and (44) of section 3 of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 and which may be adopted in order for a plan to be treated as a plan described in paragraph (1)(B).”</content></paragraph></subsection></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H83DBE4A2FBB24F0E8018642449778B8F" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Conforming amendment</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 413(c)(2) of such Code is amended by striking “section 401(a)” and inserting “sections 401(a) and 408(c)”.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H8A3978415B6248DF92A06B30D62901E5" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Technical amendment</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 408(c) of such Code is amended by inserting after paragraph (2) the following new paragraph:
<quotedContent id="H27C701E763DC4A27916B96F8D29BEF3B" styleType="OLC">
<paragraph id="HBED1442B80EC46D9B571589B286E46BF" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><content>There is a separate accounting for any interest of an employee or member (or spouse of an employee or member) in a Roth IRA.”</content></paragraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HBB87D6723D734A348293081EA3BBE002" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No Common Interest Required for Pooled Employer Plans</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 3(2) of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (29 U.S.C. 1002(2)) is amended by adding at the end the following:
<quotedContent id="H0FCA86E4392E46FE8CFFF2EC0398BF4E" styleType="OLC">
<subparagraph id="H5886F7FC64CB4FD89822E03BDDFE77E7" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><chapeau>A pooled employer plan shall be treated as—</chapeau>
<clause id="H4D92FFD5E50245EAB89B17CB1B79318C" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>a single employee pension benefit plan or single pension plan; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H17864D7E0E3E40A48075852C335AEE9A" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>a plan to which section 210(a) applies.”</content></clause></subparagraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection>
<subsection id="HD62BC7A3EDA24517867A1FAFB3665416" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Pooled Employer Plan and Provider Defined</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H22BE032740A6400FAEFE9F0F3E950426" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 3 of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (29 U.S.C. 1002) is amended by adding at the end the following:
<quotedContent id="HB9B3DBB1711748AD889062945B78BA78" styleType="OLC">
<paragraph id="HE681BD311F79473494960FD081C2A7FB" class="indent1"><num value="43">“(43) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Pooled employer plan</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="H06FA7C7CADD549FEA03B9BF79A133AC9" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The term ‘<term>pooled employer plan</term>’ means a plan—</chapeau>
<clause id="HB43C7055D7A04B608C71686A7A1E3CA5" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>which is an individual account plan established or maintained for the purpose of providing benefits to the employees of 2 or more employers;</content></clause>
<clause id="HE3ABAAEB16804D90AD0AC5CC0E2491C6" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>which is a plan described in section 401(a) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 which includes a trust exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such Code or a plan that consists of individual retirement accounts described in section 408 of such Code (including by reason of subsection (c) thereof); and</content></clause>
<clause id="H4AAF76E9B8DE4712B95197AD90FC7CE5" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><content>the terms of which meet the requirements of subparagraph (B).</content></clause>
<continuation class="indent0" role="subparagraph">Such term shall not include a plan maintained by employers which have a common interest other than having adopted the plan.</continuation></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HAF7FBF5FE31A4BFCAEBBB774FAC5DE94" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Requirements for plan terms</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The requirements of this subparagraph are met with respect to any plan if the terms of the plan—</chapeau>
<clause id="H5001BBE3E72444FA970E6EC0333B6094" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>designate a pooled plan provider and provide that the pooled plan provider is a named fiduciary of the plan;</content></clause>
<clause id="HC1028A06314944348F420C3C5148487B" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>designate one or more trustees meeting the requirements of section 408(a)(2) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (other than an employer in the plan) to be responsible for collecting contributions to, and holding the assets of, the plan and require such trustees to implement written contribution collection procedures that are reasonable, diligent, and systematic;</content></clause>
<clause id="HBCC7EDD4D2DB492682001654B7B14E03" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><chapeau>provide that each employer in the plan retains fiduciary responsibility for—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HA73A77EC02EB4A60BEA69F699027A51A" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>the selection and monitoring in accordance with section 404(a) of the person designated as the pooled plan provider and any other person who, in addition to the pooled plan provider, is designated as a named fiduciary of the plan; and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HF9DE89A0D1C2408694E2B748DEA4604D" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>to the extent not otherwise delegated to another fiduciary by the pooled plan provider and subject to the provisions of section 404(c), the investment and management of the portion of the plan’s assets attributable to the employees of the employer (or beneficiaries of such employees);</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="H02E52E01BAE24FCC8E3D7D252968A717" class="indent3"><num value="iv">“(iv) </num><content>provide that employers in the plan, and participants and beneficiaries, are not subject to unreasonable restrictions, fees, or penalties with regard to ceasing participation, receipt of distributions, or otherwise transferring assets of the plan in accordance with section 208 or paragraph (44)(C)(i)(II);</content></clause>
<clause id="H88C2818CD03F4CE78ADB6F8E2CEA7F26" class="indent3"><num value="v">“(v) </num><chapeau>require—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H33AE91FEA94F4B398F4C2358CC8223E8" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>the pooled plan provider to provide to employers in the plan any disclosures or other information which the Secretary may require, including any disclosures or other information to facilitate the selection or any monitoring of the pooled plan provider by employers in the plan; and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H7F096ADC21F5487DBA66C1FDAC72280A" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>each employer in the plan to take such actions as the Secretary or the pooled plan provider determines are necessary to administer the plan or for the plan to meet any requirement applicable under this Act or the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to a plan described in section 401(a) of such Code or to a plan that consists of individual retirement accounts described in section 408 of such Code (including by reason of subsection (c) thereof), whichever is applicable, including providing any disclosures or other information which the Secretary may require or which the pooled plan provider otherwise determines are necessary to administer the plan or to allow the plan to meet such requirements; and</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="HE257DF1267064512B35D2B3E2597AF60" class="indent3"><num value="vi">“(vi) </num><content>provide that any disclosure or other information required to be provided under clause (v) may be provided in electronic form and will be designed to ensure only reasonable costs are imposed on pooled plan providers and employers in the plan.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="HAB0C932FCC07496EBF924CC851859013" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exceptions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The term ‘<term>pooled employer plan</term>’ does not include—</chapeau>
<clause id="H13BC894289EF4ED48B644B231F655E60" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>a multiemployer plan; or</content></clause>
<clause id="HD2CCC03EDF28408B969C7B5E7CBCBCAA" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>a plan established before the date of the enactment of the Setting Every Community Up for Retirement Enhancement Act of 2019 unless the plan administrator elects that the plan will be treated as a pooled employer plan and the plan meets the requirements of this title applicable to a pooled employer plan established on or after such date.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1CA955D649254069886A1D4ADD127A8D" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment of employers as plan sponsors</inline>.—</heading><content>Except with respect to the administrative duties of the pooled plan provider described in paragraph (44)(A)(i), each employer in a pooled employer plan shall be treated as the plan sponsor with respect to the portion of the plan attributable to employees of such employer (or beneficiaries of such employees).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF421A08488F04E58BD0D6DA075196BAA" class="indent1"><num value="44">“(44) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Pooled plan provider</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="HF391641C79794AD780B01F3F5D5199CA" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The term ‘<term>pooled plan provider</term>’ means a person who—</chapeau>
<clause id="H670850DA99E74C4AB3F7044A24FFF1A6" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><chapeau>is designated by the terms of a pooled employer plan as a named fiduciary, as the plan administrator, and as the person responsible for the performance of all administrative duties (including conducting proper testing with respect to the plan and the employees of each employer in the plan) which are reasonably necessary to ensure that—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H6BDD4BE82F81437395A4AB0DC6B63C97" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>the plan meets any requirement applicable under this Act or the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to a plan described in section 401(a) of such Code or to a plan that consists of individual retirement accounts described in section 408 of such Code (including by reason of subsection (c) thereof), whichever is applicable; and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H827222738E0C45EBA6151553D49F2A76" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>each employer in the plan takes such actions as the Secretary or pooled plan provider determines are necessary for the plan to meet the requirements described in subclause (I), including providing the disclosures and information described in paragraph (43)(B)(v)(II);</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="HFBC8D07EBEF54C669AA316ECCFB507A7" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>registers as a pooled plan provider with the Secretary, and provides to the Secretary such other information as the Secretary may require, before beginning operations as a pooled plan provider;</content></clause>
<clause id="HDE3160EFE30849A68CA3358929B4B13D" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><content>acknowledges in writing that such person is a named fiduciary, and the plan administrator, with respect to the pooled employer plan; and</content></clause>
<clause id="HC178544E0B074F16B22D7AF8AC00AC86" class="indent3"><num value="iv">“(iv) </num><content>is responsible for ensuring that all persons who handle assets of, or who are fiduciaries of, the pooled employer plan are bonded in accordance with section 412.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD00EFFE7895F44B1BEF075A35E86B51A" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Audits, examinations and investigations</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary may perform audits, examinations, and investigations of pooled plan providers as may be necessary to enforce and carry out the purposes of this paragraph and paragraph (43).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H0DE3545449C14AFFA913635F65CD898A" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Guidance</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Secretary shall issue such guidance as the Secretary determines appropriate to carry out this paragraph and paragraph (43), including guidance—</chapeau>
<clause id="HD04A741A12E149E099F9529EE2B10872" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>to identify the administrative duties and other actions required to be performed by a pooled plan provider under either such paragraph; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H9EDDCCC121184E5087BD5D4E4572CE40" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><chapeau>which requires in appropriate cases that if an employer in the plan fails to take the actions required under subparagraph (A)(i)(II)—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HFFBF4EED1E1444538A14D4CFAF6E123D" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>the assets of the plan attributable to employees of such employer (or beneficiaries of such employees) are transferred to a plan maintained only by such employer (or its successor), to an eligible retirement plan as defined in section 402(c)(8)(B) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 for each individual whose account is transferred, or to any other arrangement that the Secretary determines is appropriate in such guidance; and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HFF38BBF9540644E1A7E37E9069D59191" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>such employer (and not the plan with respect to which the failure occurred or any other employer in such plan) shall, except to the extent provided in such guidance, be liable for any liabilities with respect to such plan attributable to employees of such employer (or beneficiaries of such employees).</content></subclause>
<continuation class="indent0" role="clause">The Secretary shall take into account under clause (ii) whether the failure of an employer or pooled plan provider to provide any disclosures or other information, or to take any other action, necessary to administer a plan or to allow a plan to meet requirements described in subparagraph (A)(i)(II) has continued over a period of time that demonstrates a lack of commitment to compliance. The Secretary may waive the requirements of subclause (ii)(I) in appropriate circumstances if the Secretary determines it is in the best interests of the employees of the employer referred to in such clause (and the beneficiaries of such employees) to retain the assets in the plan with respect to which the employer’s failure occurred.</continuation></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H408A4192B5404DF89C2882CF5284FAF4" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Good faith compliance with law before guidance</inline>.—</heading><content>An employer or pooled plan provider shall not be treated as failing to meet a requirement of guidance issued by the Secretary under subparagraph (C) if, before the issuance of such guidance, the employer or pooled plan provider complies in good faith with a reasonable interpretation of the provisions of this paragraph, or paragraph (43), to which such guidance relates.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HFA26D41244924C029686E8A4FABE5B46" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Aggregation rules</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of this paragraph, in determining whether a person meets the requirements of this paragraph to be a pooled plan provider with respect to any plan, all persons who perform services for the plan and who are treated as a single employer under subsection (b), (c), (m), or (o) of section 414 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 shall be treated as one person.”</content></subparagraph></paragraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph>

<section id="H5F9900D79DE544FFBEA9E7DEC43EB735" styleType="OLC"><num value="110">SEC. 110. </num><heading>TREATMENT OF CUSTODIAL ACCOUNTS ON TERMINATION OF SECTION 403(b) PLANS.</heading><content class="block">Not later than six months after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary of the Treasury shall issue guidance to provide that, if an employer terminates the plan under which amounts are contributed to a custodial account under subparagraph (A) of section 403(b)(7), the plan administrator or custodian may distribute an individual custodial account in kind to a participant or beneficiary of the plan and the distributed custodial account shall be maintained by the custodian on a tax-deferred basis as a section 403(b)(7) custodial account, similar to the treatment of fully-paid individual annuity contracts under Revenue Ruling 2011–7, until amounts are actually paid to the participant or beneficiary. The guidance shall provide further (i) that the section 403(b)(7) status of the distributed custodial account is generally maintained if the custodial account thereafter adheres to the requirements of section 403(b) that are in effect at the time of the distribution of the account and (ii) that a custodial account would not be considered distributed to the participant or beneficiary if the employer has any material retained rights under the account (but the employer would not be treated as retaining material rights simply because the custodial account was originally opened under a group contract). Such guidance shall be retroactively effective for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2008.</content></section>

<section id="H7B040AD379014485B73CC47F8F3A4AD6" styleType="OLC"><num value="112">SEC. 112. </num><heading>QUALIFIED CASH OR DEFERRED ARRANGEMENTS MUST ALLOW LONG-TERM EMPLOYEES WORKING MORE THAN 500 BUT LESS THAN 1,000 HOURS PER YEAR TO PARTICIPATE.</heading>
<subsection id="H56C36748799A4BE0B14D5B0BB8BD7CB4" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Participation Requirement</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H6F009F08F84F4E4FAD3942EB35489A2F" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 401(k)(2)(D) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended to read as follows:
<quotedContent id="H65029A1AF25041CA8CAFC55D11F6F260" styleType="OLC">
<subparagraph id="H70A1ACCF32E845FDA508AB31D8E8F9C3" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><chapeau>which does not require, as a condition of participation in the arrangement, that an employee complete a period of service with the employer (or employers) maintaining the plan extending beyond the close of the earlier of—</chapeau>
<clause id="HFD32793C12804A43AE01447F1F6F9EFA" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>the period permitted under section 410(a)(1) (determined without regard to subparagraph (B)(i) thereof), or</content></clause>
<clause id="HDB613D5CA9BF4B22ACA7585C3F2E58A7" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>subject to the provisions of paragraph (15), the first period of 3 consecutive 12-month periods during each of which the employee has at least 500 hours of service.”</content></clause></subparagraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H0032D8388AF047158BBB613B2D8894AB" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special rules</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 401(k) of such Code is amended by adding at the end the following new paragraph:

<subparagraph id="H90AB27812CAE4D208D5DD5328CF495E5" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Age requirement must be met</inline>.—</heading><content>Paragraph (2)(D)(ii) shall not apply to an employee unless the employee has met the requirement of section 410(a)(1)(A)(i) by the close of the last of the 12-month periods described in such paragraph.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H73BE19D758E3470CB1A2E0034F0ED784" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Nondiscrimination and top-heavy rules not to apply</inline>.—</heading>

<subclause id="H1C90EC5CE5004A5C936115FDE54287A0" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>notwithstanding subsection (a)(4), an employer shall not be required to make nonelective or matching contributions on behalf of such employees even if such contributions are made on behalf of other employees eligible to participate in the arrangement, and</content></subclause>

<clause id="H005B2CF2384B4ED1AB4DE7AC9391E8BB" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Top-heavy rules</inline>.—</heading><content>An employer may elect to exclude all employees who are eligible to participate in a plan maintained by the employer solely by reason of paragraph (2)(D)(ii) from the application of the vesting and benefit requirements under subsections (b) and (c) of section 416.</content></clause>
<clause id="H3BA2A4B42A194C298F492E18AC755E3F" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Vesting</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of determining whether an employee described in clause (i) has a nonforfeitable right to employer contributions (other than contributions described in paragraph (3)(D)(i)) under the arrangement, each 12-month period for which the employee has at least 500 hours of service shall be treated as a year of service, and section 411(a)(6) shall be applied by substituting ‘at least 500 hours of service’ for ‘more than 500 hours of service’ in subparagraph (A) thereof.</content></clause>
<clause id="HA9F460B638074C21A8D336C3BC6A4A0C" class="indent3"><num value="iv">“(iv) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Employees who become full-time employees</inline>.—</heading><content>This subparagraph (other than clause (iii)) shall cease to apply to any employee as of the first plan year beginning after the plan year in which the employee meets the requirements of section 410(a)(1)(A)(ii) without regard to paragraph (2)(D)(ii).</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H67CFDD6001D246888B407FEF56E4B514" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exception for employees under collectively bargained plans, etc</inline>.—</heading><content>Paragraph (2)(D)(ii) shall not apply to employees described in section 410(b)(3).</content></subparagraph>

<section id="H60082C671A3E4C5E9D5D59C91CB0CEB8" styleType="OLC"><num value="113">SEC. 113. </num><heading>PENALTY-FREE WITHDRAWALS FROM RETIREMENT PLANS FOR INDIVIDUALS IN CASE OF BIRTH OF CHILD OR ADOPTION.</heading>
<subsection id="HD61BCC38156A42519E93AA5B1C6A8C40" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 72(t)(2) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:
<quotedContent id="H4A81C286049B4B31860E1A09CC44AE35" styleType="OLC">
<subparagraph id="H046B4BC6AFC7456BA16BDDF20DA0E116" class="indent2"><num value="H">“(H) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Distributions from retirement plans in case of birth of child or adoption</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="H575F08E10972424997294E506BB58F9E" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>Any qualified birth or adoption distribution.</content></clause>
<clause id="H95F81E305CBE49B4BAE99EC71053E1B9" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation</inline>.—</heading><content>The aggregate amount which may be treated as qualified birth or adoption distributions by any individual with respect to any birth or adoption shall not exceed $5,000.</content></clause>
<clause id="H93A2B49A49A04B14AA86EA27E8DE09BD" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Qualified birth or adoption distribution</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of this subparagraph—</chapeau>
<subclause role="definitions" id="H63C4F978120C4E26B055526C9109B3F3" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>The term ‘<term>qualified birth or adoption distribution</term>’ means any distribution from an applicable eligible retirement plan to an individual if made during the 1-year period beginning on the date on which a child of the individual is born or on which the legal adoption by the individual of an eligible adoptee is finalized.</content></subclause>
<subclause role="definitions" id="HCC7088A242594D869FEF4D0779F6C666" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Eligible adoptee</inline>.—</heading><content>The term ‘<term>eligible adoptee</term>’ means any individual (other than a child of the taxpayer’s spouse) who has not attained age 18 or is physically or mentally incapable of self-support.</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="HCE241BFC5C5648DB9B46BEFB7A5E34CA" class="indent3"><num value="iv">“(iv) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment of plan distributions</inline>.—</heading>
<subclause id="H2F51F4FE3B6D41B98CE0337839FD9411" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>If a distribution to an individual would (without regard to clause (ii)) be a qualified birth or adoption distribution, a plan shall not be treated as failing to meet any requirement of this title merely because the plan treats the distribution as a qualified birth or adoption distribution, unless the aggregate amount of such distributions from all plans maintained by the employer (and any member of any controlled group which includes the employer) to such individual exceeds $5,000.</content></subclause>
<subclause role="definitions" id="H2E33AD83C4A5416BBE68B38A18216E7B" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Controlled group</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of subclause (I), the term ‘<term>controlled group</term>’ means any group treated as a single employer under subsection (b), (c), (m), or (o) of section 414.</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="H0F06B688EE0B4304BF6120AC555B9CD0" class="indent3"><num value="v">“(v) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Amount distributed may be repaid</inline>.—</heading>
<subclause id="HBFF48533069448AFBE2791408E327B3B" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>Any individual who receives a qualified birth or adoption distribution may make one or more contributions in an aggregate amount not to exceed the amount of such distribution to an applicable eligible retirement plan of which such individual is a beneficiary and to which a rollover contribution of such distribution could be made under section 402(c), 403(a)(4), 403(b)(8), 408(d)(3), or 457(e)(16), as the case may be.</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H4C65B53A3B794D8EB11F80A177220FF4" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation on contributions to applicable eligible retirement plans other than IRAs</inline>.—</heading><content>The aggregate amount of contributions made by an individual under subclause (I) to any applicable eligible retirement plan which is not an individual retirement plan shall not exceed the aggregate amount of qualified birth or adoption distributions which are made from such plan to such individual. Subclause (I) shall not apply to contributions to any applicable eligible retirement plan which is not an individual retirement plan unless the individual is eligible to make contributions (other than those described in subclause (I)) to such applicable eligible retirement plan.</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H5551D1C5F65A45889E8D32D1A3163319" class="indent4"><num value="III">“(III) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment of repayments of distributions from applicable eligible retirement plans other than IRAs</inline>.—</heading><content>If a contribution is made under subclause (I) with respect to a qualified birth or adoption distribution from an applicable eligible retirement plan other than an individual retirement plan, then the taxpayer shall, to the extent of the amount of the contribution, be treated as having received such distribution in an eligible rollover distribution (as defined in section 402(c)(4)) and as having transferred the amount to the applicable eligible retirement plan in a direct trustee to trustee transfer within 60 days of the distribution.</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HEBB2FBF0CDAC456EA74E086A1C97C837" class="indent4"><num value="IV">“(IV) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment of repayments for distributions from IRAs</inline>.—</heading><content>If a contribution is made under subclause (I) with respect to a qualified birth or adoption distribution from an individual retirement plan, then, to the extent of the amount of the contribution, such distribution shall be treated as a distribution described in section 408(d)(3) and as having been transferred to the applicable eligible retirement plan in a direct trustee to trustee transfer within 60 days of the distribution.</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="HF6DE175BE2284C999767AE6E5F3B46FE" class="indent3"><num value="vi">“(vi) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definition and special rules</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of this subparagraph—</chapeau>
<subclause role="definitions" id="HC4B74CBBC72F4D96939B3ABCC9447235" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Applicable eligible retirement plan</inline>.—</heading><content>The term ‘<term>applicable eligible retirement plan</term>’ means an eligible retirement plan (as defined in section 402(c)(8)(B)) other than a defined benefit plan.</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H45F3B20702DC4A97ABA82F8DFF90C3DF" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exemption of distributions from trustee to trustee transfer and withholding rules</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of sections 401(a)(31), 402(f), and 3405, a qualified birth or adoption distribution shall not be treated as an eligible rollover distribution.</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H4B0A83347F2B4AF0AE0152B863B9D39F" class="indent4"><num value="III">“(III) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Taxpayer must include tin</inline>.—</heading><content>A distribution shall not be treated as a qualified birth or adoption distribution with respect to any child or eligible adoptee unless the taxpayer includes the name, age, and TIN of such child or eligible adoptee on the taxpayer’s return of tax for the taxable year.</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HCA8C26D263D149BC91876B3B0E2ECB8F" class="indent4"><num value="IV">“(IV) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Distributions treated as meeting plan distribution requirements</inline>.—</heading><content>Any qualified birth or adoption distribution shall be treated as meeting the requirements of sections 401(k)(2)(B)(i), 403(b)(7)(A)(ii), 403(b)(11), and 457(d)(1)(A).”</content></subclause></clause></subparagraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection>
<subsection id="HD839790AF6674F01B87F1BACFA763947" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effective Date</inline>.—</heading><content>The amendments made by this section shall apply to distributions made after December 31, 2019.</content></subsection></section>
