<section id="HB935BFCAF48B40B7A2DDAE8FFF06E301" styleType="OLC"><num value="115">SEC. 115. </num><heading>SPECIAL RULES FOR MINIMUM FUNDING STANDARDS FOR COMMUNITY NEWSPAPER PLANS.</heading>
<subsection id="H3EABA27FA9554DFDAD51AD9534CE57FA" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Amendment to Internal Revenue Code of 1986</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 430 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection:
<quotedContent id="HFD475F9B99174AEF81FE4B64D76EBD4E" styleType="OLC">
<subsection id="HBAC6E29E323E497592946361B2F91D38" class="indent0"><num value="m">“(m) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special Rules for Community Newspaper Plans</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H1DCE604D99D841AFA67D8B7FDB974F47" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>The plan sponsor of a community newspaper plan under which no participant has had the participant’s accrued benefit increased (whether because of service or compensation) after December 31, 2017, may elect to have the alternative standards described in paragraph (3) apply to such plan, and any plan sponsored by any member of the same controlled group.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HB622DD2AD6AF461AAE9952A816876387" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Election</inline>.—</heading><content>An election under paragraph (1) shall be made at such time and in such manner as prescribed by the Secretary. Such election, once made with respect to a plan year, shall apply to all subsequent plan years unless revoked with the consent of the Secretary.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H73C425421BC44952ADA483E0EA6F72F5" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Alternative minimum funding standards</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The alternative standards described in this paragraph are the following:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H35CD4CF5FA1648F1BC06E2F7F8B4536A" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Interest rates</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="H38548524BA954F818D42348B776F1147" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding subsection (h)(2)(C) and except as provided in clause (ii), the first, second, and third segment rates in effect for any month for purposes of this section shall be 8 percent.</content></clause>
<clause id="HCD7FA2FABCC94D7EA73C40B8FFD47E98" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">New benefit accruals</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding subsection (h)(2), for purposes of determining the funding target and normal cost of a plan for any plan year, the present value of any benefits accrued or earned under the plan for a plan year with respect to which an election under paragraph (1) is in effect shall be determined on the basis of the United States Treasury obligation yield curve for the day that is the valuation date of such plan for such plan year.</content></clause>
<clause role="definitions" id="HB856008017BE4858846DC4B3910FEBBE" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">United states treasury obligation yield curve</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of this subsection, the term ‘<term>United States Treasury obligation yield curve</term>’ means, with respect to any day, a yield curve which shall be prescribed by the Secretary for such day on interest-bearing obligations of the United States.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1715CA04F9A846E1AD4752A05104AE43" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Shortfall amortization base</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="H1C60E924AC7F46598B9C5D60ED00A7B3" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Previous shortfall amortization bases</inline>.—</heading><content>The shortfall amortization bases determined under subsection (c)(3) for all plan years preceding the first plan year to which the election under paragraph (1) applies (and all shortfall amortization installments determined with respect to such bases) shall be reduced to zero under rules similar to the rules of subsection (c)(6).</content></clause>
<clause id="HEEC2369E328E4F5A8DDADC9116146DBA" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">New shortfall amortization base</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding subsection (c)(3), the shortfall amortization base for the first plan year to which the election under paragraph (1) applies shall be the funding shortfall of such plan for such plan year (determined using the interest rates as modified under subparagraph (A)).</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H6EBCB91A49B2495FB4F680A1B0F38CDB" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Determination of shortfall amortization installments</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="H9879841E1515440B930869AAC68A9E50" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">30-year period</inline>.—</heading><content>Subparagraphs (A) and (B) of subsection (c)(2) shall be applied by substituting ‘30-plan-year’ for ‘7-plan-year’ each place it appears.</content></clause>
<clause id="H4C3DF0E6F26142E6BE762156D0DA8524" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No special election</inline>.—</heading><content>The election under subparagraph (D) of subsection (c)(2) shall not apply to any plan year to which the election under paragraph (1) applies.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1269545EF8EB42E0965A7A1A62395F58" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exemption from at-risk treatment</inline>.—</heading><content>Subsection (i) shall not apply.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>

<section id="HE76544B0086246878B28066CEC7D4BAD" styleType="OLC"><num value="202">SEC. 202. </num><heading>COMBINED ANNUAL REPORT FOR GROUP OF PLANS.</heading>
<subsection id="HB6841661D3954F839C32552FE11E464B" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of the Treasury and the Secretary of Labor shall, in cooperation, modify the returns required under section 6058 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 and the reports required by section 104 of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (29 U.S.C. 1024) so that all members of a group of plans described in subsection (c) may file a single aggregated annual return or report satisfying the requirements of both such sections.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HA4CED7979D4540E3B774E84248E7244E" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Administrative Requirements</inline>.—</heading><content>In developing the consolidated return or report under subsection (a), the Secretary of the Treasury and the Secretary of Labor may require such return or report to include any information regarding each plan in the group as such Secretaries determine is necessary or appropriate for the enforcement and administration of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 and the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 and shall require such information as will enable a participant in a plan to identify any aggregated return or report filed with respect to the plan.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H585B97229007483FB6D2DDED86D7D09C" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Plans Described</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A group of plans is described in this subsection if all plans in the group—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HF8CE251647BD4BF2A75226705EC6C8DD" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>are individual account plans or defined contribution plans (as defined in section 3(34) of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (29 U.S.C. 1002(34)) or in section 414(i) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986);</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H1A5D58283F0E477ABAC2D4DB5EE1A4B3" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><chapeau>have—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H7EDC5E79162A41A1B9E9D6984D3B5B1A" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>the same trustee (as described in section 403(a) of such Act (29 U.S.C. 1103(a)));</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H4D7EC0802E7149EBACECD30085906602" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>the same one or more named fiduciaries (as described in section 402(a) of such Act (29 U.S.C. 1102(a)));</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H98DCEB45B8314D16A152D88E341BD386" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>the same administrator (as defined in section 3(16)(A) of such Act (29 U.S.C. 1002(16)(A))) and plan administrator (as defined in section 414(g) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986); and</content></subparagraph>

<section id="H6A30D7D562F9487AA638AEFAA637C5E1" styleType="OLC"><num value="203">SEC. 203. </num><heading>DISCLOSURE REGARDING LIFETIME INCOME.</heading>
<subsection id="H1CA4CA50BBB84F428CBDC93F1D0B6D3E" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Subparagraph (B) of section 105(a)(2) of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (29 U.S.C. 1025(a)(2)) is amended—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H8F160829AB9E462484D4BEDE4C5188ED" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>in clause (i), by striking “and” at the end;</content></paragraph>

<subsection id="H17ADC0FAFB914437AE9595CE1062F655" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Lifetime Income</inline>.—</heading><content>Paragraph (2) of section 105(a) of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (29 U.S.C. 1025(a)) is amended by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:
<quotedContent id="H18C2E26BD1D14030874430B5D73C770A" styleType="OLC">
<subparagraph id="HB000F486EEE4479FA0D365F417ACC3A9" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Lifetime income disclosure</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="HCD04BA008BA7462E9425A68EC0EBB073" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<subclause id="HF7FE4777A6754A97A8FBCE0672641656" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Disclosure</inline>.—</heading><content>A lifetime income disclosure shall set forth the lifetime income stream equivalent of the total benefits accrued with respect to the participant or beneficiary.</content></subclause>
<subclause role="definitions" id="H8B9F1E31D97046E181C6F2FFCCF409EB" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Lifetime income stream equivalent of the total benefits accrued</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of this subparagraph, the term ‘<term>lifetime income stream equivalent of the total benefits accrued</term>’ means the amount of monthly payments the participant or beneficiary would receive if the total accrued benefits of such participant or beneficiary were used to provide lifetime income streams described in subclause (III), based on assumptions specified in rules prescribed by the Secretary.</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HA7D6FA99A8A44B3F8E9465F86ECAE4CC" class="indent4"><num value="III">“(III) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Lifetime income streams</inline>.—</heading><content>The lifetime income streams described in this subclause are a qualified joint and survivor annuity (as defined in section 205(d)), based on assumptions specified in rules prescribed by the Secretary, including the assumption that the participant or beneficiary has a spouse of equal age, and a single life annuity. Such lifetime income streams may have a term certain or other features to the extent permitted under rules prescribed by the Secretary.</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="H4B93305BCE34461593631D00B58833E7" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Model disclosure</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Not later than 1 year after the date of the enactment of the Setting Every Community Up for Retirement Enhancement Act of 2019, the Secretary shall issue a model lifetime income disclosure, written in a manner so as to be understood by the average plan participant, which—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HC07E3EA6801F4DE3A297288953D3C081" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>explains that the lifetime income stream equivalent is only provided as an illustration;</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HBCD7A47859D84AEE8C3087F42BB7A546" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>explains that the actual payments under the lifetime income stream described in clause (i)(III) which may be purchased with the total benefits accrued will depend on numerous factors and may vary substantially from the lifetime income stream equivalent in the disclosures;</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HACE4BDDBC934468D9B65EAE97C47CCF0" class="indent4"><num value="III">“(III) </num><content>explains the assumptions upon which the lifetime income stream equivalent was determined; and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H43B17348CF054D0A80CB64803870511E" class="indent4"><num value="IV">“(IV) </num><content>provides such other similar explanations as the Secretary considers appropriate.</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="H122A9D0151204C0BB41E02C1349C7375" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Assumptions and rules</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Not later than 1 year after the date of the enactment of the Setting Every Community Up for Retirement Enhancement Act of 2019, the Secretary shall—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H782664A40C99444F8BE0F32A471B536F" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>prescribe assumptions which administrators of individual account plans may use in converting total accrued benefits into lifetime income stream equivalents for purposes of this subparagraph; and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HF5E00748DD414D6B8B55BD2B55289105" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>issue interim final rules under clause (i).</content></subclause>
<continuation class="indent0" role="clause">In prescribing assumptions under subclause (I), the Secretary may prescribe a single set of specific assumptions (in which case the Secretary may issue tables or factors which facilitate such conversions), or ranges of permissible assumptions. To the extent that an accrued benefit is or may be invested in a lifetime income stream described in clause (i)(III), the assumptions prescribed under subclause (I) shall, to the extent appropriate, permit administrators of individual account plans to use the amounts payable under such lifetime income stream as a lifetime income stream equivalent.</continuation></clause>
<clause id="H116884D9EDCF451B9F26052AF2D9D7B8" class="indent3"><num value="iv">“(iv) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation on liability</inline>.—</heading><content>No plan fiduciary, plan sponsor, or other person shall have any liability under this title solely by reason of the provision of lifetime income stream equivalents which are derived in accordance with the assumptions and rules described in clause (iii) and which include the explanations contained in the model lifetime income disclosure described in clause (ii). This clause shall apply without regard to whether the provision of such lifetime income stream equivalent is required by subparagraph (B)(iii).</content></clause>
<clause id="H45B83D4DC1834F49B40AF408AEEF0702" class="indent3"><num value="v">“(v) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effective date</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The requirement in subparagraph (B)(iii) shall apply to pension benefit statements furnished more than 12 months after the latest of the issuance by the Secretary of—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HDA075B9919874BDC90BC79C935099AB4" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>interim final rules under clause (i);</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H116FE5FE72AA49D7BCE6122D177285EE" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>the model disclosure under clause (ii); or</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H0360603A19BD41A18E4FC7F23458EAD8" class="indent4"><num value="III">“(III) </num><content>the assumptions under clause (iii).”</content></subclause></clause></subparagraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection></section>
<section id="H9A0BA7E680BB4C0BA319AF83A0E4DE2D" styleType="OLC"><num value="204">SEC. 204. </num><heading>FIDUCIARY SAFE HARBOR FOR SELECTION OF LIFETIME INCOME PROVIDER.</heading><content>Section 404 of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (29 U.S.C. 1104) is amended by adding at the end the following:
<quotedContent id="H1F51AED19EBB41D8B6DF3CA6B012FCE4" styleType="OLC">
<subsection id="H201C3CCD70A84760A4B3E03B98106991" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Safe Harbor for Annuity Selection</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H20FA1A6DC0C248A9A3C97B8A400DEB88" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>With respect to the selection of an insurer for a guaranteed retirement income contract, the requirements of subsection (a)(1)(B) will be deemed to be satisfied if a fiduciary—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HE113754930304BB8BD3AA0720F592093" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>engages in an objective, thorough, and analytical search for the purpose of identifying insurers from which to purchase such contracts;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H85935CF8DFAD4D9A92463954E92FED87" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><chapeau>with respect to each insurer identified under subparagraph (A)—</chapeau>
<clause id="HDD9341466D09492DBFCD85D0AC00F07B" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>considers the financial capability of such insurer to satisfy its obligations under the guaranteed retirement income contract; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H1A11DB438CB34DC8BBD8045268CF2230" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>considers the cost (including fees and commissions) of the guaranteed retirement income contract offered by the insurer in relation to the benefits and product features of the contract and administrative services to be provided under such contract; and</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HDA97276E4A8A4E24AF46C82913D2B774" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><chapeau>on the basis of such consideration, concludes that—</chapeau>
<clause id="H510D46A0B5D9460DB84059ADFF453EE3" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>at the time of the selection, the insurer is financially capable of satisfying its obligations under the guaranteed retirement income contract; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H23E9AAE3ABF94FD289A5D482EBC681C2" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>the relative cost of the selected guaranteed retirement income contract as described in subparagraph (B)(ii) is reasonable.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF53F7423EFBC46F99A7A125824997C9C" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Financial capability of the insurer</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A fiduciary will be deemed to satisfy the requirements of paragraphs (1)(B)(i) and (1)(C)(i) if—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H4417CE4509D945E59298A1586B1B30B1" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><chapeau>the fiduciary obtains written representations from the insurer that—</chapeau>
<clause id="HA657F8E462A34C5281AAEFC7BD9CAAC6" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>the insurer is licensed to offer guaranteed retirement income contracts;</content></clause>
<clause id="H48EE4CAE98BB4511A81687B6301E685B" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><chapeau>the insurer, at the time of selection and for each of the immediately preceding 7 plan years—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HBD1CABCA5D1C4C18BF34728281233E94" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>operates under a certificate of authority from the insurance commissioner of its domiciliary State which has not been revoked or suspended;</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H101F980E23704AB9B8870E185F2433DC" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>has filed audited financial statements in accordance with the laws of its domiciliary State under applicable statutory accounting principles;</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H7B2C3125AB5E4404B1D4BB856A3E5892" class="indent4"><num value="III">“(III) </num><content>maintains (and has maintained) reserves which satisfies all the statutory requirements of all States where the insurer does business; and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HC26BAB96C9E5480A86C0D53F910973EC" class="indent4"><num value="IV">“(IV) </num><content>is not operating under an order of supervision, rehabilitation, or liquidation;</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="HD3C6074B591D4511946A2D67121F1651" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><content>the insurer undergoes, at least every 5 years, a financial examination (within the meaning of the law of its domiciliary State) by the insurance commissioner of the domiciliary State (or representative, designee, or other party approved by such commissioner); and</content></clause>
<clause id="H9675B8F547CD46A9881894955383DDCA" class="indent3"><num value="iv">“(iv) </num><content>the insurer will notify the fiduciary of any change in circumstances occurring after the provision of the representations in clauses (i), (ii), and (iii) which would preclude the insurer from making such representations at the time of issuance of the guaranteed retirement income contract; and</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HEFDA89F3029C49FA9232F39E5E9D829E" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>after receiving such representations and as of the time of selection, the fiduciary has not received any notice described in subparagraph (A)(iv) and is in possession of no other information which would cause the fiduciary to question the representations provided.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC1BAF9F691F44520B416A62EDDE27A37" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No requirement to select lowest cost</inline>.—</heading><content>Nothing in this subsection shall be construed to require a fiduciary to select the lowest cost contract. A fiduciary may consider the value of a contract, including features and benefits of the contract and attributes of the insurer (including, without limitation, the insurer’s financial strength) in conjunction with the cost of the contract.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HD99BEF55A4E040218DF5F2449DD47AE0" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Time of selection</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H9B41143A6BC0487FAACDED416D267079" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of this subsection, the time of selection is—</chapeau>
<clause id="H660A902215584020A9EB45B4E13CBBD5" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>the time that the insurer and the contract are selected for distribution of benefits to a specific participant or beneficiary; or</content></clause>
<clause id="HA920D16EA29A491D8C0AD834494CAD67" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>if the fiduciary periodically reviews the continuing appropriateness of the conclusion described in paragraph (1)(C) with respect to a selected insurer, taking into account the considerations described in such paragraph, the time that the insurer and the contract are selected to provide benefits at future dates to participants or beneficiaries under the plan.</content></clause>
<continuation class="indent0" role="subparagraph">Nothing in the preceding sentence shall be construed to require the fiduciary to review the appropriateness of a selection after the purchase of a contract for a participant or beneficiary.</continuation></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB61DA418CFCF4EA3B4019FB6EF765BCB" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Periodic review</inline>.—</heading><content>A fiduciary will be deemed to have conducted the periodic review described in subparagraph (A)(ii) if the fiduciary obtains the written representations described in clauses (i), (ii), and (iii) of paragraph (2)(A) from the insurer on an annual basis, unless the fiduciary receives any notice described in paragraph (2)(A)(iv) or otherwise becomes aware of facts that would cause the fiduciary to question such representations.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H15FC7D0F47E94414AE9960A3D1BECEF3" class="indent1"><num value="5">“(5) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limited liability</inline>.—</heading><content>A fiduciary which satisfies the requirements of this subsection shall not be liable following the distribution of any benefit, or the investment by or on behalf of a participant or beneficiary pursuant to the selected guaranteed retirement income contract, for any losses that may result to the participant or beneficiary due to an insurer’s inability to satisfy its financial obligations under the terms of such contract.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H27ECED286F584D8DB53B21DB145F0C3B" class="indent1"><num value="6">“(6) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definitions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of this subsection—</chapeau>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="HDC38F30C0AA143EA92ABF01EC4281460" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Insurer</inline>.—</heading><content>The term ‘<term>insurer</term>’ means an insurance company, insurance service, or insurance organization, including affiliates of such companies.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="HCAC543D04D0A44559CF53E8D43086F25" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Guaranteed retirement income contract</inline>.—</heading><content>The term ‘<term>guaranteed retirement income contract</term>’ means an annuity contract for a fixed term or a contract (or provision or feature thereof) which provides guaranteed benefits annually (or more frequently) for at least the remainder of the life of the participant or the joint lives of the participant and the participant’s designated beneficiary as part of an individual account plan.”</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></section>
<section id="H5193955DEE9841709798CDE9C1AF151C" styleType="OLC"><num value="205">SEC. 205. </num><heading>MODIFICATION OF NONDISCRIMINATION RULES TO PROTECT OLDER, LONGER SERVICE PARTICIPANTS.</heading>
<subsection id="H61FA313F156C4542A1EAA4C7A3434257" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Section 401 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HC31B2A75D516471DB57698857771268B" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>by redesignating subsection (o) as subsection (p); and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HDB9CEEF6FE5340129207632EB957B973" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>by inserting after subsection (n) the following new subsection:
<quotedContent id="H7B7897F11FD8421EBBFBDB39EFC5F786" styleType="OLC">
<subsection id="H19BE9EFFF927434E8E02C16D16040AF5" class="indent0"><num value="o">“(o) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special Rules for Applying Nondiscrimination Rules to Protect Older, Longer Service and Grandfathered Participants</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H3D9C794A366C46C8B455FE45BCA9789F" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Testing of defined benefit plans with closed classes of participants</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="HEB309635386A4657A2BB553031006534" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Benefits, rights, or features provided to closed classes</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A defined benefit plan which provides benefits, rights, or features to a closed class of participants shall not fail to satisfy the requirements of subsection (a)(4) by reason of the composition of such closed class or the benefits, rights, or features provided to such closed class, if—</chapeau>
<clause id="H89062B204D9B4CE39A4F878829285A11" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>for the plan year as of which the class closes and the 2 succeeding plan years, such benefits, rights, and features satisfy the requirements of subsection (a)(4) (without regard to this subparagraph but taking into account the rules of subparagraph (I)),</content></clause>
<clause id="HD81DE2283D594FA291399FEC680EC245" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>after the date as of which the class was closed, any plan amendment which modifies the closed class or the benefits, rights, and features provided to such closed class does not discriminate significantly in favor of highly compensated employees, and</content></clause>
<clause id="H02982ADD786F43C6A8AFC896B7CE03EE" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><content>the class was closed before April 5, 2017, or the plan is described in subparagraph (C).</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD6122F4D4562493F921A921FA1CDADD1" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Aggregate testing with defined contribution plans permitted on a benefits basis</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="H1C7C35083FF34E1BBE2BAE3312AAF13A" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of determining compliance with subsection (a)(4) and section 410(b), a defined benefit plan described in clause (iii) may be aggregated and tested on a benefits basis with 1 or more defined contribution plans, including with the portion of 1 or more defined contribution plans which—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H3D06552C843145E19808D2D259376EA2" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>provides matching contributions (as defined in subsection (m)(4)(A)),</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H71F40149EA8F4FBFB9975A581175C22F" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>provides annuity contracts described in section 403(b) which are purchased with matching contributions or nonelective contributions, or</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HBD091C1286DB4275936710CC6A3F3E15" class="indent4"><num value="III">“(III) </num><content>consists of an employee stock ownership plan (within the meaning of section 4975(e)(7)) or a tax credit employee stock ownership plan (within the meaning of section 409(a)).</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="H52BBBB7768FE4453B6CF6DC496375268" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special rules for matching contributions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of clause (i), if a defined benefit plan is aggregated with a portion of a defined contribution plan providing matching contributions—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H39C7473163264A7383176305EB1FC7DD" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>such defined benefit plan must also be aggregated with any portion of such defined contribution plan which provides elective deferrals described in subparagraph (A) or (C) of section 402(g)(3), and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H11E98BC0DEE9492D8654AD1E672BFB08" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>such matching contributions shall be treated in the same manner as nonelective contributions, including for purposes of applying the rules of subsection (l).</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="HEC936A6F26B34B3AA5CEDAEB0E7837A0" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Plans described</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A defined benefit plan is described in this clause if—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H9A2EDD92844D442094F6652F473A502E" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>the plan provides benefits to a closed class of participants,</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H6B4D43229BB4415687191DA368B26B47" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>for the plan year as of which the class closes and the 2 succeeding plan years, the plan satisfies the requirements of section 410(b) and subsection (a)(4) (without regard to this subparagraph but taking into account the rules of subparagraph (I)),</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H425C77AD41E944F194958F569652AD0C" class="indent4"><num value="III">“(III) </num><content>after the date as of which the class was closed, any plan amendment which modifies the closed class or the benefits provided to such closed class does not discriminate significantly in favor of highly compensated employees, and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HB7903D5DEA6D466EB11B916234D95E32" class="indent4"><num value="IV">“(IV) </num><content>the class was closed before April 5, 2017, or the plan is described in subparagraph (C).</content></subclause></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H844C2815706440ACB401501449CBDCF0" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Plans described</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A plan is described in this subparagraph if, taking into account any predecessor plan—</chapeau>
<clause id="HA193B70C208540FD831BB3A59DBC0A47" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>such plan has been in effect for at least 5 years as of the date the class is closed, and</content></clause>
<clause id="H31FE85C3DBBE4913BDA5C30FB478471B" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>during the 5-year period preceding the date the class is closed, there has not been a substantial increase in the coverage or value of the benefits, rights, or features described in subparagraph (A) or in the coverage or benefits under the plan described in subparagraph (B)(iii) (whichever is applicable).</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HDA761ECAEF034D6EB692AD1E75854B2D" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Determination of substantial increase for benefits, rights, and features</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In applying subparagraph (C)(ii) for purposes of subparagraph (A)(iii), a plan shall be treated as having had a substantial increase in coverage or value of the benefits, rights, or features described in subparagraph (A) during the applicable 5-year period only if, during such period—</chapeau>
<clause id="H512C5EF2F2F94EFB884A7286E537C285" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>the number of participants covered by such benefits, rights, or features on the date such period ends is more than 50 percent greater than the number of such participants on the first day of the plan year in which such period began, or</content></clause>
<clause id="H9B243C0CFCA44EABAE01E45AAC3C342F" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>such benefits, rights, and features have been modified by 1 or more plan amendments in such a way that, as of the date the class is closed, the value of such benefits, rights, and features to the closed class as a whole is substantially greater than the value as of the first day of such 5-year period, solely as a result of such amendments.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H383FDF1DD2824FCA9E9DD2FC11BB4B40" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Determination of substantial increase for aggregate testing on benefits basis</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In applying subparagraph (C)(ii) for purposes of subparagraph (B)(iii)(IV), a plan shall be treated as having had a substantial increase in coverage or benefits during the applicable 5-year period only if, during such period—</chapeau>
<clause id="H4BB3EDC87E3A45ADBA8B71B4D293D0C4" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>the number of participants benefitting under the plan on the date such period ends is more than 50 percent greater than the number of such participants on the first day of the plan year in which such period began, or</content></clause>
<clause id="HC76CC9AFC8D844C691FD1DB28F791768" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>the average benefit provided to such participants on the date such period ends is more than 50 percent greater than the average benefit provided on the first day of the plan year in which such period began.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB5D507ED17A749E182E47348E28AFCF5" class="indent2"><num value="F">“(F) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Certain employees disregarded</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of subparagraphs (D) and (E), any increase in coverage or value or in coverage or benefits, whichever is applicable, which is attributable to such coverage and value or coverage and benefits provided to employees—</chapeau>
<clause id="HDF63176004BD41E9A194473E585E7CB2" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>who became participants as a result of a merger, acquisition, or similar event which occurred during the 7-year period preceding the date the class is closed, or</content></clause>
<clause id="H851B8CCAC76B4A888ADE32FEC35DA1F7" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>who became participants by reason of a merger of the plan with another plan which had been in effect for at least 5 years as of the date of the merger,</content></clause>
<continuation class="indent0" role="subparagraph">shall be disregarded, except that clause (ii) shall apply for purposes of subparagraph (D) only if, under the merger, the benefits, rights, or features under 1 plan are conformed to the benefits, rights, or features of the other plan prospectively.</continuation></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HF237A74B5DD248A68E8E27391BC7F6E2" class="indent2"><num value="G">“(G) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Rules relating to average benefit</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of subparagraph (E)—</chapeau>
<clause id="HFB07DBF6DA964FD6B0B384D160852138" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>the average benefit provided to participants under the plan will be treated as having remained the same between the 2 dates described in subparagraph (E)(ii) if the benefit formula applicable to such participants has not changed between such dates, and</content></clause>
<clause id="HCC263C0EF24E40A88D1D8760F8F2E65B" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><chapeau>if the benefit formula applicable to 1 or more participants under the plan has changed between such 2 dates, then the average benefit under the plan shall be considered to have increased by more than 50 percent only if—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H4F813E78A3C549DF944FD72CC8F2866C" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>the total amount determined under section 430(b)(1)(A)(i) for all participants benefitting under the plan for the plan year in which the 5-year period described in subparagraph (E) ends, exceeds</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HC080B4BF13434C62B525C40A07FA5B93" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>the total amount determined under section 430(b)(1)(A)(i) for all such participants for such plan year, by using the benefit formula in effect for each such participant for the first plan year in such 5-year period,</content></subclause>
<continuation class="indent0" role="clause">by more than 50 percent. In the case of a CSEC plan (as defined in section 414(y)), the normal cost of the plan (as determined under section 433(j)(1)(B)) shall be used in lieu of the amount determined under section 430(b)(1)(A)(i).</continuation></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HFDD6B81C83AF420FBAB6582B336DF0FC" class="indent2"><num value="H">“(H) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment as single plan</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of subparagraphs (E) and (G), a plan described in section 413(c) shall be treated as a single plan rather than as separate plans maintained by each employer in the plan.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H224FD8E4BBAA45C4B277270101AA39D0" class="indent2"><num value="I">“(I) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special rules</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of subparagraphs (A)(i) and (B)(iii)(II), the following rules shall apply:</chapeau>
<clause id="H3B69B2056EBC4A55B0A8830EF675ADB1" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>In applying section 410(b)(6)(C), the closing of the class of participants shall not be treated as a significant change in coverage under section 410(b)(6)(C)(i)(II).</content></clause>
<clause id="H37DA3ABD54084F7E96E8BB8EBB5FD44E" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>2 or more plans shall not fail to be eligible to be aggregated and treated as a single plan solely by reason of having different plan years.</content></clause>
<clause id="HB69FB3FDF88545E18660252FEB629610" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><content>Changes in the employee population shall be disregarded to the extent attributable to individuals who become employees or cease to be employees, after the date the class is closed, by reason of a merger, acquisition, divestiture, or similar event.</content></clause>
<clause id="H4C3825EBCFD8419E9F25C281A296A624" class="indent3"><num value="iv">“(iv) </num><content>Aggregation and all other testing methodologies otherwise applicable under subsection (a)(4) and section 410(b) may be taken into account.</content></clause>

<subparagraph id="HBD2AAD13553A4C58B2CF7A6FCBB87A1C" class="indent2"><num value="J">“(J) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Spun-off plans</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of this paragraph, if a portion of a defined benefit plan described in subparagraph (A) or (B)(iii) is spun off to another employer and the spun-off plan continues to satisfy the requirements of—</chapeau>
<clause id="HBE3A10E849C44E2DB89331179ECEDE17" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>subparagraph (A)(i) or (B)(iii)(II), whichever is applicable, if the original plan was still within the 3-year period described in such subparagraph at the time of the spin off, and</content></clause>
<clause id="H1BA5DE5ABA514334AAC63AA22E86E0EE" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>subparagraph (A)(ii) or (B)(iii)(III), whichever is applicable,</content></clause>
<continuation class="indent0" role="subparagraph">the treatment under subparagraph (A) or (B) of the spun-off plan shall continue with respect to such other employer.</continuation></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H0FDDDD6B97D349BC9B3BE1C56DCB939C" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Testing of defined contribution plans</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H5895532B01AA498C841388D2A6DEE35D" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Testing on a benefits basis</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A defined contribution plan shall be permitted to be tested on a benefits basis if—</chapeau>

<clause id="H2B4513C5E9B54D76B077B57B30D952C0" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><content>after the date as of which the class was closed, any plan amendment to the defined contribution plan which modifies the closed class or the allocations, benefits, rights, and features provided to such closed class does not discriminate significantly in favor of highly compensated employees, and</content></clause>
<clause id="H54FDC1A4D2D24949B5703EA8AC6C329E" class="indent3"><num value="iv">“(iv) </num><content>the class was closed before April 5, 2017, or the defined benefit plan under clause (i) is described in paragraph (1)(C) (as applied for purposes of paragraph (1)(B)(iii)(IV)).</content></clause></subparagraph>

<clause id="H00ADD0D4BF2947B49F3E1447F5FBDD8B" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>With respect to 1 or more defined contribution plans described in subparagraph (A), for purposes of determining compliance with subsection (a)(4) and section 410(b), the portion of such plans which provides make-whole contributions or other nonelective contributions may be aggregated and tested on a benefits basis with the portion of 1 or more other defined contribution plans which—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H48E4E47B09E44F79B41B67FCA7FF0BB7" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num><content>provides matching contributions (as defined in subsection (m)(4)(A)),</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HB57D350BAD874BDE82BFA9C99351ED20" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num><content>provides annuity contracts described in section 403(b) which are purchased with matching contributions or nonelective contributions, or</content></subclause>

<clause id="H68A44E5CE769429383C9D4F56C43E0E2" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special rules for matching contributions</inline>.—</heading><content>Rules similar to the rules of paragraph (1)(B)(ii) shall apply for purposes of clause (i).</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H84AE6C9CA65B4A178F2C4D1A34814649" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special rules for testing defined contribution plan features providing matching contributions to certain older, longer service participants</inline>.—</heading><content>In the case of a defined contribution plan which provides benefits, rights, or features to a closed class of participants whose accruals under a defined benefit plan have been reduced or eliminated, the plan shall not fail to satisfy the requirements of subsection (a)(4) solely by reason of the composition of the closed class or the benefits, rights, or features provided to such closed class if the defined contribution plan and defined benefit plan otherwise meet the requirements of subparagraph (A) but for the fact that the make-whole contributions under the defined contribution plan are made in whole or in part through matching contributions.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB2D918C6B3CF4CBBB6537F94E52FE895" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Spun-off plans</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of this paragraph, if a portion of a defined contribution plan described in subparagraph (A) or (C) is spun off to another employer, the treatment under subparagraph (A) or (C) of the spun-off plan shall continue with respect to the other employer if such plan continues to comply with the requirements of clauses (ii) (if the original plan was still within the 3-year period described in such clause at the time of the spin off) and (iii) of subparagraph (A), as determined for purposes of subparagraph (A) or (C), whichever is applicable.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H3BA1D71CEA94414FB4BE3810006FE8C8" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definitions and special rule</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of this subsection—</chapeau>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="H5A9B58F89D2D491588DABCC251590834" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Make-whole contributions</inline>.—</heading><content>Except as otherwise provided in paragraph (2)(C), the term ‘<term>make-whole contributions</term>’ means nonelective allocations for each employee in the class which are reasonably calculated, in a consistent manner, to replace some or all of the retirement benefits which the employee would have received under the defined benefit plan and any other plan or qualified cash or deferred arrangement under subsection (k)(2) if no change had been made to such defined benefit plan and such other plan or arrangement. For purposes of the preceding sentence, consistency shall not be required with respect to employees who were subject to different benefit formulas under the defined benefit plan.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H36344B70776E49FA869C596896597194" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">References to closed class of participants</inline>.—</heading><content>References to a closed class of participants and similar references to a closed class shall include arrangements under which 1 or more classes of participants are closed, except that 1 or more classes of participants closed on different dates shall not be aggregated for purposes of determining the date any such class was closed.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="H3150264FE4DC4BF5B9B3877BF1513F97" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Highly compensated employee</inline>.—</heading><content>The term ‘<term>highly compensated employee</term>’ has the meaning given such term in section 414(q).”</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph></subsection>

<subparagraph id="H0429D7FDADD04F4E95135816EB167E58" class="indent2"><num value="I">“(I) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Protected participants</inline>.—</heading>

<subsection id="H8E16E28761F243189679AE48940A45AD" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effective Date</inline>.—</heading>

<section id="H5B182BD029774958A5DF01D47927F124" styleType="OLC"><num value="206">SEC. 206. </num><heading>MODIFICATION OF PBGC PREMIUMS FOR CSEC PLANS.</heading>

<paragraph id="H4172CBA4B083471B88D61B035CCB6531" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>in clause (i), by striking “plan,” and inserting “plan other than a CSEC plan (as defined in section 210(f)(1))”;</content></paragraph>

<paragraph id="H3EE34A8160374977B681E7371C3F43BF" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>in clause (vi), by striking the period at the end and inserting “, or”; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H6E1477EC714E487FB9465D420E826E6E" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>by adding at the end the following new clause:
<quotedContent id="HBEAB61EF42A84B41BFE22C75C2459EF1" styleType="OLC">

<division id="H326FC79B8E4544ED8833BEE68F6AEFC5"><num value="P">DIVISION P—</num><heading>OTHER MATTER</heading>
<title id="HF4ACAF1ABC0B4D91BC91C2FEB0FD3119" styleType="OLC"><num value="I">TITLE I—</num><heading class="inline">PLATTE RIVER RECOVERY IMPLEMENTATION PROGRAM</heading>
<section id="HEB6B2D65DF934093BEF4A5E99B01FD0C" styleType="OLC"><num value="101">SEC. 101. </num><heading>SHORT TITLE.</heading><content class="block">This title may be cited as the “<shortTitle role="title">Temporary Relief from Certain ERISA Requirements Act of 2020</shortTitle>”.</content></section>
<section id="H12678147B4FB485EBF8B4BD809DDCE7F" styleType="OLC"><num value="102">SEC. 102. </num><heading>PURPOSE.</heading><content class="block">The purpose of this Act is to authorize the Secretary of the Interior, acting through the Commissioner of Reclamation and in partnership with the States, other Federal agencies, and other non-Federal entities, to continue the cooperative effort among the Federal and non-Federal entities through the continued implementation of the Platte River Recovery Implementation Program First Increment Extension for threatened and endangered species in the Central and Lower Platte River Basin without creating Federal water rights or requiring the grant of water rights to Federal entities.</content></section>
<section id="H4EB259D4C76744CFA484370500014834" styleType="OLC"><num value="103">SEC. 103. </num><heading>DEFINITIONS.</heading>
<chapeau class="indent0">In this Act:</chapeau>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="HBD34593CFA454F34AB2177BB41EC6B58" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Agreement</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>Agreement</term>” means the Platte River Recovery Implementation Program Cooperative Agreement entered into by the Governors of the States and the Secretary, including an amendment or addendum to the Agreement to extend the Program.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H416C8AD40150446FB2851A322E859D8A" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">First increment</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>First Increment</term>” means the Program’s first 13 years from January 1, 2007 through December 31, 2019.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H366C90B9E34142FFB4CE15681CC1BF3E" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">First increment extension</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>First Increment Extension</term>” means the extension of the Program for 13 years from January 1, 2020 through December 31, 2032.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H1B5D01C985074FA680D1184067306B29" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Governance committee</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>Governance Committee</term>” means the governance committee established under the Agreement and composed of members from the States, the Federal Government, environmental interests, and water users.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H3A7DE926AA95409583013EC94041355C" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Interest in land or water</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>interest in land or water</term>” includes fee title, short- or long-term easement, lease, or other contractual arrangement that is determined to be necessary by the Secretary to implement the land and water components of the Program.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H3A5B4E6ED215496E8102D34DFB6564E8" class="indent1"><num value="6">(6) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Program</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>Program</term>” means the Platte River Recovery Implementation Program established under the Agreement and continued under an amendment or addendum to the Agreement.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H4A06D29011B64001BFD2683D60C3257D" class="indent1"><num value="7">(7) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Project or activity</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The term “<term>project or activity</term>” means—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H2FA97E35C20B4B7FB467863F6EE207B4" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>the planning, design, permitting, or other compliance activity, construction, construction management, operation, maintenance, and replacement of a facility;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC581AD0B5CC642D69C657951090E4205" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>the acquisition of an interest in land or water;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H84361DC2FBA34C10ABD2679A0BA5F369" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>habitat restoration;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H4A11EE2D20DE4547AD03FA4D7A897B7D" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>research and monitoring;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HCCB2BA1BBFB94C0DB62F7CED3B5580C4" class="indent2"><num value="E">(E) </num><content>program administration; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H42502481C97A47F7B7722B7FDE9A477C" class="indent2"><num value="F">(F) </num><content>any other activity that is determined to be necessary by the Secretary to carry out the Program.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H80612FE3B8CF4D2DBF170BED0404E785" class="indent1"><num value="8">(8) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Secretary</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>Secretary</term>” means the Secretary of the Interior, acting through the Commissioner of Reclamation.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H2630B0E2683440088EF5B1F9A1655534" class="indent1"><num value="9">(9) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">States</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “States” means the States of Colorado, Nebraska, and Wyoming.</content></paragraph></section>
<section id="HAC45E4FA390E49E8B065E72851185938" styleType="OLC"><num value="104">SEC. 104. </num><heading>PLATTE RIVER RECOVERY IMPLEMENTATION PROGRAM.</heading>
<subsection id="H0C10210C31D9447E81212441DB5B26CA" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Implementation of Program</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H80E617588A774E6AA237C067DA9A3487" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Secretary, in cooperation with the Governance Committee, may—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HBCE121DA24404523B4D477F2ABCD3689" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>participate in the Program; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HA9BB9054C8BC410E9A57F6D5E296581B" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>carry out any projects and activities that are designated for implementation during the First Increment Extension.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H6152387B9B0D488A89FF74E96A5F3AF5" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authority of the secretary</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For the purposes of carrying out this section, the Secretary, in cooperation with the Governance Committee, may—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H59FFCEBBA60B48C69F9318E2453380A8" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>enter into agreements and contracts with Federal and non-Federal entities;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H0EAC44D7457847DF8AE3F9EDF2F96B4E" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>acquire interests in land, water, and facilities from willing sellers without the use of eminent domain;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HDECBD98521DA4EF1B41987A0508474F4" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>subsequently transfer any interests acquired under subparagraph (B); and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H76AFC2FD9D5E4760BE2BDBCAC5CC3465" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>accept or provide grants.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HB6336CC2629F4B1EA7B5D4BA281818A7" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Cost-Sharing Contributions</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H464B0D9935E14E479F41ACB8A52CB80B" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>As provided in the Agreement, the States shall contribute not less than 50 percent of the total contributions necessary to carry out the Program.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF4F15DFD919E428FAD2BB492264BF40C" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Non-federal contributions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The following contributions shall constitute the States’ share of the Program:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HBD43BC50232845A0BF8AB35F36F6BFD6" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>An additional $28,000,000 in non-Federal funds, with the balance of funds remaining to be contributed to be adjusted for inflation on October 1 of the year after the date of enactment of this Act and each October 1 thereafter.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HF78BA6C74A4C43AB8F89AAA4897D7F34" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>Additional credit for contributions of water or land for the purposes of implementing the Program, as determined to be appropriate by the Secretary.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF3A993A7035A4CF697145F2222B0EF91" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In-kind contributions</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary or the States may elect to provide a portion of the Federal share or non-Federal share, respectively, in the form of in-kind goods or services, if the contribution of goods or services is approved by the Governance Committee, as provided in Attachment 1 of the Agreement.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H3FB8FE95B63943AEB203273D24171CFF" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authority To Modify Program</inline>.—</heading><content>The Program may be modified or amended before the completion of the First Increment Extension if the Secretary and the States determine that the modifications are consistent with the purposes of the Program.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H0E01622DF97744E5AC2C5861DC34BDEB" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effect</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HB9BF69CD302448A0A8E4AEE8CBBE7A5C" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effect on reclamation laws</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>No action carried out under this section shall, with respect to the acreage limitation provisions of the reclamation laws—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HBEBDD9341F084A16A7E2E20055191F94" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>be considered in determining whether a district (as the term is defined in section 202 of the Reclamation Reform Act of 1982 (43 U.S.C. 390bb)) has discharged the obligation of the district to repay the construction cost of project facilities used to make irrigation water available for delivery to land in the district;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1F54CB88F7F74DECA169AE6F9B74FD14" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>serve as the basis for reinstating acreage limitation provisions in a district that has completed payment of the construction obligations of the district; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H429145D55AA142F5ABBD7A3FCB6B7BDB" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>serve as the basis for increasing the construction repayment obligation of the district, which would extend the period during which the acreage limitation provisions would apply.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H06F49D74171446B59F7A518FDECD9A8B" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effect on water rights</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Nothing in this section—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H023F23C79E774ABDA8DB27E0C94C70D1" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>creates Federal water rights; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H2B1330F758E64C8BA0769DBC346B3747" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>requires the grant of water rights to Federal entities.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H769D68592EC64D40810E57E42012158B" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authorization of Appropriations</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H68899100388141988BE8319CDAEBECF2" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out projects and activities under this section an additional $78,000,000 as adjusted under paragraph (3).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H5254A57372D94BB2AA72A20E87539069" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Nonreimbursable federal expenditures</inline>.—</heading><content>Any amounts to be expended under paragraph (1) shall be considered nonreimbursable Federal expenditures.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H6EF7179306444C0A8BEFEA5C021EEB6A" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Adjustment</inline>.—</heading><content>The balance of funds remaining to be expended shall be adjusted for inflation on October 1 of the year after the date of enactment of this Act and each October 1 thereafter.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HDB19024C203E4D1CBFA09D55AF2610F8" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Availability of funds</inline>.—</heading><content>At the end of each fiscal year, any unexpended funds for projects and activities made available under paragraph (1) shall be retained for use in future fiscal years to implement projects and activities under the Program. Any unexpended funds appropriated during the First Increment shall be retained and carried over from the First Increment into the First Increment Extension.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H35B7DDC1E4EA4C91AC393AE409AD5569" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Termination of Authority</inline>.—</heading><content>The authority for the Secretary to implement the First Increment Extension shall terminate on September 30, 2033.</content></subsection></section></title>
<title id="H8C408AB262F2448F989F199DFF67192B" styleType="OLC"><num value="II">TITLE II—</num><heading class="inline">GREAT LAKES</heading>
<section id="H1183FE1619114A889CE05138EF0E1244" styleType="OLC"><num value="201">SEC. 201. </num><heading>GREAT LAKES MONITORING, ASSESSMENT, SCIENCE, AND RESEARCH.</heading>
<subsection id="H78701A7B1FDA407AB73594C1A9F68F88" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definitions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In this section:</chapeau>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="HE1FB0F709E294CA29E81D76FBEF0D100" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Director</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>Director</term>” means the Director of the United States Geological Survey.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="HD97500ABB48F451FA2C12733CC4F223F" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Great lakes basin</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>Great Lakes Basin</term>” means the air, land, water, and living organisms in the United States within the drainage basin of the Saint Lawrence River at and upstream from the point at which such river and the Great Lakes become the international boundary between Canada and the United States.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H9ECF6796894A4187A3A0E1428ABA1BB8" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Findings</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Congress finds the following:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H7EE0898C0B2A4012A7A8EC7962F646E7" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>The Great Lakes support a diverse ecosystem, on which the vibrant and economically valuable Great Lakes fisheries depend.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HFD0854B475674299BDBAA3BC5C908872" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>To continue successful fisheries management and coordination, as has occurred since signing of the Convention on Great Lakes Fisheries between the United States and Canada on September 10, 1954, management of the ecosystem and its fisheries require sound, reliable science, and the use of modern scientific technologies.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H3B1A569E8F0C4AA7AEC9A2052AA5AE17" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>Fisheries research is necessary to support multi-jurisdictional fishery management decisions and actions regarding recreational and sport fishing, commercial fisheries, tribal harvest, allocation decisions, and fish stocking activities.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HE8E41E9007CE4B5C998F7A1C6855B95D" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>President Richard Nixon submitted, and the Congress approved, Reorganization Plan No. 4 (84 Stat. 2090), conferring science activities and management of marine fisheries to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H2C1C89E637514A869D14E286F442A1FF" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><content>Reorganization Plan No. 4 expressly excluded fishery research activities within the Great Lakes from the transfer, retaining management and scientific research duties within the already-established jurisdictions under the 1954 Convention on Great Lakes Fisheries, including those of the Great Lakes Fishery Commission and the Department of the Interior.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HEAB8D6055B4E42ADAA2A42B3FF9F5DC3" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Monitoring, Assessment, Science, and Research</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H6125A741C90D448AA964AAA52EC0EBA1" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>The Director may conduct monitoring, assessment, science, and research, in support of the binational fisheries within the Great Lakes Basin.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC1F1CD90B0FF44F19B9F110771E883CC" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Specific authorities</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Director shall, under paragraph (1)—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H560E3F7D62DB4A18BC5E880B1039B1FB" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>execute a comprehensive, multi-lake, freshwater fisheries science program;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H9D79EEC4B9AC4745954128282DD6E5BC" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>coordinate with and work cooperatively with regional, State, tribal, and local governments; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HF748BE10970E42449F26179C6DC90B7E" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>consult with other interested entities groups, including academia and relevant Canadian agencies.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H6EAAA8ED865A4013B208ADEFC9C6EA7D" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Included research</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>To properly serve the needs of fisheries managers, monitoring, assessment, science, and research under this section may include—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HAA568303278D4C70B84276EB59832C8A" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>deepwater ecosystem sciences;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H9102381B66454E899FA7151E51AC059D" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>biological and food-web components;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC741E188B8F44A5CAE1CF36866F11CA3" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>fish movement and behavior investigations;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H717C90AC114C4E8DBA6C230DAB1C5CEC" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>fish population structures;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HE5772A136DCA49DCA77DDD7ABB90C4AD" class="indent2"><num value="E">(E) </num><content>fish habitat investigations;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HF376BDD65B164F7DA64BB674AECA66A9" class="indent2"><num value="F">(F) </num><content>invasive species science;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1FB3175DF38F41979EF1A9D2083AFD5B" class="indent2"><num value="G">(G) </num><content>use of existing, new, and experimental biological assessment tools, equipment, vessels, other scientific instrumentation and laboratory capabilities necessary to support fishery management decisions; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HDA0FB2C0C9C540688D86D668901CD07E" class="indent2"><num value="H">(H) </num><content>studies to assess impacts on Great Lakes Fishery resources.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC16947E4BD654CE688DC663F0CCEA505" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Savings clause</inline>.—</heading><content>Nothing in this section is intended or shall be construed to impede, supersede, or alter the authority of the Great Lakes Fishery Commission, States, and Indian tribes under the Convention on Great Lakes Fisheries between the United States of America and Canada on September 10, 1954, and the Great Lakes Fishery Act of 1956 (16 U.S.C. 931 et seq.).</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H4398793811F044B9B08E4EE7242F0366" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authorization of Appropriations</inline>.—</heading><content>For each of fiscal years 2021 through 2025, there is authorized to be appropriated $15,000,000 to carry out this section.</content></subsection></section></title>
<title id="HC9AB73442D92437E8241956346A66320" styleType="OLC"><num value="III">TITLE III—</num><heading class="inline">MORRIS K. UDALL AND STEWART L. UDALL FOUNDATION</heading>
<section id="HAAFC4525570D4F269FB085F30B0290EC" styleType="OLC"><num value="301">SEC. 301. </num><heading>FINDINGS.</heading>
<chapeau class="indent0">Congress finds the following:</chapeau>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H62042413D07D452B9C90D8E6A0D4B721" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>Since 1999, the Morris K. Udall and Stewart L. Udall Foundation (referred to in this Act as the “<term>Foundation</term>”) has operated the Parks in Focus program to provide opportunities for the youth of the United States to learn about and experience the Nation’s parks and wilderness, and other outdoor areas.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HAFDD76D0D80141C68DEEA6DD0718C704" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>Since 2001, the Foundation has conducted research and provided education and training to Native American and Alaska Native professionals and leaders on Native American and Alaska Native health care issues and tribal public policy through the Native Nations Institute for Leadership, Management, and Policy.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HAB8AECDEE60D406B8B0F129209AD14B6" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><chapeau>The Foundation is committed to continuing to make a substantial contribution toward public policy in the future by—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HC1ABA28296AF41EA8FFC4D2B2979C98E" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>playing a significant role in developing the next generation of environmental, public health, public lands, natural resource, and Native American leaders; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H95C17329532D4C8CA765E5A0C021EDCD" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>working with current leaders to improve collaboration and decision-making on challenging environmental, energy, public health, and related economic problems and tribal governance and economic development issues.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></section>

<subsection id="H1DE7BFCE622F4B0DB3C497BC7394A5C8" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Sense of Congress</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>It is the sense of Congress that the John F. <section id="H7BB033F51BBD43D89D8A478D2F4D808A" styleType="OLC"><num value="1004">SEC. 1004. </num><heading>REQUIREMENTS RELATING TO CHARGES FOR COVERED SERVICES.</heading>
