<title identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI" id="H52810C464088425B956F3EECEF12F1C0"><num value="I">TITLE I—</num>
<heading class="inline">LOWERING PRICES THROUGH FAIR DRUG PRICE NEGOTIATION</heading> 
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s101" id="H099D7E00B6234B7FB8249C9E79159857" role="subsequent-section"><num value="101">SEC. 101. </num>
<heading>PROVIDING FOR LOWER PRICES FOR CERTAIN HIGH-PRICED SINGLE SOURCE DRUGS.</heading>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s101/a" id="H5B78BE1FA54C4264A861E3BD3FAB9B5A" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Program To Lower Prices for Certain High-Priced Single Source Drugs</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Title XI of the Social Security Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t42/s1301">42 U.S.C. 1301</ref> et seq.) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new part:<quotedContent meta="committee ID HWM00" id="H7C9E12F440A14D8583C3CCD39D4E3518" styleType="OLC"> <part id="H0ED478E80C484EDBBEA33E3FC9E6ADC9"><num value="E">“PART E—</num>
<heading>FAIR PRICE NEGOTIATION PROGRAM TO LOWER PRICES FOR CERTAIN HIGH-PRICED SINGLE SOURCE DRUGS</heading> 
<section id="H6626799C00084A219269E0CA580E1568" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1191">“SEC. 1191. </num>
<heading>ESTABLISHMENT OF PROGRAM.</heading>
<subsection id="HEC6BC1286BF3441ABD26BAD38992447D" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The Secretary shall establish a Fair Price Negotiation Program (in this part referred to as the ‘program’). Under the program, with respect to each price applicability period, the Secretary shall—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H233EA858674E4DDD813B05C28D378F67" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<content>publish a list of selected drugs in accordance with section 1192;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H9DAD97EAB28C4EACB4B2F741F90C78F5" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>enter into agreements with manufacturers of selected drugs with respect to such period, in accordance with section 1193;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H62300B6E376545B3B8679FBDCEBABEA3" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<content>negotiate and, if applicable, renegotiate maximum fair prices for such selected drugs, in accordance with section 1194; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H13CB53570C774D298505810C6CC956B6" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<content>carry out the administrative duties described in section 1196.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HEACC6FC882924A77B77389B18FA4BB95" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definitions Relating to Timing</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of this part:</chapeau>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="HB43E6470499B45F5B163E803DFBD0058" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Initial price applicability year</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>initial price applicability year</term>’ means a plan year (beginning with plan year 2023) or, if agreed to in an agreement under section 1193 by the Secretary and manufacturer involved, a period of more than one plan year (beginning on or after January 1, 2023).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H517A8176A0F044C6ADD2534FF62EEC16" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Price applicability period</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>price applicability period</term>’ means, with respect to a drug, the period beginning with the initial price applicability year with respect to which such drug is a selected drug and ending with the last plan year during which the drug is a selected drug.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H4ED2A5F0D92C40E99FE2751B230E25A3" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Selected drug publication date</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>selected drug publication date</term>’ means, with respect to each initial price applicability year, April 15 of the plan year that begins 2 years prior to such year.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H23ACE0617CFE47F386F724814B0B6EFC" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Voluntary negotiation period</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The term ‘<term>voluntary negotiation period</term>’ means, with respect to an initial price applicability year with respect to a selected drug, the period—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HDED19915A02B4017BCF026A158CCC4E2" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<chapeau>beginning on the sooner of—</chapeau>
<clause id="H41C6EA3C8FF840FF8A7B2F37B77A1142" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>the date on which the manufacturer of the drug and the Secretary enter into an agreement under section 1193 with respect to such drug; or</content></clause>
<clause id="HF22E4ADBD760494BB980A3D6E2293A1C" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>June 15 following the selected drug publication date with respect to such selected drug; and</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H04A84E75787546C6B4B3F915C8C7FA10" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>ending on March 31 of the year that begins one year prior to the initial price applicability year.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H7D5B4DC99E9B406387A8BBA3C7D313B6" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Other Definitions</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of this part:</chapeau>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H96119ABD16FA4026BA50D66B458FFDA6" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Fair price eligible individual</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The term ‘<term>fair price eligible individual</term>’ means, with respect to a selected drug—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H656C8342F58D4B84BDA563BF7F40FEF3" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<chapeau>in the case such drug is furnished or dispensed to the individual at a pharmacy or by a mail order service—</chapeau>
<clause id="H2000A8479EC64E7EBFEDD18BB5CFA816" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>an individual who is enrolled under a prescription drug plan under part D of title XVIII or an MA–PD plan under part C of such title under which coverage is provided for such drug; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H853971CC3BB64A128EEBCBB160DCD330" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>an individual who is enrolled under a group health plan or health insurance coverage offered in the group or individual market (as such terms are defined in section 2791 of the Public Health Service Act) with respect to which there is in effect an agreement with the Secretary under section 1197 with respect to such selected drug as so furnished or dispensed; and</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC2D9F589746643C6847EF98D5A031085" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<chapeau>in the case such drug is furnished or administered to the individual by a hospital, physician, or other provider of services or supplier—</chapeau>
<clause id="H59A6850C119642C994B78F4A4F270906" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>an individual who is entitled to benefits under part A of title XVIII or enrolled under part B of such title if such selected drug is covered under the respective part; and</content></clause>
<clause id="HBDE25D2538594023B07432641C55331B" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>an individual who is enrolled under a group health plan or health insurance coverage offered in the group or individual market (as such terms are defined in section 2791 of the Public Health Service Act) with respect to which there is in effect an agreement with the Secretary under section 1197 with respect to such selected drug as so furnished or administered.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H17A969D9E4FA4EF79ABAB1F931E8B301" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Maximum fair price</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>maximum fair price</term>’ means, with respect to a plan year during a price applicability period and with respect to a selected drug (as defined in section 1192(c)) with respect to such period, the price published pursuant to section 1195 in the Federal Register for such drug and year.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HDCB01BCF15524CD7B152C1CDE1599C3C" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Average international market price defined</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H0C3E15E8B139405C826E73C8E5B95B35" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The terms ‘average international market price’ and ‘AIM price’ mean, with respect to a drug, the average price (which shall be the net average price, if practicable, and volume-weighted, if practicable) for a unit (as defined in paragraph (4)) of the drug for sales of such drug (calculated across different dosage forms and strengths of the drug and not based on the specific formulation or package size or package type), as computed (as of the date of publication of such drug as a selected drug under section 1192(a)) in all countries described in clause (ii) of subparagraph (B) that are applicable countries (as described in clause (i) of such subparagraph) with respect to such drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB416A9E7C8E54BC8873292DAEA1BBD22" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Applicable countries</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="H8479B83BF51B42E4B6B667FB0E9B5444" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>For purposes of subparagraph (A), a country described in clause (ii) is an applicable country described in this clause with respect to a drug if there is available an average price for any unit for the drug for sales of such drug in such country.</content></clause>
<clause id="H959332B83FD14F94963BCAC62D423EA5" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Countries described</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of this paragraph, the following are countries described in this clause:</chapeau>
<subclause id="H45EAFE1CB450421FAE9DA6C3E25405A8" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num>
<content>Australia.</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H8523F3F60ED7497BB1EEE6BD1DCB08EB" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num>
<content>Canada.</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H0B63778AEF3B466B89058E2DF6395E26" class="indent4"><num value="III">“(III) </num>
<content>France.</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H0D7C4EA47C254D249F07C5A960FB76D2" class="indent4"><num value="IV">“(IV) </num>
<content>Germany.</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HD3E28E92E605479B89685A144DB851EC" class="indent4"><num value="V">“(V) </num>
<content>Japan.</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HB46D1678B32449BBBD150C2D01602BB4" class="indent4"><num value="VI">“(VI) </num>
<content>The United Kingdom.</content></subclause></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H3AEABD4719444A42AC0720C1451910C2" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Unit</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>unit</term>’ means, with respect to a drug, the lowest identifiable quantity (such as a capsule or tablet, milligram of molecules, or grams) of the drug that is dispensed.</content></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H3B135C8370E24EF8B18ABEE3FD000EB0" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1192">“SEC. 1192. </num>
<heading>SELECTION OF NEGOTIATION-ELIGIBLE DRUGS AS SELECTED DRUGS.</heading>
<subsection id="H3D1EAA26D42044428884A24457B7EA5A" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>Not later than the selected drug publication date with respect to an initial price applicability year, the Secretary shall select and publish in the Federal Register a list of—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HB92188553EE949BD8F4D6126B2A97FA6" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1)</num>
<subparagraph id="H766BFE67F73842F1B2052B102F358115" class="inline"><num value="A">(A) </num>
<content>with respect to an initial price applicability year during the period beginning with 2023 and ending with 2027, at least 25 negotiation-eligible drugs described in subparagraphs (A) and (B), but not subparagraph (C), of subsection (d)(1) (or, with respect to an initial price applicability year during such period beginning after 2023, the maximum number (if such number is less than 25) of such negotiation-eligible drugs for the year) with respect to such year;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph meta="committee ID HWM00" id="H66C2D7AE79E64E0C9A2A1DDC32BBAB9D" class="indent1"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>with respect to an initial price applicability year during the period beginning with 2028 and ending with 2032, at least 30 negotiation-eligible drugs described in subparagraphs (A) and (B), but not subparagraph (C), of subsection (d)(1) (or, with respect to an initial price applicability year during such period, the maximum number (if such number is less than 30) of such negotiation-eligible drugs for the year) with respect to such year; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph meta="committee ID HWM00" id="H3C53767C0D3B403A8094FEBA57C1574A" class="indent1"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<content>with respect to an initial price applicability year beginning after 2032, at least 35 negotiation-eligible drugs described in subparagraphs (A) and (B), but not subparagraph (C), of subsection (d)(1) (or, with respect to an initial price applicability year during such period, the maximum number (if such number is less than 35) of such negotiation-eligible drugs for the year) with respect to such year;</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HD228D9A3CB6343FCADCDE1F4644FB83F" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>all negotiation-eligible drugs described in subparagraph (C) of such subsection with respect to such year; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HEAAD57D2894B4FE797384E745E7468DD" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<content>all new-entrant negotiation-eligible drugs (as defined in subsection (g)(1)) with respect to such year.</content></paragraph>
<continuation class="indent0">Each drug published on the list pursuant to the previous sentence shall be subject to the negotiation process under section 1194 for the voluntary negotiation period with respect to such initial price applicability year (and the renegotiation process under such section as applicable for any subsequent year during the applicable price applicability period). In applying this subsection, any negotiation-eligible drug that is selected under this subsection for an initial price applicability year shall not count toward the required minimum amount of drugs to be selected under paragraph (1) for any subsequent year, including such a drug so selected that is subject to renegotiation under section 1194.</continuation></subsection>
<subsection id="H9197BB47721847B08729E20D8EC8A8E8" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Selection of Drugs</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In carrying out subsection (a)(1) the Secretary shall select for inclusion on the published list described in subsection (a) with respect to a price applicability period, the negotiation-eligible drugs that the Secretary projects will result in the greatest savings to the Federal Government or fair price eligible individuals during the price applicability period. In making this projection of savings for drugs for which there is an AIM price for a price applicability period, the savings shall be projected across different dosage forms and strengths of the drugs and not based on the specific formulation or package size or package type of the drugs, taking into consideration both the volume of drugs for which payment is made, to the extent such data is available, and the amount by which the net price for the drugs exceeds the AIM price for the drugs.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HE9EFA96DEF9149FBA3ABA6847261FDE6" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Selected Drug</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of this part, each drug included on the list published under subsection (a) with respect to an initial price applicability year shall be referred to as a ‘selected drug’ with respect to such year and each subsequent plan year beginning before the first plan year beginning after the date on which the Secretary determines two or more drug products—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H00CD9BF930AC47B5B57000B1CD54D87D" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<chapeau>are approved or licensed (as applicable)—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H0C1948494FFE4465BD132D5F5716167A" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>under section 505(j) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act using such drug as the listed drug; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H36E64610030D43C98CFCE6807DE5B65B" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>under section 351(k) of the Public Health Service Act using such drug as the reference product; and</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H0228F233A08F4E61933E23C5126DA5BA" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>continue to be marketed.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HFB2320056C1F43D0B319051683E21618" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Negotiation-Eligible Drug</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H022282FFB99140F5A7D4A0A6F8F5EEA3" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of this part, the term ‘<term>negotiation-eligible drug</term>’ means, with respect to the selected drug publication date with respect to an initial price applicability year, a qualifying single source drug, as defined in subsection (e), that meets any of the following criteria:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HF83A2511693141CDB2A37A84B010A0DB" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Covered part d drugs</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The drug is among the 125 covered part D drugs (as defined in section 1860D–2(e)) for which there was an estimated greatest net spending under parts C and D of title XVIII, as determined by the Secretary, during the most recent plan year prior to such drug publication date for which data are available.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H9E096D0D9F5446B3982F1A139EB10A0B" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Other drugs</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The drug is among the 125 drugs for which there was an estimated greatest net spending in the United States (including the 50 States, the District of Columbia, and the territories of the United States), as determined by the Secretary, during the most recent plan year prior to such drug publication date for which data are available.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H99BA00D8CE674C6AB1A226DCEE8594D5" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Insulin</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The drug is a qualifying single source drug described in subsection (e)(3).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H15704DC4A2BA45D3AE2BD66FB8F46776" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Clarification</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In determining whether a qualifying single source drug satisfies any of the criteria described in paragraph (1), the Secretary shall, to the extent practicable, use data that is aggregated across dosage forms and strengths of the drug and not based on the specific formulation or package size or package type of the drug.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HCBEA8D98FCA546E1A752B6498B4C08B5" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Publication</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Not later than the selected drug publication date with respect to an initial price applicability year, the Secretary shall publish in the Federal Register a list of negotiation-eligible drugs with respect to such selected drug publication date.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection role="definitions" id="HD8BE3DE8626547B3A423E33323D3CF31" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Qualifying Single Source Drug</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of this part, the term ‘<term>qualifying single source drug</term>’ means any of the following:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HD7394B35B95448289DE0F4034245AFBA" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Drug products</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>A drug that—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H85C97844C9564A399B894330F8123347" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>is approved under section 505(c) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act and continues to be marketed pursuant to such approval; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HF17D8D7B21094B73A30B9209166490DA" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>is not the listed drug for any drug that is approved and continues to be marketed under section 505(j) of such Act.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H3C63F9FE205F4BA0886C093603520FDE" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Biological products</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>A biological product that—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H7BE6287AF80A4AD0908CD2B430446D2B" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>is licensed under section 351(a) of the Public Health Service Act, including any product that has been deemed to be licensed under section 351 of such Act pursuant to section 7002(e)(4) of the Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act of 2009, and continues to be marketed under section 351 of such Act; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H9B7CDF6DB6EB45DFA930C1A20D598E7A" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>is not the reference product for any biological product that is licensed and continues to be marketed under section 351(k) of such Act.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HCED957F22E4B488AAA2CC3561886B5DC" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Insulin product</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Notwithstanding paragraphs (1) and (2), any insulin product that is approved under subsection (c) or (j) of section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act or licensed under subsection (a) or (k) of section 351 of the Public Health Service Act and continues to be marketed under such section 505 or 351, including any insulin product that has been deemed to be licensed under section 351(a) of the Public Health Service Act pursuant to section 7002(e)(4) of the Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act of 2009 and continues to be marketed pursuant to such licensure.</content></paragraph>
<continuation class="indent0">For purposes of applying paragraphs (1) and (2), a drug or biological product that is marketed by the same sponsor or manufacturer (or an affiliate thereof or a cross-licensed producer or distributor) as the listed drug or reference product described in such respective paragraph shall not be taken into consideration.</continuation></subsection>
<subsection id="HA8A76820D89249D48A36640A15FD83BF" class="indent0"><num value="f">“(f) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Information on International Drug Prices</inline>.—</heading>
<content>For purposes of determining which negotiation-eligible drugs to select under subsection (a) and, in the case of such drugs that are selected drugs, to determine the maximum fair price for such a drug and whether such maximum fair price should be renegotiated under section 1194, the Secretary shall use data relating to the AIM price with respect to such drug as available or provided to the Secretary and shall on an ongoing basis request from manufacturers of selected drugs information on the AIM price of such a drug.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H17C34772E19D4CC99B7673963150C889" class="indent0"><num value="g">“(g) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">New-entrant Negotiation-eligible Drugs</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="HA4C4E52EE2ED4807BE8B33C0DF3277C0" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of this part, the term ‘<term>new-entrant negotiation-eligible drug</term>’ means, with respect to the selected drug publication date with respect to an initial price applicability year, a qualifying single source drug—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HF8D7EB1358EE4825B0E87C0141ADB7A4" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>that is first approved or licensed, as described in paragraph (1), (2), or (3) of subsection (e), as applicable, during the year preceding such selected drug publication date; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HE473CCDE3BDC4DFCBA8B7E5A3E9AB7DE" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>that the Secretary determines under paragraph (2) is likely to be included as a negotiation-eligible drug with respect to the subsequent selected drug publication date.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H14D1DE3A404F43759DC5A5C5A9042997" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Determination</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In the case of a qualifying single source drug that meets the criteria described in subparagraph (A) of paragraph (1), with respect to an initial price applicability year, if the wholesale acquisition cost at which such drug is first marketed in the United States is equal to or greater than the median household income (as determined according to the most recent data collected by the United States Census Bureau), the Secretary shall determine before the selected drug publication date with respect to the initial price applicability year, if the drug is likely to be included as a negotiation-eligible drug with respect to the subsequent selected drug publication date, based on the projected spending under title XVIII or in the United States on such drug. For purposes of this paragraph the term ‘<term>United States</term>’ includes the 50 States, the District of Columbia, and the territories of the United States.</content></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="HFFEF7A3E985246FEAA337BE528B70BB6" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1193">“SEC. 1193. </num>
<heading>MANUFACTURER AGREEMENTS.</heading>
<subsection id="HBC693C0139A645F79CA8C0B2612CC1F0" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of section 1191(a)(2), the Secretary shall enter into agreements with manufacturers of selected drugs with respect to a price applicability period, by not later than June 15 following the selected drug publication date with respect to such selected drug, under which—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H8E05C6B7DE5E4B8EA3C71D0429A1D79B" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<chapeau>during the voluntary negotiation period for the initial price applicability year for the selected drug, the Secretary and manufacturer, in accordance with section 1194, negotiate to determine (and, by not later than the last date of such period and in accordance with subsection (c), agree to) a maximum fair price for such selected drug of the manufacturer in order to provide access to such price—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H680FCBEE76FC4AF69FAA4727971A72EE" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>to fair price eligible individuals who with respect to such drug are described in subparagraph (A) of section 1191(c)(1) and are furnished or dispensed such drug during, subject to subparagraph (2), the price applicability period; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H78C138FFDB5F421284C54297E1A48B89" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>to hospitals, physicians, and other providers of services and suppliers with respect to fair price eligible individuals who with respect to such drug are described in subparagraph (B) of such section and are furnished or administered such drug during, subject to subparagraph (2), the price applicability period;</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HD44D1DA49212489CA297DBCFCCECDF92" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<chapeau>the Secretary and the manufacturer shall, in accordance with a process and during a period specified by the Secretary pursuant to rulemaking, renegotiate (and, by not later than the last date of such period and in accordance with subsection (c), agree to) the maximum fair price for such drug if the Secretary determines that there is a material change in any of the factors described in section 1194(d) relating to the drug, including changes in the AIM price for such drug, in order to provide access to such maximum fair price (as so renegotiated)—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HF6C33F40616C4E3EB833F3FDCEA3BFEA" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>to fair price eligible individuals who with respect to such drug are described in subparagraph (A) of section 1191(c)(1) and are furnished or dispensed such drug during any year during the price applicability period (beginning after such renegotiation) with respect to such selected drug; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H36AB196EB35141E39E11E339F28643E1" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>to hospitals, physicians, and other providers of services and suppliers with respect to fair price eligible individuals who with respect to such drug are described in subparagraph (B) of such section and are furnished or administered such drug during any year described in subparagraph (A);</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC1A2E577663F44989DD7E389DEB94EEA" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<content>the maximum fair price (including as renegotiated pursuant to paragraph (2)), with respect to such a selected drug, shall be provided to fair price eligible individuals, who with respect to such drug are described in subparagraph (A) of section 1191(c)(1), at the pharmacy or by a mail order service at the point-of-sale of such drug;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H9CEB9041DF804F2296F29530045FB6F6" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<chapeau>the manufacturer, subject to subsection (d), submits to the Secretary, in a form and manner specified by the Secretary—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H2E3C608DD7FD4BB1926913D80556FDDC" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>for the voluntary negotiation period for the price applicability period (and, if applicable, before any period of renegotiation specified pursuant to paragraph (2)) with respect to such drug all information that the Secretary requires to carry out the negotiation (or renegotiation process) under this part, including information described in section 1192(f) and section 1194(d)(1); and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H82AAA44291FA4EA695EDD63D2928D7F9" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>on an ongoing basis, information on changes in prices for such drug that would affect the AIM price for such drug or otherwise provide a basis for renegotiation of the maximum fair price for such drug pursuant to paragraph (2);</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H8EE97CC0A2654F78802989E928956399" class="indent1"><num value="5">“(5) </num>
<content>the manufacturer agrees that in the case the selected drug of a manufacturer is a drug described in subsection (c), the manufacturer will, in accordance with such subsection, make any payment required under such subsection with respect to such drug; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H8DA420F83DF7451488CA2C3EEADEF601" class="indent1"><num value="6">“(6) </num>
<content>the manufacturer complies with requirements imposed by the Secretary for purposes of administering the program, including with respect to the duties described in section 1196.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H93446332C5F949D797C0282C6C62E156" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Agreement in Effect Until Drug Is No Longer a Selected Drug</inline>.—</heading>
<content>An agreement entered into under this section shall be effective, with respect to a drug, until such drug is no longer considered a selected drug under section 1192(c).</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HD7AA72141DE445C3AC148A492E69F5EB" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special Rule for Certain Selected Drugs Without AIM Price</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H2E61135F482949C1B27668E981AE8214" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>In the case of a selected drug for which there is no AIM price available with respect to the initial price applicability year for such drug and for which an AIM price becomes available beginning with respect to a subsequent plan year during the price applicability period for such drug, if the Secretary determines that the amount described in paragraph (2)(A) for a unit of such drug is greater than the amount described in paragraph (2)(B) for a unit of such drug, then by not later than one year after the date of such determination, the manufacturer of such selected drug shall pay to the Treasury an amount equal to the product of—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H68EAE07E49304642ADDE9151606BD9B7" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>the difference between such amount described in paragraph (2)(A) for a unit of such drug and such amount described in paragraph (2)(B) for a unit of such drug; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H2CCB1B79EE484C258637C7E240D3AAA7" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>the number of units of such drug sold in the United States, including the 50 States, the District of Columbia, and the territories of the United States, during the period described in paragraph (2)(B).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H84E45DCC5BBC45A6BE4A52A695F82D0F" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Amounts described</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H2289C62C24C646CEA3D62E2C7DA622FE" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Weighted average price before aim price available</inline>.—</heading>
<content>For purposes of paragraph (1), the amount described in this subparagraph for a selected drug described in such paragraph, is the amount equal to the weighted average manufacturer price (as defined in section 1927(k)(1)) for such dosage strength and form for the drug during the period beginning with the first plan year for which the drug is included on the list of negotiation-eligible drugs published under section 1192(d) and ending with the last plan year during the price applicability period for such drug with respect to which there is no AIM price available for such drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H34323DFEA532462AA761179DE1B45CF5" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Amount multiplier after aim price available</inline>.—</heading>
<content>For purposes of paragraph (1), the amount described in this subparagraph for a selected drug described in such paragraph, is the amount equal to 200 percent of the AIM price for such drug with respect to the first plan year during the price applicability period for such drug with respect to which there is an AIM price available for such drug.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H738C7A30C5514D1884B2B1849122601A" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Confidentiality of Information</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Information submitted to the Secretary under this part by a manufacturer of a selected drug that is proprietary information of such manufacturer (as determined by the Secretary) may be used only by the Secretary or disclosed to and used by the Comptroller General of the United States or the Medicare Payment Advisory Commission for purposes of carrying out this part.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H73B81E2C368540219742D1D4D0793E71" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Regulations</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H13BE8E50CBB84D6CB631E0565221AA48" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary shall, pursuant to rulemaking, specify, in accordance with paragraph (2), the information that must be submitted under subsection (a)(4).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H273BE240EF6F42288A6EABD05F3DB956" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Information specified</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Information described in paragraph (1), with respect to a selected drug, shall include information on sales of the drug (by the manufacturer of the drug or by another entity under license or other agreement with the manufacturer, with respect to the sales of such drug, regardless of the name under which the drug is sold) in any foreign country that is part of the AIM price. The Secretary shall verify, to the extent practicable, such sales from appropriate officials of the government of the foreign country involved.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H6D93B68DE168411BB949BE7C86A56709" class="indent0"><num value="f">“(f) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Compliance With Requirements for Administration of Program</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Each manufacturer with an agreement in effect under this section shall comply with requirements imposed by the Secretary or a third party with a contract under section 1196(c)(1), as applicable, for purposes of administering the program.</content></subsection></section> 
<section id="HF860BD49E9814A4B9A5109F1007CEED9" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1194">“SEC. 1194. </num>
<heading>NEGOTIATION AND RENEGOTIATION PROCESS.</heading>
<subsection id="H1E1B867BA9164E08BEF23CC69FCF0FA4" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of this part, under an agreement under section 1193 between the Secretary and a manufacturer of a selected drug, with respect to the period for which such agreement is in effect and in accordance with subsections (b) and (c), the Secretary and the manufacturer—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H42F4CDC660254CF4A99365CA86C2B6C1" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<content>shall during the voluntary negotiation period with respect to the initial price applicability year for such drug, in accordance with this section, negotiate a maximum fair price for such drug for the purpose described in section 1193(a)(1); and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H62BC9B7415F44690A34133504876579B" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>as applicable pursuant to section 1193(a)(2) and in accordance with the process specified pursuant to such section, renegotiate such maximum fair price for such drug for the purpose described in such section.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H0D5FF0E720E5419FB6B11BB2E7C6C09B" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Negotiating Methodology and Objective</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HE197583AB6F44E0086A1FC9243E198A9" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary shall develop and use a consistent methodology for negotiations under subsection (a) that, in accordance with paragraph (2) and subject to paragraph (3), achieves the lowest maximum fair price for each selected drug while appropriately rewarding innovation.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H1C9CD1D0566445DBBE779703962EF2EA" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prioritizing factors</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>In considering the factors described in subsection (d) in negotiating (and, as applicable, renegotiating) the maximum fair price for a selected drug, the Secretary shall, to the extent practicable, consider all of the available factors listed but shall prioritize the following factors:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H4C47916242C9411E994351E0101790F5" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Research and development costs</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The factor described in paragraph (1)(A) of subsection (d).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H78B06E847BFE4E1694EC7E20998777C7" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Market data</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The factor described in paragraph (1)(B) of such subsection.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H8E3559925C2D476DADC087D00FC580F4" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Unit costs of production and distribution</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The factor described in paragraph (1)(C) of such subsection.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H37428BC41EC749DD9437C34855D6190F" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Comparison to existing therapeutic alternatives</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The factor described in paragraph (2)(A) of such subsection.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H135846C766BD4502B1089862B6746310" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Requirement</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H829CED9122CA475BAFF4C05F0A7E958A" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In negotiating the maximum fair price of a selected drug, with respect to an initial price applicability year for the selected drug, and, as applicable, in renegotiating the maximum fair price for such drug, with respect to a subsequent year during the price applicability period for such drug, in the case that the manufacturer of the selected drug offers under the negotiation or renegotiation, as applicable, a price for such drug that is not more than the target price described in subparagraph (B) for such drug for the respective year, the Secretary shall agree under such negotiation or renegotiation, respectively, to such offered price as the maximum fair price.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HF8B6616444054C3084CC56C7890076AA" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Target price</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="HB5B90F8B9FB645E283451375828BAB7A" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Subject to clause (ii), the target price described in this subparagraph for a selected drug with respect to a year, is the average price (which shall be the net average price, if practicable, and volume-weighted, if practicable) for a unit of such drug for sales of such drug, as computed (across different dosage forms and strengths of the drug and not based on the specific formulation or package size or package type of the drug) in the applicable country described in section 1191(c)(3)(B) with respect to such drug that, with respect to such year, has the lowest average price for such drug as compared to the average prices (as so computed) of such drug with respect to such year in the other applicable countries described in such section with respect to such drug.</content></clause>
<clause id="H9FACC0A8FA3F4E689D01449108A01DCF" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Selected drugs without aim price</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In applying this paragraph in the case of negotiating the maximum fair price of a selected drug for which there is no AIM price available with respect to the initial price applicability year for such drug, or, as applicable, renegotiating the maximum fair price for such drug with respect to a subsequent year during the price applicability period for such drug before the first plan year for which there is an AIM price available for such drug, the target price described in this subparagraph for such drug and respective year is the amount that is 80 percent of the average manufacturer price (as defined in section 1927(k)(1)) for such drug and year.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC62B3119B4F846B6AB85DD789AC75ECF" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Annual report</inline>.—</heading>
<content>After the completion of each voluntary negotiation period, the Secretary shall submit to Congress a report on the maximum fair prices negotiated (or, as applicable, renegotiated) for such period. Such report shall include information on how such prices so negotiated (or renegotiated) meet the requirements of this part, including the requirements of this subsection.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H981C0C47558748508916F4ABEC793F8D" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H9E75C29FE6F640049ACAB457251BBFEA" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Subject to paragraph (2), the maximum fair price negotiated (including as renegotiated) under this section for a selected drug, with respect to each plan year during a price applicability period for such drug, shall not exceed 120 percent of the AIM price applicable to such drug with respect to such year.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HCA47BBF9BAB6454EA41D5C1308FB862B" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Selected drugs without aim price</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In the case of a selected drug for which there is no AIM price available with respect to the initial price applicability year for such drug, for each plan year during the price applicability period before the first plan year for which there is an AIM price available for such drug, the maximum fair price negotiated (including as renegotiated) under this section for the selected drug shall not exceed the amount equal to 85 percent of the average manufacturer price for the drug with respect to such year.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HB1B4F63AFCDA49E4A9B6BB46882F4FBF" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Considerations</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of negotiating and, as applicable, renegotiating (including for purposes of determining whether to renegotiate) the maximum fair price of a selected drug under this part with the manufacturer of the drug, the Secretary shall, consistent with subsection (b)(2), take into consideration the following factors:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HB2606BAA91C54F17AA5FA0138F7C9B28" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Manufacturer-specific information</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The following information, including as submitted by the manufacturer:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H2A101B005F13405B803929A5C069B4BF" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>Research and development costs of the manufacturer for the drug and the extent to which the manufacturer has recouped research and development costs.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H886EF01B743641C0AF082B1821307E8D" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>Market data for the drug, including the distribution of sales across different programs and purchasers and projected future revenues for the drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H6F9A719635A144EFB057F431D0E34CDE" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<content>Unit costs of production and distribution of the drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H52D3320E50394FE195C00E7E2B9783DC" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num>
<content>Prior Federal financial support for novel therapeutic discovery and development with respect to the drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H430A451EC76E4C60BB9E7D39BE64E1B1" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num>
<content>Data on patents and on existing and pending exclusivity for the drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HFC274FD3B4374339B35BC4982AD71DC5" class="indent2"><num value="F">“(F) </num>
<content>National sales data for the drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H7A458FA2A6364807A9922D39957BD854" class="indent2"><num value="G">“(G) </num>
<content>Information on clinical trials for the drug in the United States or in applicable countries described in section 1191(c)(3)(B).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HEF61FB7A0A4D4C01AA9BCE144CFC48ED" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Information on alternative products</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The following information:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H75F017BC52524D13B0B69529023D9C33" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>The extent to which the drug represents a therapeutic advance as compared to existing therapeutic alternatives and, to the extent such information is available, the costs of such existing therapeutic alternatives.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H95D8BCF8D25A42C693594B87EA8F7AC8" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>Information on approval by the Food and Drug Administration of alternative drug products.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H04D937F7B245483493C570922BAF4A54" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<content>Information on comparative effectiveness analysis for such products, taking into consideration the effects of such products on specific populations, such as individuals with disabilities, the elderly, terminally ill, children, and other patient populations.</content></subparagraph>
<continuation class="indent0">In considering information described in subparagraph (C), the Secretary shall not use evidence or findings from comparative clinical effectiveness research in a manner that treats extending the life of an elderly, disabled, or terminally ill individual as of lower value than extending the life of an individual who is younger, nondisabled, or not terminally ill. Nothing in the previous sentence shall affect the application or consideration of an AIM price for a selected drug.</continuation></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HA8F852B44EA94ADBBDF1FEF87DBDE1BD" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Foreign sales information</inline>.—</heading>
<content>To the extent available on a timely basis, including as provided by a manufacturer of the selected drug or otherwise, information on sales of the selected drug in each of the countries described in section 1191(c)(3)(B).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H87EB8E750FC74684B97E9333978EA05A" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Additional information</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Information submitted to the Secretary, in accordance with a process specified by the Secretary, by other parties that are affected by the establishment of a maximum fair price for the selected drug.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HD4B6ECF7187A4B6B82B94A34971823AD" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Request for Information</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of negotiating and, as applicable, renegotiating (including for purposes of determining whether to renegotiate) the maximum fair price of a selected drug under this part with the manufacturer of the drug, with respect to a price applicability period, and other relevant data for purposes of this section—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HC3FFDEA645BA4E8C9C5699132930F35F" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<content>the Secretary shall, not later than the selected drug publication date with respect to the initial price applicability year of such period, request drug pricing information from the manufacturer of such selected drug, including information described in subsection (d)(1); and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H954AB310119148D7B81F301DDF3FCC20" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>by not later than October 1 following the selected drug publication date, the manufacturer of such selected drug shall submit to the Secretary such requested information in such form and manner as the Secretary may require.</content></paragraph>
<continuation class="indent0">The Secretary shall request, from the manufacturer or others, such additional information as may be needed to carry out the negotiation and renegotiation process under this section.</continuation></subsection></section> 
<section id="HA6AE0DD30BF74DB6907A1B5A51269DD6" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1195">“SEC. 1195. </num>
<heading>PUBLICATION OF MAXIMUM FAIR PRICES.</heading>
<subsection id="HF19702CB138A4AD8BC9663577EFA1F27" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<content>With respect to an initial price applicability year and selected drug with respect to such year, not later than April 1 of the plan year prior to such initial price applicability year, the Secretary shall publish in the Federal Register the maximum fair price for such drug negotiated under this part with the manufacturer of such drug.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H4EC1B2C5BFB04B38B5A97201266611AB" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Updates</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HCB7524427DDA43B195D0341B788183F6" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Subsequent year maximum fair prices</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For a selected drug, for each plan year subsequent to the initial price applicability year for such drug with respect to which an agreement for such drug is in effect under section 1193, the Secretary shall publish in the Federal Register—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H6916459DC1A949A3B53CF3FDDBA2D877" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>subject to subparagraph (B), the amount equal to the maximum fair price published for such drug for the previous year, increased by the annual percentage increase in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (all items; U.S. city average) as of September of such previous year; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC6285D23D9494494BFEEF1DED5226592" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>in the case the maximum fair price for such drug was renegotiated, for the first year for which such price as so renegotiated applies, such renegotiated maximum fair price.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H5E35345EC8A64CF9A2C23C578B856390" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prices negotiated after deadline</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In the case of a selected drug with respect to an initial price applicability year for which the maximum fair price is determined under this part after the date of publication under this section, the Secretary shall publish such maximum fair price in the Federal Register by not later than 30 days after the date such maximum price is so determined.</content></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H1F90F95ADE644063B2FCA20190B1CC5B" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1196">“SEC. 1196. </num>
<heading>ADMINISTRATIVE DUTIES; COORDINATION PROVISIONS.</heading>
<subsection id="HE48C35679D8A4E5981608239BCE13099" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Administrative Duties</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H42C671171C2648BAA71184AA1D702DFD" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of section 1191, the administrative duties described in this section are the following:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HD5345B329B71420688C48F7DC47D4186" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>The establishment of procedures (including through agreements with manufacturers under this part, contracts with prescription drug plans under part D of title XVIII and MA–PD plans under part C of such title, and agreements under section 1197 with group health plans and health insurance issuers of health insurance coverage offered in the individual or group market) under which the maximum fair price for a selected drug is provided to fair price eligible individuals, who with respect to such drug are described in subparagraph (A) of section 1191(c)(1), at pharmacies or by mail order service at the point-of-sale of the drug for the applicable price period for such drug and providing that such maximum fair price is used for determining cost-sharing under such plans or coverage for the selected drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H2DB67A89D9164023863B518691EB219E" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>The establishment of procedures (including through agreements with manufacturers under this part and contracts with hospitals, physicians, and other providers of services and suppliers and agreements under section 1197 with group health plans and health insurance issuers of health insurance coverage offered in the individual or group market) under which, in the case of a selected drug furnished or administered by such a hospital, physician, or other provider of services or supplier to fair price eligible individuals (who with respect to such drug are described in subparagraph (B) of section 1191(c)(1)), the maximum fair price for the selected drug is provided to such hospitals, physicians, and other providers of services and suppliers (as applicable) with respect to such individuals and providing that such maximum fair price is used for determining cost-sharing under the respective part, plan, or coverage for the selected drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H5B6778FF6E7740DCB9E1AC9E8303A277" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<chapeau>The establishment of procedures (including through agreements and contracts described in subparagraphs (A) and (B)) to ensure that, not later than 90 days after the dispensing of a selected drug to a fair price eligible individual by a pharmacy or mail order service, the pharmacy or mail order service is reimbursed for an amount equal to the difference between—</chapeau>
<clause id="HA731799FF50040168C496B64D19BBDB6" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<chapeau>the lesser of—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H832306AB6645418E9DBF9D8DC9698F6A" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num>
<content>the wholesale acquisition cost of the drug;</content></subclause>
<subclause id="HFA667FB7B73746D18AD698F9B3D995A9" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num>
<content>the national average drug acquisition cost of the drug; and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H0E935D9BE7004E518BFC7949BBF340AA" class="indent4"><num value="III">“(III) </num>
<content>any other similar determination of pharmacy acquisition costs of the drug, as determined by the Secretary; and</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="HA71C4FD238E84C2EBFCC9FF6F8BB1D67" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>the maximum fair price for the drug.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H93DD2609995546CB8055D7A39112EAD1" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num>
<chapeau>The establishment of procedures to ensure that the maximum fair price for a selected drug is applied before—</chapeau>
<clause id="HE754BAFBC139450DBD7DCE820912782C" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>any coverage or financial assistance under other health benefit plans or programs that provide coverage or financial assistance for the purchase or provision of prescription drug coverage on behalf of fair price eligible individuals as the Secretary may specify; and</content></clause>
<clause id="HA4951D5A3AF74885B50DFA8666C07559" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>any other discounts.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H82FE15A0898344138E4B5C1F28C3B86B" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num>
<content>The establishment of procedures to enter into appropriate agreements and protocols for the ongoing computation of AIM prices for selected drugs, including, to the extent possible, to compute the AIM price for selected drugs and including by providing that the manufacturer of such a selected drug should provide information for such computation not later than 3 months after the first date of the voluntary negotiation period for such selected drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H48543708536747D292C24C6DB4D915A8" class="indent2"><num value="F">“(F) </num>
<content>The establishment of procedures to compute and apply the maximum fair price across different strengths and dosage forms of a selected drug and not based on the specific formulation or package size or package type of the drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD6DF678B50B343E8A0DA4D7D468BCA9B" class="indent2"><num value="G">“(G) </num>
<content>The establishment of procedures to negotiate and apply the maximum fair price in a manner that does not include any dispensing or similar fee.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HDDDDB368CC9C4D918A639E59F0A909F5" class="indent2"><num value="H">“(H) </num>
<chapeau>The establishment of procedures to carry out the provisions of this part, as applicable, with respect to—</chapeau>
<clause id="H42127555A38E4C9995FAF75FB1A6D245" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>fair price eligible individuals who are enrolled under a prescription drug plan under part D of title XVIII or an MA–PD plan under part C of such title;</content></clause>
<clause id="HBD191356272A484BAFFF2803B2350CC7" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>fair price eligible individuals who are enrolled under a group health plan or health insurance coverage offered by a health insurance issuer in the individual or group market with respect to which there is an agreement in effect under section 1197; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H9813E03C6B894E19BE8779C746E8F3C1" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num>
<content>fair price eligible individuals who are entitled to benefits under part A of title XVIII or enrolled under part B of such title.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H7ABD81764C894BC09798F3915328FC11" class="indent2"><num value="I">“(I) </num>
<content>The establishment of a negotiation process and renegotiation process in accordance with section 1194, including a process for acquiring information described in subsection (d) of such section and determining amounts described in subsection (b) of such section.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H9A417DECD5B146A08EC4BB160FC15E3F" class="indent2"><num value="J">“(J) </num>
<content>The provision of a reasonable dispute resolution mechanism to resolve disagreements between manufacturers, fair price eligible individuals, and the third party with a contract under subsection (c)(1).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HDDA77A333AE74C3BBD63940A92CB8CE8" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Monitoring compliance</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="HBD4F9E4433C7479AAC514416DE60EA82" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary shall monitor compliance by a manufacturer with the terms of an agreement under section 1193, including by establishing a mechanism through which violations of such terms may be reported.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H2113413E313540C69A3D907643EC6A09" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notification</inline>.—</heading>
<content>If a third party with a contract under subsection (c)(1) determines that the manufacturer is not in compliance with such agreement, the third party shall notify the Secretary of such noncompliance for appropriate enforcement under <ref href="usc/26/4192">section 4192</ref> of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 or section 1198, as applicable.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H458AA112F678452CA939EF4F48171A90" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Collection of Data</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H5E70A05BC438471FB2740AC9D321FD76" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">From prescription drug plans and ma–pd plans</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary may collect appropriate data from prescription drug plans under part D of title XVIII and MA–PD plans under part C of such title in a timeframe that allows for maximum fair prices to be provided under this part for selected drugs.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H551E833AB3624280A79216427C4658F3" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">From health plans</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary may collect appropriate data from group health plans or health insurance issuers offering group or individual health insurance coverage in a timeframe that allows for maximum fair prices to be provided under this part for selected drugs.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HFEA65CEF13544907A61A0A87437900B6" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Contract With Third Parties</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H891FD2BED27740189A8FB82C97ED52E5" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The Secretary may enter into a contract with 1 or more third parties to administer the requirements established by the Secretary in order to carry out this part. At a minimum, the contract with a third party under the preceding sentence shall require that the third party—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HED83590E78E7492BA9102F991E3FFEB7" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>receive and transmit information between the Secretary, manufacturers, and other individuals or entities the Secretary determines appropriate;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H89FB79EF604E4EDE93825DCB370BF667" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>receive, distribute, or facilitate the distribution of funds of manufacturers to appropriate individuals or entities in order to meet the obligations of manufacturers under agreements under this part;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD2147CC2559A455FBEA735705EA44165" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<content>provide adequate and timely information to manufacturers, consistent with the agreement with the manufacturer under this part, as necessary for the manufacturer to fulfill its obligations under this part; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H64852285DFFE4826B0210924D4DCBE1A" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num>
<content>permit manufacturers to conduct periodic audits, directly or through contracts, of the data and information used by the third party to determine discounts for applicable drugs of the manufacturer under the program.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HAFC6845B53364F20943662D2B8994F04" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Performance requirements</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary shall establish performance requirements for a third party with a contract under paragraph (1) and safeguards to protect the independence and integrity of the activities carried out by the third party under the program under this part.</content></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H0C2250EBA4FA4BB7A340C52E0DF9EBD1" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1197">“SEC. 1197. </num>
<heading>VOLUNTARY PARTICIPATION BY OTHER HEALTH PLANS.</heading>
<subsection id="H1F7417F803524600B87CB5D68A9F41DC" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Agreement to Participate Under Program</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau/>
<paragraph id="H771E5F8DBBE94589873ACA3EBB2605D4" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>Subject to paragraph (2), under the program under this part the Secretary shall be treated as having in effect an agreement with a group health plan or health insurance issuer offering health insurance coverage (as such terms are defined in section 2791 of the Public Health Service Act), with respect to a price applicability period and a selected drug with respect to such period—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HBBF67CF250684B6D85CA3F3C487697E2" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>with respect to such selected drug furnished or dispensed at a pharmacy or by mail order service if coverage is provided under such plan or coverage during such period for such selected drug as so furnished or dispensed; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD709605410E342209E716245D342DD40" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>with respect to such selected drug furnished or administered by a hospital, physician, or other provider of services or supplier if coverage is provided under such plan or coverage during such period for such selected drug as so furnished or administered.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H4166BBB5CD604EB79523E61FDAF08ECC" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Opting out of agreement</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary shall not be treated as having in effect an agreement under the program under this part with a group health plan or health insurance issuer offering health insurance coverage with respect to a price applicability period and a selected drug with respect to such period if such a plan or issuer affirmatively elects, through a process specified by the Secretary, not to participate under the program with respect to such period and drug.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HDF95636B82CF491298D14B78844052AF" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Publication of Election</inline>.—</heading>
<content>With respect to each price applicability period and each selected drug with respect to such period, the Secretary and the Secretary of Labor and the Secretary of the Treasury, as applicable, shall make public a list of each group health plan and each issuer of health insurance coverage, with respect to which coverage is provided under such plan or coverage for such drug, that has elected under subsection (a) not to participate under the program with respect to such period and drug.</content></subsection></section> 
<section id="H96F188CA53A54D5F852AFA1D36C1ADB4" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1198">“SEC. 1198. </num>
<heading>CIVIL MONETARY PENALTY.</heading>
<subsection id="H9186A7B1B88F4141A991D818542E3E1F" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Violations Relating To Offering of Maximum Fair Price</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>Any manufacturer of a selected drug that has entered into an agreement under section 1193, with respect to a plan year during the price applicability period for such drug, that does not provide access to a price that is not more than the maximum fair price (or a lesser price) for such drug for such year—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HBAD1E20699974DC798904EFD3BB3E710" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<content>to a fair price eligible individual who with respect to such drug is described in subparagraph (A) of section 1191(c)(1) and who is furnished or dispensed such drug during such year; or</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H19DBFBC738784767A507B58307EFF08E" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>to a hospital, physician, or other provider of services or supplier with respect to fair price eligible individuals who with respect to such drug is described in subparagraph (B) of such section and is furnished or administered such drug by such hospital, physician, or provider or supplier during such year;</content></paragraph>
<continuation class="indent0">shall be subject to a civil monetary penalty equal to ten times the amount equal to the difference between the price for such drug made available for such year by such manufacturer with respect to such individual or hospital, physician, provider, or supplier and the maximum fair price for such drug for such year.</continuation></subsection>
<subsection id="HB2E7DCD199484DB6AB1931DEA3962EAD" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Violations of Certain Terms of Agreement</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Any manufacturer of a selected drug that has entered into an agreement under section 1193, with respect to a plan year during the price applicability period for such drug, that is in violation of a requirement imposed pursuant to section 1193(a)(6) shall be subject to a civil monetary penalty of not more than $1,000,000 for each such violation.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H293D0655EA98434FB3446AD1C72A5BAE" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Application</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The provisions of section 1128A (other than subsections (a) and (b)) shall apply to a civil monetary penalty under this section in the same manner as such provisions apply to a penalty or proceeding under section 1128A(a).</content></subsection></section> 
<section id="H4C55FAEF3DF7478BB493FABA9C8E4E6B" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1199">“SEC. 1199. </num>
<heading>MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS.</heading>
<subsection id="H00A56F6147624AC78D4D64A3018954A0" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Paperwork Reduction Act</inline>.—</heading>
<content><ref href="usc-chapter/44/35">Chapter 35</ref> of <ref href="/us/usc/t44">title 44, United States Code</ref>, shall not apply to data collected under this part.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H7C2A58C80035475081656F70A5018BD0" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">National Academy of Medicine Study</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Not later than December 31, 2025, the National Academy of Medicine shall conduct a study, and submit to Congress a report, on recommendations for improvements to the program under this part, including the determination of the limits applied under section 1194(c).</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H1DDC9B9E3C1E4824829D0A289FBDADC5" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">MedPAC Study</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Not later than December 31, 2025, the Medicare Payment Advisory Commission shall conduct a study, and submit to Congress a report, on the program under this part with respect to the Medicare program under title XVIII, including with respect to the effect of the program on individuals entitled to benefits or enrolled under such title.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HA21BAFC572A241A89BA1E95E1EA5B951" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation on Judicial Review</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The following shall not be subject to judicial review:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HCBA13D7F085E4FDAAA80F138413C287F" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<content>The selection of drugs for publication under section 1192(a).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H788B7CB5C1E649DBB173773E9711444E" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>The determination of whether a drug is a negotiation-eligible drug under section 1192(d).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HEF38DF83B3D54A3E85DCC3BEBC420FDB" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<content>The determination of the maximum fair price of a selected drug under section 1194.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF418104DFECD4825911739912DEF9BF2" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<content>The determination of units of a drug for purposes of section 1191(c)(3).</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HDA9EE653E3FB482781B7C5D77E195245" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Coordination</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In carrying out this part with respect to group health plans or health insurance coverage offered in the group market that are subject to oversight by the Secretary of Labor or the Secretary of the Treasury, the Secretary of Health and Human Services shall coordinate with such respective Secretary.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H3B7412AC48C74931B10FF6E311C3EE6B" class="indent0"><num value="f">“(f) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Data Sharing</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary shall share with the Secretary of the Treasury such information as is necessary to determine the tax imposed by <ref href="usc/26/4192">section 4192</ref> of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986.”.</content></subsection></section></part></quotedContent></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s101/b" id="H17F6B2F9E82843EB8E93A3D3466581A9" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Application of Maximum Fair Prices and Conforming Amendments</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s101/b/1" id="H4654F8E3B098446CABBF8D87E3D9224C" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num>

<chapeau/>
<subparagraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s101/b/1/A" id="HF066F58C16734B61AE5E4A656CB3A3BB" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num>

<subparagraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s101/b/1/B" id="HA4BE5847F90A496796F887C0F79C3741" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num>

<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s101/b/1/C/i" id="HD47994198E214721B1EE207AD92B25D6" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num>
<content>in subparagraph (B), by <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> “<quotedText>, subject to subparagraph (D),</quotedText>” after “<quotedText>negotiated prices</quotedText>”; and</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s101/b/1/C/ii" id="H6227B16FD2C9496DAE2A0452C5B9B3B6" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num>
