<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIII/s301/c" id="H01BDF1DF0CC743DFB663DACA4AB875CD" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Manufacturer Discount Program</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIII/s301/c/1" id="HE8F708B1823E424EB7186D391FBAC806" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Part D of title XVIII of the Social Security Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t42/s1395w–101">42 U.S.C. 1395w–101</ref> et seq.), as amended by section 202, is further amended by <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> after section 1860D–14B the following new section:<quotedContent meta="committee ID HWM00" id="H44E3826D3FF049238D10B8ED1A1F5572" styleType="OLC"> 
<section id="H278A77E16A6547E1A23F2985532A90A2" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1860D14C">“SEC. 1860D–14C. </num>
<heading>MANUFACTURER DISCOUNT PROGRAM.</heading>
<subsection id="H2AC956C39FBD490A8760111632E5F7E0" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Establishment</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary shall establish a manufacturer discount program (in this section referred to as the ‘program’). Under the program, the Secretary shall enter into agreements described in subsection (b) with manufacturers and provide for the performance of the duties described in subsection (c). The Secretary shall establish a model agreement for use under the program by not later than January 1, 2021, in consultation with manufacturers, and allow for comment on such model agreement.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H14A1427FCD5A4E9C843F918C069C34B8" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Terms of Agreement</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H23B16A869CFC4499A1471239E92C87FA" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="HD3E3A27B2DC14E159C38A67A2651FF39" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Agreement</inline>.—</heading>
<content>An agreement under this section shall require the manufacturer to provide applicable beneficiaries access to discounted prices for applicable drugs of the manufacturer that are dispensed on or after January 1, 2022.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC89AC0200FBE41E9A5053A0B7A1CF00A" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Provision of discounted prices at the point-of-sale</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The discounted prices described in subparagraph (A) shall be provided to the applicable beneficiary at the pharmacy or by the mail order service at the point-of-sale of an applicable drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC25DEADA30E14D39A2EA374EA6441C0E" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Timing of agreement</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="HAC7D97922C694EE8904CBCD3CE4243C5" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special rule for 2022</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In order for an agreement with a manufacturer to be in effect under this section with respect to the period beginning on January 1, 2022, and ending on December 31, 2022, the manufacturer shall enter into such agreement not later than 30 days after the date of the establishment of a model agreement under subsection (a).</content></clause>
<clause id="H79E3D88254DC4E1EB3EA8AD54187158A" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">2023 and subsequent years</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In order for an agreement with a manufacturer to be in effect under this section with respect to plan year 2023 or a subsequent plan year, the manufacturer shall enter into such agreement (or such agreement shall be renewed under paragraph (4)(A)) not later than January 30 of the preceding year.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H6B75FBE498E3405E8D8AEF0E6EFFD475" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Provision of appropriate data</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Each manufacturer with an agreement in effect under this section shall collect and have available appropriate data, as determined by the Secretary, to ensure that it can demonstrate to the Secretary compliance with the requirements under the program.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H5C72F85459EF41F5A48C24CD96C490A9" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Compliance with requirements for administration of program</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Each manufacturer with an agreement in effect under this section shall comply with requirements imposed by the Secretary or a third party with a contract under subsection (d)(3), as applicable, for purposes of administering the program, including any determination under subparagraph (A) of subsection (c)(1) or procedures established under such subsection (c)(1).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H88C0E37544C44839BF078FFF1874FF70" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Length of agreement</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H69BE73872AB34FCA822069C6B6375591" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>An agreement under this section shall be effective for an initial period of not less than 12 months and shall be automatically renewed for a period of not less than 1 year unless terminated under subparagraph (B).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H29D422328F38425F82D78111AA7052C7" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Termination</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="H10A112187A1A417595AE5BEFEEA469B8" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">By the secretary</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary may provide for termination of an agreement under this section for a knowing and willful violation of the requirements of the agreement or other good cause shown. Such termination shall not be effective earlier than 30 days after the date of notice to the manufacturer of such termination. The Secretary shall provide, upon request, a manufacturer with a hearing concerning such a termination, and such hearing shall take place prior to the effective date of the termination with sufficient time for such effective date to be repealed if the Secretary determines appropriate.</content></clause>
<clause id="H61CC5615BB9A42B9ADED34C3E6030AAE" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">By a manufacturer</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>A manufacturer may terminate an agreement under this section for any reason. Any such termination shall be effective, with respect to a plan year—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HD242712C13034E9CB14DBE1E4BF5208A" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num>
<content>if the termination occurs before January 30 of a plan year, as of the day after the end of the plan year; and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H8255CC0D587D406BB46C52374311DD43" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num>
<content>if the termination occurs on or after January 30 of a plan year, as of the day after the end of the succeeding plan year.</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="HC17B0330522244E2AB39142E38FF096F" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effectiveness of termination</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Any termination under this subparagraph shall not affect discounts for applicable drugs of the manufacturer that are due under the agreement before the effective date of its termination.</content></clause>
<clause id="H14DF874D796A4C0788255C7042693CF4" class="indent3"><num value="iv">“(iv) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notice to third party</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary shall provide notice of such termination to a third party with a contract under subsection (d)(3) within not less than 30 days before the effective date of such termination.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H24FDBECB5E064936AB8084FEA28491B2" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Duties Described</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The duties described in this subsection are the following:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H9589C37AA6CB41C18090464FCA91880C" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Administration of program</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>Administering the program, including—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HEA461BAE64D64271BAC0301BD4E8C027" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>the determination of the amount of the discounted price of an applicable drug of a manufacturer;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H22D94A4466064C938A3AC5D972CC6EBA" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>the establishment of procedures under which discounted prices are provided to applicable beneficiaries at pharmacies or by mail order service at the point-of-sale of an applicable drug;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H42802022931B41B9923AC60BDFB66D91" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<chapeau>the establishment of procedures to ensure that, not later than the applicable number of calendar days after the dispensing of an applicable drug by a pharmacy or mail order service, the pharmacy or mail order service is reimbursed for an amount equal to the difference between—</chapeau>
<clause id="H25D1315D4E534F8F8D15EDE8961C4887" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>the negotiated price of the applicable drug; and</content></clause>
<clause id="HAAD5465C07674E8E81CD67C050BCAC41" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>the discounted price of the applicable drug;</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HAF40761D6D9F4717A272ED19D0C4966E" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num>
<content>the establishment of procedures to ensure that the discounted price for an applicable drug under this section is applied before any coverage or financial assistance under other health benefit plans or programs that provide coverage or financial assistance for the purchase or provision of prescription drug coverage on behalf of applicable beneficiaries as the Secretary may specify; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H2BAF19A7DC074F1EA62B120766E600C5" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num>
<content>providing a reasonable dispute resolution mechanism to resolve disagreements between manufacturers, applicable beneficiaries, and the third party with a contract under subsection (d)(3).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF14CE9BDA4D24F8F9E7AC73C43235FF1" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Monitoring compliance</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H0FA52354B1BC4B189E893D2CD7F1AB76" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary shall monitor compliance by a manufacturer with the terms of an agreement under this section.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H2DD80691FBB34204B1D3E19A0087748A" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notification</inline>.—</heading>
<content>If a third party with a contract under subsection (d)(3) determines that the manufacturer is not in compliance with such agreement, the third party shall notify the Secretary of such noncompliance for appropriate enforcement under subsection (e).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF3C1136DC00747C0B7DFCB4B84B19229" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Collection of data from prescription drug plans and ma–pd plans</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary may collect appropriate data from prescription drug plans and MA–PD plans in a timeframe that allows for discounted prices to be provided for applicable drugs under this section.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HB3DA262ED285407C919C547AB64572AA" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Administration</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HFE94025A16E84505AC3CD734D35A65B2" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Subject to paragraph (2), the Secretary shall provide for the implementation of this section, including the performance of the duties described in subsection (c).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H185BEAD26BED44888C9363F102D41193" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In providing for the implementation of this section, the Secretary shall not receive or distribute any funds of a manufacturer under the program.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H2036EC79C0594CB69E7E2759AF26A5E5" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Contract with third parties</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The Secretary shall enter into a contract with 1 or more third parties to administer the requirements established by the Secretary in order to carry out this section. At a minimum, the contract with a third party under the preceding sentence shall require that the third party—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H311EC4B5D2F744B599B6ED272B002251" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>receive and transmit information between the Secretary, manufacturers, and other individuals or entities the Secretary determines appropriate;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H8FE55E89D12F49AD9F4873557F5BFFEC" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>receive, distribute, or facilitate the distribution of funds of manufacturers to appropriate individuals or entities in order to meet the obligations of manufacturers under agreements under this section;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD013DBF5B1C84F3E9793F9B483C9ED22" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<content>provide adequate and timely information to manufacturers, consistent with the agreement with the manufacturer under this section, as necessary for the manufacturer to fulfill its obligations under this section; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H9BF9A4F178F04268972D24B3069A0F03" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num>
<content>permit manufacturers to conduct periodic audits, directly or through contracts, of the data and information used by the third party to determine discounts for applicable drugs of the manufacturer under the program.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H70C26E4DC29A42039DB767D983CA3163" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Performance requirements</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary shall establish performance requirements for a third party with a contract under paragraph (3) and safeguards to protect the independence and integrity of the activities carried out by the third party under the program under this section.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H10D38909A17348F1988AD677EDA0F216" class="indent1"><num value="5">“(5) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Implementation</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the Secretary may implement the program under this section by program instruction or otherwise.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H488B5C78DE794D83BFFB3F8A9D365636" class="indent1"><num value="6">“(6) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Administration</inline>.—</heading>
<content><ref href="usc-chapter/44/35">Chapter 35</ref> of <ref href="/us/usc/t44">title 44, United States Code</ref>, shall not apply to the program under this section.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H59684BAD39C742AEAB4F44CC1CAD209E" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Enforcement</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H71437E1E8676450AA78EBDF6BE76EE5F" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Audits</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Each manufacturer with an agreement in effect under this section shall be subject to periodic audit by the Secretary.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H7308DDCA9851458384AC0BB9DEFB97D9" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Civil money penalty</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="HE239E1734772457B9C04FFE16894A6E4" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The Secretary may impose a civil money penalty on a manufacturer that fails to provide applicable beneficiaries discounts for applicable drugs of the manufacturer in accordance with such agreement for each such failure in an amount the Secretary determines is equal to the sum of—</chapeau>
<clause id="H7A8F86BF1DA1439FBA470EA187F325B8" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>the amount that the manufacturer would have paid with respect to such discounts under the agreement, which will then be used to pay the discounts which the manufacturer had failed to provide; and</content></clause>
<clause id="HE5D286A98C0D45139E686EAC52BCC4EA" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>25 percent of such amount.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HA8C27FA4DAA34AFAA5E0A83F56CEE4E1" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Application</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The provisions of section 1128A (other than subsections (a) and (b)) shall apply to a civil money penalty under this paragraph in the same manner as such provisions apply to a penalty or proceeding under section 1128A(a).</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HC032459DC07D4426A81FDCEA45247CC4" class="indent0"><num value="f">“(f) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Clarification Regarding Availability of Other Covered Part D Drugs</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Nothing in this section shall prevent an applicable beneficiary from purchasing a covered part D drug that is not an applicable drug (including a generic drug or a drug that is not on the formulary of the prescription drug plan or MA–PD plan that the applicable beneficiary is enrolled in).</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HE71994FB6E514B26A811F2FDC76E982E" class="indent0"><num value="g">“(g) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definitions</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>In this section:</chapeau>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H5A8FED57E4C948FD8E2C6A9E3E4766B3" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Applicable beneficiary</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The term ‘<term>applicable beneficiary</term>’ means an individual who, on the date of dispensing a covered part D drug—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HF011B440CA2646D2B112930D70FBF4CF" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>is enrolled in a prescription drug plan or an MA–PD plan;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HFD413B4B37894ED2B2C7E606A27897F6" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>is not enrolled in a qualified retiree prescription drug plan; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H4C0A8E9150DD4484A76E984D2CF30EB3" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<content>has incurred costs for covered part D drugs in the year that are equal to or exceed the annual deductible specified in section 1860D–2(b)(1) for such year.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H181707F38CF44359980EA5154E51457D" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Applicable drug</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The term ‘<term>applicable drug</term>’, with respect to an applicable beneficiary—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H31767E13F5CA487988C3DD9AA6B9439E" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<chapeau>means a covered part D drug—</chapeau>
<clause id="H389ABAF746EB4DDABE505A7E3DDA162E" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>approved under a new drug application under section 505(c) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act or, in the case of a biologic product, licensed under section 351 of the Public Health Service Act; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H890F489165404A25B3BE01ABE059465D" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii)</num>
<subclause id="HEBB4C873DC02410CA20C499487FCA6E6" class="inline"><num value="I">(I) </num>
<content>if the PDP sponsor of the prescription drug plan or the MA organization offering the MA–PD plan uses a formulary, which is on the formulary of the prescription drug plan or MA–PD plan that the applicable beneficiary is enrolled in;</content></subclause>
<subclause meta="committee ID HWM00" id="H5D851DC425F94836A963B322E3E9A364" class="indent3"><num value="II">“(II) </num>
<content>if the PDP sponsor of the prescription drug plan or the MA organization offering the MA–PD plan does not use a formulary, for which benefits are available under the prescription drug plan or MA–PD plan that the applicable beneficiary is enrolled in; or</content></subclause>
<subclause meta="committee ID HWM00" id="HFB3C6F1DFA6845279D2F2F236DCA5274" class="indent3"><num value="III">“(III) </num>
<content>is provided through an exception or appeal; and</content></subclause></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H80C816C1C5984E5BA7E1FC5A680B570C" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>does not include a selected drug (as defined in section 1192(c)) during a price applicability period (as defined in section 1191(b)(2)) with respect to such drug.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H2EC29801277A4B82A99CBCAEBFA981A2" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Applicable number of calendar days</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The term ‘<term>applicable number of calendar days</term>’ means—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HE4165F672F9D4EB0AA9F034A6CC77C68" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>with respect to claims for reimbursement submitted electronically, 14 days; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1067D4A53BA849A3B2FDDF572E6F9C85" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>with respect to claims for reimbursement submitted otherwise, 30 days.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H822E3DBC304F4786BE71C57723C4AEB9" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Discounted price</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="H1A728CAA3D744B82AD7081DF707EABFA" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The term ‘<term>discounted price</term>’ means, with respect to an applicable drug of a manufacturer furnished during a year to an applicable beneficiary—</chapeau>
<clause id="HD2B0E5FB65234499865E073AD6447BEF" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>who has not incurred costs for covered part D drugs in the year that are equal to or exceed the annual out-of-pocket threshold specified in section 1860D–2(b)(4)(B)(i) for the year, 90 percent of the negotiated price of such drug; and</content></clause>
<clause id="HD236FD22C3E94EED9D0CC76529155DA7" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>who has incurred such costs in the year that are equal to or exceed such threshold for the year, 70 percent of the negotiated price of such drug.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD225523AF35F441B8B63048D0F884CD8" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Clarification</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Nothing in this section shall be construed as affecting the responsibility of an applicable beneficiary for payment of a dispensing fee for an applicable drug.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H58AA7A10F0644AD2AD8475DF9470EA3C" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special case for certain claims</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="H6F29F3187DA7402092BCFB4B09BD115C" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Claims spanning deductible</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In the case where the entire amount of the negotiated price of an individual claim for an applicable drug with respect to an applicable beneficiary does not fall at or above the annual deductible specified in section 1860D–2(b)(1) for the year, the manufacturer of the applicable drug shall provide the discounted price under this section on only the portion of the negotiated price of the applicable drug that falls at or above such annual deductible.</content></clause>
<clause id="H6E279BEE174F4059B9ED609DD198DB55" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Claims spanning out-of-pocket threshold</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>In the case where the entire amount of the negotiated price of an individual claim for an applicable drug with respect to an applicable beneficiary does not fall entirely below or entirely above the annual out-of-pocket threshold specified in section 1860D–2(b)(4)(B)(i) for the year, the manufacturer of the applicable drug shall provide the discounted price—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H64E5193BED334B38B28D5F81D7E028FF" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num>
<content>in accordance with subparagraph (A)(i) on the portion of the negotiated price of the applicable drug that falls below such threshold; and</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H2FE6538C5F424F0FB36AC39E9FD4B0F7" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num>
<content>in accordance with subparagraph (A)(ii) on the portion of such price of such drug that falls at or above such threshold.</content></subclause></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="HD8A4B4B99CCB4BE78895F948E759620C" class="indent1"><num value="5">“(5) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Manufacturer</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>manufacturer</term>’ means any entity which is engaged in the production, preparation, propagation, compounding, conversion, or processing of prescription drug products, either directly or indirectly by extraction from substances of natural origin, or independently by means of chemical synthesis, or by a combination of extraction and chemical synthesis. Such term does not include a wholesale distributor of drugs or a retail pharmacy licensed under State law.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H8CF925D212D64520833A97F9A543C335" class="indent1"><num value="6">“(6) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Negotiated price</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>negotiated price</term>’ has the meaning given such term in <ref href="/us/cfr/t42/s423.100">section 423.100 of title 42, Code of Federal Regulations</ref> (or any successor regulation), except that, with respect to an applicable drug, such negotiated price shall not include any dispensing fee for the applicable drug.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H653B891448ED4E4FAB650F4D12A5F3EF" class="indent1"><num value="7">“(7) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Qualified retiree prescription drug plan</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>qualified retiree prescription drug plan</term>’ has the meaning given such term in section 1860D–22(a)(2).”.</content></paragraph></subsection></section></quotedContent></content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIII/s301/c/2" id="H16641DBA4D9943C2A4AF326B2B664F43" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Sunset of medicare coverage gap discount program</inline>.—</heading>

<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIII/s301/c/2/B" id="H4BD2BCA1BE9743659B0A1C22932CEE6E" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num>

<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Inclusion of actuarial value of manufacturer discounts in bids</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>Section 1860D–11 of the Social Security Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t42/s1395w–111">42 U.S.C. 1395w–111</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction>—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIII/s301/c/3/A" id="HFAE523B095A742708026106DD9F0251A" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num>
<chapeau>in subsection (b)(2)(C)(iii)—</chapeau>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIII/s301/c/3/A/i" id="HF36C3EEEDDEC4DCC88FAED4D3B4856B9" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num>

<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIII/s301/c/3/A/ii" id="H54EE657DAF324B50BF362FAA9C7F0E04" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num>
<content>by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following:<quotedContent meta="committee ID HWM00" id="HF82E8F73423740D2A85C812C386ABF80" styleType="OLC"> <subclause id="HE84A85CC710F444F941376F38FB58552" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num>

<heading>ALLOWING CERTAIN ENROLLEES OF PRESCRIPTION DRUGS PLANS AND MA–PD PLANS UNDER MEDICARE PROGRAM TO SPREAD OUT COST-SHARING UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES.</heading>
<chapeau class="indent0">Section 1860D–2(b)(2) of the Social Security Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t42/s1395w–102/b/2">42 U.S.C. 1395w–102(b)(2)</ref>), as amended by section 301, is further amended—</chapeau>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIII/s302/1" id="H154E3F59F6A0483F8AB27F1BB4B3D3EA" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num>

<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIII/s302/2" id="H6E01146483F74008BB9FF56CDDC15A09" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num>
<content>by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new subparagraph:<quotedContent meta="committee ID HWM00" id="H62C00BF93AE14A56942176F3413AF6EC" styleType="OLC"> <subparagraph id="H7923D473E16C4F0E995297DC67F1D8C5" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Enrollee option regarding spreading cost-sharing</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary shall establish by regulation a process under which, with respect to plan year 2022 and subsequent plan years, a prescription drug plan or an MA–PD plan shall, in the case of a part D eligible individual enrolled with such plan for such plan year who is not a subsidy eligible individual (as defined in section 1860D–14(a)(3)) and with respect to whom the plan projects that the dispensing of the first fill of a covered part D drug to such individual will result in the individual incurring costs that are equal to or above the annual out-of-pocket threshold specified in paragraph (4)(B) for such plan year, provide such individual with the option to make the coinsurance payment required under subparagraph (A) (for the portion of such costs that are not above such annual out-of-pocket threshold) in the form of periodic installments over the remainder of such plan year.”.</content></subparagraph></quotedContent></content></paragraph></section> 
<section role="subsequent-section instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIII/s303" id="H6BC68F1D6FF148E7B444BB6F6D66E145"><num value="303">SEC. 303. </num>
<heading>ESTABLISHMENT OF PHARMACY QUALITY MEASURES UNDER MEDICARE PART D.</heading>
<chapeau class="indent0">Section 1860D–4(c) of the Social Security Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t42/s1395w–104/c">42 U.S.C. 1395w–104(c)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction>—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIII/s303/1" id="HC4515BB6B4A342A4B453E24C7F26BAAC" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num>
<content>by <amendingAction type="redesignate">redesignating</amendingAction> the paragraph (6), as added by section 50354 of division E of the Bipartisan Budget Act of 2018 (<ref href="/us/pl/115/123">Public Law 115–123</ref>), as paragraph (7); and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIII/s303/2" id="H83E38C5CB1D3412AA059C84ED880F853" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num>
<content>by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new paragraph:<quotedContent meta="committee ID HWM00" id="H7E3BBED8EEC6448DBFA7741F5E90E9F3" styleType="OLC"> <paragraph id="HEBBA1AAB37FB43BDB244AF809B43A5B8" class="indent1"><num value="8">“(8) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Application of pharmacy quality measures</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H0D19EFC106DC4726A711FBB5177C62DD" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>A PDP sponsor that implements incentive payments to a pharmacy or price concessions paid by a pharmacy based on quality measures shall use measures established or approved by the Secretary under subparagraph (B) with respect to payment for covered part D drugs dispensed by such pharmacy.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H99C9F6A049D840FE8B6E507B1C9DE1A2" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Standard pharmacy quality measures</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary shall establish or approve standard quality measures from a consensus and evidence-based organization for payments described in subparagraph (A). Such measures shall focus on patient health outcomes and be based on proven criteria measuring pharmacy performance.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H377407DCA0EE4AAA813EBD6659CACF89" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effective date</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The requirement under subparagraph (A) shall take effect for plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2021, or such earlier date specified by the Secretary if the Secretary determines there are sufficient measures established or approved under subparagraph (B) to meet the requirement under subparagraph (A).”.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></quotedContent></content></paragraph></section></title>

<section role="subsequent-section instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tIV/s402" id="H52B1B0F009D3427395EAC421584C4E86"><num value="402">SEC. 402. </num>
<heading>DISSEMINATION TO MEDICARE PART D SUBSIDY ELIGIBLE INDIVIDUALS OF INFORMATION COMPARING PREMIUMS OF CERTAIN PRESCRIPTION DRUG PLANS.</heading>
<content>Section 1860D–1(c)(3) of the Social Security Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t42/s1395w–101/c/3">42 U.S.C. 1395w–101(c)(3)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new subparagraph:<quotedContent meta="committee ID HWM00" id="H1FEBF7C6F3B745E78A10C6C9AE31BC32" styleType="OLC"> <subparagraph id="H8AFB8705C2204BA0AFE637323C623B8E" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Information on premiums for subsidy eligible individuals</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="HBE09B81C12B84517A013A8A178FAF3ED" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>For plan year 2022 and each subsequent plan year, the Secretary shall disseminate to each subsidy eligible individual (as defined in section 1860D–14(a)(3)) information under this paragraph comparing premiums that would apply to such individual for prescription drug coverage under LIS benchmark plans, including, in the case of an individual enrolled in a prescription drug plan under this part, information that compares the premium that would apply if such individual were to remain enrolled in such plan to premiums that would apply if the individual were to enroll in other LIS benchmark plans.</content></clause>
<clause role="definitions" id="HF416D8714C254793804273DAA80CD774" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">LIS benchmark plan</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of clause (i), the term ‘<term>LIS benchmark plan</term>’ means, with respect to an individual, a prescription drug plan under this part that is offered in the region in which the individual resides and—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HCCF34CE088DA4CF683ED85E334D7FB54" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num>
<content>that provides for a premium that is not more than the low-income benchmark premium amount (as defined in section 1860D–14(b)(2)) for such region; or</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H73274748F6C4449E96C21FC96B9C7307" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num>
<content>with respect to which the premium would be waived as de minimis pursuant to section 1860D–14(a)(5) for such individual.”.</content></subclause></clause></subparagraph></quotedContent></content></section>

<title identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tV" id="H684E0FF4C43E45FE977DE520450BDECF"><num value="V">TITLE V—</num>
<heading class="inline">DRUG PRICE TRANSPARENCY</heading> 
<section role="subsequent-section instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tV/s501" id="H0CC439A184AD4337B739E64C72DA0343"><num value="501">SEC. 501. </num>
<heading>DRUG PRICE TRANSPARENCY.</heading>
<content>Part A of title XI of the Social Security Act <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new sections:<quotedContent meta="committee ID HWM00" id="HB46C46B26B2F48DF9CA69DF5FF275C85" styleType="OLC"> 
<section id="H3DDBBE7F78954C98B4B6AF0138CC56A5" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1150C">“SEC. 1150C. </num>
<heading>REPORTING ON DRUG PRICES.</heading>
<subsection id="H5E0A44234FB74927A58BD3507586C507" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definitions</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>In this section:</chapeau>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H2AC5B6E0BDBF484F912D4E732E749CAC" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Manufacturer</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The term ‘<term>manufacturer</term>’ means the person—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H5D0DE350271A4399BDF431F12258CC04" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>that holds the application for a drug approved under section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act or licensed under section 351 of the Public Health Service Act; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H2E0484D5194C4543AD350FC4AE1EF15F" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>who is responsible for setting the wholesale acquisition cost for the drug.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H33DA546696B34064A05EABEDD9B9E690" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Qualifying drug</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The term ‘<term>qualifying drug</term>’ means any drug that is approved under subsection (c) or (j) of section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act or licensed under subsection (a) or (k) of section 351 of the Public Health Service Act—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HC4514F65B1D6476CBD133C69FF1AA5C6" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<chapeau>that has a wholesale acquisition cost of $100 or more, adjusted for inflation occurring after the date of enactment of this section, for a month’s supply or a typical course of treatment that lasts less than a month, and is—</chapeau>
<clause id="H16347A8552D2451A9F2F59FEFF52F201" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>subject to section 503(b)(1) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H573D34483CF6487BAA6B0CA78D728FEA" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>not a preventative vaccine; and</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H2094C42DA01B47469111690B621E9623" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>for which, during the previous calendar year, at least 1 dollar of the total amount of sales were for individuals enrolled under the Medicare program under title XVIII or under a State Medicaid plan under title XIX or under a waiver of such plan.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="HBF9CA48C12F84E31B6A76FCD6C854388" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Wholesale acquisition cost</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>wholesale acquisition cost</term>’ has the meaning given that term in section 1847A(c)(6)(B).</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H4987AC877652411C878468E65F17860D" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Report</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H2E4F7FD267E440B4901C309CF8D4661A" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Report required</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The manufacturer of a qualifying drug shall submit a report to the Secretary if, with respect to the qualifying drug—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H9CEAEECDDA024426A75C684413C08505" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<chapeau>there is an increase in the price of the qualifying drug that results in an increase in the wholesale acquisition cost of that drug that is equal to—</chapeau>
<clause id="H5B1437EF99B34E10A176EA3125D69DBB" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>10 percent or more within a 12-month period beginning on or after January 1, 2019; or</content></clause>
<clause id="H47E5C39CD1924960B395F2780767115F" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>25 percent or more within a 36-month period beginning on or after January 1, 2019;</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H3C4D5DDCF81845EE8EF04F83FBE55717" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>the estimated price of the qualifying drug or spending per individual or per user of such drug (as estimated by the Secretary) for the applicable year (or per course of treatment in such applicable year as determined by the Secretary) is at least $26,000 beginning on or after January 1, 2021; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HCB6AD7C4A9394F17A225A1A71D5296B0" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<chapeau>there was an increase in the price of the qualifying drug that resulted in an increase in the wholesale acquisition cost of that drug that is equal to—</chapeau>
<clause id="H5584AAC4B72A4EDF9E2E68FA3BF9D5BB" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>10 percent or more within a 12-month period that begins and ends during the 5-year period preceding January 1, 2021; or</content></clause>
<clause id="H1F5595246F9B48D980701FDECE86F1D4" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>25 percent or more within a 36-month period that begins and ends during the 5-year period preceding January 1, 2021.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HBA3E2EEFA08048EA8540B4AA9DD9FFF5" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Report deadline</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>Each report described in paragraph (1) shall be submitted to the Secretary—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HA6B8D3B666A74C3EB75CD6D0C8574F9F" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>in the case of a report with respect to an increase in the price of a qualifying drug that occurs during the period beginning on January 1, 2019, and ending on the day that is 60 days after the date of the enactment of this section, not later than 90 days after such date of enactment;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H7B5B5F70098742E7912E64726F6C6211" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>in the case of a report with respect to an increase in the price of a qualifying drug that occurs after the period described in subparagraph (A), not later than 30 days prior to the planned effective date of such price increase for such qualifying drug;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H6FA7ED3A5D1740F6BAFDFC8135F5F8B4" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<content>in the case of a report with respect to a qualifying drug that meets the criteria under paragraph (1)(B), not later than 30 days after such drug meets such criteria; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HE1AFC6F4260F4E75869DB882F6A2F380" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num>
<content>in the case of a report with respect to an increase in the price of a qualifying drug that occurs during a 12-month or 36-month period described in paragraph (1)(C), not later than April 1, 2021.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H11FB4EA813DB4E3DBCF39658C47A8B5E" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Contents</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>A report under subsection (b), consistent with the standard for disclosures described in <ref href="/us/cfr/t12/s213.3/d">section 213.3(d) of title 12, Code of Federal Regulations</ref> (as in effect on the date of enactment of this section), shall, at a minimum, include—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H149EDB606C544A25A0D8706BC70F3E3A" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<chapeau>with respect to the qualifying drug—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H4FC43AD1AC524277B94AD05DBF34B104" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>the percentage by which the manufacturer will raise the wholesale acquisition cost of the drug within the 12-month period or 36-month period as described in subsection (b)(1)(A)(i), (b)(1)(A)(ii), (b)(1)(C)(i), or (b)(1)(C)(ii), as applicable, and the effective date of such price increase or the cost associated with a qualifying drug if such drug meets the criteria under subsection (b)(1)(B) and the effective date at which such drug meets such criteria;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H83266C4503EA49F9939EEC9C8764E37C" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>an explanation for, and description of, each price increase for such drug that will occur during the 12-month period or the 36-month period described in subsection (b)(1)(A)(i), (b)(1)(A)(ii), (b)(1)(C)(i), or (b)(1)(C)(ii), as applicable;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD7D450563BD14BCA986C3D45AE9BBC8A" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<content>an explanation for, and description of, the cost associated with a qualifying drug if such drug meets the criteria under subsection (b)(1)(B), as applicable;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HBBD939E9B39D4BA2989FA86EBF4D52A5" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num>
<chapeau>if known and different from the manufacturer of the qualifying drug, the identity of—</chapeau>
<clause id="H02BFDB8BC0DB4D55BCC1EFC4B427D61E" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<chapeau>the sponsor or sponsors of any investigational new drug applications under section 505(i) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act for clinical investigations with respect to such drug, for which the full reports are submitted as part of the application—</chapeau>
<subclause id="HA763CF4367A8495F8912EB38B017A6CE" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num>
<content>for approval of the drug under section 505 of such Act; or</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H6606204AE77A41D79E6CBD0DCB5378D0" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num>
<content>for licensure of the drug under section 351 of the Pubic Health Service Act; and</content></subclause></clause>
<clause id="H7E3BFCB5DD114C00A68FF32769553084" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>the sponsor of an application for the drug approved under such section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act or licensed under section 351 of the Public Health Service Act;</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC224BB93B2944105979246EEFE25F900" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num>
<content>a description of the history of the manufacturer’s price increases for the drug since the approval of the application for the drug under section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act or the issuance of the license for the drug under section 351 of the Public Health Service Act, or since the manufacturer acquired such approved application or license, if applicable;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H6318AA0FA0804C87B97E9EEF46C8E6A3" class="indent2"><num value="F">“(F) </num>
<content>the current wholesale acquisition cost of the drug;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HA80763014EAE4B079652A9D488D0A40D" class="indent2"><num value="G">“(G) </num>
<chapeau>the total expenditures of the manufacturer on—</chapeau>
<clause id="HF862838FDD844862BF9CA078FE163A3E" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>materials and manufacturing for such drug;</content></clause>
<clause id="H433F1E0961B14861A403800119C5AE2B" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>acquiring patents and licensing for such drug; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H8B416541111C4F54A18F13593A57B3D2" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num>
<content>purchasing or acquiring such drug from another manufacturer, if applicable;</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1C106697A70044D191382174AEA46DDC" class="indent2"><num value="H">“(H) </num>
<content>the percentage of total expenditures of the manufacturer on research and development for such drug that was derived from Federal funds;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HE65EACC555C543E08667D5EFD7AFB4C1" class="indent2"><num value="I">“(I) </num>
<content>the total expenditures of the manufacturer on research and development for such drug that is necessary to demonstrate that it meets applicable statutory standards for approval under section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act or licensure under section 351 of the Public Health Service Act, as applicable;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB3BA45712B6F4B34ACA02EDB42865868" class="indent2"><num value="J">“(J) </num>
<content>the total expenditures of the manufacturer on pursuing new or expanded indications or dosage changes for such drug under section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act or section 351 of the Public Health Service Act;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H7288BF40E83B482AB59092B1D2D9CC9B" class="indent2"><num value="K">“(K) </num>
<content>the total expenditures of the manufacturer on carrying out postmarket requirements related to such drug, including under section 505(o)(3) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1FA029B4438C4E60A62D710FF8679199" class="indent2"><num value="L">“(L) </num>
<content>the total revenue and the net profit generated from the qualifying drug for each calendar year since the approval of the application for the drug under section 505 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act or the issuance of the license for the drug under section 351 of the Public Health Service Act, or since the manufacturer acquired such approved application or license; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H3A03CD3FFDDD44149F4D2BAC9747FB36" class="indent2"><num value="M">“(M) </num>
<content>the total costs associated with marketing and advertising for the qualifying drug;</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HCA409D8A79B1448A9AEC876DEA8DE716" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<chapeau>with respect to the manufacturer—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H6E2250B32DD34F8F864DFF1B65EB88B3" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>the total revenue and the net profit of the manufacturer for each of the 12-month period described in subsection (b)(1)(A)(i) or (b)(1)(C)(i) or the 36-month period described in subsection (b)(1)(A)(ii) or (b)(1)(C)(ii), as applicable;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H816D6964E872486DAEA1AA7A6A9C6690" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>all stock-based performance metrics used by the manufacturer to determine executive compensation for each of the 12-month periods described in subsection (b)(1)(A)(i) or (b)(1)(C)(i) or the 36-month periods described in subsection (b)(1)(A)(ii) or (b)(1)(C)(ii), as applicable; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H88B7EAEDC3824783A93A54C43CC0943B" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<chapeau>any additional information the manufacturer chooses to provide related to drug pricing decisions, such as total expenditures on—</chapeau>
<clause id="H539CA6D69468406FAB6BD8C137B15D27" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>drug research and development; or</content></clause>
<clause id="HEAE15A022B13463FB332A4544A5760CE" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>clinical trials, including on drugs that failed to receive approval by the Food and Drug Administration; and</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HAAC9DBD84EDF47DC962F2699039D2215" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<content>such other related information as the Secretary considers appropriate and as specified by the Secretary.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H1BA7C2CD318E4EB690049485E761CC4E" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Information Provided</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The manufacturer of a qualifying drug that is required to submit a report under subsection (b), shall ensure that such report and any explanation for, and description of, each price increase described in subsection (c)(1) shall be truthful, not misleading, and accurate.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H13E75C10C42746FA9DCB6DFDCD94FF8A" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Civil Monetary Penalty</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Any manufacturer of a qualifying drug that fails to submit a report for the drug as required by this section, following notification by the Secretary to the manufacturer that the manufacturer is not in compliance with this section, shall be subject to a civil monetary penalty of $75,000 for each day on which the violation continues.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H00D9ABF24FC44032947E2B2707D47E07" class="indent0"><num value="f">“(f) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">False Information</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Any manufacturer that submits a report for a drug as required by this section that knowingly provides false information in such report is subject to a civil monetary penalty in an amount not to exceed $100,000 for each item of false information.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H4A1D4E39C8464103986FEE64EDDC23A5" class="indent0"><num value="g">“(g) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Public Posting</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HAB0F1BF79C8D4F0E8F703D9D07E8CD31" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Subject to paragraph (4), the Secretary shall post each report submitted under subsection (b) on the public website of the Department of Health and Human Services the day the price increase of a qualifying drug is scheduled to go into effect.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H46354B2959184C05A1194FF0DD417EF4" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Format</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>In developing the format in which reports will be publicly posted under paragraph (1), the Secretary shall consult with stakeholders, including beneficiary groups, and shall seek feedback from consumer advocates and readability experts on the format and presentation of the content of such reports to ensure that such reports are—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H33190742514E4E29AA4F23D9495CF367" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>user-friendly to the public; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H24E4B5335469468E98CB7BE6B3772E17" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>written in plain language that consumers can readily understand.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HCE8D3F5C74F24CEB8AFEB61407DFF402" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">List</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In addition to the reports submitted under subsection (b), the Secretary shall also post a list of each qualifying drug with respect to which the manufacturer was required to submit such a report in the preceding year and whether such manufacturer was required to submit such report based on a qualifying price increase or whether such drug meets the criteria under subsection (b)(1)(B).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HB506AF29BFB34E3785A3EB74D782944D" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Protected information</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In carrying out this section, the Secretary shall enforce applicable law concerning the protection of confidential commercial information and trade secrets.</content></paragraph></subsection></section> 
<section id="H0A4B445FA2214890BE278C9525950B64" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1150D">“SEC. 1150D. </num>
<heading>ANNUAL REPORT TO CONGRESS.</heading>
<subsection id="HFEE78DD0C52342CCACA46BDF477C42FB" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>Subject to subsection (b), the Secretary shall submit to the Committees on Energy and Commerce and Ways and Means of the House of Representatives and the Committees on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions and Finance of the Senate, and post on the public website of the Department of Health and Human Services in a way that is user-friendly to the public and written in plain language that consumers can readily understand, an annual report—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H294D0CE645DF4CE9A3B3D66C0F597474" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<content>summarizing the information reported pursuant to section 1150C;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H9FE0265B7E9A4D41B6CA493116A71124" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>including copies of the reports and supporting detailed economic analyses submitted pursuant to such section;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HE63A0FC59EF24507AF4A2939070D0C1F" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<content>detailing the costs and expenditures incurred by the Department of Health and Human Services in carrying out section 1150C; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H004DF60FAAD748D2ACEBBA23506D9D47" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<content>explaining how the Department of Health and Human Services is improving consumer and provider information about drug value and drug price transparency.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HADAB503D307E43FDA9C1B088CC859942" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Protected Information</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In carrying out this section, the Secretary shall enforce applicable law concerning the protection of confidential commercial information and trade secrets.”.</content></subsection></section></quotedContent></content></section></title>
