<section id="H1383932123F143C684E85B0B62D0CDEE" role="subsequent-section"><num value="2729A">“SEC. 2729A. </num>
<heading>FAIR PRICE DRUG NEGOTIATION PROGRAM AND APPLICATION OF MAXIMUM FAIR PRICES.</heading>
<subsection id="H1619804821674970A31819DA1AFE9CFC" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>In the case of a group health plan or health insurance issuer offering health insurance coverage that is treated under section 1197 of the Social Security Act as having in effect an agreement with the Secretary under the Fair Price Drug Negotiation Program under part E of title XI of such Act, with respect to a price applicability period (as defined in section 1191(b) of such Act) and a selected drug (as defined in section 1192(c) of such Act) with respect to such period with respect to which coverage is provided under such plan or coverage—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HDC7085071588457694F3231B062DEB5E" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<content>the provisions of such part shall apply to the plans or coverage offered by such plan or issuer, and to the individuals enrolled under such plans or coverage, during such period, with respect to such selected drug, in the same manner as such provisions apply to prescription drug plans and MA–PD plans, and to individuals enrolled under such prescription drug plans and MA–PD plans;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H343F9A02CAEF49DF90D27379E1DB9816" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>the plan or issuer shall apply any cost-sharing responsibilities under such plan or coverage, with respect to such selected drug, by substituting the maximum fair price negotiated under such part for such drug in lieu of the contracted rate under such plan or coverage for such selected drug; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H2D0F918FBB7B4E6AB5A0303FCA17484A" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<content>the Secretary shall apply the provisions of such part to such plan, issuer, and coverage, and such individuals so enrolled in such plans.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H9363C3200EE54E9C98069687A5220BAE" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notification Regarding Nonparticipation in Fair Drug Price Negotiation Program</inline>.—</heading>
<content>A group health plan or a health insurance issuer offering group or individual health insurance coverage shall publicly disclose in a manner and in accordance with a process specified by the Secretary any election made under section 1197 of the Social Security Act by the plan or issuer to not participate in the Fair Drug Price Negotiation Program under part E of title XI of such Act with respect to a selected drug (as defined in section 1192(c) of such Act) for which coverage is provided under such plan or coverage before the beginning of the plan year for which such election was made.”.</content></subsection></section></quotedContent></content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s101/b/2/B" id="H32DBB5BD97D947CA8FAB06494948470B" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">ERISA</inline>.—</heading>
<clause role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s101/b/2/B/i" id="H89A747D2511540199616DD68FC5C3784" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Subpart B of part 7 of subtitle B of title I of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (<ref href="/us/usc/t29/s1181">29 U.S.C. 1181</ref> et. seq.) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new section:<quotedContent meta="committee ID HED00" id="H462F904F65924A1782B412F0D1BC2710" styleType="OLC"> 
<section id="H9C2D96DAF4D04A41B159C9C459FED3D3" role="subsequent-section"><num value="716">“SEC. 716. </num>
<heading>FAIR PRICE DRUG NEGOTIATION PROGRAM AND APPLICATION OF MAXIMUM FAIR PRICES.</heading>
<subsection id="H2F8D9186055C4E1598916C4C5100EADA" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>In the case of a group health plan or health insurance issuer offering group health insurance coverage that is treated under section 1197 of the Social Security Act as having in effect an agreement with the Secretary under the Fair Price Drug Negotiation Program under part E of title XI of such Act, with respect to a price applicability period (as defined in section 1191(b) of such Act) and a selected drug (as defined in section 1192(c) of such Act) with respect to such period with respect to which coverage is provided under such plan or coverage—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HDEECE160573B47BCB96528EA8D610C2E" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<chapeau>the provisions of such part shall apply, as applicable—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H2EF41A9BD103491094987E226DD3AA09" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>if coverage of such selected drug is provided under such plan or coverage if the drug is furnished or dispensed at a pharmacy or by a mail order service, to the plans or coverage offered by such plan or issuer, and to the individuals enrolled under such plans or coverage, during such period, with respect to such selected drug, in the same manner as such provisions apply to prescription drug plans and MA–PD plans, and to individuals enrolled under such prescription drug plans and MA–PD plans during such period; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD242A96A58D84D74A3BE7172868F3EBC" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>if coverage of such selected drug is provided under such plan or coverage if the drug is furnished or administered by a hospital, physician, or other provider of services or supplier, to the plans or coverage offered by such plan or issuers, to the individuals enrolled under such plans or coverage, and to hospitals, physicians, and other providers of services and suppliers during such period, with respect to such drug in the same manner as such provisions apply to the Secretary, to individuals entitled to benefits under part A of title XVIII or enrolled under part B of such title, and to hospitals, physicians, and other providers and suppliers participating under title XVIII during such period;</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H68FA69E93DA849A48BB8B4CEC53F127D" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>the plan or issuer shall apply any cost-sharing responsibilities under such plan or coverage, with respect to such selected drug, by substituting an amount not more than the maximum fair price negotiated under such part E of title XI for such drug in lieu of the drug price upon which the cost-sharing would have otherwise applied, and such cost-sharing responsibilities with respect to such selected drug may not exceed such amount; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H108E1EB792AD4AE392E5E01F04F03A11" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<content>the Secretary shall apply the provisions of such part E to such plan, issuer, and coverage, and such individuals so enrolled in such plans.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H105D8F30710E410BBB038BEECAE2B8BA" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notification Regarding Nonparticipation in Fair Drug Price Negotiation Program</inline>.—</heading>
<content>A group health plan or a health insurance issuer offering group health insurance coverage shall publicly disclose in a manner and in accordance with a process specified by the Secretary any election made under section 1197 of the Social Security Act by the plan or issuer to not participate in the Fair Drug Price Negotiation Program under part E of title XI of such Act with respect to a selected drug (as defined in section 1192(c) of such Act) for which coverage is provided under such plan or coverage before the beginning of the plan year for which such election was made.”.</content></subsection></section></quotedContent></content></clause>

<section id="H86C3156D77FA44C5B5B834EB63C69ED1" role="subsequent-section"><num value="9816">“SEC. 9816. </num>
<heading>FAIR PRICE DRUG NEGOTIATION PROGRAM AND APPLICATION OF MAXIMUM FAIR PRICES.</heading>
<subsection id="HB6290930B2184807A29506509C877FC2" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>In the case of a group health plan that is treated under section 1197 of the Social Security Act as having in effect an agreement with the Secretary under the Fair Price Drug Negotiation Program under part E of title XI of such Act, with respect to a price applicability period (as defined in section 1191(b) of such Act) and a selected drug (as defined in section 1192(c) of such Act) with respect to such period with respect to which coverage is provided under such plan—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HC35425DD47E04FDF9514129CDCB6E110" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<content>the provisions of such part shall apply to the plans offered by such plan, and to the individuals enrolled under such plans, during such period, with respect to such selected drug, in the same manner as such provisions apply to prescription drug plans and MA–PD plans, and to individuals enrolled under such prescription drug plans and MA–PD plans;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HE20C542783FA4697912DFDDEFA7DA0BA" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>the plan shall apply any cost-sharing responsibilities under such plan, with respect to such selected drug, by substituting the maximum fair price negotiated under such part for such drug in lieu of the contracted rate under such plan for such selected drug; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H28C379645F85433EB89467DBBF6669BE" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<content>the Secretary shall apply the provisions of such part to such plan and such individuals so enrolled in such plan.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HE9287E39075448BABFC5BE509263473B" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notification Regarding Nonparticipation in Fair Drug Price Negotiation Program</inline>.—</heading>
<content>A group health plan shall publicly disclose in a manner and in accordance with a process specified by the Secretary any election made under section 1197 of the Social Security Act by the plan to not participate in the Fair Drug Price Negotiation Program under part E of title XI of such Act with respect to a selected drug (as defined in section 1192(c) of such Act) for which coverage is provided under such plan before the beginning of the plan year for which such election was made.”.</content></subsection></section></quotedContent></content></clause>
<clause role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s101/b/2/C/ii" id="H859F2BA16F574F7E9B6F528C3D2F1BD4" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Clerical amendment</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The table of sections for subchapter B of chapter 100 of such Code <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new item:<quotedContent meta="committee ID HED00" id="H3BA3A45300F7486583DD3B24B9B939C6" styleType="OLC"> <toc meta="committee ID HED00"> <referenceItem role="section">

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s102" id="H5D71B268930E4A6BB99E5B35CE843000" role="subsequent-section"><num value="102">SEC. 102. </num>
<heading>SELECTED DRUG MANUFACTURER EXCISE TAX IMPOSED DURING NONCOMPLIANCE PERIODS.</heading>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s102/a" id="H4A5EF6A410D64453A59EC3214FB0E721" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Subchapter E of <ref href="usc-chapter/26/32">chapter 32</ref> of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new section:<quotedContent meta="committee ID HED00" id="H3CB76CD0A42F42E7B21A00619B3DD7AC" styleType="OLC"> 
<section id="HF89B763D8F5F405B82DFC6D85FEB2BA6" role="subsequent-section"><num value="4192">“SEC. 4192. </num>
<heading>SELECTED DRUGS DURING NONCOMPLIANCE PERIODS.</heading>
<subsection id="HAB39C0ADE6234707A228E938CDEB10C9" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>There is hereby imposed on the sale by the manufacturer, producer, or importer of any selected drug during a day described in subsection (b) a tax in an amount such that the applicable percentage is equal to the ratio of—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H3B57E6DF28D04C9FA3486D8D432107C5" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<content>such tax, divided by</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H98E53392D6894FFB87E38C5D6D42AF0A" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>the sum of such tax and the price for which so sold.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H2302EE0C2A234C64AF7EFBDF02A5E61B" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Noncompliance Periods</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>A day is described in this subsection with respect to a selected drug if it is a day during one of the following periods:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HF3E4EA2A411541F48F86B7080E27ED97" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<content>The period beginning on the June 16th immediately following the selected drug publication date and ending on the first date during which the manufacturer of the drug has in place an agreement described in subsection (a) of section 1193 of the Social Security Act with respect to such drug.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HA76F9038E6C74AABBF354846B3136D86" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>The period beginning on the April 1st immediately following the June 16th described in paragraph (1) and ending on the first date during which the manufacturer of the drug has agreed to a maximum fair price under such agreement.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H2A8BCD72D429493C99E7EAB6B36A384F" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<content>In the case of a selected drug with respect to which the Secretary of Health and Human Services has specified a renegotiation period under such agreement, the period beginning on the first date after the last date of such renegotiation period and ending on the first date during which the manufacturer of the drug has agreed to a renegotiated maximum fair price under such agreement.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H40BB5DC3F9A34BFBB484CC983738D271" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<content>With respect to information that is required to be submitted to the Secretary of Health and Human Services under such agreement, the period beginning on the date on which such Secretary certifies that such information is overdue and ending on the date that such information is so submitted.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HFCF0541C494B46C09FF671DDCA05FE97" class="indent1"><num value="5">“(5) </num>
<content>In the case of a selected drug with respect to which a payment is due under subsection (c) of such section 1193, the period beginning on the date on which the Secretary of Health and Human Services certifies that such payment is overdue and ending on the date that such payment is made in full.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection role="definitions" id="H2AE16996DD984DDCBA5EBC49E5BCAAD8" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Applicable Percentage</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The term ‘<term>applicable percentage</term>’ means—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HE7AD7BF2BE3D4E418F8710137CCC0C33" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<content>in the case of sales of a selected drug during the first 90 days described in subsection (b) with respect to such drug, 65 percent,</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H1BAFCB0C18B34C6994C3B388959DA399" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>in the case of sales of such drug during the 91st day through the 180th day described in subsection (b) with respect to such drug, 75 percent,</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H807EB57C4F97437997C3B66B378A9359" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<content>in the case of sales of such drug during the 181st day through the 270th day described in subsection (b) with respect to such drug, 85 percent, and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H70C5C732AA8147EEAF2EB05A829FC873" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<content>in the case of sales of such drug during any subsequent day, 95 percent.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection role="definitions" id="H0EA08ADD111D4AE4A258189B55BEED57" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definitions</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The terms ‘selected drug publication date’ and ‘maximum fair price’ have the meaning given such terms in section 1191 of the Social Security Act and the term ‘<term>selected drug</term>’ has the meaning given such term in section 1192 of such Act.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HFB8D2FC85BB04FC497F92A53FE4E6700" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Anti-Abuse Rule</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In the case of a sale which was timed for the purpose of avoiding the tax imposed by this section, the Secretary may treat such sale as occurring during a day described in subsection (b).”.</content></subsection></section></quotedContent></content></subsection>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s102/b" id="HEF87D4E1778F4EB39556916CB42DAB09" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">No Deduction for Excise Tax Payments</inline>.—</heading>
<content><ref href="usc/26/275">Section 275</ref> of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> “<quotedText>or by section 4192</quotedText>” before the period at the end of subsection (a)(6).</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tI/s102/c" id="HF1AF7E59CCF64F9A9CFBF64BF3931CAB" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num>

<title identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tII" id="H8A812AE8483F4210BC1F67FE7A41ABB5"><num value="II">TITLE II—</num>
<heading class="inline">MEDICARE PARTS B AND D PRESCRIPTION DRUG INFLATION REBATES</heading> 
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tII/s201" id="H5143EF5DC9054A728D416A3AA2C18B51" role="subsequent-section"><num value="201">SEC. 201. </num>
<heading>MEDICARE PART B REBATE BY MANUFACTURERS.</heading>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tII/s201/a" id="HC45B93EC11A4489D9321F9C327B4C9AC" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Section 1834 of the Social Security Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t42/s1395m">42 U.S.C. 1395m</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new subsection:<quotedContent meta="committee ID HED00" id="H21406DE0701846EA9460E4E9902DA6AE" styleType="OLC"> <subsection id="HD47572453822427DA6711FE9AEA2B58C" class="indent0"><num value="x">“(x) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Rebate by Manufacturers for Single Source Drugs With Prices Increasing Faster Than Inflation</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HDB9C6378693D49A59E802F78DDE63CE6" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Requirements</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="HFD648D75A50340E583D71D76CF764BAE" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Secretarial provision of information</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>Not later than 6 months after the end of each calendar quarter beginning on or after July 1, 2021, the Secretary shall, for each part B rebatable drug, report to each manufacturer of such part B rebatable drug the following for such calendar quarter:</chapeau>
<clause id="H2D217DBEBF2A492A94A509B2B861291E" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>Information on the total number of billing units described in subparagraph (A)(i) of paragraph (3) with respect to such drug and calendar quarter.</content></clause>
<clause id="H5D39EFEB576E43008D2525280103D91E" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>Information on the amount (if any) of the excess average sales price increase described in subparagraph (A)(ii) of such paragraph for such drug and calendar quarter.</content></clause>
<clause id="H0094D66D3ABF46779D1C802028990963" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num>
<content>The rebate amount specified under such paragraph for such part B rebatable drug and calendar quarter.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H57F0FF4861A2407F920706CCC25EADD8" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Manufacturer requirement</inline>.—</heading>
<content>For each calendar quarter beginning on or after July 1, 2021, the manufacturer of a part B rebatable drug shall, for such drug, not later than 30 days after the date of receipt from the Secretary of the information described in subparagraph (A) for such calendar quarter, provide to the Secretary a rebate that is equal to the amount specified in paragraph (3) for such drug for such calendar quarter.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H569D73E468A44997A2A30446CD270A58" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Part b rebatable drug defined</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="H10EA182CAC614992A7513B51DB6B06A8" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>In this subsection, the term ‘<term>part B rebatable drug</term>’ means a single source drug or biological (as defined in subparagraph (D) of section 1847A(c)(6)), including a biosimilar biological product (as defined in subparagraph (H) of such section), paid for under this part, except such term shall not include such a drug or biological—</chapeau>
<clause id="H6A4C0BE09008446D95A1F0B7F8143D18" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>if the average total allowed charges for a year per individual that uses such a drug or biological, as determined by the Secretary, are less than, subject to subparagraph (B), $100; or</content></clause>
<clause id="H1BDB00C6F07C49F39B8042BAEE4F03FC" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>that is a vaccine described in subparagraph (A) or (B) of section 1861(s)(10).</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD638573346C34D53B7EABDEAE00D3587" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Increase</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The dollar amount applied under subparagraph (A)(i)—</chapeau>
<clause id="H4D55B652B6654A9BAE106542F96063C0" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>for 2022, shall be the dollar amount specified under such subparagraph for 2021, increased by the percentage increase in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (United States city average) as of the first quarter of the previous year; and</content></clause>
<clause id="HF6749F2F5E0749CCB33593ECFEFEC43F" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>for a subsequent year, shall be the dollar amount specified in this clause (or clause (i)) for the previous year, increased by the percentage increase in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (United States city average) as of the first quarter of the previous year.</content></clause>
<continuation class="indent0">Any dollar amount specified under this subparagraph that is not a multiple of $10 shall be rounded to the nearest multiple of $10.</continuation></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H5CAE1FEFBC024F148101BAF42B0435C1" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Rebate amount</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="HF5E0FEBB1A6B47CE839B1AF46681BB76" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of paragraph (1)(B), the amount specified in this paragraph for a part B rebatable drug assigned to a billing and payment code for a calendar quarter is, subject to paragraph (4), the amount equal to the product of—</chapeau>
<clause id="HA63B06FA5D8C465DB2FA7AE338272C5F" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>subject to subparagraph (B), the total number of billing units, as described in section 1847A(b)(6)(B), for such part B rebatable drug furnished under this part during the calendar quarter; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H2672B1389FF246B089BCA75A12986A8A" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<chapeau>the amount (if any) by which—</chapeau>
<subclause id="H628D9BA83E69417A96B298051B429357" class="indent4"><num value="I">“(I) </num>
<content>the payment amount under subparagraph (B) or (C) of section 1847A(b)(1), as applicable, for such part B rebatable drug during the calendar quarter; exceeds</content></subclause>
<subclause id="H870BF4BB9A6C4BCBBAE576AD3D687889" class="indent4"><num value="II">“(II) </num>
<content>the inflation-adjusted payment amount determined under subparagraph (C) for such part B rebatable drug during the calendar quarter.</content></subclause></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HEBC00326227347E7835957B7ED1EEE8D" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Excluded units</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of subparagraph (A)(i), the total number of billing units for part B rebatable drugs furnished during a calendar quarter shall not include—</chapeau>
<clause id="H1482F4A50F134CC69972AAA96FA08B57" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>units packaged into the payment for a related procedure or service under section 1833(t) or under section 1833(i) (instead of separately payable under such respective section);</content></clause>
<clause id="H45EE86E6E8CC401F8A29611554B0BA41" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>units included under the single payment system for renal dialysis services under section 1881(b)(14); or</content></clause>
<clause id="H7FD6C3C1F87044A68AB9D804DAD197F5" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num>
<content>units of a part B rebatable drug of a manufacturer that is furnished to an individual, if such manufacturer, with respect to the furnishing of such units of such drug, provides for discounts under section 340B of the Public Health Service Act or for rebates under section 1927.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H0178A74BC188498BB335A2CA3D81037E" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Determination of inflation-adjusted payment amount</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The inflation-adjusted payment amount determined under this subparagraph for a part B rebatable drug for a calendar quarter is—</chapeau>
<clause id="H560EAA29FD014A00AC1990B599DC800E" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>the payment amount for the billing and payment code for such drug in the payment amount benchmark quarter (as defined in subparagraph (D)); increased by</content></clause>
<clause id="HEA324DC0EB1B40F88A5FFD083CF8BE81" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>the percentage by which the rebate period CPI–U (as defined in subparagraph (F)) for the calendar quarter exceeds the benchmark period CPI–U (as defined in subparagraph (E)).</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="HF7DACFBC90E344508F0F7C570595B7C7" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Payment amount benchmark quarter</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>payment amount benchmark quarter</term>’ means the calendar quarter beginning January 1, 2016.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="H6369A548D3D1497083FBA43D9FA79A07" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Benchmark period cpi–u</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>benchmark period CPI–U</term>’ means the consumer price index for all urban consumers (United States city average) for July 2015.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="HC67734A9D54741E692DD9A66C33C7037" class="indent2"><num value="F">“(F) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Rebate period cpi–u</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>rebate period CPI–U</term>’ means, with respect to a calendar quarter described in subparagraph (C), the greater of the benchmark period CPI–U and the consumer price index for all urban consumers (United States city average) for the first month of the calendar quarter that is two calendar quarters prior to such described calendar quarter.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HAE625DB4282F495DB6077808EFD41557" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special treatment of certain drugs and exemption</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="HFE37B397BDAE452D944214D9F8BBA7BF" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Subsequently approved drugs</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Subject to subparagraph (B), in the case of a part B rebatable drug first approved by the Food and Drug Administration after July 1, 2015, clause (i) of paragraph (3)(C) shall be applied as if the term ‘<term>payment amount benchmark quarter</term>’ were defined under paragraph (3)(D) as the third full calendar quarter after the day on which the drug was first marketed and clause (ii) of paragraph (3)(C) shall be applied as if the term ‘<term>benchmark period CPI–U</term>’ were defined under paragraph (3)(E) as if the reference to ‘July 2015’ under such paragraph were a reference to ‘the first month of the first full calendar quarter after the day on which the drug was first marketed’.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD68F47FA894C460082ACDC38167DCB85" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Timeline for provision of rebates for new drugs</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In the case of a part B rebatable drug first approved by the Food and Drug Administration after July 1, 2015, clause (i) of paragraph (1)(B) shall be applied as if the reference to ‘July 1, 2021’ under such paragraph were a reference to the later of the 6th full calendar quarter after the day on which the drug was first marketed or July 1, 2021.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H50EFF389F9AA4D74AF55F47B37C858C5" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exemption for shortages</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary may reduce or waive the rebate under paragraph (1)(B) with respect to a part B rebatable drug that appears on the drug shortage list in effect under section 506(e) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act or in the case of other exigent circumstances, as determined by the Secretary.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="HFE56630163FF4C6BA8F28116F8E0ACC2" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Selected drugs</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In the case of a part B rebatable drug that is a selected drug (as defined in section 1192(c)), for each applicable year beginning after the price applicability period (as defined in section 1191(b)(2) with respect to such drug, clause (i) of paragraph (3)(C) shall be applied as if the term ‘<term>payment amount benchmark quarter</term>’ were defined under paragraph (3)(D) as the calendar quarter beginning January 1 of the last year beginning during such price applicability period with respect to such selected drug and clause (ii) of paragraph (3)(C) shall be applied as if the term ‘<term>benchmark period CPI–U</term>’ were defined under paragraph (3)(E) as if the reference to ‘July 2015’ under such paragraph were a reference to the July of the year preceding such last year.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC98F8E171F43400BB872CAB8C24F7FE8" class="indent1"><num value="5">“(5) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Application to beneficiary coinsurance</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>In the case of a part B rebatable drug for which a rebate is payable under this subsection—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H5EE78519FDED453AB18BF86A45B9785B" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>in computing the amount of any coinsurance applicable under this title to an individual with respect to such drug, the computation of such coinsurance shall be based on the inflation-adjusted payment amount determined under paragraph (3)(C) for such part B rebatable drug; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HEA151F10CF0B4B2A84CFDB2DC50522B9" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>the amount of such coinsurance is equal to 20 percent of such inflation-adjusted payment amount so determined.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H861D36957A5847629C8EA4EFB6D91022" class="indent1"><num value="6">“(6) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Rebate deposits</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Amounts paid as rebates under paragraph (1)(B) shall be deposited into the Federal Supplementary Medical Insurance Trust Fund established under section 1841.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HBA621200003547D18452454D4F552965" class="indent1"><num value="7">“(7) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Civil money penalty</inline>.—</heading>
<content>If a manufacturer of a part B rebatable drug has failed to comply with the requirements under paragraph (1)(B) for such drug for a calendar quarter, the manufacturer shall be subject to, in accordance with a process established by the Secretary pursuant to regulations, a civil money penalty in an amount equal to at least 125 percent of the amount specified in paragraph (3) for such drug for such calendar quarter. The provisions of section 1128A (other than subsections (a) (with respect to amounts of penalties or additional assessments) and (b)) shall apply to a civil money penalty under this paragraph in the same manner as such provisions apply to a penalty or proceeding under section 1128A(a).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H552998BD22F34609B7A1492893FBDF1E" class="indent1"><num value="8">“(8) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Study and report</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H58EF1546D07F4A43BAC59648708FC463" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Study</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The Secretary shall conduct a study of the feasibility of and operational issues involved with the following:</chapeau>
<clause id="HE5F13259C32244F38CCFBAD38651A0A8" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>Including multiple source drugs (as defined in section 1847A(c)(6)(C)) in the rebate system under this subsection.</content></clause>
<clause id="HC77F4EFC82EA47A8BDBBC62DEF38252A" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>Including drugs and biologicals paid for under MA plans under part C in the rebate system under this subsection.</content></clause>
<clause id="HC360CE41A11F4DF48797742638C55EE1" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num>
<content>Including drugs excluded under paragraph (2)(A) and billing units of drugs excluded under paragraph (3)(B) in the rebate system under this subsection.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H26D761DE404949FB9B15071A75C78D6A" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Report</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Not later than 3 years after the date of the enactment of this subsection, the Secretary shall submit to Congress a report on the study conducted under subparagraph (A).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC56924850EED4F48B7281C52CEC0E270" class="indent1"><num value="9">“(9) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Application to multiple source drugs</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary may, based on the report submitted under paragraph (8) and pursuant to rulemaking, apply the provisions of this subsection to multiple source drugs (as defined in section 1847A(c)(6)(C)), including, for purposes of determining the rebate amount under paragraph (3), by calculating manufacturer-specific average sales prices for the benchmark period and the rebate period.”.</content></paragraph></subsection></quotedContent></content></subsection>

<section role="subsequent-section instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3/tII/s202" id="HC9CA5E4DB2C045F48FF29330FBB67DC7"><num value="202">SEC. 202. </num>
<heading>MEDICARE PART D REBATE BY MANUFACTURERS.</heading>
<content>Part D of title XVIII of the Social Security Act <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> after section 1860D–14A (<ref href="/us/usc/t42/s1395w–114a">42 U.S.C. 1395w–114a</ref>) the following new section:<quotedContent meta="committee ID HED00" id="HC18DFE4A815E43D39509CA9001123C97" styleType="OLC"> 
<section id="HF32661932F1A41F08D26816454B39C90" role="subsequent-section"><num value="1860D14B">“SEC. 1860D–14B. </num>
<heading>MANUFACTURER REBATE FOR CERTAIN DRUGS WITH PRICES INCREASING FASTER THAN INFLATION.</heading>
<subsection role="definitions" id="HB98A7991ECF24D31AB4F6CC1F628879B" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Subject to the provisions of this section, in order for coverage to be available under this part for a part D rebatable drug of a manufacturer dispensed during an applicable year, the manufacturer must have entered into and have in effect an agreement described in subsection (b). For purposes of this section the term ‘<term>applicable year</term>’ means a year beginning with 2022.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H0F95E55E16644485B12706A5E8243BB1" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Agreements</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HD898A391F09B403EABF703889E1FF699" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Terms of agreement</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>An agreement described in this subsection, with respect to a manufacturer of a part D rebatable drug, is an agreement under which the following applies:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H4A338693CE2243A8918F1BF049922056" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Secretarial provision of information</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>Not later than 9 months after the end of each applicable year with respect to which the agreement is in effect, the Secretary, for the part D rebatable drug of the manufacturer, reports to the manufacturer the following for such year:</chapeau>
<clause id="H9BC2AA74E31A4E73A9C74BC469CD22CA" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>Information on the total units (as defined in subsection (g)(2)) dispensed for each dosage form and strength with respect to such part D rebatable drug and year.</content></clause>
<clause id="H024849C98F6B4DECA58B0D0000E64BD2" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>Information on the amount (if any) of the excess average manufacturer price increase described in subsection (c)(1)(B) for each dosage form and strength with respect to such drug and year.</content></clause>
<clause id="H7689A91E44ED4B21965E672013E6CD00" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num>
<content>The rebate amount specified under subsection (c) for each dosage form and strength with respect to such drug and year.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HCE5BE48CB40B426787D6BF6E74175ED3" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Manufacturer requirements</inline>.—</heading>
<content>For each applicable year with respect to which the agreement is in effect, the manufacturer of the part D rebatable drug, for each dosage form and strength with respect to such drug, not later than 30 days after the date of receipt from the Secretary of the information described in subparagraph (A) for such year, provides to the Secretary a rebate that is equal to the amount specified in subsection (c) for such dosage form and strength with respect to such drug for such year.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HE26F844BD07F4ED19395CD3A4F261E74" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Length of agreement</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H4A8E7E9A08C6408F8C14A9702E549BE6" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>An agreement under this section, with respect to a part D rebatable drug, shall be effective for an initial period of not less than one year and shall be automatically renewed for a period of not less than one year unless terminated under subparagraph (B).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB6ECA7DCF0E547908816AB8373CFE8A3" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Termination</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="H2A5898B474454F70BDB4B0E1B2D7C54F" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">By secretary</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary may provide for termination of an agreement under this section for violation of the requirements of the agreement or other good cause shown. Such termination shall not be effective earlier than 60 days after the date of notice of such termination. The Secretary shall provide, upon request, a manufacturer with a hearing concerning such a termination, but such hearing shall not delay the effective date of the termination.</content></clause>
<clause id="H002E4AB0DF12416883D025D10D033CD2" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">By a manufacturer</inline>.—</heading>
<content>A manufacturer may terminate an agreement under this section for any reason. Any such termination shall not be effective until the year beginning at least 60 days after the date the manufacturer provides notice to the Secretary.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1A8959AA21694F3CBB398C6DC64A4F08" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effectiveness of termination</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Any termination under this paragraph shall not affect rebates due under the agreement under this section before the effective date of its termination.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HF46D23DC8E274C0F8FD40656FBDFA14B" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Delay before reentry</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In the case of any agreement under this section with a manufacturer which is terminated in a plan year, another such agreement with the manufacturer (or a successor manufacturer) may not be entered into before the subsequent plan year, unless the Secretary finds good cause for an earlier reinstatement of such an agreement.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H3EFCAB44E7DD474D9290BE6D00E6A422" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Information</inline>.—</heading>
<content>For purposes of carrying out this section, the Secretary shall use information submitted by manufacturers under section 1927(b)(3).</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HB00F5E3D32A4451DACCAE60C52053AAE" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Rebate Amount</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H5AC503D597A146908F02C9042F75222B" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>For purposes of this section, the amount specified in this subsection for a dosage form and strength with respect to a part D rebatable drug and applicable year is, subject to subparagraphs (B) and (C) of paragraph (3), the amount equal to the product of—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H9225FA937EB1422B94B9D81E999361DE" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>the total average number of units weighted by, and dispensed for, such dosage form and strength with respect to such part D rebatable drug and year; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1E8F133BE1314876B1C7843FE5052552" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<chapeau>the amount (if any) by which—</chapeau>
<clause id="HBFC8A6AD10FB45FC87399F104163F251" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>the average manufacturer price (as defined in subsection (g)) paid for such dosage form and strength with respect to such part D rebatable drug during the year; exceeds</content></clause>
<clause id="HC962D39EC6C94312BD37F15637EC5FB4" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>the inflation-adjusted payment amount determined under paragraph (2) for such dosage form and strength with respect to such part D rebatable drug during the year.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HD48449868E4A42C68E3938FA4D9BAC0D" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Determination of inflation-adjusted payment amount</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The inflation-adjusted payment amount determined under this paragraph for a dosage form and strength with respect to a part D rebatable drug for an applicable year, subject to subparagraphs (A) and (D) of paragraph (3), is—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H75112CF9542B4BECBD4F5BA24B362C7A" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<content>the average manufacturer price paid for such dosage form and strength with respect to such drug in the payment amount benchmark year (as defined in subsection (g)(3)); increased by</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H0BFFFDED483940E58A5909E5083AD13D" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<content>the percentage by which the rebate period CPI–U (as defined in subsection (g)(5)) for the applicable year exceeds the benchmark period CPI–U (as defined in subsection (g)(4)).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H51BD84EFBEB043BDAC405681ECBBFEEF" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special treatment of certain drugs and exemption</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="H683FB1EE0B6841DEBF1B3E24E6F3475C" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Subsequently approved drugs</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In the case of a part D rebatable drug first approved by the Food and Drug Administration after January 1, 2016, subparagraph (A) of paragraph (2) shall be applied as if the term ‘<term>payment amount benchmark year</term>’ were defined under subsection (g)(3) as the first year beginning after the day on which the drug was first marketed and subparagraph (B) of paragraph (2) shall be applied as if the term ‘<term>benchmark period CPI–U</term>’ were defined under subsection (g)(4) as if the reference to ‘January 2016’ under such subsection were a reference to ‘January of the first year beginning after the date on which the drug was first marketed by any manufacturer’.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H01C13C96159546BEBECC12FAD270C042" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exemption for shortages</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The Secretary may reduce or waive the rebate under paragraph (1) with respect to a part D rebatable drug in the case of a shortage of such drug or other exigent circumstances, as determined by the Secretary.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H494DF7D082F748CD8F29DCAB2B4CDD65" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment of new formulations</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="HCF88B9521D724185B48527AB02DAE8C0" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In the case of a part D rebatable drug that is a line extension of a single source drug or an innovator multiple source drug that is an oral solid dosage form, the Secretary shall establish a formula for determining the amount specified in this subsection with respect to such part D rebatable drug and an applicable year with consideration of the single source drug or an innovator multiple source drug.</content></clause>
<clause role="definitions" id="H5DEC0754680D4630B075B8E1ECAA2ECB" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Line extension defined</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In this subparagraph, the term ‘<term>line extension</term>’ means, with respect to a part D rebatable drug, a new formulation of the drug (as determined by the Secretary), such as an extended release formulation, but does not include an abuse-deterrent formulation of the drug (as determined by the Secretary), regardless of whether such abuse-deterrent formulation is an extended release formulation.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="HC133E673624147F7A1B8BCFE95A4122F" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Selected drugs</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In the case of a part D rebatable drug that is a selected drug (as defined in section 1192(c)), for each applicable year beginning after the price applicability period (as defined in section 1191(b)(2) with respect to such drug, subparagraph (A) of paragraph (2) shall be applied as if the term ‘<term>payment amount benchmark year</term>’ were defined under subsection (g)(3) as the last year beginning during such price applicability period with respect to such selected drug and subparagraph (B) of paragraph (2) shall be applied as if the term ‘<term>benchmark period CPI–U</term>’ were defined under subsection (g)(4) as if the reference to ‘January 2016’ under such subsection were a reference to January of the last year beginning during such price applicability period with respect to such drug.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H4DC834E9466941E099BC6313F592762F" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Rebate Deposits</inline>.—</heading>
<content>Amounts paid as rebates under subsection (c) shall be deposited into the Medicare Prescription Drug Account in the Federal Supplementary Medical Insurance Trust Fund established under section 1841.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HD888A5A3FF3342B6AA09CB9649294E5A" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Civil Money Penalty</inline>.—</heading>
<content>In the case of a manufacturer of a part D rebatable drug with an agreement in effect under this section who has failed to comply with the terms of the agreement under subsection (b)(1)(B) with respect to such drug for an applicable year, the Secretary may impose a civil money penalty on such manufacturer in an amount equal to 125 percent of the amount specified in subsection (c) for such drug for such year. The provisions of section 1128A (other than subsections (a) (with respect to amounts of penalties or additional assessments) and (b)) shall apply to a civil money penalty under this subsection in the same manner as such provisions apply to a penalty or proceeding under section 1128A(a).</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H42B78814030541B3B9E8C1DED6D2B36D" class="indent0"><num value="f">“(f) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Judicial Review</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>There shall be no judicial review of the following:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H1C56F7C2DADB4448B277BE9CDBF66C69" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<content>The determination of units under this section.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC024001399244AE7A8D9F6D02B13669B" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<content>The determination of whether a drug is a part D rebatable drug under this section.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF1DDDB7E1F464C459D308010075F767E" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<content>The calculation of the rebate amount under this section.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HE56F774F76D941F79C6907F1D0892FAE" class="indent0"><num value="g">“(g) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definitions</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>In this section:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H1A14DC362019410CA9167FC2F57E75E1" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Part d rebatable drug defined</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="HD3F178BEC45542F59CD2960F231C0BB5" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>part D rebatable drug</term>’ means a drug or biological that would (without application of this section) be a covered part D drug, except such term shall, with respect to an applicable year, not include such a drug or biological if the average total cost under a prescription drug plan under this part or MA–PD plan under part C for such year per individual who uses such a drug or biological, as determined by the Secretary, are less than, subject to subparagraph (B), $100, as determined by the Secretary using the most recent data available or, if data is not available, as estimated by the Secretary.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1ADB535CD02A489F9A62202DEEF7208E" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Increase</inline>.—</heading>
<chapeau>The dollar amount applied under subparagraph (A)—</chapeau>
<clause id="H979E5BD9167D47CCA95DE965F475DD16" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num>
<content>for 2023, shall be the dollar amount specified under such subparagraph for 2022, increased by the percentage increase in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (United States city average) as of January of 2022; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H2BF1CD3DC113471F9F5CA5505011D208" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num>
<content>for a subsequent year, shall be the dollar amount specified in this subparagraph (or subparagraph (A)) for the previous year, increased by the percentage increase in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (United States city average) as of January of the previous year.</content></clause>
<continuation class="indent0">Any dollar amount specified under this subparagraph that is not a multiple of $10 shall be rounded to the nearest multiple of $10.</continuation></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H2CDFDA5168644E579A9E9A6BDF0177F0" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Unit defined</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>unit</term>’ means, with respect to a part D rebatable drug, the lowest identifiable quantity (such as a capsule or tablet, milligram of molecules, or grams) of the part D rebatable drug that is dispensed to individuals enrolled under a prescription drug plan under this part or an MA–PD plan under part C.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H6A9484C11EE44C41AF56DF02549E79D9" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Payment amount benchmark year</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>payment amount benchmark year</term>’ means the year beginning January 1, 2016.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H558615545A2F4C8FAA88FF89F07495C9" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Benchmark period cpi–u</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>benchmark period CPI–U</term>’ means the consumer price index for all urban consumers (United States city average) for January 2016.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H628D8E8BAB3744E2A52C577CA8D8EBDD" class="indent1"><num value="5">“(5) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Rebate period cpi–u</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>rebate period CPI–U</term>’ means, with respect to an applicable year, the consumer price index for all urban consumers (United States city average) for January of such year.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="HD34997FEF484427BAB266EBA406FC8E5" class="indent1"><num value="6">“(6) </num>
<heading><inline class="smallCaps">Average manufacturer price</inline>.—</heading>
<content>The term ‘<term>average manufacturer price</term>’ has the meaning, with respect to a part D rebatable drug of a manufacturer for an applicable year, given such term in section 1927(k)(1), with respect to a covered outpatient drug of a manufacturer for a rebate period under section 1927. For purposes of applying the previous sentence, with respect to a part D rebatable drug of a manufacturer and an applicable year, the Secretary shall use the information with respect to the average manufacturer price for such drug reported by the manufacturer under section 1927(b)(3) with respect to each of the quarters in the applicable year and calculate an annual average manufacturer price for such applicable year as the average of such average manufacturer prices for each such quarter, weighted by units of such drug sold or dispensed with respect to such applicable year.”.</content></paragraph></subsection></section></quotedContent></content></section></title>
