<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt1/s1005" id="H0F16C399554E44BA9BE7140E96DF575F"><num value="1005">SEC. 1005. </num><heading>EFFECTIVE DATE.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt1/s1005/a" id="H54D4FC8E26234C39ABA52EED1D827BF9" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>Except as provided in subsection (b), the amendments made by this part (other than the amendments made by section 1004) shall take effect January 1, 2020.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt1/s1005/b" id="H83D9240EE6E148F38E07AF9C896002BE" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>Subject to the approval of the Election Assistance Commission, if a State certifies to the Election Assistance Commission that the State will not meet the deadline referred to in subsection (a) because of extraordinary circumstances and includes in the certification the reasons for the failure to meet the deadline, subsection (a) shall apply to the State as if the reference in such subsection to “January 1, 2020” were a reference to “January 1, 2022”.</content></subsection></section></part><part identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2" id="H77AB7E8011014B7197BE0160C7CF4654"><num value="2">PART 2—</num><heading>AUTOMATIC VOTER REGISTRATION</heading>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011" id="H33AA15728EF7423FA32F21E0B61B9654"><num value="1011">SEC. 1011. </num><heading>SHORT TITLE; FINDINGS AND PURPOSE.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011/a" id="HBD8F51BFA1C34D6485078556F604B58F" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Short Title</inline>.—</heading><content>This part may be cited as the “<shortTitle role="part">Automatic Voter Registration Act of 2019</shortTitle>”.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011/b" id="H302AB3727D744E2CAD457843450BA9BD" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Findings and Purpose</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011/b/1" id="H1A4A448BE62E460A9853AEEAB36E533E" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Findings</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Congress finds that—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011/b/1/A" id="H2933A8FE89A14186A5F2C960D9A6BDE6" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>the right to vote is a fundamental right of citizens of the United States;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011/b/1/B" id="HC2A8BFD4549E46C9A1BBBA6AFA577053" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>it is the responsibility of the State and Federal Governments to ensure that every eligible citizen is registered to vote;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011/b/1/C" id="HC46BDACBC9C841CBB97D4D2B8ACC7536" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>existing voter registration systems can be inaccurate, costly, inaccessible and confusing, with damaging effects on voter participation in elections and disproportionate impacts on young people, persons with disabilities, and racial and ethnic minorities; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011/b/1/D" id="H979003895B11468F81D58E7D56D49C9E" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>voter registration systems must be updated with 21st Century technologies and procedures to maintain their security.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011/b/2" id="HEFD71F1E204643F48F17E7D83EB434A8" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Purpose</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>It is the purpose of this part—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011/b/2/A" id="H9DD32654815D4FF5B4B147ED57EFFC07" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>to establish that it is the responsibility of government at every level to ensure that all eligible citizens are registered to vote;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011/b/2/B" id="HADA24ACC1BF14BD38BF42A841513165B" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>to enable the State and Federal Governments to register all eligible citizens to vote with accurate, cost-efficient, and up-to-date procedures;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011/b/2/C" id="H586D05F077C34616B0FF161416D7BFA9" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>to modernize voter registration and list maintenance procedures with electronic and Internet capabilities; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1011/b/2/D" id="H1C2FE4BFF30E4ABE980BFD3C9B981B3E" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>to protect and enhance the integrity, accuracy, efficiency, and accessibility of the electoral process for all eligible citizens.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012" id="H749DDAE19B554CA8AD85A52232E77A0D"><num value="1012">SEC. 1012. </num><heading>AUTOMATIC REGISTRATION OF ELIGIBLE INDIVIDUALS.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/a" id="HC93C8318A3D9406A9CAEF11E94B22D97" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Requiring States to Establish and Operate Automatic Registration System</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/a/1" id="HF875DD841EBF45A1B317D9035347C7CE" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>The chief State election official of each State shall establish and operate a system of automatic registration for the registration of eligible individuals to vote for elections for Federal office in the State, in accordance with the provisions of this part.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/a/2" id="H1F38FEE3CFD14A89B984A4A625675EB8" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definition</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>automatic registration</term>” means a system that registers an individual to vote in elections for Federal office in a State, if eligible, by electronically transferring the information necessary for registration from government agencies to election officials of the State so that, unless the individual affirmatively declines to be registered, the individual will be registered to vote in such elections.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/b" id="H8857F6C6AAC4435085946A5BE8329EE8" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Registration of Voters Based on New Agency Records</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The chief State election official shall—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/b/1" id="H2B04DEBDAA2847ADB9DBD0B7E69B7705" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>not later than 15 days after a contributing agency has transmitted information with respect to an individual pursuant to section 1013, ensure that the individual is registered to vote in elections for Federal office in the State if the individual is eligible to be registered to vote in such elections; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/b/2" id="H5AB884F5691A4ACFBE6191F424B07791" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>not later than 120 days after a contributing agency has transmitted such information with respect to the individual, send written notice to the individual, in addition to other means of notice established by this part, of the individual’s voter registration status.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/c" id="H4B64CA3EF0C4496087F9F26D56604190" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">One-time Registration of Voters Based on Existing Contributing Agency Records</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The chief State election official shall—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/c/1" id="H00A5F759C4D5462D900B51D389270A9A" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>identify all individuals whose information is transmitted by a contributing agency pursuant to section 1014 and who are eligible to be, but are not currently, registered to vote in that State;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/c/2" id="H74B505EE97EE49D7A216551355314589" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><chapeau>promptly send each such individual written notice, in addition to other means of notice established by this part, which shall not identify the contributing agency that transmitted the information but shall include—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/c/2/A" id="H2881B207EB784D9A96AEC165A657FB97" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>an explanation that voter registration is voluntary, but if the individual does not decline registration, the individual will be registered to vote;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/c/2/B" id="H2A4F60A4051A43418A0F129C90987D1C" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>a statement offering the opportunity to decline voter registration through means consistent with the requirements of this part;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/c/2/C" id="HA38AFCBBB0874881BA61D3CBD3794AD8" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>in the case of a State in which affiliation or enrollment with a political party is required in order to participate in an election to select the party’s candidate in an election for Federal office, a statement offering the individual the opportunity to affiliate or enroll with a political party or to decline to affiliate or enroll with a political party, through means consistent with the requirements of this part;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/c/2/D" id="H8AE7F21BA19A41E997CB58B28E98B35A" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>the substantive qualifications of an elector in the State as listed in the mail voter registration application form for elections for Federal office prescribed pursuant to section 9 of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993, the consequences of false registration, and a statement that the individual should decline to register if the individual does not meet all those qualifications;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/c/2/E" id="HE6C402AA0F1D447CA2403C1F7C9D5EEC" class="indent2"><num value="E">(E) </num><content>instructions for correcting any erroneous information; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/c/2/F" id="H4C78A2F62B2E4C22976218FAEE7C4BD6" class="indent2"><num value="F">(F) </num><content>instructions for providing any additional information which is listed in the mail voter registration application form for elections for Federal office prescribed pursuant to section 9 of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993;</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/c/3" id="H3E373582B5D647C3A19C96FB75FC9205" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>ensure that each such individual who is eligible to register to vote in elections for Federal office in the State is promptly registered to vote not later than 45 days after the official sends the individual the written notice under paragraph (2), unless, during the 30-day period which begins on the date the election official sends the individual such written notice, the individual declines registration in writing, through a communication made over the Internet, or by an officially-logged telephone communication; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/c/4" id="H4748E19488C74A6787224779646554C3" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>send written notice to each such individual, in addition to other means of notice established by this part, of the individual’s voter registration status.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/d" id="HB5ABC0C78B874978BA435A6F982319A5" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment of Individuals Under 18 Years of Age</inline>.—</heading><content>A State may not refuse to treat an individual as an eligible individual for purposes of this part on the grounds that the individual is less than 18 years of age at the time a contributing agency receives information with respect to the individual, so long as the individual is at least 16 years of age at such time.</content></subsection>
<subsection role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1012/e" id="H3F9F6FB8B7C44716BF7E7EB4C14C5481" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Contributing Agency Defined</inline>.—</heading><content>In this part, the term “<term>contributing agency</term>” means, with respect to a State, an agency listed in section 1013(e).</content></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013" id="HA9FB66B0A2DD4B70886B7834F921CAB2"><num value="1013">SEC. 1013. </num><heading>CONTRIBUTING AGENCY ASSISTANCE IN REGISTRATION.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/a" id="HEF0740624DD54532A9690A8258152180" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>In accordance with this part, each contributing agency in a State shall assist the State’s chief election official in registering to vote all eligible individuals served by that agency.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b" id="HB1A3AE6D1BE54386BA16173ED429C6E5" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Requirements for Contributing Agencies</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/1" id="H93A3D01690C9462D91E0339935B4FBD3" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Instructions on automatic registration</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>With each application for service or assistance, and with each related recertification, renewal, or change of address, or, in the case of an institution of higher education, with each registration of a student for enrollment in a course of study, each contributing agency that (in the normal course of its operations) requests individuals to affirm United States citizenship (either directly or as part of the overall application for service or assistance) shall inform each such individual who is a citizen of the United States of the following:</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/1/A" id="H4BC50B60370E443E89BBFCA50FB1D378" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>Unless that individual declines to register to vote, or is found ineligible to vote, the individual will be registered to vote or, if applicable, the individual’s registration will be updated.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/1/B" id="HAE42517C696846AF806C167AF99AA87F" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>The substantive qualifications of an elector in the State as listed in the mail voter registration application form for elections for Federal office prescribed pursuant to section 9 of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993, the consequences of false registration, and the individual should decline to register if the individual does not meet all those qualifications.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/1/C" id="H5D5DEACE3D484C19971F9657151CE0BB" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>In the case of a State in which affiliation or enrollment with a political party is required in order to participate in an election to select the party’s candidate in an election for Federal office, the requirement that the individual must affiliate or enroll with a political party in order to participate in such an election.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/1/D" id="H469A0C5619A3465AB14150A8B50B59C8" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>Voter registration is voluntary, and neither registering nor declining to register to vote will in any way affect the availability of services or benefits, nor be used for other purposes.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/2" id="HCCC1B47DD79443758DFBBDF7B1185D31" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Opportunity to decline registration required</inline>.—</heading><content>Each contributing agency shall ensure that each application for service or assistance, and each related recertification, renewal, or change of address, or, in the case of an institution of higher education, each registration of a student for enrollment in a course of study, cannot be completed until the individual is given the opportunity to decline to be registered to vote.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/3" id="H68706400C90140519CA1BEB1EB0B3F25" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Information transmittal</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Upon the expiration of the 30-day period which begins on the date the contributing agency informs the individual of the information described in paragraph (1), each contributing agency shall electronically transmit to the appropriate State election official, in a format compatible with the statewide voter database maintained under section 303 of the Help America Vote Act of 2002 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s21083">52 U.S.C. 21083</ref>), the following information, unless during such 30-day period the individual declined to be registered to vote:</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/3/A" id="H9A0D2891341141B997343876E06B076F" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>The individual’s given name(s) and surname(s).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/3/B" id="HAF09CFE8FDFD431EAFE32DB71F450A2E" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>The individual’s date of birth.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/3/C" id="HF013722986004E8FA562B698FA3C97E7" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>The individual’s residential address.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/3/D" id="HE6784256B6EB4BDEA3EF34B5C7E340EA" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>Information showing that the individual is a citizen of the United States.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/3/E" id="H52160BFE23C94056A5AFCD5728EF4ECD" class="indent2"><num value="E">(E) </num><content>The date on which information pertaining to that individual was collected or last updated.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/3/F" id="H349734B424AE42A7889052DBC7498D25" class="indent2"><num value="F">(F) </num><content>If available, the individual’s signature in electronic form.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/3/G" id="H139B332EE4634A6BA65CEDD4C32FD192" class="indent2"><num value="G">(G) </num><content>Information regarding the individual’s affiliation or enrollment with a political party, if the individual provides such information.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/b/3/H" id="H35165968788C4E2BA25F92A73C1ED8C1" class="indent2"><num value="H">(H) </num><content>Any additional information listed in the mail voter registration application form for elections for Federal office prescribed pursuant to section 9 of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993, including any valid driver’s license number or the last 4 digits of the individual’s social security number, if the individual provided such information.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/c" id="HE30F5723691E40EE8E401C9B390EEEA2" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Alternate Procedure for Certain Contributing Agencies</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>With each application for service or assistance, and with each related recertification, renewal, or change of address, any contributing agency that in the normal course of its operations does not request individuals applying for service or assistance to affirm United States citizenship (either directly or as part of the overall application for service or assistance) shall—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/c/1" id="H166B1D4711D744D9B3A6ADBA930CFF01" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>complete the requirements of section 7(a)(6) of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s20506/a/6">52 U.S.C. 20506(a)(6)</ref>);</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/c/2" id="H7AEEF565869346BBB503E1915202B34F" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>ensure that each applicant’s transaction with the agency cannot be completed until the applicant has indicated whether the applicant wishes to register to vote or declines to register to vote in elections for Federal office held in the State; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/c/3" id="H347A56C61A764AC7BF0353018CB7A394" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>for each individual who wishes to register to vote, transmit that individual’s information in accordance with subsection (b)(3).</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/d" id="HAEF5519C78674C279D33310F19D62316" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Required Availability of Automatic Registration Opportunity With Each Application for Service or Assistance</inline>.—</heading><content>Each contributing agency shall offer each individual, with each application for service or assistance, and with each related recertification, renewal, or change of address, or in the case of an institution of higher education, with each registration of a student for enrollment in a course of study, the opportunity to register to vote as prescribed by this section without regard to whether the individual previously declined a registration opportunity.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e" id="H085DA821084B44669D716F059C631239" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Contributing Agencies</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/1" id="H84EB264CF8D447A99439DD42120D681C" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">State agencies</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In each State, each of the following agencies shall be treated as a contributing agency:</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/1/A" id="HB9C8C74744304FDF9523FA39C92F6E6F" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>Each agency in a State that is required by Federal law to provide voter registration services, including the State motor vehicle authority and other voter registration agencies under the National Voter Registration Act of 1993.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/1/B" id="H9398B40259D4479ABC6C2153FC2AC51F" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>Each agency in a State that administers a program pursuant to title III of the Social Security Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t42/s501/etseq">42 U.S.C. 501 et seq.</ref>), title XIX of the Social Security Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t42/s1396/etseq">42 U.S.C. 1396 et seq.</ref>), or the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (<ref href="/us/pl/111/148">Public Law 111–148</ref>).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/1/C" id="H54FABA2D65E04102AD4015C62619D8C2" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>Each State agency primarily responsible for regulating the private possession of firearms.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/1/D" id="HCF41574F365A45D78A8B4B32128A0E37" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>Each State agency primarily responsible for maintaining identifying information for students enrolled at public secondary schools, including, where applicable, the State agency responsible for maintaining the education data system described in section 6201(e)(2) of the America COMPETES Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t20/s9871/e/2">20 U.S.C. 9871(e)(2)</ref>).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/1/E" id="H6833C6DBAB554232AA8A61A5A48259DD" class="indent2"><num value="E">(E) </num><content>In the case of a State in which an individual disenfranchised by a criminal conviction may become eligible to vote upon completion of a criminal sentence or any part thereof, or upon formal restoration of rights, the State agency responsible for administering that sentence, or part thereof, or that restoration of rights.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/1/F" id="H84EA38FD0774470BBB2853685CED07D9" class="indent2"><num value="F">(F) </num><content>Any other agency of the State which is designated by the State as a contributing agency.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/2" id="H761AC9E8FB6C4F26A62245FBAC70432E" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Federal agencies</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In each State, each of the following agencies of the Federal government shall be treated as a contributing agency with respect to individuals who are residents of that State (except as provided in subparagraph (C)):</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/2/A" id="HBC83FABA2D0F46E1BEB27342217562C1" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>The Social Security Administration, the Department of Veterans Affairs, the Defense Manpower Data Center of the Department of Defense, the Employee and Training Administration of the Department of Labor, and the Center for Medicare &amp; Medicaid Services of the Department of Health and Human Services.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/2/B" id="H020DE33596114CA291F1C628A443BCFC" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>The Bureau of Citizenship and Immigration Services, but only with respect to individuals who have completed the naturalization process.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/2/C" id="H20272ACAD8064B5E9C255E52B2E3D71F" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>In the case of an individual who is a resident of a State in which an individual disenfranchised by a criminal conviction under Federal law may become eligible to vote upon completion of a criminal sentence or any part thereof, or upon formal restoration of rights, the Federal agency responsible for administering that sentence or part thereof (without regard to whether the agency is located in the same State in which the individual is a resident), but only with respect to individuals who have completed the criminal sentence or any part thereof.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/2/D" id="H904BDF0EE19A4D028850AEE9F71DB765" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>Any other agency of the Federal government which the State designates as a contributing agency, but only if the State and the head of the agency determine that the agency collects information sufficient to carry out the responsibilities of a contributing agency under this section.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/3" id="HFF634AF1471645EE9B6529F53AA23DEE" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special rule for institutions of higher education</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/3/A" id="HFC2996A392264D5DAAC07ADBAE3B6102" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special rule</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of this part, each institution of higher education described in subparagraph (B) shall be treated as a contributing agency in the State in which it is located, except that—</chapeau>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/3/A/i" id="H546FAC214ADC4E22BBCDFD57580EBFA3" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>the institution shall be treated as a contributing agency only if, in its normal course of operations, the institution requests each student registering for enrollment in a course of study, including enrollment in a program of distance education, as defined in section 103(7) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (<ref href="/us/usc/t20/s1003/7">20 U.S.C. 1003(7)</ref>), to affirm whether or not the student is a United States citizen; and</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/3/A/ii" id="HB03C978B441C44E79BDF0883862CB685" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>if the institution is treated as a contributing agency in a State pursuant to clause (i), the institution shall serve as a contributing agency only with respect to students, including students enrolled in a program of distance education, as defined in section 103(7) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (<ref href="/us/usc/t20/s1003/7">20 U.S.C. 1003(7)</ref>), who reside in the State.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/3/B" id="H3C602C25FD3942ED9A49C0F042845405" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Institutions described</inline>.—</heading><content>An institution described in this subparagraph is an institution of higher education which has a program participation agreement in effect with the Secretary of Education under section 487 of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (<ref href="/us/usc/t20/s1094">20 U.S.C. 1094</ref>) and which is located in a State to which section 4(b) of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s20503/b">52 U.S.C. 20503(b)</ref>) does not apply.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/4" id="H6E31E719E10A4A0EB01161B149DA146F" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Publication</inline>.—</heading><content>Not later than 180 days prior to the date of each election for Federal office held in the State, the chief State election official shall publish on the public website of the official an updated list of all contributing agencies in that State.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1013/e/5" id="H74EBBB087D8F4E73ACC8E84CCEE24EC2" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Public education</inline>.—</heading><content>The chief State election official of each State, in collaboration with each contributing agency, shall take appropriate measures to educate the public about voter registration under this section.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1014" id="H53F77FC33C104191A321CEB91AE92094"><num value="1014">SEC. 1014. </num><heading>ONE-TIME CONTRIBUTING AGENCY ASSISTANCE IN REGISTRATION OF ELIGIBLE VOTERS IN EXISTING RECORDS.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1014/a" id="H5C062F5CF6DB4D6FB7D2A6C6D8B75DC4" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Initial Transmittal of Information</inline>.—</heading><content>For each individual already listed in a contributing agency’s records as of the date of enactment of this Act, and for whom the agency has the information listed in section 1013(b)(3), the agency shall promptly transmit that information to the appropriate State election official in accordance with section 1013(b)(3) not later than the effective date described in section 1011(a).</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1014/b" id="H245564AB48AF4488AB9A057C605AB950" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Transition</inline>.—</heading><content>For each individual listed in a contributing agency’s records as of the effective date described in section 1011(a) (but who was not listed in a contributing agency’s records as of the date of enactment of this Act), and for whom the agency has the information listed in section 1013(b)(3), the Agency shall promptly transmit that information to the appropriate State election official in accordance with section 1013(b)(3) not later than 6 months after the effective date described in section 1011(a).</content></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015" id="H6619A20126B84C94AE5707BBC6F6A2FF"><num value="1015">SEC. 1015. </num><heading>VOTER PROTECTION AND SECURITY IN AUTOMATIC REGISTRATION.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/a" id="HE3958C6AC52D41F6BD8A1507542ED014" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Protections for Errors in Registration</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>An individual shall not be prosecuted under any Federal or State law, adversely affected in any civil adjudication concerning immigration status or naturalization, or subject to an allegation in any legal proceeding that the individual is not a citizen of the United States on any of the following grounds:</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/a/1" id="H3AB1D053654743699500ABF43F7E2B32" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>The individual notified an election office of the individual’s automatic registration to vote under this part.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/a/2" id="H997D2014FA5A4BBCBF77373E9FA5B808" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>The individual is not eligible to vote in elections for Federal office but was automatically registered to vote under this part.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/a/3" id="HF8AE10BF5A6F4A7BA9C4FA91CF6B130B" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>The individual was automatically registered to vote under this part at an incorrect address.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/a/4" id="HDC9CBE7793924A63AFC446C1F0E5429F" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>The individual declined the opportunity to register to vote or did not make an affirmation of citizenship, including through automatic registration, under this part.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/b" id="H9C6EB125418B47759F3A9310AA137A4B" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limits on Use of Automatic Registration</inline>.—</heading><content>The automatic registration of any individual or the fact that an individual declined the opportunity to register to vote or did not make an affirmation of citizenship (including through automatic registration) under this part may not be used as evidence against that individual in any State or Federal law enforcement proceeding, and an individual’s lack of knowledge or willfulness of such registration may be demonstrated by the individual’s testimony alone.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/c" id="H5FF4C4E65A5F4E42B3731797DB621266" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Protection of Election Integrity</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Nothing in subsections (a) or (b) may be construed to prohibit or restrict any action under color of law against an individual who—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/c/1" id="HC3315B5F41CB4C2FBE35F9ED01BE08B5" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>knowingly and willfully makes a false statement to effectuate or perpetuate automatic voter registration by any individual; or</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/c/2" id="H9A7871F1E8B84ABBBA1113FED4C9C501" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>casts a ballot knowingly and willfully in violation of State law or the laws of the United States.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/d" id="HEAF32A474B3748C2AC9F6DA695154899" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Contributing Agencies’ Protection of Information</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Nothing in this part authorizes a contributing agency to collect, retain, transmit, or publicly disclose any of the following:</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/d/1" id="H96D5ADBC11F24494920B135DFB72FBEB" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>An individual’s decision to decline to register to vote or not to register to vote.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/d/2" id="H7FA8602B016F48E79CFB5EED641B3218" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>An individual’s decision not to affirm his or her citizenship.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/d/3" id="H64B172B10A3945B5B7946B4EAA447CD1" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>Any information that a contributing agency transmits pursuant to section 1013(b)(3), except in pursuing the agency’s ordinary course of business.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e" id="H6F265B5FA80247489CFC20B6A873C370" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Election Officials’ Protection of Information</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1" id="HA330E9948D2F40AEACE3998BAAE8B8C3" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Public disclosure prohibited</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/A" id="H8964E6F5E3234D6D99AC4C0A39F17EBE" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Subject to subparagraph (B), with respect to any individual for whom any State election official receives information from a contributing agency, the State election officials shall not publicly disclose any of the following:</chapeau>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/A/i" id="HA0BD83BDD3334BA7B71433E2FB7A0DEF" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>The identity of the contributing agency.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/A/ii" id="H4555E033AEB64DA587BACF37363C3473" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>Any information not necessary to voter registration.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/A/iii" id="HFECB3731E6874FC9A4CB38EFED2C6F6D" class="indent3"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><content>Any voter information otherwise shielded from disclosure under State law or section 8(a) of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s20507/a">52 U.S.C. 20507(a)</ref>).</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/A/iv" id="H94C56E277FCE42E68D9C1A06C2308578" class="indent3"><num value="iv">(iv) </num><content>Any portion of the individual’s social security number.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/A/v" id="H0EBEE40ECB8E4FA0AFA86C50D1627B55" class="indent3"><num value="v">(v) </num><content>Any portion of the individual’s motor vehicle driver’s license number.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/A/vi" id="H71ED9F8BCE904576ACCDE9F1731C3CDE" class="indent3"><num value="vi">(vi) </num><content>The individual’s signature.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/A/vii" id="H26D84F68DE1B4C61A355A34BC334DF3F" class="indent3"><num value="vii">(vii) </num><content>The individual’s telephone number.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/A/viii" id="H1B954EB9775A4376B5ABE03639CD4079" class="indent3"><num value="viii">(viii) </num><content>The individual’s email address.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/B" id="H5D5C2D7F9BF64F9680D357A9E09E55E2" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special rule for individuals registered to vote</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>With respect to any individual for whom any State election official receives information from a contributing agency and who, on the basis of such information, is registered to vote in the State under this part, the State election officials shall not publicly disclose any of the following:</chapeau>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/B/i" id="HEA32B9F8B2C1452991AFC7B813984EA4" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>The identity of the contributing agency.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/B/ii" id="H709157501FC74819B9ACC26FAB2B83C5" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>Any information not necessary to voter registration.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/B/iii" id="H7032E97A635B453290D30A5E4B31E9B0" class="indent3"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><content>Any voter information otherwise shielded from disclosure under State law or section 8(a) of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s20507/a">52 U.S.C. 20507(a)</ref>).</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/B/iv" id="HD1D06EB0F67147BC91DF0C8A3AA50426" class="indent3"><num value="iv">(iv) </num><content>Any portion of the individual’s social security number.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/B/v" id="H570EA51C56954BEEB8E15C066CBBC585" class="indent3"><num value="v">(v) </num><content>Any portion of the individual’s motor vehicle driver’s license number.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/1/B/vi" id="HC209B3792B6C4C98B5AE8BF7A45631D2" class="indent3"><num value="vi">(vi) </num><content>The individual’s signature.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/2" id="H273D62D010C64AA5987CC1E4117CB881" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Voter record changes</inline>.—</heading><content>Each State shall maintain for at least 2 years and shall make available for public inspection (and, where available, photocopying at a reasonable cost), including in electronic form and through electronic methods, all records of changes to voter records, including removals, the reasons for removals, and updates.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/3" id="HCA62B4008BB2458D86061876696C0F18" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Database management standards</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Director of the National Institute of Standards and Technology shall, after providing the public with notice and the opportunity to comment—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/3/A" id="H86A1FF6E60BB44A3BC94C3C3036F7E68" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>establish standards governing the comparison of data for voter registration list maintenance purposes, identifying as part of such standards the specific data elements, the matching rules used, and how a State may use the data to determine and deem that an individual is ineligible under State law to vote in an election, or to deem a record to be a duplicate or outdated;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/3/B" id="H86B2F1CACB7546AA9F8211BAAB6355DE" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>ensure that the standards developed pursuant to this paragraph are uniform and nondiscriminatory and are applied in a uniform and nondiscriminatory manner; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/3/C" id="H2585C010734F4968A0DA3E873173CD57" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>not later than 45 days after the deadline for public notice and comment, publish the standards developed pursuant to this paragraph on the Director’s website and make those standards available in written form upon request.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/4" id="HEC2CEC1A5A3C40BA95E1E4118D420AFD" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Security policy</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Director of the National Institute of Standards and Technology shall, after providing the public with notice and the opportunity to comment, publish privacy and security standards for voter registration information not later than 45 days after the deadline for public notice and comment. The standards shall require the chief State election official of each State to adopt a policy that shall specify—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/4/A" id="HA4CD694101FE4FCE90FD57B56F29DFD3" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>each class of users who shall have authorized access to the computerized statewide voter registration list, specifying for each class the permission and levels of access to be granted, and setting forth other safeguards to protect the privacy, security, and accuracy of the information on the list; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/4/B" id="H4234957F06B54D49A3EC499D87FBE280" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>security safeguards to protect personal information transmitted through the information transmittal processes of section 1013 or section 1014, the online system used pursuant to section 1017, any telephone interface, the maintenance of the voter registration database, and any audit procedure to track access to the system.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/5" id="H740E71C0F2D44C9C86A83EB366E0E4C5" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">State compliance with national standards</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/5/A" id="H48C34A99E0B346DE86AF4E9860A0C1CD" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Certification</inline>.—</heading><content>The chief executive officer of the State shall annually file with the Election Assistance Commission a statement certifying to the Director of the National Institute of Standards and Technology that the State is in compliance with the standards referred to in paragraphs (3) and (4). A State may meet the requirement of the previous sentence by filing with the Commission a statement which reads as follows: “_____ hereby certifies that it is in compliance with the standards referred to in paragraphs (3) and (4) of section 1015(e) of the Automatic Voter Registration Act of 2019.” (with the blank to be filled in with the name of the State involved).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/5/B" id="H0B19976A4F87411DB289E67C3B7D3A6A" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Publication of policies and procedures</inline>.—</heading><content>The chief State election official of a State shall publish on the official’s website the policies and procedures established under this section, and shall make those policies and procedures available in written form upon public request.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/5/C" id="HEAF4A2912AA743F5B95BD4BE1C289767" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Funding dependent on certification</inline>.—</heading><content>If a State does not timely file the certification required under this paragraph, it shall not receive any payment under this part for the upcoming fiscal year.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/e/5/D" id="H6F3B7818275747DA86A4FC6A4998D3DC" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Compliance of states that require changes to state law</inline>.—</heading><content>In the case of a State that requires State legislation to carry out an activity covered by any certification submitted under this paragraph, for a period of not more than 2 years the State shall be permitted to make the certification notwithstanding that the legislation has not been enacted at the time the certification is submitted, and such State shall submit an additional certification once such legislation is enacted.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/f" id="HC314279400AB41868139F300622B42BF" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Restrictions on Use of Information</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>No person acting under color of law may discriminate against any individual based on, or use for any purpose other than voter registration, election administration, or enforcement relating to election crimes, any of the following:</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/f/1" id="H8FC5715811DC4394BC474DB5C97E3F0A" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>Voter registration records.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/f/2" id="H91134B99C61F42FCA029DA04E8AD3638" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>An individual’s declination to register to vote or complete an affirmation of citizenship under section 1013(b).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/f/3" id="HE29BCF60EDA449F2B95C5FEDCAFCC470" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>An individual’s voter registration status.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1015/g" id="HA410956C48234BF9A05AEB9D70811C3B" class="indent0"><num value="g">(g) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition on the Use of Voter Registration Information for Commercial Purposes</inline>.—</heading><content>Information collected under this part shall not be used for commercial purposes. Nothing in this subsection may be construed to prohibit the transmission, exchange, or dissemination of information for political purposes, including the support of campaigns for election for Federal, State, or local public office or the activities of political committees (including committees of political parties) under the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971.</content></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1016" id="H82652E5B440246BA9FBB69EAD11B2729"><num value="1016">SEC. 1016. </num><heading>REGISTRATION PORTABILITY AND CORRECTION.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1016/a" id="H0D75605EF0C042E19D724DDE59B4B645" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Correcting Registration Information at Polling Place</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Notwithstanding section 302(a) of the Help America Vote Act of 2002 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s21082/a">52 U.S.C. 21082(a)</ref>), if an individual is registered to vote in elections for Federal office held in a State, the appropriate election official at the polling pace for any such election (including a location used as a polling place on a date other than the date of the election) shall permit the individual to—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1016/a/1" id="H9543B6193E0345ABA5E24EE43F66B84C" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>update the individual’s address for purposes of the records of the election official;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1016/a/2" id="H4D8AB23F73B34B7992F1AD228A1A16FA" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>correct any incorrect information relating to the individual, including the individual’s name and political party affiliation, in the records of the election official; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1016/a/3" id="HF651674058A347259100368EA280C844" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>cast a ballot in the election on the basis of the updated address or corrected information, and to have the ballot treated as a regular ballot and not as a provisional ballot under section 302(a) of such Act.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1016/b" id="H899B8B086F9A42E5A22C20DF872FDEC5" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Updates to Computerized Statewide Voter Registration Lists</inline>.—</heading><content>If an election official at the polling place receives an updated address or corrected information from an individual under subsection (a), the official shall ensure that the address or information is promptly entered into the computerized Statewide voter registration list in accordance with section 303(a)(1)(A)(vi) of the Help America Vote Act of 2002 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s21083/a/1/A/vi">52 U.S.C. 21083(a)(1)(A)(vi)</ref>).</content></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017" id="HCA4878D8A1E94E0D976BEC46CC16E63C"><num value="1017">SEC. 1017. </num><heading>PAYMENTS AND GRANTS.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/a" id="H1AE34FF503FB456C900AF325120EB1B8" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>The Election Assistance Commission shall make grants to each eligible State to assist the State in implementing the requirements of this part (or, in the case of an exempt State, in implementing its existing automatic voter registration program).</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/b" id="H80E74E73C41145318154AD30448393D4" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Eligibility; Application</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A State is eligible to receive a grant under this section if the State submits to the Commission, at such time and in such form as the Commission may require, an application containing—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/b/1" id="HD383733B2217474D9BD8793A760F7781" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>a description of the activities the State will carry out with the grant;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/b/2" id="H2B8607CFEB8943CEBA2A5EC78F9C50A6" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>an assurance that the State shall carry out such activities without partisan bias and without promoting any particular point of view regarding any issue; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/b/3" id="H07A4A271C30744338870AE7118D8A28B" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>such other information and assurances as the Commission may require.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/c" id="HD3F6D394AEDB425399CB8617647516CA" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Amount of Grant; Priorities</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Commission shall determine the amount of a grant made to an eligible State under this section. In determining the amounts of the grants, the Commission shall give priority to providing funds for those activities which are most likely to accelerate compliance with the requirements of this part (or, in the case of an exempt State, which are most likely to enhance the ability of the State to automatically register individuals to vote through its existing automatic voter registration program), including—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/c/1" id="HC47987DD492241DA87C7E6E0593CA867" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>investments supporting electronic information transfer, including electronic collection and transfer of signatures, between contributing agencies and the appropriate State election officials;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/c/2" id="H8887CD00991442BEBCEA4F880CD9EBB0" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>updates to online or electronic voter registration systems already operating as of the date of the enactment of this Act;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/c/3" id="HD1C29373407843BFA69066C1118BA28E" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>introduction of online voter registration systems in jurisdictions in which those systems did not previously exist; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/c/4" id="HB0312F31F88B438D84CC8FB9427EE123" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>public education on the availability of new methods of registering to vote, updating registration, and correcting registration.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/d" id="HC73920FB9B864DF2AF28028A579FC7EC" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authorization of Appropriations</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/d/1" id="H1A1DACBB45A346E994E3E090D61667EE" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authorization</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/d/1/A" id="HEC285913326F4D1A86955971A0C61192" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>$500,000,000 for fiscal year 2019; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/d/1/B" id="HAA0C7E80B87E4624918DEA7C41A17329" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>such sums as may be necessary for each succeeding fiscal year.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1017/d/2" id="H7CFEAF25909E4E6F8038B6C0021979A3" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Continuing availability of funds</inline>.—</heading><content>Any amounts appropriated pursuant to the authority of this subsection shall remain available without fiscal year limitation until expended.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1018" id="H535614BCBD3D4D019E020EE35F3481E6"><num value="1018">SEC. 1018. </num><heading>TREATMENT OF EXEMPT STATES.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1018/a" id="H38F9E5313DA546A38786A033086CC214" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Waiver of Requirements</inline>.—</heading><content>Except as provided in subsection (b), this part does not apply with respect to an exempt State.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1018/b" id="HD07EA34E0E554EC3AD87615C95655F24" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exceptions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The following provisions of this part apply with respect to an exempt State:</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1018/b/1" id="HC2744D3445664CCDB6457B76B5DFA58A" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>section 1016 (relating to registration portability and correction).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1018/b/2" id="HC17B12312793408A8ED7794C601E92D5" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>section 1017 (relating to payments and grants).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1018/b/3" id="H070FE7F2E04A4F59B2D2856231D45E59" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>Section 1019(e) (relating to enforcement).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1018/b/4" id="H16035FDCC0324701BA857AFD392AFBE3" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>Section 1019(f) (relating to relation to other laws).</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1019" id="H7454415C064A45BB9F28B83373282339"><num value="1019">SEC. 1019. </num><heading>MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1019/a" id="HE2B578795F6B4D5ABA8085567E1413CB" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Accessibility of Registration Services</inline>.—</heading><content>Each contributing agency shall ensure that the services it provides under this part are made available to individuals with disabilities to the same extent as services are made available to all other individuals.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1019/b" id="H128D51017E2B40C1A9915BF660C57081" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Transmission Through Secure Third Party Permitted</inline>.—</heading><content>Nothing in this part shall be construed to prevent a contributing agency from contracting with a third party to assist the agency in meeting the information transmittal requirements of this part, so long as the data transmittal complies with the applicable requirements of this part, including the privacy and security provisions of section 1015.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1019/c" id="H0534BF20CCC143B5964FD307155F91B3" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Nonpartisan, Nondiscriminatory Provision of Services</inline>.—</heading><content>The services made available by contributing agencies under this part and by the State under sections 1006 and 1007 shall be made in a manner consistent with paragraphs (4), (5), and (6)(C) of section 7(a) of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s20506/a">52 U.S.C. 20506(a)</ref>).</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1019/d" id="H53A7EC5992C741789E7B730806391B2E" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notices</inline>.—</heading><content>Each State may send notices under this part via electronic mail if the individual has provided an electronic mail address and consented to electronic mail communications for election-related materials. All notices sent pursuant to this part that require a response must offer the individual notified the opportunity to respond at no cost to the individual.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1019/e" id="HDF7CDB865A784B7D9B24B50EA690E2B6" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Enforcement</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 11 of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s20510">52 U.S.C. 20510</ref>), relating to civil enforcement and the availability of private rights of action, shall apply with respect to this part in the same manner as such section applies to such Act.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1019/f" id="HFFC224C2A8C04CC3A099724A6C00E6EB" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Relation to Other Laws</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Except as provided, nothing in this part may be construed to authorize or require conduct prohibited under, or to supersede, restrict, or limit the application of any of the following:</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1019/f/1" id="HEEB9FB4F5CCF4CFCAFD592246F92A295" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>The Voting Rights Act of 1965 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s10301/etseq">52 U.S.C. 10301 et seq.</ref>).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1019/f/2" id="H129A21A90276449FBA9DC0E628AF9399" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>The Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Absentee Voting Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s20301/etseq">52 U.S.C. 20301 et seq.</ref>).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1019/f/3" id="H9EFE4FDD9BFA40BBB1E8BA2503DCDB62" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>The National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s20501/etseq">52 U.S.C. 20501 et seq.</ref>).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1019/f/4" id="H3FE0C744C6754BCBBA24CEC856BAEA4D" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>The Help America Vote Act of 2002 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s20901/etseq">52 U.S.C. 20901 et seq.</ref>).</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1020" id="H660B649EAF364A91A8F117DE864F809A"><num value="1020">SEC. 1020. </num><heading>DEFINITIONS.</heading>
<chapeau class="indent0">In this part, the following definitions apply:</chapeau>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1020/1" id="HBF29469A5BDB4B458457B2A04D480146" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>The term “<term>chief State election official</term>” means, with respect to a State, the individual designated by the State under section 10 of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s20509">52 U.S.C. 20509</ref>) to be responsible for coordination of the State’s responsibilities under such Act.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1020/2" id="HFDCE4D83F8C745B6BC86C4F307F1BE14" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>The term “<term>Commission</term>” means the Election Assistance Commission.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1020/3" id="H18312122D9D0461D866750DDFE0D5157" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>The term “<term>exempt State</term>” means a State which, under law which is in effect continuously on and after the date of the enactment of this Act, operates an automatic voter registration program under which an individual is automatically registered to vote in elections for Federal office in the State if the individual provides the motor vehicle authority of the State (or, in the case of a State in which an individual is automatically registered to vote at the time the individual applies for benefits or services with a Permanent Dividend Fund of the State, provides the appropriate official of such Fund) with such identifying information as the State may require.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1020/4" id="H56721C1246DC4176A167A04B65846C69" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>The term “<term>State</term>” means each of the several States and the District of Columbia.</content></paragraph></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1021" id="HA4497FF547CF4506A7B73E12149D54B9"><num value="1021">SEC. 1021. </num><heading>EFFECTIVE DATE.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1021/a" id="HC364273A2A054B39A9735FC8DF1EA3EC" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>Except as provided in subsection (b), this part and the amendments made by this part shall apply with respect to a State beginning January 1, 2021.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt2/s1021/b" id="H94CBDF30C8364182B479FF1CD2FB85B6" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>Subject to the approval of the Commission, if a State certifies to the Commission that the State will not meet the deadline referred to in subsection (a) because of extraordinary circumstances and includes in the certification the reasons for the failure to meet the deadline, subsection (a) shall apply to the State as if the reference in such subsection to “January 1, 2021” were a reference to “January 1, 2023”.</content></subsection></section></part><part identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dA/tI/stA/pt3" id="HBC413CF6518C43DAA8C0470161201FAB"><num value="3">PART 3—</num><heading>SAME DAY VOTER REGISTRATION</heading>

<section id="H53DB9F85781C41219EE3DCB013A58B86"><num value="304">“SEC. 304. </num><heading>SAME DAY REGISTRATION.</heading>
<subsection id="H3598DA30234D4ACFA650872343A42E47" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H7983631AE46E4FDEA6567A828727F074" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Registration</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Notwithstanding section 8(a)(1)(D) of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s20507/a/1/D">52 U.S.C. 20507(a)(1)(D)</ref>), each State shall permit any eligible individual on the day of a Federal election and on any day when voting, including early voting, is permitted for a Federal election—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H4063BD69DA8543558AC5F7896BEFBBDE" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>to register to vote in such election at the polling place using a form that meets the requirements under section 9(b) of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (or, if the individual is already registered to vote, to revise any of the individual’s voter registration information); and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H4972A225834E4F1A9E6A7B7E1346E71A" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>to cast a vote in such election.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H3EE25C49742C42BCAE536B8CD1B5F6A1" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exception</inline>.—</heading><content>The requirements under paragraph (1) shall not apply to a State in which, under a State law in effect continuously on and after the date of the enactment of this section, there is no voter registration requirement for individuals in the State with respect to elections for Federal office.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection role="definitions" id="HC29B0080738E4FE1B2F27AB6B9D0C88A" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Eligible Individual</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of this section, the term ‘<term>eligible individual</term>’ means, with respect to any election for Federal office, an individual who is otherwise qualified to vote in that election.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H860E4D54168748CEA57F88E168383C3D" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effective Date</inline>.—</heading><content>Each State shall be required to comply with the requirements of subsection (a) for the regularly scheduled general election for Federal office occurring in November 2020 and for any subsequent election for Federal office.”</content></subsection></section></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph></subsection>
