<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5101/f" id="HED49F80570854EF8857E1F77574B5EFE" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reimbursement of Costs</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5101/f/1" id="H05000E2CEFE24DF79B37B142E4DE1BEA" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reimbursement</inline>.—</heading><content>Upon receiving the report submitted by a State under section 5103(a) with respect to an election cycle, the Commission shall transmit a payment to the State in an amount equal to the reasonable costs incurred by the State in operating the voucher pilot program under this part during the cycle.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5101/f/2" id="HA05F22DD6A4A47E3A33BA5F1EDC5EEA9" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Source of funds</inline>.—</heading><content>Payments to States under the program shall be made using amounts in the Freedom From Influence Fund under section 541 of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 (as added by section 5111), hereafter referred to as the “Fund”.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5101/f/3" id="H14EFB3820F5B4924BB2BFF8172C90792" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Mandatory reduction of payments in case of insufficient amounts in freedom from influence fund</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5101/f/3/A" id="H93C0F2F6EB7B478B83C32A830E69F16E" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Advance audits by commission</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Not later than 90 days before the first day of each program operation period, the Commission shall—</chapeau>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5101/f/3/A/i" id="H3FB36CD3E1274018A9E601D6EC118EFF" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>audit the Fund to determine whether, after first making payments to participating candidates under title V of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 (as added by section 5111), the amounts remaining in the Fund will be sufficient to make payments to States under this part in the amounts provided under this subsection; and</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5101/f/3/A/ii" id="HCE9871A6837E49D48A080476053FBC2E" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>submit a report to Congress describing the results of the audit.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5101/f/3/B" id="HF4F8756DE9004560A850E500E41EDB02" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reductions in amount of payments</inline>.—</heading>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5101/f/3/B/i" id="H2A746A444D4A431CB69D61D624D5E088" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Automatic reduction on pro rata basis</inline>.—</heading><content>If, on the basis of the audit described in subparagraph (A), the Commission determines that the amount anticipated to be available in the Fund with respect to an election cycle involved is not, or may not be, sufficient to make payments to States under this part in the full amount provided under this subsection, the Commission shall reduce each amount which would otherwise be paid to a State under this subsection by such pro rata amount as may be necessary to ensure that the aggregate amount of payments anticipated to be made with respect to the cycle will not exceed the amount anticipated to be available for such payments in the Fund with respect to such cycle.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5101/f/3/B/ii" id="HE83C95D3DF2D4B34B0F22F7B92F1D192" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Restoration of reductions in case of availability of sufficient funds during election cycle</inline>.—</heading><content>If, after reducing the amounts paid to States with respect to an election cycle under clause (i), the Commission determines that there are sufficient amounts in the Fund to restore the amount by which such payments were reduced (or any portion thereof), to the extent that such amounts are available, the Commission may make a payment on a pro rata basis to each such State with respect to the cycle in the amount by which such State’s payments were reduced under clause (i) (or any portion thereof, as the case may be).</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5101/f/3/B/iii" id="HB449054C03F04958BE64EA0B91DDD152" class="indent3"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No use of amounts from other sources</inline>.—</heading><content>In any case in which the Commission determines that there are insufficient moneys in the Fund to make payments to States under this part, moneys shall not be made available from any other source for the purpose of making such payments.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5101/f/3" id="H03C201A5279D42D5BD9E5504F465779A" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Cap on amount of payment</inline>.—</heading><content>The aggregate amount of payments made to any State with respect to any program operation period may not exceed $10,000,000. If the State determines that the maximum payment amount under this paragraph with respect to the program operation period involved is not, or may not be, sufficient to cover the reasonable costs incurred by the State in operating the program under this part for such period, the State shall reduce the amount of the voucher provided to each qualified individual by such pro rata amount as may be necessary to ensure that the reasonable costs incurred by the State in operating the program will not exceed the amount paid to the State with respect to such period.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102" id="H1B1550CB023B40B68EB6B2520A1E0F96"><num value="5102">SEC. 5102. </num><heading>VOUCHER PROGRAM DESCRIBED.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/a" id="H84047625B731458191B19E70C31258D3" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">General Elements of Program</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/a/1" id="H487094EB8BE8420B94415D478A8C2C08" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Elements described</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The elements of a voucher pilot program operated by a State under this part are as follows:</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/a/1/A" id="HD54B0F3A61DC4156B9827F25E1D48603" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>The State shall provide each qualified individual upon the individual’s request with a voucher worth $25 to be known as a “My Voice Voucher” during the election cycle which will be assigned a routing number and which at the option of the individual will be provided in either paper or electronic form.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/a/1/B" id="H3509F0E334664838AE7145086B13CFC0" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>Using the routing number assigned to the My Voice Voucher, the individual may submit the My Voice Voucher in either electronic or paper form to qualified candidates for election for the office of Representative in, or Delegate or Resident Commissioner to, the Congress and allocate such portion of the value of the My Voice Voucher in increments of $5 as the individual may select to any such candidate.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/a/1/C" id="H5172AB1D7F8446E48447E509106B5860" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>If the candidate transmits the My Voice Voucher to the Commission, the Commission shall pay the candidate the portion of the value of the My Voice Voucher that the individual allocated to the candidate, which shall be considered a contribution by the individual to the candidate for purposes of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/a/2" id="H278E47C68A4847F2983D1CA624F6BDFC" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Designation of qualified individuals</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of paragraph (1)(A), a “qualified individual” with respect to a State means an individual—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/a/2/A" id="HEBAE498E050A4BCCA01AB9716A12C679" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>who is a resident of the State;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/a/2/B" id="H552801366379416DB446C030D5CED4D8" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>who will be of voting age as of the date of the election for the candidate to whom the individual submits a My Voice Voucher; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/a/2/C" id="H84191B1EBAD64F08B5C172E31A27C14F" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>who is not prohibited under Federal law from making contributions to candidates for election for Federal office.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/a/3" id="H91BE01C258B846DDB3C2D5B12D748CFE" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment as contribution to candidate</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971, the submission of a My Voice Voucher to a candidate by an individual shall be treated as a contribution to the candidate by the individual in the amount of the portion of the value of the Voucher that the individual allocated to the candidate.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/b" id="H67EDFCBB29E146ED84C83D5C1CC2953B" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Fraud Prevention Mechanism</inline>.—</heading><content>In addition to the elements described in subsection (a), a State operating a voucher pilot program under this part shall permit an individual to revoke a My Voice Voucher not later than 2 days after submitting the My Voice Voucher to a candidate.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/c" id="H3E2744B5C2F5476396E720EA32EA2A89" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Oversight Commission</inline>.—</heading><content>In addition to the elements described in subsection (a), a State operating a voucher pilot program under this part shall establish a commission or designate an existing entity to oversee and implement the program in the State, except that no such commission or entity may be comprised of elected officials.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5102/d" id="H4AF81D049FE6445C868A9C95F42B8B40" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Public Information Campaign</inline>.—</heading><content>In addition to the elements described in subsection (a), a State operating a voucher pilot program under this part shall carry out a public information campaign to disseminate awareness of the program among qualified individuals.</content></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5103" id="H5DB07E5687C54EDFA85EA83C903DE276"><num value="5103">SEC. 5103. </num><heading>REPORTS.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5103/a" id="H850C8BF3A46F4627856BF809BAFD69AC" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Preliminary Report</inline>.—</heading><content>Not later than 6 months after the first election cycle of the program operation period, a State which operates a voucher pilot program under this part shall submit a report to the Commission analyzing the operation and effectiveness of the program during the cycle and including such other information as the Commission may require.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5103/b" id="H99269E8D4FF249459DEB42ECF48A9E7E" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Final Report</inline>.—</heading><content>Not later than 6 months after the end of the program operation period, the State shall submit a final report to the Commission analyzing the operation and effectiveness of the program and including such other information as the Commission may require.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5103/c" id="H7154743898B94F9AB91177AA9B6FBC4F" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Report by Commission</inline>.—</heading><content>Not later than the end of the first election cycle which begins after the program operation period, the Commission shall submit a report to Congress which summarizes and analyzes the results of the voucher pilot program, and shall include in the report such recommendations as the Commission considers appropriate regarding the expansion of the pilot program to all States and territories, along with such other recommendations and other information as the Commission considers appropriate.</content></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5104" id="HC4DAFF84C3A144BBB85F3DDAFDA85340"><num value="5104">SEC. 5104. </num><heading>DEFINITIONS.</heading>
<subsection role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5104/a" id="H4D5CAFC893EB419E80B927FF8DFF31CF" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Election Cycle</inline>.—</heading><content>In this part, the term “<term>election cycle</term>” means the period beginning on the day after the date of the most recent regularly scheduled general election for Federal office and ending on the date of the next regularly scheduled general election for Federal office.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5104/b" id="H11D58B6B37604B6BAB49BCC075C1BB56" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definitions Relating to Periods</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In this part, the following definitions apply:</chapeau>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5104/b/1" id="HD623401353D744FCB027719424C021D9" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Program application period</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>program application period</term>” means the first election cycle which begins after the date of the enactment of this Act.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5104/b/2" id="HB3188740EE884120A5ACD0F7943E47E5" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Program preparation period</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>program preparation period</term>” means the first election cycle which begins after the program application period.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt1/s5104/b/3" id="H01F6649C857B4A0E8F71EA170DFDE8A9" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Program operation period</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>program operation period</term>” means the first 2 election cycles which begin after the program preparation period.</content></paragraph></subsection></section></part><part identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt2" id="HAFA4279DEC5246FF9B4BE349D89B6565"><num value="2">PART 2—</num><heading>SMALL DOLLAR FINANCING OF CONGRESSIONAL ELECTION CAMPAIGNS</heading>
<section role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stB/pt2/s5111" id="H51E99C39477A417C8D14CDE909972827"><num value="5111">SEC. 5111. </num><heading>BENEFITS AND ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS FOR CANDIDATES.</heading><content>The Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30101/etseq">52 U.S.C. 30101 et seq.</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following:
<quotedContent meta="act-name:Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971" changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H76B61F273B9E4AD0BFCDAA81D14948E1" styleType="OLC">
<title id="H0395DF0B6D2947C8B516C3484944954B"><num value="V">“TITLE V—</num><heading class="inline">SMALL DOLLAR FINANCING OF CONGRESSIONAL ELECTION CAMPAIGNS</heading>
<subtitle id="HB9F82B6AAEFF4E86BB6D9D30625ADBE0"><num value="A">“Subtitle A—</num><heading>Benefits</heading>
<section id="H40F493D4F1AA4AB2A3DBDED9172C294A"><num value="501">“SEC. 501. </num><heading>BENEFITS FOR PARTICIPATING CANDIDATES.</heading>
<subsection id="HC27A8776997E4E08B4787005CCF2A338" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>If a candidate for election to the office of Representative in, or Delegate or Resident Commissioner to, the Congress is certified as a participating candidate under this title with respect to an election for such office, the candidate shall be entitled to payments as provided under this title.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H43EB2DBD0FFA472F88F722385947E97B" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Amount of Payment</inline>.—</heading><content>The amount of a payment made under this title shall be equal to 600 percent of the amount of qualified small dollar contributions received by the candidate since the most recent payment made to the candidate under this title during the election cycle, without regard to whether or not the candidate received any of the contributions before, during, or after the Small Dollar Democracy qualifying period applicable to the candidate under section 511(c).</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H33666C93CCDE48659FA560076DA5726A" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limit on Aggregate Amount of Payments</inline>.—</heading><content>The aggregate amount of payments made to a participating candidate with respect to an election cycle under this title may not exceed 50 percent of the average of the 20 greatest amounts of disbursements made by the authorized committees of any winning candidate for the office of Representative in, or Delegate or Resident Commissioner to, the Congress during the most recent election cycle, rounded to the nearest $100,000.</content></subsection></section>
<section id="H8536C586599B4BF5A6A75A26F9E27D56"><num value="502">“SEC. 502. </num><heading>PROCEDURES FOR MAKING PAYMENTS.</heading>
<subsection id="H90498169C6CD47E0B81767CE24E09DDE" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Commission shall make a payment under section 501 to a candidate who is certified as a participating candidate upon receipt from the candidate of a request for a payment which includes—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HC5F63346BCE44235AE9B4908728796F7" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><content>a statement of the number and amount of qualified small dollar contributions received by the candidate since the most recent payment made to the candidate under this title during the election cycle;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF70D5F126DE6461592EB5F65699DD5E8" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><content>a statement of the amount of the payment the candidate anticipates receiving with respect to the request;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H77ADBD2F934F4098966E1882A0F2F80A" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><content>a statement of the total amount of payments the candidate has received under this title as of the date of the statement; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H8B500EA8C838425B9175A52702C551A3" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><content>such other information and assurances as the Commission may require.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H34EE27D513264A909E61A663A942A3F9" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Restrictions on Submission of Requests</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A candidate may not submit a request under subsection (a) unless each of the following applies:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HD8D35E538D7E40BD80BA09EF786D1FD2" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><content>The amount of the qualified small dollar contributions in the statement referred to in subsection (a)(1) is equal to or greater than $5,000, unless the request is submitted during the 30-day period which ends on the date of a general election.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H67280CC97E6746A090F8C826078513E2" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><content>The candidate did not receive a payment under this title during the 7-day period which ends on the date the candidate submits the request.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HA202A01A4D334BF990E34030C7E9391D" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Time of Payment</inline>.—</heading><content>The Commission shall, in coordination with the Secretary of the Treasury, take such steps as may be necessary to ensure that the Secretary is able to make payments under this section from the Treasury not later than 2 business days after the receipt of a request submitted under subsection (a).</content></subsection></section>
<section id="H24F2DCFE0F274475A9361E374330899F"><num value="503">“SEC. 503. </num><heading>USE OF FUNDS.</heading>
<subsection id="H2A41181D24084C15B323114C7045E690" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Use of Funds for Authorized Campaign Expenditures</inline>.—</heading><content>A candidate shall use payments made under this title, including payments provided with respect to a previous election cycle which are withheld from remittance to the Commission in accordance with section 524(a)(2), only for making direct payments for the receipt of goods and services which constitute authorized expenditures (as determined in accordance with title III) in connection with the election cycle involved.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H1E972F280B9A448BABE34867EEB756F9" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibiting Use of Funds for Legal Expenses, Fines, or Penalties</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding title III, a candidate may not use payments made under this title for the payment of expenses incurred in connection with any action, claim, or other matter before the Commission or before any court, hearing officer, arbitrator, or other dispute resolution entity, or for the payment of any fine or civil monetary penalty.</content></subsection></section>
<section id="H89F2AB3CD4844BEEBA3CDA60E5FA6343"><num value="504">“SEC. 504. </num><heading>QUALIFIED SMALL DOLLAR CONTRIBUTIONS DESCRIBED.</heading>
<subsection role="definitions" id="HD2CE914F8AD74D34A8BCEE9C0E101B95" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In this title, the term ‘<term>qualified small dollar contribution</term>’ means, with respect to a candidate and the authorized committees of a candidate, a contribution that meets the following requirements:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H5AEF9AF506474BE9A61799E8D2B6D4B0" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><chapeau>The contribution is in an amount that is—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H607D753F29FE43F291E0FA4244920AF9" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>not less than $1; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H4A51BEABE5004E3CAFD3B30A72FB114D" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>not more than $200.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H362B7324819B461DA4E3718FF4D43B09" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2)</num><subparagraph id="H1ECFD8B208F94924A87086A3CBB56B95" class="inline"><num value="A">(A) </num><chapeau>The contribution is made directly by an individual to the candidate or an authorized committee of the candidate and is not—</chapeau>
<clause changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HD32D28A4109A49EB9E8D6FC7337CB03E" class="indent2"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>forwarded from the individual making the contribution to the candidate or committee by another person; or</content></clause>
<clause changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HEBF0D4ADF1C74200951B3A72DD882DF9" class="indent2"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>received by the candidate or committee with the knowledge that the contribution was made at the request, suggestion, or recommendation of another person.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H2C2D395D05794AC3B2C3E1FB6F0FC177" class="indent1"><num value="B">“(B) </num><chapeau>In this paragraph—</chapeau>
<clause id="HFBB15995FB1A4D5E9013158961E8F5B4" class="indent2"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>the term ‘<term>person</term>’ does not include an individual (other than an individual described in section 304(i)(7) of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971), a political committee of a political party, or any political committee which is not a separate segregated fund described in section 316(b) of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 and which does not make contributions or independent expenditures, does not engage in lobbying activity under the Lobbying Disclosure Act of 1995 (<ref href="/us/usc/t2/s1601/etseq">2 U.S.C. 1601 et seq.</ref>), and is not established by, controlled by, or affiliated with a registered lobbyist under such Act, an agent of a registered lobbyist under such Act, or an organization which retains or employs a registered lobbyist under such Act; and</content></clause>
<clause id="HEE9FF04DA69C4D8CA2F3BA8C3A37FA02" class="indent2"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>a contribution is not ‘made at the request, suggestion, or recommendation of another person’ solely on the grounds that the contribution is made in response to information provided to the individual making the contribution by any person, so long as the candidate or authorized committee does not know the identity of the person who provided the information to such individual.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HA6E99DE57A0F4B97ABD1FE8FA49B90AE" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><content>The individual who makes the contribution does not make contributions to the candidate or the authorized committees of the candidate with respect to the election involved in an aggregate amount that exceeds the amount described in paragraph (1)(B), or any contribution to the candidate or the authorized committees of the candidate with respect to the election involved that otherwise is not a qualified small dollar contribution.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H0DEF7477BA644615997538A2FA75D147" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment of My Voice Vouchers</inline>.—</heading><content>Any payment received by a candidate and the authorized committees of a candidate which consists of a My Voice Voucher under the Government By the People Act of 2019 shall be considered a qualified small dollar contribution for purposes of this title, so long as the individual making the payment meets the requirements of paragraphs (2) and (3) of subsection (a).</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HE75B7DBC9AC04C6C84F7DB216A2118E1" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Restriction on Subsequent Contributions</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HABD8999313704575B1BFC2ADA314C407" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibiting donor from making subsequent nonqualified contributions during election cycle</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H7EE48A166D4D4F31BD790EAC8A6584A3" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>An individual who makes a qualified small dollar contribution to a candidate or the authorized committees of a candidate with respect to an election may not make any subsequent contribution to such candidate or the authorized committees of such candidate with respect to the election cycle which is not a qualified small dollar contribution.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H940B8C59C4AB4684B1C46B55A70E94F4" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exception for contributions to candidates who voluntarily withdraw from participation during qualifying period</inline>.—</heading><content>Subparagraph (A) does not apply with respect to a contribution made to a candidate who, during the Small Dollar Democracy qualifying period described in section 511(c), submits a statement to the Commission under section 513(c) to voluntarily withdraw from participating in the program under this title.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H329CB3A78D204B3BB2172136706A35AE" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment of subsequent nonqualified contributions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>If, notwithstanding the prohibition described in paragraph (1), an individual who makes a qualified small dollar contribution to a candidate or the authorized committees of a candidate with respect to an election makes a subsequent contribution to such candidate or the authorized committees of such candidate with respect to the election which is prohibited under paragraph (1) because it is not a qualified small dollar contribution, the candidate may take one of the following actions:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HD5AD96D4E3654EB0B44A86FB028902E8" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>Not later than 2 weeks after receiving the contribution, the candidate may return the subsequent contribution to the individual. In the case of a subsequent contribution which is not a qualified small dollar contribution because the contribution fails to meet the requirements of paragraph (3) of subsection (a) (relating to the aggregate amount of contributions made to the candidate or the authorized committees of the candidate by the individual making the contribution), the candidate may return an amount equal to the difference between the amount of the subsequent contribution and the amount described in paragraph (1)(B) of subsection (a).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HDCD58015E55E40B6BAF3F0669241177B" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>The candidate may retain the subsequent contribution, so long as not later than 2 weeks after receiving the subsequent contribution, the candidate remits to the Commission for deposit in the Freedom From Influence Fund under section 541 an amount equal to any payments received by the candidate under this title which are attributable to the qualified small dollar contribution made by the individual involved.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HB108DB581B2E4817B9A0370C6FD35AB3" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No effect on ability to make multiple contributions</inline>.—</heading><content>Nothing in this section may be construed to prohibit an individual from making multiple qualified small dollar contributions to any candidate or any number of candidates, so long as each contribution meets each of the requirements of paragraphs (1), (2), and (3) of subsection (a).</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H26E5AED707E54730AD74A0D74E87F45E" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notification Requirements for Candidates</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H1B4D2729F7B24FCB8554E2693558337E" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notification</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Each authorized committee of a candidate who seeks to be a participating candidate under this title shall provide the following information in any materials for the solicitation of contributions, including any internet site through which individuals may make contributions to the committee:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HF5685863098E4581A2948357DFC67068" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>A statement that if the candidate is certified as a participating candidate under this title, the candidate will receive matching payments in an amount which is based on the total amount of qualified small dollar contributions received.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H2120B0EFF7054F7AB0233C1098BC223E" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>A statement that a contribution which meets the requirements set forth in subsection (a) shall be treated as a qualified small dollar contribution under this title.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HF13542B2D42C41E9B7CDBADB20E1FCD3" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>A statement that if a contribution is treated as qualified small dollar contribution under this title, the individual who makes the contribution may not make any contribution to the candidate or the authorized committees of the candidate during the election cycle which is not a qualified small dollar contribution.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF1646E82630C49CB9C0320A404BF9C86" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Alternative methods of meeting requirements</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>An authorized committee may meet the requirements of paragraph (1)—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H3E7A08DE4C1848248F570722E026EDEB" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>by including the information described in paragraph (1) in the receipt provided under section 512(b)(3) to a person making a qualified small dollar contribution; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HDA2A50D7B0A34A4F917DC577BF37436F" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>by modifying the information it provides to persons making contributions which is otherwise required under title III (including information it provides through the internet).</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section></subtitle>
<subtitle id="HB085D59317CE4815A3F81B1C63D3C629"><num value="B">“Subtitle B—</num><heading>Eligibility and Certification</heading>
<section id="HA568FB6CD5854387AC763AF2174A9908"><num value="511">“SEC. 511. </num><heading>ELIGIBILITY.</heading>
<subsection id="HB1E6F3DFF3214EF0B9331E5929F949D1" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A candidate for the office of Representative in, or Delegate or Resident Commissioner to, the Congress is eligible to be certified as a participating candidate under this title with respect to an election if the candidate meets the following requirements:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HA23140D5923C42B397B74980EE84514C" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><content>The candidate files with the Commission a statement of intent to seek certification as a participating candidate.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC590FFC714434B9A85607B6FB3D6F32E" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><content>The candidate meets the qualifying requirements of section 512.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H4FB4567A86A5472BAB46337D72252D64" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><content>The candidate files with the Commission a statement certifying that the authorized committees of the candidate meet the requirements of section 504(d).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HB5C37249704B4465BCB0CB853F15B091" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><chapeau>Not later than the last day of the Small Dollar Democracy qualifying period, the candidate files with the Commission an affidavit signed by the candidate and the treasurer of the candidate’s principal campaign committee declaring that the candidate—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H0B55C3B2FC014D64A2BD8032E996FF8C" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>has complied and, if certified, will comply with the contribution and expenditure requirements of section 521;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H409C426DC0254CEB86657E3877A104C8" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>if certified, will run only as a participating candidate for all elections for the office that such candidate is seeking during that election cycle; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H56BFB65BCEF748DE925D0C5FBEE22B08" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>has either qualified or will take steps to qualify under State law to be on the ballot.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HA231BA6AD15D4A7A966C1CA49224FF13" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">General Election</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding subsection (a), a candidate shall not be eligible to be certified as a participating candidate under this title for a general election or a general runoff election unless the candidate’s party nominated the candidate to be placed on the ballot for the general election or the candidate is otherwise qualified to be on the ballot under State law.</content></subsection>
<subsection role="definitions" id="H659DA4F96C154DB1A8B4613A9F06B9A0" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Small Dollar Democracy Qualifying Period Defined</inline>.—</heading><content>The term ‘<term>Small Dollar Democracy qualifying period</term>’ means, with respect to any candidate for an office, the 180-day period (during the election cycle for such office) which begins on the date on which the candidate files a statement of intent under section 511(a)(1), except that such period may not continue after the date that is 30 days before the date of the general election for the office.</content></subsection></section>
<section id="HFF3AABB43ECC44CDA0E75BD675741CA9"><num value="512">“SEC. 512. </num><heading>QUALIFYING REQUIREMENTS.</heading>
<subsection id="H36B39B8867464C3E8A69FF2D498F9D16" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Receipt of Qualified Small Dollar Contributions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A candidate for the office of Representative in, or Delegate or Resident Commissioner to, the Congress meets the requirement of this section if, during the Small Dollar Democracy qualifying period described in section 511(c), each of the following occurs:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H06330DD6AEC34AC98B26739EA1ED050D" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><content>Not fewer than 1,000 individuals make a qualified small dollar contribution to the candidate.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H051E725B2A4741A68D4203218158EA25" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><content>The candidate obtains a total dollar amount of qualified small dollar contributions which is equal to or greater than $50,000.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H7BB6B714EF5B4B0E87EA028589AEF148" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Requirements Relating to Receipt of Qualified Small Dollar Contribution</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Each qualified small dollar contribution—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HF81F9B57A6D74F87910B316AF50BE4C5" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><content>may be made by means of a personal check, money order, debit card, credit card, electronic payment account, or any other method deemed appropriate by the Commission;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H68D03124C98F4FB2B6011292BC382748" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><content>shall be accompanied by a signed statement (or, in the case of a contribution made online or through other electronic means, an electronic equivalent) containing the contributor’s name and address; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H11531566BADA49B4AF336195403EFA9A" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><content>shall be acknowledged by a receipt that is sent to the contributor with a copy (in paper or electronic form) kept by the candidate for the Commission.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H58375B0B4E6149C9B4D595F764E57CE6" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Verification of Contributions</inline>.—</heading><content>The Commission shall establish procedures for the auditing and verification of the contributions received and expenditures made by participating candidates under this title, including procedures for random audits, to ensure that such contributions and expenditures meet the requirements of this title.</content></subsection></section>
<section id="H861431CFBFB0464AB50962E0D2CB9499"><num value="513">“SEC. 513. </num><heading>CERTIFICATION.</heading>
<subsection id="H41C3534A4028422DAC4DB9BE25B336AF" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Deadline and Notification</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H1BC0960965614AC987C2E7DE04C773C5" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Not later than 5 business days after a candidate files an affidavit under section 511(a)(4), the Commission shall—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HECC79F0DDA394D688C9F03709A7D0121" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>determine whether or not the candidate meets the requirements for certification as a participating candidate;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H311D645EBDB047EB8E294EBD79190C40" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>if the Commission determines that the candidate meets such requirements, certify the candidate as a participating candidate; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1B68EF7250FE4AA9B9F8AFCF18ECF99D" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>notify the candidate of the Commission’s determination.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HE3AAD934E62946B4AB74D1759DA275E5" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Deemed certification for all elections in election cycle</inline>.—</heading><content>If the Commission certifies a candidate as a participating candidate with respect to the first election of the election cycle involved, the Commission shall be deemed to have certified the candidate as a participating candidate with respect to all subsequent elections of the election cycle.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H4C1A805B466249AD91F58C83E513CFFF" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Revocation of Certification</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H56A13A7E884846D299A56E71D206372D" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Commission shall revoke a certification under subsection (a) if—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H653C1A9928D644C5BB5E93A41B98B2B0" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>a candidate fails to qualify to appear on the ballot at any time after the date of certification (other than a candidate certified as a participating candidate with respect to a primary election who fails to qualify to appear on the ballot for a subsequent election in that election cycle);</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H20157409A3FA42BD9CBB1907C8F33D5E" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>a candidate ceases to be a candidate for the office involved, as determined on the basis of an official announcement by an authorized committee of the candidate or on the basis of a reasonable determination by the Commission; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HCDE4684D0A5E4B8A8E243A976AA1BE32" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>a candidate otherwise fails to comply with the requirements of this title, including any regulatory requirements prescribed by the Commission.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H6A0C840F7FA44A5F8A689C31B6C2B510" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Existence of criminal sanction</inline>.—</heading><content>The Commission shall revoke a certification under subsection (a) if a penalty is assessed against the candidate under section 309(d) with respect to the election.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HE994F976C4744378A9E7B588849788A3" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effect of revocation</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>If a candidate’s certification is revoked under this subsection—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H0C0B7A893F9D41B0B8A464F8639DA57A" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>the candidate may not receive payments under this title during the remainder of the election cycle involved; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H64947F8D09BE414CAE494944193E7ABC" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><chapeau>in the case of a candidate whose certification is revoked pursuant to subparagraph (A) or subparagraph (C) of paragraph (1)—</chapeau>
<clause id="H5F2EA8F784094B448219F7F43BD039EA" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>the candidate shall repay to the Freedom From Influence Fund established under section 541 an amount equal to the payments received under this title with respect to the election cycle involved plus interest (at a rate determined by the Commission on the basis of an appropriate annual percentage rate for the month involved) on any such amount received; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H826465CD884246E8A2DA209E861AC86B" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>the candidate may not be certified as a participating candidate under this title with respect to the next election cycle.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HCFB39EEA296844BF81850B8E89183C65" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibiting participation in future elections for candidates with multiple revocations</inline>.—</heading><content>If the Commission revokes the certification of an individual as a participating candidate under this title pursuant to subparagraph (A) or subparagraph (C) of paragraph (1) a total of 3 times, the individual may not be certified as a participating candidate under this title with respect to any subsequent election.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H0FCE27E96B674FA099D30974A96A6C94" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Voluntary Withdrawal From Participating During Qualifying Period</inline>.—</heading><content>At any time during the Small Dollar Democracy qualifying period described in section 511(c), a candidate may withdraw from participation in the program under this title by submitting to the Commission a statement of withdrawal (without regard to whether or not the Commission has certified the candidate as a participating candidate under this title as of the time the candidate submits such statement), so long as the candidate has not submitted a request for payment under section 502.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HF17F67705F1A4BB29D4312C763572BB7" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Participating Candidate Defined</inline>.—</heading><content>In this title, a ‘participating candidate’ means a candidate for the office of Representative in, or Delegate or Resident Commissioner to, the Congress who is certified under this section as eligible to receive benefits under this title.</content></subsection></section></subtitle>
<subtitle id="H81EA1F73FFE744F78B44BBEA77CB4C24"><num value="C">“Subtitle C—</num><heading>Requirements for Candidates Certified as Participating Candidates</heading>
<section id="H9FE1CC792D34480893D9A13134053877"><num value="521">“SEC. 521. </num><heading>CONTRIBUTION AND EXPENDITURE REQUIREMENTS.</heading>
<subsection id="H45D136865DC94ACAAF918AFCF3F7DD44" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Permitted Sources of Contributions and Expenditures</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Except as provided in subsection (c), a participating candidate with respect to an election shall, with respect to all elections occurring during the election cycle for the office involved, accept no contributions from any source and make no expenditures from any amounts, other than the following:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HBE2D741EBDD54FDC8E5B81DCA715B6C6" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><content>Qualified small dollar contributions.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H3A59747AEE2742CE90897F08A7FED53E" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><content>Payments under this title.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H2E14CC2E08AC491BB058E0D2E157C6E2" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><content>Contributions from political committees established and maintained by a national or State political party, subject to the applicable limitations of section 315.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HCCE9672AFB264E3297A48FDD39A6ACDC" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><content>Subject to subsection (b), personal funds of the candidate or of any immediate family member of the candidate (other than funds received through qualified small dollar contributions).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H405D1D55ECD24B87AB2C5F9F66EB7553" class="indent1"><num value="5">“(5) </num><content>Contributions from individuals who are otherwise permitted to make contributions under this Act, subject to the applicable limitations of section 315, except that the aggregate amount of contributions a participating candidate may accept from any individual with respect to any election during the election cycle may not exceed $1,000.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H1F6A72537412405A9CD4105809704302" class="indent1"><num value="6">“(6) </num><content>Contributions from multicandidate political committees, subject to the applicable limitations of section 315.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H75CEE9A4C6C84E2FAEDE36E85919672B" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special Rules for Personal Funds</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H18228C67A9FC4DDFB40400FC92C08081" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limit on amount</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A candidate who is certified as a participating candidate may use personal funds (including personal funds of any immediate family member of the candidate) so long as—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H23778E84BDA44840AFE3CDCE258782F7" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>the aggregate amount used with respect to the election cycle (including any period of the cycle occurring prior to the candidate’s certification as a participating candidate) does not exceed $50,000; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HCDC31330B943455EA4D25690879779DC" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>the funds are used only for making direct payments for the receipt of goods and services which constitute authorized expenditures in connection with the election cycle involved.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H921681ACB3F74F88AFCA2FFBD3A25578" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Immediate family member defined</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In this subsection, the term ‘<term>immediate family member</term>’ means, with respect to a candidate—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H0771ED9CDE934C5D96070F99259AD9B1" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>the candidate’s spouse;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HCECD1D3642EF42A1BB7D7C76407A40EB" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>a child, stepchild, parent, grandparent, brother, half-brother, sister, or half-sister of the candidate or the candidate’s spouse; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HFFA25448FF254877A65A3326290EF680" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>the spouse of any person described in subparagraph (B).</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HDA4D51112D8048DEA944AAEB82D34F10" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exceptions</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H289EE167DB4944DC9E78D5B0845344DF" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exception for contributions received prior to filing of statement of intent</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A candidate who has accepted contributions that are not described in subsection (a) is not in violation of subsection (a), but only if all such contributions are—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HC6DE448E46024E2A83A559E084DCA2A7" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>returned to the contributor;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HA68B1FC78D5346D0960CF0AF85101756" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>submitted to the Commission for deposit in the Freedom From Influence Fund established under section 541; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD91573FC5BA94D1790B920A03A22F174" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>spent in accordance with paragraph (2).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H77AD5981467B46B883ECABF03E0466DF" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exception for expenditures made prior to filing of statement of intent</inline>.—</heading><content>If a candidate has made expenditures prior to the date the candidate files a statement of intent under section 511(a)(1) that the candidate is prohibited from making under subsection (a) or subsection (b), the candidate is not in violation of such subsection if the aggregate amount of the prohibited expenditures is less than the amount referred to in section 512(a)(2) (relating to the total dollar amount of qualified small dollar contributions which the candidate is required to obtain) which is applicable to the candidate.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HD2E4A678541A4802876C830F374AA756" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exception for campaign surpluses from a previous election</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding paragraph (1), unexpended contributions received by the candidate or an authorized committee of the candidate with respect to a previous election may be retained, but only if the candidate places the funds in escrow and refrains from raising additional funds for or spending funds from that account during the election cycle in which a candidate is a participating candidate.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HD0C322889B6D45438E11DA3EB90468EE" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exception for contributions received before the effective date of this title</inline>.—</heading><content>Contributions received and expenditures made by the candidate or an authorized committee of the candidate prior to the effective date of this title shall not constitute a violation of subsection (a) or (b). Unexpended contributions shall be treated the same as campaign surpluses under paragraph (3), and expenditures made shall count against the limit in paragraph (2).</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HE5ED7A48A28142A798C3B5A080978D40" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special Rule for Coordinated Party Expenditures</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of this section, a payment made by a political party in coordination with a participating candidate shall not be treated as a contribution to or as an expenditure made by the participating candidate.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H7EF8B494CC5041F88F9925228F1FFB69" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition on Joint Fundraising Committees</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HEAE38A32046E40EE9F42BB55A8B66DCC" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition</inline>.—</heading><content>An authorized committee of a candidate who is certified as a participating candidate under this title with respect to an election may not establish a joint fundraising committee with a political committee other than another authorized committee of the candidate.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HD612F2EE64254BEF88243F2E30EEF953" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Status of existing committees for prior elections</inline>.—</heading><content>If a candidate established a joint fundraising committee described in paragraph (1) with respect to a prior election for which the candidate was not certified as a participating candidate under this title and the candidate does not terminate the committee, the candidate shall not be considered to be in violation of paragraph (1) so long as that joint fundraising committee does not receive any contributions or make any disbursements during the election cycle for which the candidate is certified as a participating candidate under this title.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H5B55AD1536D441548C20B4C537F70796" class="indent0"><num value="f">“(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition on Leadership PACs</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HB3C4E997AF6D4F1CA732337071125E73" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition</inline>.—</heading><content>A candidate who is certified as a participating candidate under this title with respect to an election may not associate with, establish, finance, maintain, or control a leadership PAC.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H67863A49539C48D797F313DD5154F2CC" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Status of existing leadership pacs</inline>.—</heading><content>If a candidate established, financed, maintained, or controlled a leadership PAC prior to being certified as a participating candidate under this title and the candidate does not terminate the leadership PAC, the candidate shall not be considered to be in violation of paragraph (1) so long as the leadership PAC does not receive any contributions or make any disbursements during the election cycle for which the candidate is certified as a participating candidate under this title.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H74428754C1394596A36EE89020043B0D" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Leadership pac defined</inline>.—</heading><content>In this subsection, the term ‘<term>leadership PAC</term>’ has the meaning given such term in section 304(i)(8)(B).</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<section id="H3092D056C21B45419382BC1948DC951F"><num value="522">“SEC. 522. </num><heading>ADMINISTRATION OF CAMPAIGN.</heading>
<subsection id="HDCAF2A150C574C528F94552691A4CD99" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Separate Accounting for Various Permitted Contributions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Each authorized committee of a candidate certified as a participating candidate under this title—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H83F0E6C8C0BB4B5BB59406B7CCF57B45" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><content>shall provide for separate accounting of each type of contribution described in section 521(a) which is received by the committee; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HBC17756D9454446E9AFEDDD6D2AE0FCC" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><content>shall provide for separate accounting for the payments received under this title.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H3CDE35AC3F62459AA02B6BE47CCA0786" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Enhanced Disclosure of Information on Donors</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H2F9D17F8AE0C4E8F942DFB4795FEC430" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Mandatory identification of individuals making qualified small dollar contributions</inline>.—</heading><content>Each authorized committee of a participating candidate under this title shall elect, in accordance with section 304(b)(3)(A), to include in the reports the committee submits under section 304 the identification of each person who makes a qualified small dollar contribution to the committee.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H4C2B09762A9146228D52AEF6121E0401" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Mandatory disclosure through internet</inline>.—</heading><content>Each authorized committee of a participating candidate under this title shall ensure that all information reported to the Commission under this Act with respect to contributions and expenditures of the committee is available to the public on the internet (whether through a site established for purposes of this subsection, a hyperlink on another public site of the committee, or a hyperlink on a report filed electronically with the Commission) in a searchable, sortable, and downloadable manner.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<section id="HE0D10C9423B146AC887EFA3DAD4E45D3"><num value="523">“SEC. 523. </num><heading>PREVENTING UNNECESSARY SPENDING OF PUBLIC FUNDS.</heading>
<subsection id="H378A34A5A85F4D82B70008715DA2A60B" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Mandatory Spending of Available Private Funds</inline>.—</heading><content>An authorized committee of a candidate certified as a participating candidate under this title may not make any expenditure of any payments received under this title in any amount unless the committee has made an expenditure in an equivalent amount of funds received by the committee which are described in paragraphs (1), (3), (4), (5), and (6) of section 521(a).</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H7A4C36E91B244E84A0E81E279B9A102F" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation</inline>.—</heading><content>Subsection (a) applies to an authorized committee only to the extent that the funds referred to in such subsection are available to the committee at the time the committee makes an expenditure of a payment received under this title.</content></subsection></section>
<section id="H495BF5EEC6774F6E868144FDD89EA8FF"><num value="524">“SEC. 524. </num><heading>REMITTING UNSPENT FUNDS AFTER ELECTION.</heading>
<subsection id="H8A86F4D4653747D88CB23D94A02DDBD7" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Remittance Required</inline>.—</heading><content>Not later than the date that is 180 days after the last election for which a candidate certified as a participating candidate qualifies to be on the ballot during the election cycle involved, such participating candidate shall remit to the Commission for deposit in the Freedom From Influence Fund established under section 541 an amount equal to the balance of the payments received under this title by the authorized committees of the candidate which remain unexpended as of such date.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HE69FE82F20094529BB2EADEE352973BE" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Permitting Candidates Participating in Next Election Cycle to Retain Portion of Unspent Funds</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding subsection (a), a participating candidate may withhold not more than $100,000 from the amount required to be remitted under subsection (a) if the candidate files a signed affidavit with the Commission that the candidate will seek certification as a participating candidate with respect to the next election cycle, except that the candidate may not use any portion of the amount withheld until the candidate is certified as a participating candidate with respect to that next election cycle. If the candidate fails to seek certification as a participating candidate prior to the last day of the Small Dollar Democracy qualifying period for the next election cycle (as described in section 511), or if the Commission notifies the candidate of the Commission’s determination does not meet the requirements for certification as a participating candidate with respect to such cycle, the candidate shall immediately remit to the Commission the amount withheld.</content></subsection></section></subtitle>
<subtitle id="H854FE8A9CD824355A8547F611E0E62AE"><num value="D">“Subtitle D—</num><heading>Enhanced Match Support</heading>
<section id="H1798D9C2A85C42B0B1F3A15159D88CB5"><num value="531">“SEC. 531. </num><heading>ENHANCED SUPPORT FOR GENERAL ELECTION.</heading>
<subsection id="H44A383D2B70740939408119286A326C7" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Availability of Enhanced Support</inline>.—</heading><content>In addition to the payments made under subtitle A, the Commission shall make an additional payment to an eligible candidate under this subtitle.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H69352FF19157451286436A67416789F0" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Use of Funds</inline>.—</heading><content>A candidate shall use the additional payment under this subtitle only for authorized expenditures in connection with the election involved.</content></subsection></section>
<section id="HFFAAD22A985C4D46B998962BBA4900AD"><num value="532">“SEC. 532. </num><heading>ELIGIBILITY.</heading>
<subsection id="HF100459AFBC74C47844001F739B8388D" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A candidate is eligible to receive an additional payment under this subtitle if the candidate meets each of the following requirements:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H3874B86EDA154610875FA0CC9C368464" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><content>The candidate is on the ballot for the general election for the office the candidate seeks.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H2334F49FA73D4A4C95E3608D09247F04" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><content>The candidate is certified as a participating candidate under this title with respect to the election.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H837D7DBABA9A4AC69A69B91DA1C4D857" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><content>During the enhanced support qualifying period, the candidate receives qualified small dollar contributions in a total amount of not less than $50,000.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H416FC08DD53B41F48075DE9DD5209B91" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><chapeau>During the enhanced support qualifying period, the candidate submits to the Commission a request for the payment which includes—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H9048FA633268444A854358EB51BD8B82" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>a statement of the number and amount of qualified small dollar contributions received by the candidate during the enhanced support qualifying period;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB56AB69D34C54F3FA630E8405CE67493" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>a statement of the amount of the payment the candidate anticipates receiving with respect to the request; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H9E723D155B19414CB1C3D61F62A895DA" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>such other information and assurances as the Commission may require.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H66A5801F7E304AC195D5BF24573A44E5" class="indent1"><num value="5">“(5) </num><content>After submitting a request for the additional payment under paragraph (4), the candidate does not submit any other application for an additional payment under this subtitle.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection role="definitions" id="H136FF156904F48B383AF7238889A2D57" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Enhanced Support Qualifying Period Described</inline>.—</heading><content>In this subtitle, the term ‘<term>enhanced support qualifying period</term>’ means, with respect to a general election, the period which begins 60 days before the date of the election and ends 14 days before the date of the election.</content></subsection></section>
<section id="HB5B95CD1A7824B4D82C8CC12FB8432F8"><num value="533">“SEC. 533. </num><heading>AMOUNT.</heading>
<subsection id="H1837B43AD00A419691C97DA88FC93047" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Subject to subsection (b), the amount of the additional payment made to an eligible candidate under this subtitle shall be an amount equal to 50 percent of—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HF624FC9E8D634D23B9988A9CA39A6B98" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><content>the amount of the payment made to the candidate under section 501(b) with respect to the qualified small dollar contributions which are received by the candidate during the enhanced support qualifying period (as included in the request submitted by the candidate under section 532(a)(4)); or</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HA031825CF9E2499BB3C8E047D210B2B4" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><content>in the case of a candidate who is not eligible to receive a payment under section 501(b) with respect to such qualified small dollar contributions because the candidate has reached the limit on the aggregate amount of payments under subtitle A for the election cycle under section 501(c), the amount of the payment which would have been made to the candidate under section 501(b) with respect to such qualified small dollar contributions if the candidate had not reached such limit.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HC4F89161DA78430494EB5F3F7BBC04E7" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limit</inline>.—</heading><content>The amount of the additional payment determined under subsection (a) with respect to a candidate may not exceed $500,000.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HED05E573ED6C4AD1BCC1781A77EE693D" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No Effect on Aggregate Limit</inline>.—</heading><content>The amount of the additional payment made to a candidate under this subtitle shall not be included in determining the aggregate amount of payments made to a participating candidate with respect to an election cycle under section 501(c).</content></subsection></section>
<section id="H7A61FD9C0B864D708A78D6B7447EA60F"><num value="534">“SEC. 534. </num><heading>WAIVER OF AUTHORITY TO RETAIN PORTION OF UNSPENT FUNDS AFTER ELECTION.</heading><content class="block">“Notwithstanding section 524(a)(2), a candidate who receives an additional payment under this subtitle with respect to an election is not permitted to withhold any portion from the amount of unspent funds the candidate is required to remit to the Commission under section 524(a)(1).</content></section></subtitle>
<subtitle id="H0BE32CDE4606480992F6BF2A81CDC3DE"><num value="E">“Subtitle E—</num><heading>Administrative Provisions</heading>
<section id="HEFFA4F775CD74821890EF1450D2CB6CB"><num value="541">“SEC. 541. </num><heading>FREEDOM FROM INFLUENCE FUND.</heading>
<subsection id="HF90793BFCB8F43B7B30D5D667681121F" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Establishment</inline>.—</heading><content>There is established in the Treasury a fund to be known as the ‘Freedom From Influence Fund’.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H235EF383572A45EB8987FD0660CEE69E" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Amounts Held by Fund</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Fund shall consist of the following amounts:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HA107E9921BDD4C7BB2234B2F298D9C19" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Deposits</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Amounts deposited into the Fund under—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H4E900D941E1A49DFB0F024FD666EF546" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>section 521(c)(1)(B) (relating to exceptions to contribution requirements);</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H32F639D705A84D67988AB760818ABD5A" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>section 523 (relating to remittance of unused payments from the Fund); and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H71741485732D440E8075BA918B75F891" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>section 544 (relating to violations).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H92C4D028022049E9A885AD951F3BEAFF" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Investment returns</inline>.—</heading><content>Interest on, and the proceeds from, the sale or redemption of any obligations held by the Fund under subsection (c).</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H8788B2EB1D3E46849F0BBDA54080CBB3" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Investment</inline>.—</heading><content>The Commission shall invest portions of the Fund in obligations of the United States in the same manner as provided under section 9602(b) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HDFA73BDC2409476AA8473B7A8F21B05C" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Use of Fund to Make Payments to Participating Candidates</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HD88F28592CD94232B0A15A68E7C090E8" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Payments to participating candidates</inline>.—</heading><content>Amounts in the Fund shall be available without further appropriation or fiscal year limitation to make payments to participating candidates as provided in this title.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H397BFC3145B640C18A4D72E476B96CEB" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Mandatory reduction of payments in case of insufficient amounts in fund</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="HA0E433327FC843409CAE6C2B74019C44" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Advance audits by commission</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Not later than 90 days before the first day of each election cycle (beginning with the first election cycle that begins after the date of the enactment of this title), the Commission shall—</chapeau>
<clause id="HD446EEF7738440C48F5AEF3712766D4B" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>audit the Fund to determine whether the amounts in the Fund will be sufficient to make payments to participating candidates in the amounts provided in this title during such election cycle; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H43037455350B401AAA520B9F30C4C3BD" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>submit a report to Congress describing the results of the audit.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H2FB0453BBF79422397F6A3D88E1E3E2F" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reductions in amount of payments</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="H8A9EFCD1F0F8411A9B2CF832CBE95709" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Automatic reduction on pro rata basis</inline>.—</heading><content>If, on the basis of the audit described in subparagraph (A), the Commission determines that the amount anticipated to be available in the Fund with respect to the election cycle involved is not, or may not be, sufficient to satisfy the full entitlements of participating candidates to payments under this title for such election cycle, the Commission shall reduce each amount which would otherwise be paid to a participating candidate under this title by such pro rata amount as may be necessary to ensure that the aggregate amount of payments anticipated to be made with respect to the election cycle will not exceed the amount anticipated to be available for such payments in the Fund with respect to such election cycle.</content></clause>
<clause id="HC5E333C40AD44BA79A3340FEE1A3B1BB" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Restoration of reductions in case of availability of sufficient funds during election cycle</inline>.—</heading><content>If, after reducing the amounts paid to participating candidates with respect to an election cycle under clause (i), the Commission determines that there are sufficient amounts in the Fund to restore the amount by which such payments were reduced (or any portion thereof), to the extent that such amounts are available, the Commission may make a payment on a pro rata basis to each such participating candidate with respect to the election cycle in the amount by which such candidate’s payments were reduced under clause (i) (or any portion thereof, as the case may be).</content></clause>
<clause id="H8659DFBEB7004B66BA934AD42324875D" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No use of amounts from other sources</inline>.—</heading><content>In any case in which the Commission determines that there are insufficient moneys in the Fund to make payments to participating candidates under this title, moneys shall not be made available from any other source for the purpose of making such payments.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HD204F637D72F44DE90F63D2FFB625418" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Use of Fund to Make Other Payments</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In addition to the use described in subsection (d), amounts in the Fund shall be available without further appropriation or fiscal year limitation—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HE3AA3CF037BB4AC2B600B501C70ACD8A" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><content>to make payments to States under the My Voice Voucher Program under the Government By the People Act of 2019, subject to reductions under section 5101(f)(3) of such Act;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H691D3449FE9E43E1A3CA1C47CBF1D18F" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><content>to make payments to candidates under chapter 95 of subtitle H of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, subject to reductions under section 9013(b) of such Code; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H2FE59513E35245C7ADA7FA592C3EDC9F" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><content>to make payments to candidates under chapter 96 of subtitle H of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, subject to reductions under section 9043(b) of such Code.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H6A44FDB3DB1A4744B772BEFFCB78A70D" class="indent0"><num value="f">“(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effective Date</inline>.—</heading><content>This section shall take effect on the date of the enactment of this title.</content></subsection></section>
