<section id="H7AB5C798C95B4CA087963BD5BA594222"><num value="542">“SEC. 542. </num><heading>REVIEWS AND REPORTS BY GOVERNMENT ACCOUNTABILITY OFFICE.</heading>
<subsection id="HA519183BCBE644539FA27DE454A22471" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Review of Small Dollar Financing</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HAEBF204745BC4B8AACE56796F096D56B" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>After each regularly scheduled general election for Federal office, the Comptroller General of the United States shall conduct a comprehensive review of the Small Dollar financing program under this title, including—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H2C75D532B6174F2D926F324269646E44" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>the maximum and minimum dollar amounts of qualified small dollar contributions under section 504;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H8CA96C565F8347B58CEFDCCE7E4EA0FC" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>the number and value of qualified small dollar contributions a candidate is required to obtain under section 512(a) to be eligible for certification as a participating candidate;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H9A665CFA9CD943068644BDCCE8A3418A" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>the maximum amount of payments a candidate may receive under this title;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H9B0CD6856CFF44BC913BA6D8AABE3671" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><content>the overall satisfaction of participating candidates and the American public with the program; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HA6B5F4A15D1C47CFA95EC5829D784643" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num><content>such other matters relating to financing of campaigns as the Comptroller General determines are appropriate.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H53E9D488FDA54FC9A65799A404A8A5DF" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Criteria for review</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In conducting the review under subparagraph (A), the Comptroller General shall consider the following:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H78574E9C2E0A4C0D8AA83594872B9521" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Qualified small dollar contributions</inline>.—</heading><content>Whether the number and dollar amounts of qualified small dollar contributions required strikes an appropriate balance regarding the importance of voter involvement, the need to assure adequate incentives for participating, and fiscal responsibility, taking into consideration the number of primary and general election participating candidates, the electoral performance of those candidates, program cost, and any other information the Comptroller General determines is appropriate.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HE6D2137DCEF94FA2AB00E9B00B0A887A" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Review of payment levels</inline>.—</heading><content>Whether the totality of the amount of funds allowed to be raised by participating candidates (including through qualified small dollar contributions) and payments under this title are sufficient for voters in each State to learn about the candidates to cast an informed vote, taking into account the historic amount of spending by winning candidates, media costs, primary election dates, and any other information the Comptroller General determines is appropriate.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HA4D8C43CA90F4870AB844FA153B367CE" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Recommendations for adjustment of amounts</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Based on the review conducted under subparagraph (A), the Comptroller General may recommend to Congress adjustments of the following amounts:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HFCE2FB79823B40549411EC851F1520FF" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>The number and value of qualified small dollar contributions a candidate is required to obtain under section 512(a) to be eligible for certification as a participating candidate.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H0691458F631B468B8CD7519087448C9C" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>The maximum amount of payments a candidate may receive under this title.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HF73DFC819C7F4EC58F81567960A05F9B" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reports</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Not later than each June 1 which follows a regularly scheduled general election for Federal office for which payments were made under this title, the Comptroller General shall submit to the Committee on House Administration of the House of Representatives a report—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HA87ECE56DE6940C49181681554A7EDAA" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><content>containing an analysis of the review conducted under subsection (a), including a detailed statement of Comptroller General’s findings, conclusions, and recommendations based on such review, including any recommendations for adjustments of amounts described in subsection (a)(3); and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H598DC1DEB8F740BCAEFA7A347219566C" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><content>documenting, evaluating, and making recommendations relating to the administrative implementation and enforcement of the provisions of this title.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HF396EED6A5CD4178B6B7D00997FDD394" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authorization of Appropriations</inline>.—</heading><content>There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as are necessary to carry out the purposes of this section.</content></subsection></section>
<section id="H00CE84A1E698476D97890E7E1298091D"><num value="543">“SEC. 543. </num><heading>ADMINISTRATION BY COMMISSION.</heading>
<chapeau class="indent0">“The Commission shall prescribe regulations to carry out the purposes of this title, including regulations to establish procedures for—</chapeau>
<paragraph id="H6A8A350189B94C71A8AE4F728BEF22C0" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><content>verifying the amount of qualified small dollar contributions with respect to a candidate;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HCD73DC1729E44193A9B8ED4967186D91" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><content>effectively and efficiently monitoring and enforcing the limits on the raising of qualified small dollar contributions;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H9A817D1F16EB468FA84A4C28A3340A2F" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><content>effectively and efficiently monitoring and enforcing the limits on the use of personal funds by participating candidates; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HB9517C442D7A4B5F8FAA07166BAB48F5" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><content>monitoring the use of allocations from the Freedom From Influence Fund established under section 541 and matching contributions under this title through audits of not fewer than 1/10 (or, in the case of the first 3 election cycles during which the program under this title is in effect, not fewer than 1/3) of all participating candidates or other mechanisms.</content></paragraph></section>
<section id="HC6B082863BDD4F5F942ECA1C45EAD7F7"><num value="544">“SEC. 544. </num><heading>VIOLATIONS AND PENALTIES.</heading>
<subsection id="H54F4FD6035F546A5AA2DDA7C2397D8F2" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Civil Penalty for Violation of Contribution and Expenditure Requirements</inline>.—</heading><content>If a candidate who has been certified as a participating candidate accepts a contribution or makes an expenditure that is prohibited under section 521, the Commission may assess a civil penalty against the candidate in an amount that is not more than 3 times the amount of the contribution or expenditure. Any amounts collected under this subsection shall be deposited into the Freedom From Influence Fund established under section 541.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H9345B6265B9743C6BFBB8F6EB69B3C61" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Repayment for Improper Use of Freedom From Influence Fund</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HB170A31B5EF64965A0DBE614DB530805" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>If the Commission determines that any payment made to a participating candidate was not used as provided for in this title or that a participating candidate has violated any of the dates for remission of funds contained in this title, the Commission shall so notify the candidate and the candidate shall pay to the Fund an amount equal to—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H0E2694283653420D80F5BEF3E6E57F32" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>the amount of payments so used or not remitted, as appropriate; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD53384D26015411C9C9E6AE7F4D95F5C" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>interest on any such amounts (at a rate determined by the Commission).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H5035370D9C9343A78AE2DF7D1269C40B" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Other action not precluded</inline>.—</heading><content>Any action by the Commission in accordance with this subsection shall not preclude enforcement proceedings by the Commission in accordance with section 309(a), including a referral by the Commission to the Attorney General in the case of an apparent knowing and willful violation of this title.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H09E7EEC4EEF94DF48D5F439476089C68" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibiting Candidates Subject to Criminal Penalty From Qualifying as Participating Candidates</inline>.—</heading><content>A candidate is not eligible to be certified as a participating candidate under this title with respect to an election if a penalty has been assessed against the candidate under section 309(d) with respect to any previous election.</content></subsection></section>
<section id="H76691825B34A4704BEB43E6BBCA5E224"><num value="545">“SEC. 545. </num><heading>APPEALS PROCESS.</heading>
<subsection id="H75A7A9BB70BC4D52998A3EA4FEC1FA54" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Review of Actions</inline>.—</heading><content>Any action by the Commission in carrying out this title shall be subject to review by the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia upon petition filed in the Court not later than 30 days after the Commission takes the action for which the review is sought.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H12F3539EE53E49BC9E8DF886226D56AF" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Procedures</inline>.—</heading><content>The provisions of <ref href="/us/usc/t5/ch7">chapter 7 of title 5, United States Code</ref>, apply to judicial review under this section.</content></subsection></section>

<section role="definitions" id="HBB91B46BA4074BF3A5745588C06A561F"><num value="547">“SEC. 547. </num><heading>ELECTION CYCLE DEFINED.</heading><content class="block">“In this title, the term ‘<term>election cycle</term>’ means, with respect to an election for an office, the period beginning on the day after the date of the most recent general election for that office (or, if the general election resulted in a runoff election, the date of the runoff election) and ending on the date of the next general election for that office (or, if the general election resulted in a runoff election, the date of the runoff election).”</content></section></subtitle></title></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></section>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt1/s5201" id="HE5D6CB5DDFE14F74B0ED95E9C7FFB37C"><num value="5201">SEC. 5201. </num><heading>INCREASE IN AND MODIFICATIONS TO MATCHING PAYMENTS.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt1/s5201/a" id="H14F0704446D542DBB0D5600FC556A72C" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Increase and Modification</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt1/s5201/a/1" id="H7BA8953250124B8ABC80956DA00B34FF" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The first sentence of section 9034(a) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction>—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt1/s5201/a/1/A" id="HCCC247BFC06B4D938BEA016A4400B139" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> “<quotedText>an amount equal to the amount of each contribution</quotedText>” and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> “<quotedText>an amount equal to 600 percent of the amount of each matchable contribution (disregarding any amount of contributions from any person to the extent that the total of the amounts contributed by such person for the election exceeds $200)</quotedText>”; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt1/s5201/a/1/B" id="HCC08CEDEB02B4D55AFEB4E35B0D00BE8" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> “<quotedText>authorized committees</quotedText>” and all that follows through “<quotedText>$250</quotedText>” and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> “<quotedText>authorized committees</quotedText>”.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt1/s5201/a/2" id="H01AB61923A444FE18FD307B6EC2BF4A8" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Matchable contributions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Section 9034 of such Code <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction>—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt1/s5201/a/2/A" id="H2359D4B4A838490E81C7F32056F98003" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> the last sentence of subsection (a); and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt1/s5201/a/2/B" id="H4B999E2679D94753A3B39655C76226C2" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new subsection:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H67A4D28FD8724C438F0EEE089299EDFA" styleType="OLC">
<subsection id="HD89347F585664194814E10CD6A9597AB" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Matchable Contribution Defined</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of this section and section 9033(b)—</chapeau>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H9CF602C5EB5742A6A0E19ED44C7671B1" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Matchable contribution</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The term ‘<term>matchable contribution</term>’ means, with respect to the nomination for election to the office of President of the United States, a contribution by an individual to a candidate or an authorized committee of a candidate with respect to which the candidate has certified in writing that—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HD069918DB59A4D4D9646F6D03755747C" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>the individual making such contribution has not made aggregate contributions (including such matchable contribution) to such candidate and the authorized committees of such candidate in excess of $1,000 for the election;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HCBA0E6E868BA4F90A1942A8334FA40AC" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>such candidate and the authorized committees of such candidate will not accept contributions from such individual (including such matchable contribution) aggregating more than the amount described in subparagraph (A); and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HFE5CDF24911F4E1CA920D8BCEDE0889F" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>such contribution was a direct contribution.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H9135C82FCC8A4538B08355EBFE8D9FF0" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Contribution</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of this subsection, the term ‘<term>contribution</term>’ means a gift of money made by a written instrument which identifies the individual making the contribution by full name and mailing address, but does not include a subscription, loan, advance, or deposit of money, or anything of value or anything described in subparagraph (B), (C), or (D) of section 9032(4).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H66E98C375778409699AAA4754BDC91C7" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Direct contribution</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph role="definitions" id="H703A655E5FB940DBAC81386DA52E4168" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of this subsection, the term ‘<term>direct contribution</term>’ means, with respect to a candidate, a contribution which is made directly by an individual to the candidate or an authorized committee of the candidate and is not—</chapeau>
<clause id="HFC6275B01EAB451DAA3AC25E9910EA50" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>forwarded from the individual making the contribution to the candidate or committee by another person; or</content></clause>
<clause id="H9690269508084C00A09CD91CEAC43685" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>received by the candidate or committee with the knowledge that the contribution was made at the request, suggestion, or recommendation of another person.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HCB11551DCC7F45A2BEFF6088D0924E0A" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Other definitions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In subparagraph (A)—</chapeau>
<clause role="definitions" id="H71574CE03A544C16A377E6313815C579" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>the term ‘<term>person</term>’ does not include an individual (other than an individual described in section 304(i)(7) of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971), a political committee of a political party, or any political committee which is not a separate segregated fund described in section 316(b) of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 and which does not make contributions or independent expenditures, does not engage in lobbying activity under the Lobbying Disclosure Act of 1995 (<ref href="/us/usc/t2/s1601/etseq">2 U.S.C. 1601 et seq.</ref>), and is not established by, controlled by, or affiliated with a registered lobbyist under such Act, an agent of a registered lobbyist under such Act, or an organization which retains or employs a registered lobbyist under such Act; and</content></clause>
<clause id="HB185EFDADB3C451FA86CC3486174A2DA" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>a contribution is not ‘made at the request, suggestion, or recommendation of another person’ solely on the grounds that the contribution is made in response to information provided to the individual making the contribution by any person, so long as the candidate or authorized committee does not know the identity of the person who provided the information to such individual.”</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt1/s5201/a/3" id="H81B8A1A9CD73479E8CF25900263732C4" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Conforming amendments</inline>.—</heading>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt1/s5207" id="H2344565C4DEE4E9AA6FADEB0F3F9486E"><num value="5207">SEC. 5207. </num><heading>USE OF FREEDOM FROM INFLUENCE FUND AS SOURCE OF PAYMENTS.</heading>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt1/s5207/a" id="HE05A1E88C9284CF1ADCA1B8F28BEEE92" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>Chapter 96 of subtitle H of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new section:

<section id="H0AA5BF9A737C4591ACDA95483B0253CB"><num value="9043">“SEC. 9043. </num><heading>USE OF FREEDOM FROM INFLUENCE FUND AS SOURCE OF PAYMENTS.</heading>
<subsection id="H97DE8B4B05F845C0BCB28409A7CD28FD" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding any other provision of this chapter, effective with respect to the Presidential election held in 2028 and each succeeding Presidential election, all payments made to candidates under this chapter shall be made from the Freedom From Influence Fund established under section 541 of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 (hereafter in this section referred to as the ‘Fund’).</content></subsection>
<subsection id="HECFF2AA2B91F485CB2E629D842F74328" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Mandatory Reduction of Payments in Case of Insufficient Amounts in Fund</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H2A06E2542425410CB7106B31E130C517" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Advance audits by commission</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Not later than 90 days before the first day of each Presidential election cycle (beginning with the cycle for the election held in 2028), the Commission shall—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HB6AB307A235B4E3F8FF1414C95ECEB44" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>audit the Fund to determine whether, after first making payments to participating candidates under title V of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 and then making payments to States under the My Voice Voucher Program under the Government By the People Act of 2019, the amounts remaining in the Fund will be sufficient to make payments to candidates under this chapter in the amounts provided under this chapter during such election cycle; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HEA622F7F95904A1591EA8B891D2167CD" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>submit a report to Congress describing the results of the audit.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H39DFAB0B599547719083F7F8946AFA14" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reductions in amount of payments</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H033F491FC08C40DCA49C92C252F80F19" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Automatic reduction on pro rata basis</inline>.—</heading><content>If, on the basis of the audit described in paragraph (1), the Commission determines that the amount anticipated to be available in the Fund with respect to the Presidential election cycle involved is not, or may not be, sufficient to satisfy the full entitlements of candidates to payments under this chapter for such cycle, the Commission shall reduce each amount which would otherwise be paid to a candidate under this chapter by such pro rata amount as may be necessary to ensure that the aggregate amount of payments anticipated to be made with respect to the cycle will not exceed the amount anticipated to be available for such payments in the Fund with respect to such cycle.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB7F8F1A4261044279669770A212C79AF" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Restoration of reductions in case of availability of sufficient funds during election cycle</inline>.—</heading><content>If, after reducing the amounts paid to candidates with respect to an election cycle under subparagraph (A), the Commission determines that there are sufficient amounts in the Fund to restore the amount by which such payments were reduced (or any portion thereof), to the extent that such amounts are available, the Commission may make a payment on a pro rata basis to each such candidate with respect to the election cycle in the amount by which such candidate’s payments were reduced under subparagraph (A) (or any portion thereof, as the case may be).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H04D65120B8D2472AA87321CEFDD11E40" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No use of amounts from other sources</inline>.—</heading><content>In any case in which the Commission determines that there are insufficient moneys in the Fund to make payments to candidates under this chapter, moneys shall not be made available from any other source for the purpose of making such payments.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H50F8DAF8547D4558B076C193C94D65AE" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No effect on amounts transferred for pediatric research initiative</inline>.—</heading><content>This section does not apply to the transfer of funds under section 9008(i).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H427FBFC3E4824F10B7BEF0C257824DE9" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Presidential election cycle defined</inline>.—</heading><content>In this section, the term ‘<term>Presidential election cycle</term>’ means, with respect to a Presidential election, the period beginning on the day after the date of the previous Presidential general election and ending on the date of the Presidential election.”</content></paragraph></subsection></section></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection>

<subsection id="HCE7E87E73B7149A78B0DAB054F8853B5" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In order to be eligible to receive any payments under section 9006, the candidates of a political party in a Presidential election shall meet the following requirements:</chapeau>
<paragraph id="HC85E1DE25E6C44BDB853F96E3A218C5F" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Participation in primary payment system</inline>.—</heading><content>The candidate for President received payments under chapter 96 for the campaign for nomination for election to be President.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H0069A149B47A4F2C9E158CF1DB7E518F" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Agreements with commission</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The candidates, in writing—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H6D6EAAEEA4564B588919E7B6A91A4DB7" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>agree to obtain and furnish to the Commission such evidence as it may request of the qualified campaign expenses of such candidates,</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC69E6B22BD884A0A9D21CD99972278E2" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>agree to keep and furnish to the Commission such records, books, and other information as it may request, and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H8EB6CAFCEF474D05A9BE63955F1762C6" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>agree to an audit and examination by the Commission under section 9007 and to pay any amounts required to be paid under such section.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF3E3D27E08C64814BCF405DC69A136D2" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition on joint fundraising committees</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="HF8C6EBADBC5D411982A49F8779F51625" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition</inline>.—</heading><content>The candidates certifies in writing that the candidates will not establish a joint fundraising committee with a political committee other than another authorized committee of the candidate.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HEC9358B1D2814484A4A8E5699D138164" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Status of existing committees for prior elections</inline>.—</heading><content>If a candidate established a joint fundraising committee described in subparagraph (A) with respect to a prior election for which the candidate was not eligible to receive payments under section 9006 and the candidate does not terminate the committee, the candidate shall not be considered to be in violation of subparagraph (A) so long as that joint fundraising committee does not receive any contributions or make any disbursements with respect to the election for which the candidate is eligible to receive payments under section 9006.”</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt2/s5212" id="HAA71BE873156498CB396DB10C64694A6"><num value="5212">SEC. 5212. </num><heading>REPEAL OF EXPENDITURE LIMITATIONS AND USE OF QUALIFIED CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS.</heading>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt2/s5212/a" id="H43615113A87C4B95B4C92F8A8950F10F" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Use of Qualified Campaign Contributions Without Expenditure Limits; Application of Same Requirements for Major, Minor, and New Parties</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 9003 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> subsections (b) and (c) and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> the following:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HEF2794A984B341B38A97E860FA0DF588" styleType="OLC">
<subsection id="H505A8F1CD30A42F0AB4FEC8B9232DC1C" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Use of Qualified Campaign Contributions To Defray Expenses</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H0B91ADB61FC349648C3613A71403A8BA" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In order to be eligible to receive any payments under section 9006, the candidates of a party in a Presidential election shall certify to the Commission, under penalty of perjury, that—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HFF88347B37EA48689E4AEBB64682FEE9" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><chapeau>such candidates and their authorized committees have not and will not accept any contributions to defray qualified campaign expenses other than—</chapeau>
<clause id="H36BFE9FF13534D8A98D0BACFA4EED880" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>qualified campaign contributions, and</content></clause>
<clause id="H23A3797CEA5743CC81AEE706412271DB" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>contributions to the extent necessary to make up any deficiency payments received out of the fund on account of the application of section 9006(c), and</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H6978B534D5AB46718A00D1D5FA97D2B7" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>such candidates and their authorized committees have not and will not accept any contribution to defray expenses which would be qualified campaign expenses but for subparagraph (C) of section 9002(11).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HAC5A7E9924944579AA77513F6BD9FADC" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Timing of certification</inline>.—</heading><content>The candidate shall make the certification required under this subsection at the same time the candidate makes the certification required under subsection (a)(3).”</content></paragraph></subsection></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt2/s5212/b" id="H0C73B2BDFFC0410A95BC50A4C49E5F00" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definition of Qualified Campaign Contribution</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 9002 of such Code <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new paragraph:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H0FC732EBBADC4C7DB67C67C8BE5D41EA" styleType="OLC">
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H6D49D9487E094BC6A80C43D646EA4AD5" class="indent1"><num value="13">“(13) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Qualified campaign contribution</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The term ‘<term>qualified campaign contribution</term>’ means, with respect to any election for the office of President of the United States, a contribution from an individual to a candidate or an authorized committee of a candidate which—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H726C49E087D14E04A71CC1F567DEAB34" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>does not exceed $1,000 for the election; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HDF0399AB2B9344DEB78E5DAB58332292" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><chapeau>with respect to which the candidate has certified in writing that—</chapeau>
<clause id="H45D94009683B47FCA90129F7236FD259" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>the individual making such contribution has not made aggregate contributions (including such qualified contribution) to such candidate and the authorized committees of such candidate in excess of the amount described in subparagraph (A), and</content></clause>
<clause id="H67ED6B042E2A41A6A05D48909DB09FD3" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>such candidate and the authorized committees of such candidate will not accept contributions from such individual (including such qualified contribution) aggregating more than the amount described in subparagraph (A) with respect to such election.”</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt2/s5213" id="H0C074509BFAE4CC6B330384BB2D8ECDC"><num value="5213">SEC. 5213. </num><heading>MATCHING PAYMENTS AND OTHER MODIFICATIONS TO PAYMENT AMOUNTS.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt2/s5213/a" id="H6613AD5B245948228BA938C6F8DD4F94" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt2/s5213/a/1" id="HF6A7819893084F68BA82770504388BCF" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Amount of payments; application of same amount for candidates of major, minor, and new parties</inline>.—</heading><content>Subsection (a) of section 9004 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> to read as follows:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H47B44F02C23F4F508131324A114D0798" styleType="OLC">
<subsection id="H980700D7EB0140B68F0C3205C8509E5F" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>Subject to the provisions of this chapter, the eligible candidates of a party in a Presidential election shall be entitled to equal payment under section 9006 in an amount equal to 600 percent of the amount of each matchable contribution received by such candidate or by the candidate’s authorized committees (disregarding any amount of contributions from any person to the extent that the total of the amounts contributed by such person for the election exceeds $200), except that total amount to which a candidate is entitled under this paragraph shall not exceed $250,000,000.”</content></subsection></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt2/s5213/a/2" id="H67F0417F5A834E739E5C6FDB7DA45B1F" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Repeal of separate limitations for candidates of minor and new parties; inflation adjustment</inline>.—</heading><content>Subsection (b) of section 9004 of such Code <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> to read as follows:

<subparagraph id="H3CA0F83C46FF41CB8C14435BB72558D0" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>such dollar amount; multiplied by</content></subparagraph>

<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt2/s5213/b" id="H8EDEF29570684D87920785F549FE1A96" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Matchable Contribution</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 9002 of such Code, as amended by section 5212(b), <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new paragraph:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H00CF3432FE214AEEBDD5104458B8D3AC" styleType="OLC">
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H0E672B781ECA4BC6B1931CF36DA471AE" class="indent1"><num value="14">“(14) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Matchable contribution</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The term ‘<term>matchable contribution</term>’ means, with respect to the election to the office of President of the United States, a contribution by an individual to a candidate or an authorized committee of a candidate with respect to which the candidate has certified in writing that—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H60B8E1F1736A416BA044986E9AEECAF4" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>the individual making such contribution has not made aggregate contributions (including such matchable contribution) to such candidate and the authorized committees of such candidate in excess of $1,000 for the election;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H19A84BB6CBEC44058F36CFC0F648BBB7" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>such candidate and the authorized committees of such candidate will not accept contributions from such individual (including such matchable contribution) aggregating more than the amount described in subparagraph (A) with respect to such election; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB34FC76E8BAC4835AF9853D771B7599D" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>such contribution was a direct contribution (as defined in section 9034(c)(3)).”</content></subparagraph></paragraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt2/s5214" id="H60F389AE1D774A769D5AE8547C7DB8E4"><num value="5214">SEC. 5214. </num><heading>INCREASE IN LIMIT ON COORDINATED PARTY EXPENDITURES.</heading>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt2/s5214/a" id="HB67422A72315444E882F00E9E32CE1DF" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 315(d)(2) of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30116/d/2">52 U.S.C. 30116(d)(2)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> to read as follows:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HF500A1407F84423A9D7CAC03E259472F" styleType="OLC">
<paragraph id="H7E8B218672CE4D9388255548DD8445EE" class="indent0"><num value="2">“(2)</num><subparagraph id="HB07A6BAE64E246BCA79045B5C5C54465" class="inline"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>The national committee of a political party may not make any expenditure in connection with the general election campaign of any candidate for President of the United States who is affiliated with such party which exceeds $100,000,000.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HFE25CE050A4547149CA40C93C05872B0" class="indent0"><num value="B">“(B) </num><chapeau>For purposes of this paragraph—</chapeau>
<clause id="H824887BA096F4330A7311E27C7C58E28" class="indent1"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>any expenditure made by or on behalf of a national committee of a political party and in connection with a Presidential election shall be considered to be made in connection with the general election campaign of a candidate for President of the United States who is affiliated with such party; and</content></clause>
<clause id="HE83561DBF7304871AE7FAA82BCF5682E" class="indent1"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>any communication made by or on behalf of such party shall be considered to be made in connection with the general election campaign of a candidate for President of the United States who is affiliated with such party if any portion of the communication is in connection with such election.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H513EDF263B11403CBB4635FDF7825661" class="indent0"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>Any expenditure under this paragraph shall be in addition to any expenditure by a national committee of a political party serving as the principal campaign committee of a candidate for the office of President of the United States.”</content></subparagraph></paragraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection>

<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt2/s5218/a" id="H6051A5A57B494B7DB08D76255A198112" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>Chapter 95 of subtitle H of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new section:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H7FCC556A71FF4AC2B010B21F12D98D07" styleType="OLC">
<section id="H01455A3BE70447A49189B6B813950562"><num value="9013">“SEC. 9013. </num><heading>USE OF FREEDOM FROM INFLUENCE FUND AS SOURCE OF PAYMENTS.</heading>
<subsection id="HE7791D7DD7484B54B8C974AA7E31B5BA" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding any other provision of this chapter, effective with respect to the Presidential election held in 2028 and each succeeding Presidential election, all payments made under this chapter shall be made from the Freedom From Influence Fund established under section 541 of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971.</content></subsection>
<subsection id="H05F4C91378C346FFB98AD70D807218BA" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Mandatory Reduction of Payments in Case of Insufficient Amounts in Fund</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HAC86424279E247A7A1F44035261F8732" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Advance audits by commission</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Not later than 90 days before the first day of each Presidential election cycle (beginning with the cycle for the election held in 2028), the Commission shall—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H11F7C87DCDBD4E2BB04FDE5E01410D19" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>audit the Fund to determine whether, after first making payments to participating candidates under title V of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 and then making payments to States under the My Voice Voucher Program under the Government By the People Act of 2019 and then making payments to candidates under chapter 96, the amounts remaining in the Fund will be sufficient to make payments to candidates under this chapter in the amounts provided under this chapter during such election cycle; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC16E6112C7804C73B8E3D774A1DA2D5E" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>submit a report to Congress describing the results of the audit.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H22972802DAD3491096CF64305F0690C5" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reductions in amount of payments</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H590CD16ABF3E42B3910F31803A37D5A3" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Automatic reduction on pro rata basis</inline>.—</heading><content>If, on the basis of the audit described in paragraph (1), the Commission determines that the amount anticipated to be available in the Fund with respect to the Presidential election cycle involved is not, or may not be, sufficient to satisfy the full entitlements of candidates to payments under this chapter for such cycle, the Commission shall reduce each amount which would otherwise be paid to a candidate under this chapter by such pro rata amount as may be necessary to ensure that the aggregate amount of payments anticipated to be made with respect to the cycle will not exceed the amount anticipated to be available for such payments in the Fund with respect to such cycle.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HF6189FCD5A4B49AAA7A1B77ACB1207BD" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Restoration of reductions in case of availability of sufficient funds during election cycle</inline>.—</heading><content>If, after reducing the amounts paid to candidates with respect to an election cycle under subparagraph (A), the Commission determines that there are sufficient amounts in the Fund to restore the amount by which such payments were reduced (or any portion thereof), to the extent that such amounts are available, the Commission may make a payment on a pro rata basis to each such candidate with respect to the election cycle in the amount by which such candidate’s payments were reduced under subparagraph (A) (or any portion thereof, as the case may be).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H6C71AD27653E459D9078618249936579" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No use of amounts from other sources</inline>.—</heading><content>In any case in which the Commission determines that there are insufficient moneys in the Fund to make payments to candidates under this chapter, moneys shall not be made available from any other source for the purpose of making such payments.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HF61162AA01774D1CB4BD6014908F19C5" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No effect on amounts transferred for pediatric research initiative</inline>.—</heading><content>This section does not apply to the transfer of funds under section 9008(i).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H87A5E5A080B04B3D9AF706CCF1A2589A" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Presidential election cycle defined</inline>.—</heading><content>In this section, the term ‘<term>Presidential election cycle</term>’ means, with respect to a Presidential election, the period beginning on the day after the date of the previous Presidential general election and ending on the date of the Presidential election.”</content></paragraph></subsection></section></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stC/pt3/s5221" id="H6760CE1400964AC09ABF5EB10E89804E"><num value="5221">SEC. 5221. </num><heading>EFFECTIVE DATE.</heading>

<subtitle identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD" id="H7A38B2497B5E4213B6B3A0EA4E56ECFA"><num value="D">Subtitle D—</num><heading>Personal Use Services as Authorized Campaign Expenditures</heading>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD/s5301" id="H42454F8417D34A6EA1FEB17EFF95F6BF"><num value="5301">SEC. 5301. </num><heading>SHORT TITLE; FINDINGS; PURPOSE.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD/s5301/a" id="H4AA3BDD5253444AF91809D380DF4C8CB" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Short Title</inline>.—</heading><content>This subtitle may be cited as the “<shortTitle role="subtitle">Help America Run Act</shortTitle>”.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD/s5301/b" id="HE6DF3B70186B4A7DA895AE374090B123" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Findings</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Congress finds the following:</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD/s5301/b/1" id="H481803682F5E40AAB6228752119C82E9" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>Everyday Americans experience barriers to entry before they can consider running for office to serve their communities.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD/s5301/b/2" id="H51A65C04249B4CD18925712BD5F68637" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>Current law states that campaign funds cannot be spent on everyday expenses that would exist whether or not a candidate were running for office, like childcare and food. While the law seems neutral, its actual effect is to privilege the independently wealthy who want to run, because given the demands of running for office, candidates who must work to pay for childcare or to afford health insurance are effectively being left out of the process, even if they have sufficient support to mount a viable campaign.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD/s5301/b/3" id="H52362F5338A54206BD0B59EEE7AFCBD1" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>Thus current practice favors those prospective candidates who do not need to rely on a regular paycheck to make ends meet. The consequence is that everyday Americans who have firsthand knowledge of the importance of stable childcare, a safety net, or great public schools are less likely to get a seat at the table. This governance by the few is antithetical to the democratic experiment, but most importantly, when lawmakers do not share the concerns of everyday Americans, their policies reflect that.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD/s5301/b/4" id="H46A7F927B80649EBB00559921EEBFAE5" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>These circumstances have contributed to a Congress that does not always reflect everyday Americans. The New York Times reported in 2019 that fewer than 5 percent of representatives cite blue-collar or service jobs in their biographies. A 2015 survey by the Center for Responsive Politics showed that the median net worth of lawmakers was just over $1 million in 2013, or 18 times the wealth of the typical American household.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD/s5301/b/5" id="H08DF17CD1EBC4EF09932886DEA9896ED" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><content>These circumstances have also contributed to a governing body that does not reflect the nation it serves. For instance, women are 51% of the American population. Yet even with a record number of women serving in the One Hundred Sixteenth Congress, the Pew Research Center notes that more than three out of four Members of this Congress are male. The Center for American Women And Politics found that one third of women legislators surveyed had been actively discouraged from running for office, often by political professionals. This type of discouragement, combined with the prohibitions on using campaign funds for domestic needs like childcare, burdens that still fall disproportionately on American women, particularly disadvantages working mothers. These barriers may explain why only 10 women in history have given birth while serving in Congress, in spite of the prevalence of working parents in other professions. Yet working mothers and fathers are best positioned to create policy that reflects the lived experience of most Americans.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD/s5301/c" id="H3A89158E2FEC4AF5ACB7D3B5B6FE9478" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Purpose</inline>.—</heading><content>It is the purpose of this subtitle to ensure that all Americans who are otherwise qualified to serve this Nation are able to run for office, regardless of their economic status. By expanding permissible uses of campaign funds and providing modest assurance that testing a run for office will not cost one’s livelihood, the Help America Run Act will facilitate the candidacy of representatives who more accurately reflect the experiences, challenges, and ideals of everyday Americans.</content></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD/s5302" id="H75FBD98523AA4EEBAB6E285D25A70AB2"><num value="5302">SEC. 5302. </num><heading>TREATMENT OF PAYMENTS FOR CHILD CARE AND OTHER PERSONAL USE SERVICES AS AUTHORIZED CAMPAIGN EXPENDITURE.</heading>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD/s5302/a" id="H6972DAD292A7476B99DCE046BD88D14F" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Personal Use Services as Authorized Campaign Expenditures</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 313 of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30114">52 U.S.C. 30114</ref>), as amended by section 5113, <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new subsection:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HCD89FBCAAED1451FBDA652D87BDCFF20" styleType="OLC">
<subsection id="HC7C4279633E6477585BB7CD722D066FB" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment of Payments for Child Care and Other Personal Use Services as Authorized Campaign Expenditure</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H1D503C72AFAC410397E2DCF81C2970CF" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authorized expenditures</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of subsection (a), the payment by an authorized committee of a candidate for any of the personal use services described in paragraph (3) shall be treated as an authorized expenditure if the services are necessary to enable the participation of the candidate in campaign-connected activities.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HE83C16CE4681420390F2E3D4B682A795" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitations</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="HF9F4B30070A74DD5A87FB50C2A469521" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limit on total amount of payments</inline>.—</heading><content>The total amount of payments made by an authorized committee of a candidate for personal use services described in paragraph (3) may not exceed the limit which is applicable under any law, rule, or regulation on the amount of payments which may be made by the committee for the salary of the candidate (without regard to whether or not the committee makes payments to the candidate for that purpose).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H3F148D65F0FF415EA5B3D5926E0149ED" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Corresponding reduction in amount of salary paid to candidate</inline>.—</heading><content>To the extent that an authorized committee of a candidate makes payments for the salary of the candidate, any limit on the amount of such payments which is applicable under any law, rule, or regulation shall be reduced by the amount of any payments made to or on behalf of the candidate for personal use services described in paragraph (3), other than personal use services described in subparagraph (E) of such paragraph.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1600236ED132493EAA599F14D15CF012" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exclusion of candidates who are officeholders</inline>.—</heading><content>Paragraph (1) does not apply with respect to an authorized committee of a candidate who is a holder of Federal office.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H58DE87BA34DD44389477858E80D6FD78" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Personal use services described</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The personal use services described in this paragraph are as follows:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HD61FC461762B44B380CA5A6BF885292D" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>Child care services.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD3165CC06F1444BAB00DD6C993874331" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>Elder care services.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H7D6FF6FF05624E4E914F22611232C9B0" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>Services similar to the services described in subparagraph (A) or subparagraph (B) which are provided on behalf of any dependent who is a qualifying relative under section 152 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HA47BC56FA3984AE09890E2D2005E1F14" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><content>Dues, fees, and other expenses required to maintain an license or similar requirement related to an individual’s profession.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H1030E8C2341448CC9BDA67209C168EA0" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num><content>Costs associated with health insurance coverage.”</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stD/s5302/b" id="HEDC6C25CC24B4CC8A2D2092E95316BDF" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effective Date</inline>.—</heading><content>The amendments made by this section shall take effect on the date of the enactment of this Act.</content></subsection></section></subtitle>
<subtitle identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stE" id="H5BBE9F0C7BB043B6B9B7798A978C407A"><num value="E">Subtitle E—</num><heading>Severability</heading>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tV/stE/s5401" id="HFD43D982F872428192668654A86072E3"><num value="5401">SEC. 5401. </num><heading>SEVERABILITY.</heading><content class="block">If any provision of this title or amendment made by this title, or the application of a provision or amendment to any person or circumstance, is held to be unconstitutional, the remainder of this title and amendments made by this title, and the application of the provisions and amendment to any person or circumstance, shall not be affected by the holding.</content></section></subtitle></title>

<subtitle identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA" id="H1E09243E71B24D9898DD605F89089A65"><num value="A">Subtitle A—</num><heading>Restoring Integrity to America’s Elections</heading>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6001" id="H850A91165E1A4605B8AF13E86F4AED04"><num value="6001">SEC. 6001. </num><heading>SHORT TITLE.</heading><content class="block">This subtitle may be cited as the “<shortTitle role="subtitle">Restoring Integrity to America’s Elections Act</shortTitle>”.</content></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6002" id="H74D1CF3645684519A0C2C8D4F5FC8B3C"><num value="6002">SEC. 6002. </num><heading>MEMBERSHIP OF FEDERAL ELECTION COMMISSION.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6002/a" id="H840A1541E56141378DF97A130BF5D554" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reduction in Number of Members; Removal of Secretary of Senate and Clerk of House as Ex Officio Members</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6002/a/1" id="H479197BAE94C43CEB14C2C600BD12D12" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general; quorum</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 306(a)(1) of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30106/a/1">52 U.S.C. 30106(a)(1)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> the second and third sentences and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> the following: “<quotedText>The Commission is composed of 5 members appointed by the President by and with the advice and consent of the Senate, of whom no more than 2 may be affiliated with the same political party. A member shall by treated as affiliated with a political party if the member was affiliated, including as a registered voter, employee, consultant, donor, officer, or attorney, with such political party or any of its candidates or elected public officials at any time during the 5-year period ending on the date on which such individual is nominated to be a member of the Commission. A majority of the number of members of the Commission who are serving at the time shall constitute a quorum, except that 3 members shall constitute a quorum if there are 4 members serving at the time.</quotedText>”.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6002/a/2" id="HD8D829ECCFE94D0E975B2DD3D461AB30" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Conforming amendments relating to reduction in number of members</inline>.—</heading><subparagraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6002/a/2/A" id="H4DD83340E73346E8BFC1F2722C4A41BC" class="inline"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>The second sentence of section 306(c) of such Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30106/c">52 U.S.C. 30106(c)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> “<quotedText>affirmative vote of 4 members of the Commission</quotedText>” and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> “<quotedText>affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the Commission who are serving at the time</quotedText>”.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6002/a/2/B" id="HFE48885C7C074850B5C5AB1792FB937A" changed="added" origin="#HHA00" class="indent1"><num value="B">(B) </num><chapeau>Such Act is further amended by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> “<quotedText>affirmative vote of 4 of its members</quotedText>” and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> “<quotedText>affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the Commission who are serving at the time</quotedText>” each place it appears in the following sections:</chapeau>

<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6002/a/2/B/iii" id="H912A417CE8434335A2C3DEED2EC2297B" class="indent2"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><content>Section 309(a)(5)(C) (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30109/a/5/C">52 U.S.C. 30109(a)(5)(C)</ref>).</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6002/a/2/B/iv" id="H0095948D58344C6B872964F9AD0BF7DD" class="indent2"><num value="iv">(iv) </num><content>Section 309(a)(6)(A) (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30109/a/6/A">52 U.S.C. 30109(a)(6)(A)</ref>).</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6002/a/2/B/v" id="H2A4FAC3F531C494B956DA64231AB7D82" class="indent2"><num value="v">(v) </num><content>Section 311(b) (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30111/b">52 U.S.C. 30111(b)</ref>).</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6002/a/3" id="H7BEC66F33B224DBD83070FF64F2BE90F" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Conforming amendment relating to removal of ex officio members</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 306(a) of such Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30106/a">52 U.S.C. 30106(a)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> “<quotedText>(other than the Secretary of the Senate and the Clerk of the House of Representatives)</quotedText>” each place it appears in paragraphs (4) and (5).</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6002/b" id="H2C1444AB3ABF48CEA885B8E484DC6776" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Terms of Service</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 306(a)(2) of such Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30106/a/2">52 U.S.C. 30106(a)(2)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> to read as follows:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HF4F9704E46874054879A215B1D7DCB2F" styleType="OLC">
<paragraph id="HC2846C3B0DDF467FB814E53BB4B10568" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Terms of service</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="HD602788A24724AC3876D7E698F7E7199" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>Each member of the Commission shall serve for a single term of 6 years.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC5DF285DED0849C78AF7B044796F0C7A" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special rule for initial appointments</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the members first appointed to serve terms that begin in January 2022, the President shall designate 2 to serve for a 3-year term.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HFB618620288E4B59B736547552B06E58" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No reappointment permitted</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>An individual who served a term as a member of the Commission may not serve for an additional term, except that—</chapeau>
<clause id="H478B1098A9984D5B881EAC6835F45C29" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>an individual who served a 3-year term under subparagraph (B) may also be appointed to serve a 6-year term under subparagraph (A); and</content></clause>
<clause id="H93A2855C292343F29709042982352892" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>for purposes of this subparagraph, an individual who is appointed to fill a vacancy under subparagraph (D) shall not be considered to have served a term if the portion of the unexpired term the individual fills is less than 50 percent of the period of the term.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H581D36713A814EBF83A6F22F112CD92A" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Vacancies</inline>.—</heading><content>Any vacancy occurring in the membership of the Commission shall be filled in the same manner as in the case of the original appointment. Except as provided in subparagraph (C), an individual appointed to fill a vacancy occurring other than by the expiration of a term of office shall be appointed only for the unexpired term of the member he or she succeeds.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H367BCC956AAE42208631A320F3770DDA" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation on service after expiration of term</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A member of the Commission may continue to serve on the Commission after the expiration of the member’s term for an additional period, but only until the earlier of—</chapeau>
<clause id="H480A01D140F445C582B9FE69391ADB93" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>the date on which the member’s successor has taken office as a member of the Commission; or</content></clause>
<clause id="HB08F846CEA83410E9C607E77ECF75E51" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>the expiration of the 1-year period that begins on the last day of the member’s term.”</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6002/c" id="HD2F3F7A6F5474A6E90A907582FEBFB27" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Qualifications</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 306(a)(3) of such Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30106/a/3">52 U.S.C. 30106(a)(3)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> to read as follows:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H30CEE698791B4EF3BEF198F8C0B54728" styleType="OLC">
<paragraph id="H430C075C9AB14E4D98AB39BDDF21620A" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Qualifications</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H2A6D9678035B4001BF4C3B4CC4DF9815" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>The President may select an individual for service as a member of the Commission if the individual has experience in election law and has a demonstrated record of integrity, impartiality, and good judgment.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H51922DC2133848A891886748E1647E2D" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Assistance of blue ribbon advisory panel</inline>.—</heading>
<clause id="H1295DCC03BBC420D86DF175F534B8EB9" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>Prior to the regularly scheduled expiration of the term of a member of the Commission and upon the occurrence of a vacancy in the membership of the Commission prior to the expiration of a term, the President shall convene a Blue Ribbon Advisory Panel, consisting of an odd number of individuals selected by the President from retired Federal judges, former law enforcement officials, or individuals with experience in election law, except that the President may not select any individual to serve on the panel who holds any public office at the time of selection.</content></clause>
<clause id="H9A7178343AC24FB4ACCA3C239CBECFCE" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Recommendations</inline>.—</heading><content>With respect to each member of the Commission whose term is expiring or each vacancy in the membership of the Commission (as the case may be), the Blue Ribbon Advisory Panel shall recommend to the President at least one but not more than 3 individuals for nomination for appointment as a member of the Commission.</content></clause>
<clause id="H32D75A69E48543FAB295A3412BDC7DA7" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Publication</inline>.—</heading><content>At the time the President submits to the Senate the nominations for individuals to be appointed as members of the Commission, the President shall publish the Blue Ribbon Advisory Panel’s recommendations for such nominations.</content></clause>
<clause id="HB30229C099AC442ABC90F0D6029044BF" class="indent3"><num value="iv">“(iv) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exemption from federal advisory committee act</inline>.—</heading><content>The Federal Advisory Committee Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t5/app">5 U.S.C. App.</ref>) does not apply to a Blue Ribbon Advisory Panel convened under this subparagraph.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H3CCDF3D178EA4E73AC62A2973898D12B" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibiting engagement with other business or employment during service</inline>.—</heading><content>A member of the Commission shall not engage in any other business, vocation, or employment. Any individual who is engaging in any other business, vocation, or employment at the time of his or her appointment to the Commission shall terminate or liquidate such activity no later than 90 days after such appointment.”</content></subparagraph></paragraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6003" id="H70079089F66B4FF3BE58A8C73694AF1E"><num value="6003">SEC. 6003. </num><heading>ASSIGNMENT OF POWERS TO CHAIR OF FEDERAL ELECTION COMMISSION.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6003/a" id="H0F09CD0D2B1C4E668BD5E7B6FD9776DC" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Appointment of Chair by President</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6003/a/1" id="H6288782D4965466C9F4BB70417544572" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 306(a)(5) of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30106/a/5">52 U.S.C. 30106(a)(5)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> to read as follows:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H557CFB24822541BEA7A608F0E7EF41C5" styleType="OLC">
<paragraph id="H3578BCA7A51A458886C2A867A517F034" class="indent1"><num value="5">“(5) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Chair</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H8BD8F3ACDE164722A416F09B87BA46FA" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Initial appointment</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the members first appointed to serve terms that begin in January 2022, one such member (as designated by the President at the time the President submits nominations to the Senate) shall serve as Chair of the Commission.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HE1909AFF4A7349A6A44BB2429D79A1DC" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Subsequent appointments</inline>.—</heading><content>Any individual who is appointed to succeed the member who serves as Chair of the Commission for the term beginning in January 2022 (as well as any individual who is appointed to fill a vacancy if such member does not serve a full term as Chair) shall serve as Chair of the Commission.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H24B6968EEA2644F4A0A4CDDE4CED17E5" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Vice chair</inline>.—</heading><content>The Commission shall select, by majority vote of its members, one of its members to serve as Vice Chair, who shall act as Chair in the absence or disability of the Chair or in the event of a vacancy in the position of Chair.”</content></subparagraph></paragraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6003/a/2" id="H7408E487FADD46729353D996C212B8A9" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Conforming amendment</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 309(a)(2) of such Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30109/a/2">52 U.S.C. 30109(a)(2)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> “<quotedText>through its chairman or vice chairman</quotedText>” and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> “<quotedText>through the Chair</quotedText>”.</content></paragraph></subsection>
