<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6003/b/1" id="HD645AB5552CE4F2D885B3B5001912BD3" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Assignment of certain powers to chair</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 307(a) of such Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30107/a">52 U.S.C. 30107(a)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> to read as follows:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H1981FB7AC15D42D196A0C323720D7833" styleType="OLC">
<subsection id="H2F835E8365B0475987AAD997EF214505" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Distribution of Powers Between Chair and Commission</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H487A4889534B4F8CA36392315D85A852" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Powers assigned to chair</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph id="H653869ED40C84863B2DADAD4A4CFBE68" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Administrative powers</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Chair of the Commission shall be the chief administrative officer of the Commission and shall have the authority to administer the Commission and its staff, and (in consultation with the other members of the Commission) shall have the power—</chapeau>
<clause id="HA4902A2FFC61484BA05A21CB9164B008" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>to appoint and remove the staff director of the Commission;</content></clause>
<clause id="HA6D3F8CC0E8845AAB2DFAD6A523BA1CF" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>to request the assistance (including personnel and facilities) of other agencies and departments of the United States, whose heads may make such assistance available to the Commission with or without reimbursement; and</content></clause>
<clause id="H91AEA6CD22FA4209A7B7CE70FBD67BBD" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><content>to prepare and establish the budget of the Commission and to make budget requests to the President, the Director of the Office of Management and Budget, and Congress.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H0979219CA9E843B19AB86B167EA1AB3D" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Other powers</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Chair of the Commission shall have the power—</chapeau>
<clause id="H1734F9A940244705B49B63B65C5404E8" class="indent3"><num value="i">“(i) </num><content>to appoint and remove the general counsel of the Commission with the concurrence of at least 2 other members of the Commission;</content></clause>
<clause id="H5E7FBD984DCC4951BE5C1DA8D34BCD2B" class="indent3"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>to require by special or general orders, any person to submit, under oath, such written reports and answers to questions as the Chair may prescribe;</content></clause>
<clause id="H545CB888E5B7432998A4CDC2FFE94912" class="indent3"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><content>to administer oaths or affirmations;</content></clause>
<clause id="H8438FE7E36E24D95AD6342757198C251" class="indent3"><num value="iv">“(iv) </num><content>to require by subpoena, signed by the Chair, the attendance and testimony of witnesses and the production of all documentary evidence relating to the execution of its duties;</content></clause>
<clause id="H334D824359DD445E9A25A5D3A61DA8FC" class="indent3"><num value="v">“(v) </num><content>in any proceeding or investigation, to order testimony to be taken by deposition before any person who is designated by the Chair, and shall have the power to administer oaths and, in such instances, to compel testimony and the production of evidence in the same manner as authorized under clause (iv); and</content></clause>
<clause id="H4679FE859ACA4A8EA0DE500AD184B32E" class="indent3"><num value="vi">“(vi) </num><content>to pay witnesses the same fees and mileage as are paid in like circumstances in the courts of the United States.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H7376D67D6B9E44A3B90F3613A3A297BA" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Powers assigned to commission</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Commission shall have the power—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HF28B73117B514264A67DD26DBB17F943" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>to initiate (through civil actions for injunctive, declaratory, or other appropriate relief), defend (in the case of any civil action brought under section 309(a)(8) of this Act) or appeal (including a proceeding before the Supreme Court on certiorari) any civil action in the name of the Commission to enforce the provisions of this Act and chapter 95 and chapter 96 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, through its general counsel;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HD733CFB38F254D5FA6086754F2DC8C23" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>to render advisory opinions under section 308 of this Act;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HDC628B6D0519405C9493DE72629C664F" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>to develop such prescribed forms and to make, amend, and repeal such rules, pursuant to the provisions of <ref href="/us/usc/t5/ch5">chapter 5 of title 5, United States Code</ref>, as are necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act and chapter 95 and chapter 96 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB487669CC5B947BDAFE93ECEEE8B9AC4" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><content>to conduct investigations and hearings expeditiously, to encourage voluntary compliance, and to report apparent violations to the appropriate law enforcement authorities; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H877C209973504D05A035E088978D3B77" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num><content>to transmit to the President and Congress not later than June 1 of each year a report which states in detail the activities of the Commission in carrying out its duties under this Act, and which includes any recommendations for any legislative or other action the Commission considers appropriate.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H2E572E459D8F48EB9135191F6EEC3DB7" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Permitting commission to exercise other powers of chair</inline>.—</heading><content>With respect to any investigation, action, or proceeding, the Commission, by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members who are serving at the time, may exercise any of the powers of the Chair described in paragraph (1)(B).”</content></paragraph></subsection></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6004" id="H726B89FDB7BF4ACEA28795163A67E37F"><num value="6004">SEC. 6004. </num><heading>REVISION TO ENFORCEMENT PROCESS.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6004/a" id="H9187D1F8C48E45F7BEE36B8D5CE09E82" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Standard for Initiating Investigations and Determining Whether Violations Have Occurred</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6004/a/1" id="HB223223E81A2448288262B0B5AF507DF" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Revision of standards</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 309(a) of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30109/a">52 U.S.C. 30109(a)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> paragraphs (2) and (3) and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> the following:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HA4960B63117342A5BB62ED8462B5D867" styleType="traditional">
<paragraph id="HE34DDAFAAFBA43DD93B61C170F3AE072" class="indent0"><num value="2">“(2)</num><subparagraph id="H15C0B1473C7A4DF9A4470F0E20C625D8" class="inline"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>The general counsel, upon receiving a complaint filed with the Commission under paragraph (1) or upon the basis of information ascertained by the Commission in the normal course of carrying out its supervisory responsibilities, shall make a determination as to whether or not there is reason to believe that a person has committed, or is about to commit, a violation of this Act or chapter 95 or chapter 96 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, and as to whether or not the Commission should either initiate an investigation of the matter or that the complaint should be dismissed. The general counsel shall promptly provide notification to the Commission of such determination and the reasons therefore, together with any written response submitted under paragraph (1) by the person alleged to have committed the violation. Upon the expiration of the 30-day period which begins on the date the general counsel provides such notification, the general counsel’s determination shall take effect, unless during such 30-day period the Commission, by vote of a majority of the members of the Commission who are serving at the time, overrules the general counsel’s determination. If the determination by the general counsel that the Commission should investigate the matter takes effect, or if the determination by the general counsel that the complaint should be dismissed is overruled as provided under the previous sentence, the general counsel shall initiate an investigation of the matter on behalf of the Commission.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HF3D7D69BC4D142A7A75192FB1097E67C" class="indent0"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>If the Commission initiates an investigation pursuant to subparagraph (A), the Commission, through the Chair, shall notify the subject of the investigation of the alleged violation. Such notification shall set forth the factual basis for such alleged violation. The Commission shall make an investigation of such alleged violation, which may include a field investigation or audit, in accordance with the provisions of this section. The general counsel shall provide notification to the Commission of any intent to issue a subpoena or conduct any other form of discovery pursuant to the investigation. Upon the expiration of the 15-day period which begins on the date the general counsel provides such notification, the general counsel may issue the subpoena or conduct the discovery, unless during such 15-day period the Commission, by vote of a majority of the members of the Commission who are serving at the time, prohibits the general counsel from issuing the subpoena or conducting the discovery.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HB5B3A587CCA843EBBBCAD37BD98C301E" class="indent0"><num value="3">“(3)</num><subparagraph id="H1C95AC39F0B44794B8FDBC383CEFDF1C" class="inline"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>Upon completion of an investigation under paragraph (2), the general counsel shall promptly submit to the Commission the general counsel’s recommendation that the Commission find either that there is probable cause or that there is not probable cause to believe that a person has committed, or is about to commit, a violation of this Act or chapter 95 or chapter 96 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, and shall include with the recommendation a brief stating the position of the general counsel on the legal and factual issues of the case.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HE802767655E8459D98267E099032EBF1" class="indent0"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>At the time the general counsel submits to the Commission the recommendation under subparagraph (A), the general counsel shall simultaneously notify the respondent of such recommendation and the reasons therefore, shall provide the respondent with an opportunity to submit a brief within 30 days stating the position of the respondent on the legal and factual issues of the case and replying to the brief of the general counsel. The general counsel and shall promptly submit such brief to the Commission upon receipt.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H219AF52665B94CCFBC9A9EBB6FC69B48" class="indent0"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>Not later than 30 days after the general counsel submits the recommendation to the Commission under subparagraph (A) (or, if the respondent submits a brief under subparagraph (B), not later than 30 days after the general counsel submits the respondent’s brief to the Commission under such subparagraph), the Commission shall approve or disapprove the recommendation by vote of a majority of the members of the Commission who are serving at the time.”</content></subparagraph></paragraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6004/a/2" id="H7ACFA408663E4B9E89F4BE6747EE7344" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Conforming amendment relating to initial response to filing of complaint</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Section 309(a)(1) of such Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30109/a/1">52 U.S.C. 30109(a)(1)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction>—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6004/a/2/A" id="H0D9E36F2BF364A46BFE7B38F834B98C1" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>in the third sentence, by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> “<quotedText>the Commission</quotedText>” and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> “<quotedText>the general counsel</quotedText>”; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6004/a/2/B" id="H316B5DE34AC64DD5828BA60433689C5B" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>by <amendingAction type="amend">amending</amendingAction> the fourth sentence to read as follows: “<quotedText>Not later than 15 days after receiving notice from the general counsel under the previous sentence, the person may provide the general counsel with a written response that no action should be taken against such person on the basis of the complaint.</quotedText>”.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6004/b" id="HF2E7CE3218714121A6E23E5ECAECFC3F" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Revision of Standard for Review of Dismissal of Complaints</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6004/b/1" id="H86651EE839A1455991834FB375CC4B70" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 309(a)(8) of such Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30109/a/8">52 U.S.C. 30109(a)(8)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> to read as follows:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HB5B04B0DCA85496EA4723540636436F8" styleType="traditional">
<paragraph id="HAAFE083D5BC44A23AAD064E9B7EDA4D9" class="indent0"><num value="8">“(8)</num><subparagraph id="H9D9C6177B24046F295591248B704EE28" class="inline"><num value="A">(A)</num><clause id="HC5F2DBAF770649C08206D2C7E31FBD53" class="inline"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>Any party aggrieved by an order of the Commission dismissing a complaint filed by such party after finding either no reason to believe a violation has occurred or no probable cause a violation has occurred may file a petition with the United States District Court for the District of Columbia. Any petition under this subparagraph shall be filed within 60 days after the date on which the party received notice of the dismissal of the complaint.</content></clause>
<clause changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HE07FF4A63D5348D98262372674640DBD" class="indent0"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>In any proceeding under this subparagraph, the court shall determine by de novo review whether the agency’s dismissal of the complaint is contrary to law. In any matter in which the penalty for the alleged violation is greater than $50,000, the court should disregard any claim or defense by the Commission of prosecutorial discretion as a basis for dismissing the complaint.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H7B9C3CF259734CB997843BC020C58C3C" class="indent0"><num value="B">“(B)</num><clause id="H05345DBAEB004AED9E7A0D3AE56CF19D" class="inline"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>Any party who has filed a complaint with the Commission and who is aggrieved by a failure of the Commission, within one year after the filing of the complaint, to either dismiss the complaint or to find reason to believe a violation has occurred or is about to occur, may file a petition with the United States District Court for the District of Columbia.</content></clause>
<clause changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H482690187AA6433398DCB76D2C751351" class="indent0"><num value="ii">“(ii) </num><content>In any proceeding under this subparagraph, the court shall treat the failure to act on the complaint as a dismissal of the complaint, and shall determine by de novo review whether the agency’s failure to act on the complaint is contrary to law.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H40FEE35B33D84AF58129964D89CC8BA6" class="indent0"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>In any proceeding under this paragraph the court may declare that the dismissal of the complaint or the failure to act is contrary to law, and may direct the Commission to conform with such declaration within 30 days, failing which the complainant may bring, in the name of such complainant, a civil action to remedy the violation involved in the original complaint.”</content></subparagraph></paragraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6004/b/2" id="H0AD79B6918084EE1A3DF350714DFC780" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effective date</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The amendments made by paragraph (1) shall apply—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6004/b/2/A" id="H632C347FB3E44984AC949CCAE49ADF2D" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>in the case of complaints which are dismissed by the Federal Election Commission, with respect to complaints which are dismissed on or after the date of the enactment of this Act; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6004/b/2/B" id="H19A089E529534CE895F68D90136F59C0" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>in the case of complaints upon which the Federal Election Commission failed to act, with respect to complaints which were filed on or after the date of the enactment of this Act.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6005" id="H09D8B6F0C2B948BDB7203806C240ABB9"><num value="6005">SEC. 6005. </num><heading>PERMITTING APPEARANCE AT HEARINGS ON REQUESTS FOR ADVISORY OPINIONS BY PERSONS OPPOSING THE REQUESTS.</heading>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6005/a" id="H4B916085ED534E55954DA88ACF138748" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 308 of such Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30108">52 U.S.C. 30108</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new subsection:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="H5A94D82480D74020B476C8D88FF1BA21" styleType="traditional">
<subsection id="H3C43A5532B8D40F89E66E319F665A5AB" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num><content>To the extent that the Commission provides an opportunity for a person requesting an advisory opinion under this section (or counsel for such person) to appear before the Commission to present testimony in support of the request, and the person (or counsel) accepts such opportunity, the Commission shall provide a reasonable opportunity for an interested party who submitted written comments under subsection (d) in response to the request (or counsel for such interested party) to appear before the Commission to present testimony in response to the request.”</content></subsection></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stA/s6005/b" id="H427EC69E887840F6BA131BB85FBF7FA2" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effective Date</inline>.—</heading><content>The amendment made by subsection (a) shall apply with respect to requests for advisory opinions under section 308 of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 which are made on or after the date of the enactment of this Act.</content></subsection></section>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6102" id="H88359EC4DA294EC0A962368EEBCAC267"><num value="6102">SEC. 6102. </num><heading>CLARIFICATION OF TREATMENT OF COORDINATED EXPENDITURES AS CONTRIBUTIONS TO CANDIDATES.</heading>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6102/a" id="H46A43BCE53664416A5AC826A525B33C8" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Treatment as Contribution to Candidate</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Section 301(8)(A) of the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30101/8/A">52 U.S.C. 30101(8)(A)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction>—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6102/a/1" id="H2980087BE4244983AA4A502AE1451539" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> “<quotedText>or</quotedText>” at the end of clause (i);</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6102/a/2" id="H45338965BE3440B09038F406D20BDB9D" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> the period at the end of clause (ii) and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> “<quotedText>; or</quotedText>”; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6102/a/3" id="H642C9A47FBB345A79E458AD832285DD8" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new clause:

<clause id="H76D7D29B9CD943E38C620C4276228B1F" class="indent2"><num value="iii">“(iii) </num><content>any payment made by any person (other than a candidate, an authorized committee of a candidate, or a political committee of a political party) for a coordinated expenditure (as such term is defined in section 326) which is not otherwise treated as a contribution under clause (i) or clause (ii).”</content></clause></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6102/b" id="H89E517519A2A44C084F2360F6E78FC32" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definitions</inline>.—</heading><content>Title III of such Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t52/s30101/etseq">52 U.S.C. 30101 et seq.</ref>), as amended by section 4702(a), <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> at the end the following new section:
<quotedContent changed="added" origin="#HHA00" id="HEA81D571291F4408A4E7FDE6C4EDE313" styleType="OLC">
<section id="H71653385D7BE4BED8AC09410F6D15DDC"><num value="326">“SEC. 326. </num><heading>PAYMENTS FOR COORDINATED EXPENDITURES.</heading>
<subsection id="HB61695BE4E0F4C5CB5EC0190C7FD2C48" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Coordinated Expenditures</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H9AA17394F6334748B4201A84C16501BF" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of section 301(8)(A)(iii), the term ‘<term>coordinated expenditure</term>’ means—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H50B7D005E15948939324617D504AC907" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>any expenditure, or any payment for a covered communication described in subsection (d), which is made in cooperation, consultation, or concert with, or at the request or suggestion of, a candidate, an authorized committee of a candidate, a political committee of a political party, or agents of the candidate or committee, as defined in subsection (b); or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC70F06C417994FC28ED8711C6553A538" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>any payment for any communication which republishes, disseminates, or distributes, in whole or in part, any video or broadcast or any written, graphic, or other form of campaign material prepared by the candidate or committee or by agents of the candidate or committee (including any excerpt or use of any video from any such broadcast or written, graphic, or other form of campaign material).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H1AE218C76CBE4E2FBDCB6622C1CBC6A9" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exception for payments for certain communications</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>A payment for a communication (including a covered communication described in subsection (d)) shall not be treated as a coordinated expenditure under this subsection if—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H05F9611B98454F62864FDCBB2F06830F" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>the communication appears in a news story, commentary, or editorial distributed through the facilities of any broadcasting station, newspaper, magazine, or other periodical publication, unless such facilities are owned or controlled by any political party, political committee, or candidate; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HCB6ECB0DDBEB4EC4B7C91CD574009A07" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>the communication constitutes a candidate debate or forum conducted pursuant to regulations adopted by the Commission pursuant to section 304(f)(3)(B)(iii), or which solely promotes such a debate or forum and is made by or on behalf of the person sponsoring the debate or forum.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HB423C668377D4AABB5C49FDCF5C7E08A" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Coordination Described</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H57E8C69ECFCD49AA82D8A53A143FC7E6" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of this section, a payment is made ‘in cooperation, consultation, or concert with, or at the request or suggestion of,’ a candidate, an authorized committee of a candidate, a political committee of a political party, or agents of the candidate or committee, if the payment, or any communication for which the payment is made, is not made entirely independently of the candidate, committee, or agents. For purposes of the previous sentence, a payment or communication not made entirely independently of the candidate or committee includes any payment or communication made pursuant to any general or particular understanding with, or pursuant to any communication with, the candidate, committee, or agents about the payment or communication.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H7EA97DA6553043AEB3C416277F11FB38" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No finding of coordination based solely on sharing of information regarding legislative or policy position</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of this section, a payment shall not be considered to be made by a person in cooperation, consultation, or concert with, or at the request or suggestion of, a candidate or committee, solely on the grounds that the person or the person’s agent engaged in discussions with the candidate or committee, or with any agent of the candidate or committee, regarding that person’s position on a legislative or policy matter (including urging the candidate or committee to adopt that person’s position), so long as there is no communication between the person and the candidate or committee, or any agent of the candidate or committee, regarding the candidate’s or committee’s campaign advertising, message, strategy, policy, polling, allocation of resources, fundraising, or other campaign activities.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H037E9BA2CF854F82AC4811A55F95E6BE" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No effect on party coordination standard</inline>.—</heading><content>Nothing in this section shall be construed to affect the determination of coordination between a candidate and a political committee of a political party for purposes of section 315(d).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H68B4926F46FE4356B7A775CEADAEFFDF" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">No safe harbor for use of firewall</inline>.—</heading><content>A person shall be determined to have made a payment in cooperation, consultation, or concert with, or at the request or suggestion of, a candidate or committee, in accordance with this section without regard to whether or not the person established and used a firewall or similar procedures to restrict the sharing of information between individuals who are employed by or who are serving as agents for the person making the payment.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="H2EC2023E05024A8A9949DA6C08CCA7EE" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Payments by Coordinated Spenders for Covered Communications</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="H70C03DF87A3E42FF95FF61F6CABA3E62" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Payments made in cooperation, consultation, or concert with candidates</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of subsection (a)(1)(A), if the person who makes a payment for a covered communication, as defined in subsection (d), is a coordinated spender under paragraph (2) with respect to the candidate as described in subsection (d)(1), the payment for the covered communication is made in cooperation, consultation, or concert with the candidate.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="HF55A27A2E95146A2B01D194FC3F5EAAD" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Coordinated spender defined</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of this subsection, the term ‘<term>coordinated spender</term>’ means, with respect to a candidate or an authorized committee of a candidate, a person (other than a political committee of a political party) for which any of the following applies:</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H700ED0A158F249AE81312C4D6DFDCC61" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>During the 4-year period ending on the date on which the person makes the payment, the person was directly or indirectly formed or established by or at the request or suggestion of, or with the encouragement of, the candidate (including an individual who later becomes a candidate) or committee or agents of the candidate or committee, including with the approval of the candidate or committee or agents of the candidate or committee.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HC362B3CF00D94951A65EEBBB2A78ACE6" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>The candidate or committee or any agent of the candidate or committee solicits funds, appears at a fundraising event, or engages in other fundraising activity on the person’s behalf during the election cycle involved, including by providing the person with names of potential donors or other lists to be used by the person in engaging in fundraising activity, regardless of whether the person pays fair market value for the names or lists provided. For purposes of this subparagraph, the term ‘<term>election cycle</term>’ means, with respect to an election for Federal office, the period beginning on the day after the date of the most recent general election for that office (or, if the general election resulted in a runoff election, the date of the runoff election) and ending on the date of the next general election for that office (or, if the general election resulted in a runoff election, the date of the runoff election).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H9A4B8717F4524CC3883C9765FFE0DAD4" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>The person is established, directed, or managed by the candidate or committee or by any person who, during the 4-year period ending on the date on which the person makes the payment, has been employed or retained as a political, campaign media, or fundraising adviser or consultant for the candidate or committee or for any other entity directly or indirectly controlled by the candidate or committee, or has held a formal position with the candidate or committee (including a position as an employee of the office of the candidate at any time the candidate held any Federal, State, or local public office during the 4-year period).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H2267319B46AD4F1F8709E8640ACA5CD0" class="indent2"><num value="D">“(D) </num><content>The person has retained the professional services of any person who, during the 2-year period ending on the date on which the person makes the payment, has provided or is providing professional services relating to the campaign to the candidate or committee, without regard to whether the person providing the professional services used a firewall. For purposes of this subparagraph, the term ‘<term>professional services</term>’ includes any services in support of the candidate’s or committee’s campaign activities, including advertising, message, strategy, policy, polling, allocation of resources, fundraising, and campaign operations, but does not include accounting or legal services.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H0951F91A857747B48036D0B96FFFCAC4" class="indent2"><num value="E">“(E) </num><content>The person is established, directed, or managed by a member of the immediate family of the candidate, or the person or any officer or agent of the person has had more than incidental discussions about the candidate’s campaign with a member of the immediate family of the candidate. For purposes of this subparagraph, the term ‘<term>immediate family</term>’ has the meaning given such term in section 9004(e) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HF37D9837BD6C427AB539E3B9B99F79BA" class="indent0"><num value="d">“(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Covered Communication Defined</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="definitions" id="H1F2006675CEC4AF593C8D2986BA40A81" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>For purposes of this section, the term ‘<term>covered communication</term>’ means, with respect to a candidate or an authorized committee of a candidate, a public communication (as defined in section 301(22)) which—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H72B584A030404DB3A85437BE3F564496" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>expressly advocates the election of the candidate or the defeat of an opponent of the candidate (or contains the functional equivalent of express advocacy);</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H5FFC614E35B645F1ACDEAC7CB83E1ED2" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>promotes or supports the election of the candidate, or attacks or opposes the election of an opponent of the candidate (regardless of whether the communication expressly advocates the election or defeat of a candidate or contains the functional equivalent of express advocacy); or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H4E2A7A498741474D9DF41F05FC8CD288" class="indent2"><num value="C">“(C) </num><content>refers to the candidate or an opponent of the candidate but is not described in subparagraph (A) or subparagraph (B), but only if the communication is disseminated during the applicable election period.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC256AD924A39463684032E0CD307C14B" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Applicable election period</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In paragraph (1)(C), the ‘applicable election period’ with respect to a communication means—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="HC77513944E8243F4A9B9E7CEC12AE8C7" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>in the case of a communication which refers to a candidate in a general, special, or runoff election, the 120-day period which ends on the date of the election; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="HB9DD6F6C94154DFAB2CCD0DEC23ADDCE" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>in the case of a communication which refers to a candidate in a primary or preference election, or convention or caucus of a political party that has authority to nominate a candidate, the 60-day period which ends on the date of the election or convention or caucus.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HA6F3DB4CF73C4335AACD886FA1F38999" class="indent1"><num value="3">“(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special rules for communications involving congressional candidates</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of this subsection, a public communication shall not be considered to be a covered communication with respect to a candidate for election for an office other than the office of President or Vice President unless it is publicly disseminated or distributed in the jurisdiction of the office the candidate is seeking.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection id="HD2831515043446DD8C18D00D5FEEC607" class="indent0"><num value="e">“(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Penalty</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph id="HA6D75498A1DD4FC0807F383E89CE53C8" class="indent1"><num value="1">“(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Determination of amount</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Any person who knowingly and willfully commits a violation of this Act by making a contribution which consists of a payment for a coordinated expenditure shall be fined an amount equal to the greater of—</chapeau>
<subparagraph id="H74A8885AC11B48ECB54FB789E04A6287" class="indent2"><num value="A">“(A) </num><content>in the case of a person who makes a contribution which consists of a payment for a coordinated expenditure in an amount exceeding the applicable contribution limit under this Act, 300 percent of the amount by which the amount of the payment made by the person exceeds such applicable contribution limit; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph id="H0218CE4C9DB74E6B8650CC02B092B905" class="indent2"><num value="B">“(B) </num><content>in the case of a person who is prohibited under this Act from making a contribution in any amount, 300 percent of the amount of the payment made by the person for the coordinated expenditure.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HC343E2E80FEB4EA6BAEE78C948FCB489" class="indent1"><num value="2">“(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Joint and several liability</inline>.—</heading><content>Any director, manager, or officer of a person who is subject to a penalty under paragraph (1) shall be jointly and severally liable for any amount of such penalty that is not paid by the person prior to the expiration of the 1-year period which begins on the date the Commission imposes the penalty or the 1-year period which begins on the date of the final judgment following any judicial review of the Commission’s action, whichever is later.”</content></paragraph></subsection></section></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6102/c" id="H0E1D7F19709D437A9CC31F2FEB9279EB" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effective Date</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6102/c/1" id="H3F37A5EDFC554E099888D259F8C5230C" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Repeal of existing regulations on coordination</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Effective upon the expiration of the 90-day period which begins on the date of the enactment of this Act—</chapeau>
<subparagraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6102/c/1/A" id="H4BE5198252364DB58B42B3A86FEB49FE" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>the regulations on coordinated communications adopted by the Federal Election Commission which are in effect on the date of the enactment of this Act (as set forth in <ref href="/us/cfr/t11/pt109">11 CFR Part 109</ref>, Subpart C, under the heading “<headingText>Coordination</headingText>”) are <amendingAction type="repeal">repealed</amendingAction>; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6102/c/1/B" id="H6B184F001469480E9D9C0D3BFDE3473E" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>the Federal Election Commission shall promulgate new regulations on coordinated communications which reflect the amendments made by this Act.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6102/c/2" id="HCD6A910A9B4E476E89CEE60B68122740" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Effective date</inline>.—</heading><content>The amendments made by this section shall apply with respect to payments made on or after the expiration of the 120-day period which begins on the date of the enactment of this Act, without regard to whether or not the Federal Election Commission has promulgated regulations in accordance with paragraph (1)(B) as of the expiration of such period.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6103" id="H4FCC0137412048FC81CF7A5A41469AC7"><num value="6103">SEC. 6103. </num><heading>CLARIFICATION OF BAN ON FUNDRAISING FOR SUPER PACS BY FEDERAL CANDIDATES AND OFFICEHOLDERS.</heading>

<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dB/tVI/stB/s6103/a/1" id="H3DC23AE665BD44C4AB2D52364D3EECBF" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> “<quotedText>or</quotedText>” at the end of subparagraph (A);</content></paragraph>

<subtitle identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stB" id="H9D868557B88D4506BD8BC154383C2187"><num value="B">Subtitle B—</num><heading>Conflicts of Interests</heading>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stB/s9101" id="HB4079C4CB69C46D9ADB7ED69CB0BD3A2"><num value="9101">SEC. 9101. </num><heading>[RESERVED].</heading><content/></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stB/s9102" id="H2A33E658682D4808901BB444840E01C0"><num value="9102">SEC. 9102. </num><heading>CONFLICT OF INTEREST RULES FOR MEMBERS OF CONGRESS AND CONGRESSIONAL STAFF.</heading><content class="block">No Member, officer, or employee of a committee or Member of either House of Congress may knowingly use his or her official position to introduce or aid the progress or passage of legislation, a principal purpose of which is to further only his or her pecuniary interest, only the pecuniary interest of his or her immediate family, or only the pecuniary interest of a limited class of persons or enterprises, when he or she, or his or her immediate family, or enterprises controlled by them, are members of the affected class.</content></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stB/s9103" id="HFA5B63F39B3347228DFF4682C47E88F6"><num value="9103">SEC. 9103. </num><heading>EXERCISE OF RULEMAKING POWERS.</heading>
<chapeau class="indent0">The provisions of this subtitle are enacted by the Congress—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stB/s9103/1" id="H1B1FFC599AD24C30B7CB6CDBCBAF0FAB" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>as an exercise of the rulemaking power of the House of Representatives and the Senate, respectively, and as such they shall be considered as part of the rules of each House, respectively, or of that House to which they specifically apply, and such rules shall supersede other rules only to the extent that they are inconsistent therewith; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stB/s9103/2" id="HF4ADBE64BC9940FCBF9D7DA712B5E6D9" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>with full recognition of the constitutional right of either House to change such rules (so far as relating to such House) at any time, in the same manner, and to the same extent as in the case of any other rule of such House.</content></paragraph></section></subtitle>
<subtitle identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stC" id="H99E3B29FA383426188DC7CCDBAEBBD61"><num value="C">Subtitle C—</num><heading>Campaign Finance and Lobbying Disclosure</heading>

<chapeau class="indent0">In this subtitle:</chapeau>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9302/1" id="HFDC9340FF76341FA9A445616F200BCF8" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Congressionally mandated report</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The term “<term>congressionally mandated report</term>”—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9302/1/A" id="HDCE9E8702FD54198B8896BE5659C3F2D" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>means a report that is required to be submitted to either House of Congress or any committee of Congress, or subcommittee thereof, by a statute, resolution, or conference report that accompanies legislation enacted into law; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9302/1/B" id="HF7754F6DACA44C7BB146DAA893E85FB9" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>does not include a report required under <ref href="/us/usc/t36/stII/ptB">part B of subtitle II of title 36, United States Code</ref>.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9302/2" id="H3F6F6F24F159491C86D14FE4BF868BC2" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Director</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>Director</term>” means the Director of the Government Publishing Office.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9302/3" id="H47D5F1F9D8D94B71AB542765EA58249C" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Federal agency</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>Federal agency</term>” has the meaning given that term under <ref href="/us/usc/t40/s102">section 102 of title 40, United States Code</ref>, but does not include the Government Accountability Office.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9302/4" id="HCAFEBFF3CC624A59A36BFF17EC6EE648" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Open format</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The term “<term>open format</term>” means a file format for storing digital data based on an underlying open standard that—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9302/4/A" id="H5B02E4EC6BE24C1FB199259F28AA558B" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>is not encumbered by any restrictions that would impede reuse; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9302/4/B" id="H69C6AAF657AE40B9B3E1D09D46AF1F76" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>is based on an underlying open data standard that is maintained by a standards organization.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9302/5" id="H1B01A9DC109243FF9ABDC9EE0596A484" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reports online portal</inline>.—</heading><content>The term “<term>reports online portal</term>” means the online portal established under section (3)(a).</content></paragraph></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303" id="HC415CC4A46B54B40A8E902DA7FEC00A4"><num value="9303">SEC. 9303. </num><heading>ESTABLISHMENT OF ONLINE PORTAL FOR CONGRESSIONALLY MANDATED REPORTS.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/a" id="H673EAE2303C445AFAA67F8DE957BB4F6" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Requirement To Establish Online Portal</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/a/1" id="HE4BE4A82942A42FC8EE0114962941701" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, the Director shall establish and maintain an online portal accessible by the public that allows the public to obtain electronic copies of all congressionally mandated reports in one place. The Director may publish other reports on the online portal.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/a/2" id="H62EA25A61004427BA4388F49983B7405" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Existing functionality</inline>.—</heading><content>To the extent possible, the Director shall meet the requirements under paragraph (1) by using existing online portals and functionality under the authority of the Director.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/a/3" id="HC691EB318C494ED7A6B7F8ED426673D3" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Consultation</inline>.—</heading><content>In carrying out this subtitle, the Director shall consult with the Clerk of the House of Representatives, the Secretary of the Senate, and the Librarian of Congress regarding the requirements for and maintenance of congressionally mandated reports on the reports online portal.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b" id="HECD5EBE6D68F407686E3209ABA8C690D" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Content and Function</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The Director shall ensure that the reports online portal includes the following:</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1" id="H6DD15E046C714737B284194AE912FD72" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><chapeau>Subject to subsection (c), with respect to each congressionally mandated report, each of the following:</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/A" id="H97E6ED6CB4A84EDF9B304162E1BF56AD" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>A citation to the statute, conference report, or resolution requiring the report.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/B" id="H36E45D7506114E9EAFE5E96358F54A0A" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>An electronic copy of the report, including any transmittal letter associated with the report, in an open format that is platform independent and that is available to the public without restrictions, including restrictions that would impede the re-use of the information in the report.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/C" id="H48D833A857C348228A49502CBFA5E41E" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><chapeau>The ability to retrieve a report, to the extent practicable, through searches based on each, and any combination, of the following:</chapeau>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/C/i" id="H805DA1BF13554A20BC419EB16E2DB85B" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>The title of the report.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/C/ii" id="H472D6EF2FC4A4D48B1B1E37195031D6F" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>The reporting Federal agency.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/C/iii" id="HF0A52035BA8F4E7389B283F3F0BBDA10" class="indent3"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><content>The date of publication.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/C/iv" id="H6F6BBCAE8B5D41D88699ECF29AAEEDCE" class="indent3"><num value="iv">(iv) </num><content>Each congressional committee receiving the report, if applicable.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/C/v" id="HF7E19FB61D9145F1826B442102585AE1" class="indent3"><num value="v">(v) </num><content>The statute, resolution, or conference report requiring the report.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/C/vi" id="H9070B3ED6FFD424F92586BEFC9B52F49" class="indent3"><num value="vi">(vi) </num><content>Subject tags.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/C/vii" id="H5F1475DDDF5647A38845C3EF21569F6A" class="indent3"><num value="vii">(vii) </num><content>A unique alphanumeric identifier for the report that is consistent across report editions.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/C/viii" id="H521D40E357FC43A0A853931F42D1059F" class="indent3"><num value="viii">(viii) </num><content>The serial number, Superintendent of Documents number, or other identification number for the report, if applicable.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/C/ix" id="HEA3F8655498249BC8591CB7F7FC564C2" class="indent3"><num value="ix">(ix) </num><content>Key words.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/C/x" id="H6A6FE3401E074318B50AA770451EFD30" class="indent3"><num value="x">(x) </num><content>Full text search.</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/C/xi" id="H54607DC716EF416A937C5C60BDDF2CB2" class="indent3"><num value="xi">(xi) </num><content>Any other relevant information specified by the Director.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/D" id="H4C4BE25228EF49C8B7875C54B285551C" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>The date on which the report was required to be submitted, and on which the report was submitted, to the reports online portal.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/E" id="H6C0575A1D27342CC9B12BD82260F6299" class="indent2"><num value="E">(E) </num><content>Access to the report not later than 30 calendar days after its submission to Congress.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/1/F" id="H3097069EF6BB4B169909670EFCDD420C" class="indent2"><num value="F">(F) </num><content>To the extent practicable, a permanent means of accessing the report electronically.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/2" id="H76410B4E50984473B1798A51140F5350" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>A means for bulk download of all congressionally mandated reports.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/3" id="HD1D1FB0B236A486BBDF782DC838B555C" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>A means for downloading individual reports as the result of a search.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/4" id="H8532546688784EC39674BA8E69470F5A" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>An electronic means for the head of each Federal agency to submit to the reports online portal each congressionally mandated report of the agency, as required by section 4.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/5" id="H9E2D1C23E855459CBB8CF987F478BEDA" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><chapeau>In tabular form, a list of all congressionally mandated reports that can be searched, sorted, and down­loaded by—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/5/A" id="H4A121D6D51524270B466939B765304CA" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>reports submitted within the required time;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/5/B" id="H1FA87305D0D845CF83E4AE1C4CAD9DB3" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>reports submitted after the date on which such reports were required to be submitted; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/b/5/C" id="H923A48EED29942B7BA69259B6D121F50" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>reports not submitted.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/c" id="H629DDB9C0DE44DABAE573569A36D773F" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Noncompliance by Federal Agencies</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/c/1" id="H3B8B92231AEC4A72803B948FCF0B5350" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reports not submitted</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>If a Federal agency does not submit a congressionally mandated report to the Director, the Director shall to the extent practicable—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/c/1/A" id="HFCACB3A39D1D467B8A3BA2390EAAE225" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><chapeau>include on the reports online portal—</chapeau>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/c/1/A/i" id="H085F354BABE54BE88EC76183110D52C9" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>the information required under clauses (i), (ii), (iv), and (v) of subsection (b)(1)(C); and</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/c/1/A/ii" id="H7189699B1A34428288B96EDD6CF76731" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>the date on which the report was required to be submitted; and</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/c/1/B" id="HA7EEDCE5E86843C5BB314E03C69522E1" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>include the congressionally mandated report on the list described in subsection (b)(5)(C).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/c/2" id="H75BCAE0DE5844731B313D428E9FCCF55" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reports not in open format</inline>.—</heading><content>If a Federal agency submits a congressionally mandated report that is not in an open format, the Director shall include the congressionally mandated report in another format on the reports online portal.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/d" id="H9FF6C6BFEAA74584941C18C4E989A56F" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Free Access</inline>.—</heading><content>The Director may not charge a fee, require registration, or impose any other limitation in exchange for access to the reports online portal.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9303/e" id="HB240CC63667643EFBEA43A022A8EB8D1" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Upgrade Capability</inline>.—</heading><content>The reports online portal shall be enhanced and updated as necessary to carry out the purposes of this subtitle.</content></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9304" id="HE2698EB1860F4CF6951E973B5B4EDB89"><num value="9304">SEC. 9304. </num><heading>FEDERAL AGENCY RESPONSIBILITIES.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9304/a" id="H16915451FBDB4FA685DA9068AD382C2E" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Submission of Electronic Copies of Reports</inline>.—</heading><content>Concurrently with the submission to Congress of each congressionally mandated report, the head of the Federal agency submitting the congressionally mandated report shall submit to the Director the information required under subparagraphs (A) through (D) of section 3(b)(1) with respect to the congressionally mandated report. Nothing in this subtitle shall relieve a Federal agency of any other requirement to publish the congressionally mandated report on the online portal of the Federal agency or otherwise submit the congressionally mandated report to Congress or specific committees of Congress, or subcommittees thereof.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9304/b" id="H3CCBDB88FE994453AC6A9BD77FB69651" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Guidance</inline>.—</heading><content>Not later than 240 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the Director of the Office of Management and Budget, in consultation with the Director, shall issue guidance to agencies on the implementation of this Act.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9304/c" id="H0F0AB78943AB4C298C7B9C4579C7189D" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Structure of Submitted Report Data</inline>.—</heading><content>The head of each Federal agency shall ensure that each congressionally mandated report submitted to the Director complies with the open format criteria established by the Director in the guidance issued under subsection (b).</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9304/d" id="H1233C6A9EAA64345B8164C9A65E6FE12" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Point of Contact</inline>.—</heading><content>The head of each Federal agency shall designate a point of contact for congressionally mandated report.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9304/e" id="H01D04E3673BB4620AF07BDAEEAA9E244" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">List of Reports</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>As soon as practicable each calendar year (but not later than April 1), and on a rolling basis during the year if feasible, the Librarian of Congress shall submit to the Director a list of congressionally mandated reports from the previous calendar year, in consultation with the Clerk of the House of Representatives, which shall—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9304/e/1" id="H95F9855ABE8A4BF48C8A25DC5A14BCE0" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>be provided in an open format;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9304/e/2" id="HCAD21CE06FF94F4AB6064186CC44DA88" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>include the information required under clauses (i), (ii), (iv), (v) of section 3(b)(1)(C) for each report;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9304/e/3" id="H35C108684A3A47FDBE842D4D31649C0E" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>include the frequency of the report;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9304/e/4" id="H9D089D619D7E4C5983C6040363EE7FF2" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>include a unique alphanumeric identifier for the report that is consistent across report editions;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9304/e/5" id="HAD777C630AC94E0B964D7F8A8BD28867" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><content>include the date on which each report is required to be submitted; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9304/e/6" id="H0DAF9938879F4DD88BFA57612F4641CC" class="indent1"><num value="6">(6) </num><content>be updated and provided to the Director, as necessary.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9305" id="HCF2233BF720544CAB47EE7FD298401E8"><num value="9305">SEC. 9305. </num><heading>REMOVING AND ALTERING REPORTS.</heading>
<chapeau class="indent0">A report submitted to be published to the reports online portal may only be changed or removed, with the exception of technical changes, by the head of the Federal agency concerned if—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9305/1" id="H195FB80FA6CF4B388B90BBF66AD9C72A" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>the head of the Federal agency consults with each congressional committee to which the report is submitted; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9305/2" id="HDC690259FDF944ABA104C3C89B3991A8" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>Congress enacts a joint resolution authorizing the changing or removal of the report.</content></paragraph></section>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9306" id="H64A44A4DC9E54B3CAF596FDBE9205470"><num value="9306">SEC. 9306. </num><heading>RELATIONSHIP TO THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT.</heading>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9306/a" id="H08B73955B6A5457FA61ED7FD36DEF7C3" class="indent0"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Nothing in this subtitle shall be construed to—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9306/a/1" id="H8B6EEEFFCF324F1BBF88BC6235D85657" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>require the disclosure of information or records that are exempt from public disclosure under <ref href="/us/usc/t5/s552">section 552 of title 5, United States Code</ref>; or</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9306/a/2" id="H825097DBFB8146F180922BE157453B55" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>to impose any affirmative duty on the Director to review congressionally mandated reports submitted for publication to the reports online portal for the purpose of identifying and redacting such information or records.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9306/b" id="H3DD78C49653542A48C4018903F9DB9F5" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Redaction of Information</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>The head of a Federal agency may redact information required to be disclosed under this Act if the information would be properly withheld from disclosure under <ref href="/us/usc/t5/s552">section 552 of title 5, United States Code</ref>, and shall—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9306/b/1" id="HD4A3A76FDD5D4875BCF8B6908404A06E" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>redact information required to be disclosed under this subtitle if disclosure of such information is prohibited by law;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9306/b/2" id="H15FBFB0A13BD474EB81D17AAAB2A1866" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>redact information being withheld under this subsection prior to submitting the information to the Director;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9306/b/3" id="H884060FE0F04429A887E949BE5890B08" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>redact only such information properly withheld under this subsection from the submission of information or from any congressionally mandated report submitted under this subtitle;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9306/b/4" id="H62689BE70CE040049FA0F8F959C2FA39" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>identify where any such redaction is made in the submission or report; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/1/dC/tIX/stD/s9306/b/5" id="H6FAC2E16F8D84966817AA2A296D26371" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><content>identify the exemption under which each such redaction is made.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
