<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7021" id="HA101D8FDE5CD4427A1D9F1FB40348E41" changed="added"><num value="7021"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7021. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7021/a" id="H32CE42EFB2EA4AA5AD89688888D0461F" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Lethal Military Equipment Exports</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7021/a/1" id="HFA0C943458254CB591DE0D9B8D7838F3" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made available under titles III through VI of this Act may be made available to any foreign government which provides lethal military equipment to a country the government of which the Secretary of State has determined supports international terrorism for purposes of section 6(j) of the Export Administration Act of 1979 as continued in effect pursuant to the International Emergency Economic Powers Act: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the prohibition under this section with respect to a foreign government shall terminate 12 months after that government ceases to provide such military equipment: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That this section applies with respect to lethal military equipment provided under a contract entered into after October 1, 1997.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7021/a/2" id="HE0EA04B6E5C64C8F92C160E8C1BD3BDC" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Determination</inline>.—</heading><content>Assistance restricted by paragraph (1) or any other similar provision of law, may be furnished if the President determines that to do so is important to the national interest of the United States.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7021/a/3" id="HE701C51A202043FBBDCCA0F772344E75" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Report</inline>.—</heading><content>Whenever the President makes a determination pursuant to paragraph (2), the President shall submit to the Committees on Appropriations a report with respect to the furnishing of such assistance, including a detailed explanation of the assistance to be provided, the estimated dollar amount of such assistance, and an explanation of how the assistance furthers United States national interest.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7021/b" id="H75CC787849BA4DFC8B1A8C26D84EE719" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Bilateral Assistance</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7021/b/1" id="HD147DBB330DF42ABBFD28F76EE2AA1BA" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitations</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Funds appropriated for bilateral assistance in titles III through VI of this Act and funds appropriated under any such title in prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs, shall not be made available to any foreign government which the President determines—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7021/b/1/A" id="H5BC6C0A69F2E493C85AC7B0CB0E152A9" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>grants sanctuary from prosecution to any individual or group which has committed an act of international terrorism;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7021/b/1/B" id="HAD168E187EE44EB7860BF18E6EB22B1F" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>otherwise supports international terrorism; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7021/b/1/C" id="H21AEF6C4D53F464690A26485F8334A0D" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>is controlled by an organization designated as a terrorist organization under section 219 of the Immigration and Nationality Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t8/s1189">8 U.S.C. 1189</ref>).</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7021/b/2" id="H9742063B7A95401CA3519D900304F2A2" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>The President may waive the application of paragraph (1) to a government if the President determines that national security or humanitarian reasons justify such waiver: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the President shall publish each such waiver in the Federal Register and, at least 15 days before the waiver takes effect, shall notify the Committees on Appropriations of the waiver (including the justification for the waiver) in accordance with the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection></section>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7023" id="H84C80BA4BBD6454C92C36AB488ABD8A4" changed="added"><num value="7023"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7023. </inline></num><chapeau class="inline">For the purpose of titles II through VI of this Act “program, project, and activity” shall be defined at the appropriations Act account level and shall include all appropriations and authorizations Acts funding directives, ceilings, and limitations with the exception that for the following accounts: “Economic Support Fund”, “Assistance for Europe, Eurasia and Central Asia”, and “Foreign Military Financing Program”, “program, project, and activity” shall also be considered to include country, regional, and central program level funding within each such account; and for the development assistance accounts of the United States Agency for International Development, “program, project, and activity” shall also be considered to include central, country, regional, and program level funding, either as—</chapeau>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7025" id="H52B8E9F4113349ED8069EDEB74FD1858" changed="notChanged"><num value="7025"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7025. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7025/a" id="H7005D2ACB09041C8B078474309B85810" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">World Markets</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>None of the funds appropriated or made available pursuant to titles III through VI of this Act for direct assistance and none of the funds otherwise made available to the Export-Import Bank and the United States International Development Finance Corporation shall be obligated or expended to finance any loan, any assistance, or any other financial commitments for establishing or expanding production of any commodity for export by any country other than the United States, if the commodity is likely to be in surplus on world markets at the time the resulting productive capacity is expected to become operative and if the assistance will cause substantial injury to United States producers of the same, similar, or competing commodity: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such prohibition shall not apply to the Export-Import Bank if in the judgment of its Board of Directors the benefits to industry and employment in the United States are likely to outweigh the injury to United States producers of the same, similar, or competing commodity, and the Chairman of the Board so notifies the Committees on Appropriations: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That this subsection shall not prohibit—</proviso></chapeau>

<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H6B7233EFD6DE4966A7A1644BE1D77E07"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">separate accounts</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026" id="HC358A21BC3A94513A095BEA936A36E32" changed="notChanged"><num value="7026"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7026. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a" id="HFE5A6C86D511414D9E687152DAD88161" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Separate Accounts for Local Currencies</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/1" id="H45C2DFC8EFC04462969B36755A27A5E3" changed="notChanged" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Agreements</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>If assistance is furnished to the government of a foreign country under chapters 1 and 10 of part I or chapter 4 of part II of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 under agreements which result in the generation of local currencies of that country, the Administrator of the United States Agency for International Development shall—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/1/A" id="HC33F3EC9FC6943FE885973B530B0AD7B" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>require that local currencies be deposited in a separate account established by that government;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/1/B" id="H31F6267A0B324A929CE0A4607F7154CE" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><chapeau>enter into an agreement with that government which sets forth—</chapeau>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/1/B/i" id="H0B0F165415454A2C8FF904453B5855F2" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>the amount of the local currencies to be generated; and</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/1/B/ii" id="H682242547FB44C3D93B2F0CE907645B6" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>the terms and conditions under which the currencies so deposited may be utilized, consistent with this section; and</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/1/C" id="HAC8DDE98501A45CE98372AF385774F82" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>establish by agreement with that government the responsibilities of USAID and that government to monitor and account for deposits into and disbursements from the separate account.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/2" id="H44D1D62FA6B342F2BF3FA39AE5FBF539" changed="notChanged" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Uses of local currencies</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>As may be agreed upon with the foreign government, local currencies deposited in a separate account pursuant to subsection (a), or an equivalent amount of local currencies, shall be used only—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/2/A" id="HC0E3C8E0B882419F885FDCA0BFD083C1" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><chapeau>to carry out chapter 1 or 10 of part I or chapter 4 of part II of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 (as the case may be), for such purposes as—</chapeau>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/2/A/i" id="H6DF6462E90264707BEE5F0C7FA638806" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>project and sector assistance activities; or</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/2/A/ii" id="H8030BEFE7AA945CEB16E19A106AA9CEF" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>debt and deficit financing; or</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/2/B" id="HA52012EBF7824C13B6892B7836E29851" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>for the administrative requirements of the United States Government.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/3" id="H6DE28E0609834B82A83B5B1866B95FAE" changed="notChanged" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Programming accountability</inline>.—</heading><content>USAID shall take all necessary steps to ensure that the equivalent of the local currencies disbursed pursuant to subsection (a)(2)(A) from the separate account established pursuant to subsection (a)(1) are used for the purposes agreed upon pursuant to subsection (a)(2).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/a/4" id="HFA0C848188494410A9C1140371D8C3AA" changed="notChanged" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Termination of assistance programs</inline>.—</heading><content>Upon termination of assistance to a country under chapter 1 or 10 of part I or chapter 4 of part II of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 (as the case may be), any unencumbered balances of funds which remain in a separate account established pursuant to subsection (a) shall be disposed of for such purposes as may be agreed to by the government of that country and the United States Government.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/b" id="H3E2797EBF3014E0B81D45B99458CABA8" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Separate Accounts for Cash Transfers</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/b/1" id="H008F34FF9D4D4A088482307C11C88ECE" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>If assistance is made available to the government of a foreign country, under chapter 1 or 10 of part I or chapter 4 of part II of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, as cash transfer assistance or as nonproject sector assistance, that country shall be required to maintain such funds in a separate account and not commingle with any other funds.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/b/2" id="H676E88AD6AFA4391ABAAD66D614506F5" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Applicability of other provisions of law</inline>.—</heading><content>Such funds may be obligated and expended notwithstanding provisions of law which are inconsistent with the nature of this assistance including provisions which are referenced in the Joint Explanatory Statement of the Committee of Conference accompanying House Joint Resolution 648 (House Report No. 98–1159).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/b/3" id="HC5973F08F7664FE0A4A54E9139A8A08F" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notification</inline>.—</heading><content>At least 15 days prior to obligating any such cash transfer or nonproject sector assistance, the President shall submit a notification through the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations, which shall include a detailed description of how the funds proposed to be made available will be used, with a discussion of the United States interests that will be served by such assistance (including, as appropriate, a description of the economic policy reforms that will be promoted by such assistance).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7026/b/4" id="HAF25FD4838AB44A08A35FD791BBDA4BE" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exemption</inline>.—</heading><content>Nonproject sector assistance funds may be exempt from the requirements of paragraph (1) only through the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="HC71C84E790E745BE9FDA3BE50F4BB39B"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">eligibility for assistance</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7027" id="HBC5653370A1F4A5EA779EAB9D5246EF2" changed="added"><num value="7027"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7027. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7027/a" id="HA7B1BCC81A134A88A7FFFB5D6F005C33" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Assistance Through Nongovernmental Organizations</inline>.—</heading><content>Restrictions contained in this or any other Act with respect to assistance for a country shall not be construed to restrict assistance in support of programs of nongovernmental organizations from funds appropriated by this Act to carry out the provisions of chapters 1, 10, 11, and 12 of part I and chapter 4 of part II of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 and from funds appropriated under the heading “<headingText>Assistance for Europe, Eurasia and Central Asia</headingText>”: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That before using the authority of this subsection to furnish assistance in support of programs of nongovernmental organizations, the President shall notify the Committees on Appropriations pursuant to the regular notification procedures, including a description of the program to be assisted, the assistance to be provided, and the reasons for furnishing such assistance: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That nothing in this subsection shall be construed to alter any existing statutory prohibitions against abortion or involuntary sterilizations contained in this or any other Act.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7027/b" id="H90C0986D3D2846D5992415299AC6C9F1" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps"><ref href="/us/pl/480">Public Law 480</ref></inline>.—</heading><content>During fiscal year 2020, restrictions contained in this or any other Act with respect to assistance for a country shall not be construed to restrict assistance under the Food for Peace Act (<ref href="/us/pl/83/480">Public Law 83–480</ref>; <ref href="/us/usc/t7/s1721/etseq">7 U.S.C. 1721 et seq.</ref>): <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That none of the funds appropriated to carry out title I of such Act and made available pursuant to this subsection may be obligated or expended except as provided through the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7027/c" id="H9449BDC6B02743CC894BC041C65E5594" changed="notChanged" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exception</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>This section shall not apply—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7027/c/1" id="H44BDAAA53DF741C2B991138B582D47AC" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>with respect to section 620A of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 or any comparable provision of law prohibiting assistance to countries that support international terrorism; or</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7027/c/2" id="HE272098A12694FAFA7FED402380E064E" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>with respect to section 116 of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 or any comparable provision of law prohibiting assistance to the government of a country that violates internationally recognized human rights.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H3ED593D47C4B481F8E8853D481260723"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">local competition</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7028" id="HDF87C983C7BB4D48888EFCCE8606FAEF" changed="added"><num value="7028"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7028. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7028/a" id="H6BFE857B82D94660A57D23506152A309" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Requirements for Exceptions to Competition for Local Entities</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act that are made available to the United States Agency for International Development may only be made available for limited competitions through local entities if the requirements contained under this section in the report accompanying this Act are met.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7028/b" id="H2ED99F0F47CB4327B6A3DDC27ADCA02F" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Extension of Procurement Authority</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 7077 of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2012 (<ref href="/us/pl/112/74/dI">division I of Public Law 112–74</ref>) shall continue in effect during fiscal year 2020.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H3E1C385DF3134CBB9C5629BA51D1D36A"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">international financial institutions</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7029" id="H94AAC1F98D87474D9054CD97B0928162" changed="added"><num value="7029"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7029. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7029/a" id="HC654F92FB1F84C99971EFD86A0233846" changed="added" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Safeguards</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of the Treasury shall instruct the United States Executive Director of the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development and the International Development Association to vote against any loan, grant, policy, or strategy if such institution has adopted and is implementing any social or environmental safeguard relevant to such loan, grant, policy, or strategy that provides less protection than World Bank safeguards in effect on September 30, 2015.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7029/b" id="H38E72E2A936842F88E3B3E8D5A418EE2" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Compensation</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated under title V of this Act may be made as payment to any international financial institution while the United States executive director to such institution is compensated by the institution at a rate which, together with whatever compensation such executive director receives from the United States, is in excess of the rate provided for an individual occupying a position at level IV of the Executive Schedule under <ref href="/us/usc/t5/s5315">section 5315 of title 5, United States Code</ref>, or while any alternate United States executive director to such institution is compensated by the institution at a rate in excess of the rate provided for an individual occupying a position at level V of the Executive Schedule under <ref href="/us/usc/t5/s5316">section 5316 of title 5, United States Code</ref>.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7029/c" id="H23284E208B3E4AC892FD7233B5BA23DA" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Human Rights</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of the Treasury shall instruct the United States executive director of each international financial institution to promote human rights due diligence and risk management, as appropriate, in connection with any loan, grant, policy, or strategy of such institution in accordance with the criteria specified under this section in the report accompanying this Act.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7029/d" id="HB80C60A0BC664D7BAC9D4732D05418C6" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Fraud and Corruption</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of the Treasury shall instruct the United States executive director of each international financial institution to promote in loan, grant, and other financing agreements improvements in borrowing countries’ financial management and judicial capacity to investigate, prosecute, and punish fraud and corruption.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H46975E776CDF480BA1BC66B9C3519E3E"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">multi-year pledges</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7030" id="H4E136BAC57364F9F9E2942F36B846118" changed="added"><num value="7030"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7030. </inline></num><content class="inline">None of the funds appropriated by this Act may be used to make any pledge for future year funding for any multilateral or bilateral program funded in titles III through VI of this Act unless such pledge meets the requirements enumerated under this section in the report accompanying this Act.</content></section>
<appropriations level="small" id="H08F99B1F96D544039C5B359CF7D304EB"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">financial management and budget transparency</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031" id="H9D4B244E14A840B58764FFA2A0825E3F" changed="added"><num value="7031"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7031. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/a" id="H66B8C96A653E40928522636BE1A2EA5B" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation on Direct Government-to-Government Assistance</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/a/1" id="H996A78C9A1C74D6CA89DF945D1D4D2E6" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Requirements</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act may be made available for direct government-to-government assistance only if the conditions enumerated under this section in the report accompanying this Act are fully met.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/a/2" id="H681649C8A3BD4702BFB3C0CD276C25DB" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Suspension of assistance</inline>.—</heading><content>The Administrator of the United States Agency for International Development or the Secretary of State, as appropriate, shall suspend any direct government-to-government assistance if the Administrator or the Secretary has credible information of material misuse of such assistance, unless the Administrator or the Secretary reports to the Committees on Appropriations that it is in the national interest of the United States to continue such assistance, including a justification, or that such misuse has been appropriately addressed.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/a/3" id="H8C0DBC3B34CD4760AF3B44B9A1E5EAA2" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Debt service payment prohibition</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds made available by this Act may be used by the government of any foreign country for debt service payments owed by any country to any international financial institution.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/b" id="H251F3C901A3D4DEF90A4BA8A1084D639" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">National Budget and Contract Transparency</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/b/1" id="H5916CD3FED014ABFAC36FCCDB7CE0429" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Minimum requirements of fiscal transparency</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of State shall continue to update and strengthen the “minimum requirements of fiscal transparency” for each government receiving assistance appropriated by this Act, as identified in the report required by section 7031(b) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2014 (<ref href="/us/pl/113/76/dK">division K of Public Law 113–76</ref>).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/b/2" id="HA451146E2FB344D193C057439D0A3DFB" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Determination and report</inline>.—</heading><content>For each government identified pursuant to paragraph (1), the Secretary of State, not later than 180 days after enactment of this Act, shall make or update any determination of “significant progress” or “no significant progress” in meeting the minimum requirements of fiscal transparency, and make such determinations publicly available in an annual “Fiscal Transparency Report” to be posted on the Department of State website.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/b/3" id="HA7DF7C85972B44D2827BA17045986791" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Assistance</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated under title III and under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” in title IV of this Act shall be made available for programs and activities to assist governments identified pursuant to paragraph (1) to improve budget transparency and to support civil society organizations in such countries that promote budget transparency.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/c" id="H9A3487CE10854EF0894A8DD74C61CFAF" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Anti-Kleptocracy and Human Rights</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/c/1" id="H26712E74AFB44DDCBA70077969E0C325" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Ineligibility</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/c/1/A" id="H070E382956D545998C45C728AE328730" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>Officials of foreign governments and their immediate family members about whom the Secretary of State has credible information have been involved in significant corruption, including corruption related to the extraction of natural resources, or a gross violation of human rights shall be ineligible for entry into the United States.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/c/1/B" id="HC0AB0BCCB1664F88A8AD46158EAA5069" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>The Secretary shall also publicly or privately designate or identify officials of foreign governments and their immediate family members about whom the Secretary has such credible information without regard to whether the individual has applied for a visa.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/c/2" id="H7167F8F647984BDFAF67CAA1F26EB91A" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exception</inline>.—</heading><content>Individuals shall not be ineligible if entry into the United States would further important United States law enforcement objectives or is necessary to permit the United States to fulfill its obligations under the United Nations Headquarters Agreement: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That nothing in paragraph (1) shall be construed to derogate from United States Government obligations under applicable international agreements.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/c/3" id="H8EADFE0EBD9E4A60B073C186BD73A7D8" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary may waive the application of paragraph (1) if the Secretary determines that the waiver would serve a compelling national interest or that the circumstances which caused the individual to be ineligible have changed sufficiently.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7031/d" id="HE35A52D1D6184F598BEB260274144830" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Foreign Assistance Website</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under titles I and II, and funds made available for any independent agency in title III, as appropriate, shall be made available to support the provision of additional information on United States Government foreign assistance on the Department of State foreign assistance website: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That all Federal agencies funded under this Act shall provide such information on foreign assistance, upon request, to the Department of State.</proviso></content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H2E513DB7F2E045ECBFDF8B121F843A09"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">democracy programs</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7032" id="H1F957BCDB462468BA94E99616F280F81" changed="added"><num value="7032"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7032. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7032/a" id="HF151D804C0FE415794B6C7DB92FDFC7E" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Funding</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Development Assistance”, “Economic Support Fund”, “Democracy Fund”, “Assistance for Europe, Eurasia and Central Asia”, and “International Narcotics Control and Law Enforcement”, not less than $2,400,000,000 shall be made available for democracy programs.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7032/b" id="H9A9F62173CBF4D4A941A89EECD278BFB" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authorities</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7032/b/1" id="H4796B6080FA74101B7E96B0E5A793782" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>Funds made available by this Act for democracy programs pursuant to subsection (a) and under the heading “<headingText>National Endowment for Democracy</headingText>” may be made available notwithstanding any other provision of law, and with regard to the National Endowment for Democracy (NED), any regulation.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7032/b/2" id="H6C9A5C1362E24B08A1254D8B5F1BCBFF" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>Funds made available by this Act for the NED are made available pursuant to the authority of the National Endowment for Democracy Act (<ref href="/us/pl/98/164/tV">title V of Public Law 98–164</ref>), including all decisions regarding the selection of beneficiaries.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7032/c" id="H3C64B3FAC19A47C6BC531D74D1B2782F" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definition of Democracy Programs</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of funds appropriated by this Act, the term “<term>democracy programs</term>” means programs that support good governance, credible and competitive elections, freedom of expression, association, assembly, and religion, human rights, labor rights, independent media, and the rule of law, and that otherwise strengthen the capacity of democratic political parties, governments, nongovernmental organizations and institutions, and citizens to support the development of democratic states and institutions that are responsive and accountable to citizens.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7032/d" id="H7C18F28E5DA34EA1B6DDDBADADDB2D87" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Program Prioritization</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds made available pursuant to this section that are made available for programs to strengthen government institutions shall be prioritized for those institutions that demonstrate a commitment to democracy and the rule of law.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7032/e" id="H4F84AD8ED5CA4D1A99318012AD3D1C23" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Restriction on Prior Approval</inline>.—</heading><content>With respect to the provision of assistance for democracy programs in this Act, the organizations implementing such assistance, the specific nature of that assistance, and the participants in such programs shall not be subject to the prior approval by the government of any foreign country.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7032/f" id="H454A3ADA40E64607836AE7541C151608" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Continuation of Current Practices</inline>.—</heading><content>The United States Agency for International Development shall continue to implement civil society and political competition and consensus building programs abroad with funds appropriated by this Act in a manner that recognizes the unique benefits of grants and cooperative agreements in implementing such programs.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7032/g" id="HC7E2F34898324E1F8BF60515E993DABE" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="g">(g) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Informing the National Endowment for Democracy</inline>.—</heading><content>The Assistant Secretary for Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor, Department of State, and the Assistant Administrator for Democracy, Conflict, and Humanitarian Assistance, USAID, shall regularly inform the National Endowment for Democracy of democracy programs that are planned and supported by funds made available by this Act and prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7032/h" id="H170A2BA9A3B1479F9BD1A6DDAE8CF43C" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="h">(h) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Protection of Civil Society Activists and Journalists</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under title III shall be made available to support and protect civil society activists and journalists who have been threatened, harassed, or attacked, consistent with the action plan submitted pursuant to, and on the same terms and conditions of, section 7032(i) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2018 (<ref href="/us/pl/115/141/dK">division K of Public Law 115–141</ref>).</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H9F87176C0FAD49DA9207AA242DD6FA9A"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">international religious freedom</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7033" id="H583B0D25F0804CF08C389DE5E27EB431" changed="added"><num value="7033"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7033. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7033/a" id="H25D7AE48394448819B62A2933ACD3425" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">International Religious Freedom Office and Special Envoy to Promote Religious Freedom</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Diplomatic Programs</headingText>” shall be made available for the Office of International Religious Freedom, Bureau of Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor, Department of State, and the Special Envoy to Promote Religious Freedom of Religious Minorities in the Near East and South Central Asia, as authorized in the Near East and South Central Asia Religious Freedom Act of 2014 (<ref href="/us/pl/113/161">Public Law 113–161</ref>), including for support staff at not less than the amounts specified for such offices in the table under such heading in the report accompanying this Act.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7033/b" id="HF008D3AEC1E44F308D4494F214D2CE78" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Assistance</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Democracy Fund”, “Economic Support Fund”, and “International Broadcasting Operations” shall be made available for international religious freedom programs and funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “International Disaster Assistance” and “Migration and Refugee Assistance” shall be made available for humanitarian assistance for vulnerable and persecuted religious minorities.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7033/c" id="HABEE8843318245E0B13CD9D92BABD637" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authority</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act and prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” may be made available notwithstanding any other provision of law for assistance for ethnic and religious minorities in Iraq and Syria.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H713A67C6C7B5487E996D0973729D4B9C"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">special provisions</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034" id="H21ED9F2AABF64FDDAE2DC008819C3B4F" changed="added"><num value="7034"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7034. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/a" id="HA1A4CD5599274BB0B2EAEFCEAC6BCBB0" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Victims of War, Displaced Children, and Displaced Burmese</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated in titles III and VI of this Act that are made available for victims of war, displaced children, displaced Burmese, and to combat trafficking in persons and assist victims of such trafficking, may be made available notwithstanding any other provision of law.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/b" id="H15E0E33674E742C09F7E1535FFD64982" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Atrocities Prevention</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Economic Support Fund” and “International Narcotics Control and Law Enforcement”, not less than $5,000,000 shall be made available for programs to prevent atrocities, including to implement recommendations of the Atrocities Prevention Board, or any successor entity.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/c" id="HB429FDBDE9E74FD292660497512E8A45" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">World Food Programme</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds managed by the Bureau for Democracy, Conflict, and Humanitarian Assistance, or any successor humanitarian assistance bureau, of the United States Agency for International Development, from this or any other Act, may be made available as a general contribution to the World Food Programme, notwithstanding any other provision of law.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/d" id="H84688263E1504DC48EE02AFE40BDEA16" changed="notChanged" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Directives and Authorities</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/d/1" id="H63A41DD8CA20457EB10393B17FF371A9" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Research and training</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Assistance for Europe, Eurasia and Central Asia</headingText>” shall be made available to carry out the Program for Research and Training on Eastern Europe and the Independent States of the Former Soviet Union as authorized by the Soviet-Eastern European Research and Training Act of 1983 (<ref href="/us/usc/t22/s4501/etseq">22 U.S.C. 4501 et seq.</ref>).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/d/2" id="HA053AC1C350F47998FF00EF2EA03E93A" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Additional authorities</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the amounts made available by title I of this Act under the heading “<headingText>Diplomatic Programs</headingText>”, up to $500,000 may be made available for grants pursuant to section 504 of the Foreign Relations Authorization Act, Fiscal Year 1979 (<ref href="/us/usc/t22/s2656d">22 U.S.C. 2656d</ref>), including to facilitate collaboration with indigenous communities, and up to $1,000,000 may be made available for grants to carry out the activities of the Cultural Antiquities Task Force.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/d/3" id="H1B1281739EB54E6981B2161F4AD8D505" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Innovation</inline>.—</heading><content>The USAID Administrator may use funds appropriated by this Act under title III to make innovation incentive awards: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That each individual award may not exceed $100,000: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That no more than 15 such awards may be made during fiscal year 2020.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/d/4" id="HF0F2EF62106349549FD5F3988D64F910" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exchange visitor program</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds made available by this Act may be used to modify the Exchange Visitor Program administered by the Department of State to implement the Mutual Educational and Cultural Exchange Act of 1961, as amended, (<ref href="/us/pl/87/256">Public Law 87–256</ref>; <ref href="/us/usc/t22/s2451/etseq">22 U.S.C. 2451 et seq.</ref>), except through the formal rulemaking process pursuant to the Administrative Procedure Act and notwithstanding the exceptions to such rulemaking process in such Act: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That funds made available for such purpose shall only be made available after consultation with, and subject to the regular notification procedures of, the Committees on Appropriations, regarding how any proposed modification would affect the public diplomacy goals of, and the estimated economic impact on, the United States.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/d/5" id="H44987A22B6F645C490D76560B65D9025" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Private sector partnerships</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Development Assistance” and “Economic Support Fund” that are made available for private sector partnerships, up to $50,000,000 may remain available until September 30, 2022: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That funds made available pursuant to this paragraph may only be made available following prior consultation with the appropriate congressional committees, and the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/d/6" id="H1BACADB6B344464E964215C64EC89CC3" class="indent1"><num value="6">(6) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Vietnam education foundation</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 207(c) of the Vietnam Education Foundation Act of 2000 (<ref href="/us/stat/114/2763A–257">114 Stat. 2763A–257</ref>; <ref href="/us/usc/t22/s2452">22 U.S.C. 2452</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="add">adding</amendingAction> a new paragraph as follows:
<quotedContent styleType="OLC" id="HE7F9C1153F6248C38A79D2CC78A4F445">
<paragraph id="H3B0EB75624CA4BEBB1EB1CCEE7928B27" class="indent1"><num value="4">“(4) </num><content>On October 1, 2019, any remaining unobligated balances of funds made available under the heading ‘<headingText>Vietnam Education Foundation—Vietnam Debt Repayment Fund</headingText>’ that are not necessary for liquidating the final liabilities of the Vietnam Education Foundation shall be available for grants authorized by section 211 of this Act.”</content></paragraph></quotedContent><inline role="after-quoted-block">.</inline></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/e" id="HAB4D2B552F4B45B3A1048AE84F9893DB" changed="notChanged" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Partner Vetting</inline>.—</heading><content>Prior to initiating a partner vetting program, or making significant changes to the scope of an existing partner vetting program, the Secretary of State and USAID Administrator, as appropriate, shall consult with the Committees on Appropriations.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/f" id="HE79E0290D82846C1B2AB8DC4CD551261" changed="notChanged" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Contingencies</inline>.—</heading><content>During fiscal year 2020, the President may use up to $200,000,000 under the authority of section 451 of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, notwithstanding any other provision of law.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/g" id="H9A76CD5296754C9D9702CA5DEC0A30E3" changed="notChanged" class="indent0"><num value="g">(g) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Transfer of Funds for Extraordinary Protection</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of State may transfer to, and merge with, funds under the heading “<headingText>Protection of Foreign Missions and Officials</headingText>” unobligated balances of expired funds appropriated under the heading “<headingText>Diplomatic Programs</headingText>” for fiscal year 2020, except for funds designated for Overseas Contingency Operations/Global War on Terrorism pursuant to section 251(b)(2)(A)(ii) of the Balanced Budget and Emergency Deficit Control Act of 1985, at no later than the end of the fifth fiscal year after the last fiscal year for which such funds are available for the purposes for which appropriated: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That not more than $50,000,000 may be transferred.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/h" id="H1D66A757C440466E9B6732A8F43D4C2A" changed="notChanged" class="indent0"><num value="h">(h) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Protections and Remedies for Employees of Diplomatic Missions and International Organizations</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 7034(k) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2015 (<ref href="/us/pl/113/235/dJ">division J of Public Law 113–235</ref>) shall continue in effect during fiscal year 2020.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/i" id="H9CD0773115F045A69D9639222F7E87A0" changed="notChanged" class="indent0"><num value="i">(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Extension of Authorities</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/i/1" id="H8B31043E5B07469B87179EB6B85ABC81" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Passport fees</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 1(b)(2) of the Passport Act of June 4, 1920 (<ref href="/us/usc/t22/s214/b/2">22 U.S.C. 214(b)(2)</ref>) shall be applied by substituting “September 30, 2020” for “September 30, 2010”.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/i/2" id="H7653CE02545145AE925270C856FE64FA" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Incentives for critical posts</inline>.—</heading><content>The authority contained in section 1115(d) of the Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2009 (<ref href="/us/pl/111/32">Public Law 111–32</ref>) shall remain in effect through September 30, 2020.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/i/3" id="H303621F316534BEF99051F7D3FEA3EE7" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">USAID civil service annuitant waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 625(j)(1) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 (<ref href="/us/usc/t22/s2385/j/1">22 U.S.C. 2385(j)(1)</ref>) shall be applied by substituting “September 30, 2020” for “October 1, 2010” in subparagraph (B).</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/i/4" id="H6D73E336F1EB4A0F929F6F87D0685C61" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Overseas pay comparability</inline>.—</heading><content>The authority provided by section 1113 of the Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2009 (<ref href="/us/pl/111/32">Public Law 111–32</ref>) shall remain in effect through September 30, 2020: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the exercise of the authority of section 1113 of such Act, as carried forward by this Act, shall be subject to prior consultation with the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></paragraph>

<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/i/6" id="H859528A28AD5455EB46409FC4102BA75" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="6">(6) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Inspector general annuitant waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>The authorities provided in section 1015(b) of the Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2010 (<ref href="/us/pl/111/212">Public Law 111–212</ref>) shall remain in effect through September 30, 2020.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/i/7" id="H32C5FEAFECF046A8B3FDD11D2AC5D348" changed="notChanged" class="indent1"><num value="7">(7) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Accountability review boards</inline>.—</heading><content>The authority provided by section 301(a)(3) of the Omnibus Diplomatic Security and Antiterrorism Act of 1986 (<ref href="/us/usc/t22/s4831/a/3">22 U.S.C. 4831(a)(3)</ref>) shall remain in effect for facilities in Afghanistan through September 30, 2020, except that the notification and reporting requirements contained in such section shall include the Committees on Appropriations.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/i/8" id="H896AD6D3B2874982BF558D7A8AD6E7D4" changed="notChanged" class="indent1"><num value="8">(8) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special inspector general for afghanistan reconstruction competitive status</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding any other provision of law, any employee of the Special Inspector General for Afghanistan Reconstruction (SIGAR) who completes at least 12 months of continuous service after the date of enactment of this Act or who is employed on the date on which SIGAR terminates, whichever occurs first, shall acquire competitive status for appointment to any position in the competitive service for which the employee possesses the required qualifications.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/i/9" id="HD9F2B3DE34B44CAEA23E8F8AF6396BFD" changed="notChanged" class="indent1"><num value="9">(9) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Transfer of balances</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 7081(h) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2017 (<ref href="/us/pl/115/31/dJ">division J of Public Law 115–31</ref>) shall continue in effect during fiscal year 2020.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/i/10" id="HD2D17C46B3144A5AA374B50786606809" changed="notChanged" class="indent1"><num value="10">(10) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Department of state inspector general waiver authority</inline>.—</heading><content>The Inspector General of the Department of State may waive the provisions of subsections (a) through (d) of section 824 of the Foreign Service Act of 1980 (<ref href="/us/usc/t22/s4064">22 U.S.C. 4064</ref>) on a case-by-case basis for an annuitant reemployed by the Inspector General on a temporary basis, subject to the same constraints and in the same manner by which the Secretary of State may exercise such waiver authority pursuant to subsection (g) of such section.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/j" id="H60BE6395FCEC4007A4E8D097B5F21023" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="j">(j) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">HIV/AIDS Working Capital Fund</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds available in the HIV/AIDS Working Capital Fund established pursuant to section 525(b)(1) of the Foreign Operations, Export Financing, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2005 (<ref href="/us/pl/108/447">Public Law 108–447</ref>) may be made available for pharmaceuticals and other products for other global health and child survival activities to the same extent as HIV/AIDS pharmaceuticals and other products, subject to the terms and conditions in such section: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the authority in section 525(b)(5) of the Foreign Operations, Export Financing, and Related Programs Appropriation Act, 2005 (<ref href="/us/pl/108/447">Public Law 108–447</ref>) shall be exercised by the Assistant Administrator for Global Health, USAID, with respect to funds deposited for such non-HIV/AIDS pharmaceuticals and other products, and shall be subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/k" id="H14BE8688CEF5416AB1AD37E6DEF99562" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="k">(k) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Loans, Consultation, and Notification</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/k/1" id="HC808F78963AA4001BF23F8ABBBDB6B26" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Loan guarantees</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated under the headings “Economic Support Fund” and “Assistance for Europe, Eurasia and Central Asia” by this Act and prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs may be made available for the costs, as defined in section 502 of the Congressional Budget Act of 1974, of loan guarantees for Egypt, Jordan, Tunisia, and Ukraine, which are authorized to be provided: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That amounts made available under this paragraph for the costs of such guarantees shall not be considered assistance for the purposes of provisions of law limiting assistance to a country.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/k/2" id="HB38A8FE0BEE64D6FA01FCCCEF0F155D5" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Designation requirement</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds made available pursuant to paragraph (1) from prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs that were previously designated by the Congress for Overseas Contingency Operations/Global War on Terrorism pursuant to section 251(b)(2)(A)(ii) of the Balanced Budget and Emergency Deficit Control Act of 1985 are designated by the Congress for Overseas Contingency Operations/Global War on Terrorism pursuant to section 251(b)(2)(A)(ii) of such Act.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/k/3" id="H9F968E6F7FC04A368EBE0D955ECB2A3A" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Consultation and notification</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds made available pursuant to the authorities of this subsection shall be subject to prior consultation with the appropriate congressional committees, and subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/l" id="H2F2B1F384329487AAE1763DCF1FA25DA" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="l">(l) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Local Works</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/l/1" id="H860F500A3CE64557BD3D58F3B462FD16" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Development Assistance” and “Economic Support Fund”, not less than $50,000,000 shall be made available for Local Works pursuant to section 7080 of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2015 (<ref href="/us/pl/113/235/dJ">division J of Public Law 113–235</ref>), which may remain available until September 30, 2024.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/l/2" id="H0BC01C523F5942E4B0002E637167CF29" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>For the purposes of section 7080 of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2015 (<ref href="/us/pl/113/235/dJ">division J of Public Law 113–235</ref>), “eligible entities” shall be defined as small local, international, and United States-based nongovernmental organizations, educational institutions, and other small entities that have received less than a total of $5,000,000 from USAID over the previous 5 fiscal years: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That departments or centers of such educational institutions may be considered individually in determining such eligibility.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/m" id="H370E2A41C5334434927F7A79BA38E0AE" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="m">(m) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Definitions</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/m/1" id="H9F25D8595F034195A00BBC4AE7526372" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Appropriate congressional committees</inline>.—</heading><content>Unless otherwise defined in this Act, for purposes of this Act the term “<term>appropriate congressional committees</term>” means the Committees on Appropriations and Foreign Relations of the Senate and the Committees on Appropriations and Foreign Affairs of the House of Representatives.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/m/2" id="H79A8C24D32784F7092BE98DBF4DE0790" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Funds appropriated by this act and prior acts</inline>.—</heading><content>Unless otherwise defined in this Act, for purposes of this Act the term “<term>funds appropriated by this Act and prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs</term>” means funds that remain available for obligation, and have not expired.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/m/3" id="H253DB3781EBE4C9AB5AB632F8281447F" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">International financial institutions</inline>.—</heading><content>In this Act “international financial institutions” means the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the International Development Association, the International Finance Corporation, the Inter-American Development Bank, the International Monetary Fund, the International Fund for Agricultural Development, the Asian Development Fund, the Inter-American Investment Corporation, the North American Development Bank, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the African Development Bank, the African Development Fund, and the Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/m/4" id="HCEE4005EDE0A4855B48CE9597359E946" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Paris agreement</inline>.—</heading><content>In this Act, the term “<term>Paris Agreement</term>” means the decision by the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change’s 21st Conference of Parties in Paris, France, adopted December 12, 2015.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/m/5" id="HF563A154CEEF45898B2C86A4499BA462" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Southern kordofan reference</inline>.—</heading><content>Any reference to Southern Kordofan in this or any other Act making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs shall for fiscal year 2020, and each fiscal year thereafter, be deemed to include portions of Western Kordofan that were previously part of Southern Kordofan prior to the 2013 division of Southern Kordofan.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/m/6" id="H8FEDE5A3386045D8A54AB7F125F309AD" class="indent1"><num value="6">(6) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">USAID</inline>.—</heading><content>In this Act, the term “<term>USAID</term>” means the United States Agency for International Development.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph role="definitions" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/m/7" id="H3F0CCA230A45425092F3269D7D8D8E9F" class="indent1"><num value="7">(7) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Spend plan</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>In this Act, the term “<term>spend plan</term>” means a plan for the uses of funds appropriated for a particular entity, country, program, purpose, or account and which shall include, at a minimum, a description of—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/m/7/A" id="HD473E66696884D59BDAF135EF791C06C" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>realistic and sustainable goals, criteria for measuring progress, and a timeline for achieving such goals;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/m/7/B" id="H726B8AEFB41146ED8E4BAFDD20E42BC6" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>amounts and sources of funds by account;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/m/7/C" id="H07E17FB435054EA4BADC2CF0BF4646EF" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>how such funds will complement other ongoing or planned programs; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7034/m/7/D" id="H1F9FC412EC0947DC94375B147BA11FD4" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>implementing partners, to the maximum extent practicable.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="HADBFFCC7C45546D091FD1D095F0BCF66"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">law enforcement and security</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035" id="H8F3E9706853F435284ABC4D5454D736B" changed="added"><num value="7035"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7035. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/a" id="H45B83099FE1443C79E789E0CDF2563BD" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Assistance</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/a/1" id="H2DEF4EB408F141CE88DCA5178E990DA1" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Community-based police assistance</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds made available under titles III and IV of this Act to carry out the provisions of chapter 1 of part I and chapters 4 and 6 of part II of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, may be used, notwithstanding section 660 of that Act, to enhance the effectiveness and accountability of civilian police authority through training and technical assistance in human rights, the rule of law, anti-corruption, strategic planning, and through assistance to foster civilian police roles that support democratic governance, including assistance for programs to prevent conflict, respond to disasters, address gender-based violence, and foster improved police relations with the communities they serve.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/a/2" id="HF078D3A8DC9746A1A941080B1C330ED0" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Counterterrorism partnerships fund</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the heading Nonproliferation, Anti-terrorism, Demining and Related Programs shall be made available for the Counterterrorism Partnerships Fund for programs in areas liberated from, under the influence of, or adversely affected by, the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria or other terrorist organizations: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such areas shall include the Kurdistan Region of Iraq: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That prior to the obligation of funds made available pursuant to this paragraph, the Secretary of State shall take all practicable steps to ensure that mechanisms are in place for monitoring, oversight, and control of such funds: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That funds made available pursuant to this paragraph shall be subject to prior consultation with the appropriate congressional committees, and the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/b" id="HE001A02E96CB47F6BAA7EAE765229E0A" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authorities</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/b/1" id="HCDC746E174F841A8B88AB15A3029AF09" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reconstituting civilian police authority</inline>.—</heading><content>In providing assistance with funds appropriated by this Act under section 660(b)(6) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, support for a nation emerging from instability may be deemed to mean support for regional, district, municipal, or other sub-national entity emerging from instability, as well as a nation emerging from instability.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/b/2" id="HCAB9FADB23CE4F36BB0F83FBD3EEE110" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Disarmament, demobilization, and reintegration</inline>.—</heading><content>Section 7034(d) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2015 (<ref href="/us/pl/113/235/dJ">division J of Public Law 113–235</ref>) shall continue in effect during fiscal year 2020.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/b/3" id="H0AA1774B3D1C4CE5885533376D0D88A9" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">International prison conditions</inline>.—</heading><content> Funds appropriated by this Act shall be made available for assistance to eliminate inhumane conditions in foreign prisons and other detention facilities, notwithstanding section 660 of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the Secretary of State and the USAID Administrator shall consult with the Committees on Appropriations on the proposed uses of such funds prior to obligation and not later than 60 days after enactment of this Act.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/b/4" id="H3CD4DD6A00D74DB3A180A536EFB4BCAC" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Extension of war reserves stockpile authority</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/b/4/A" id="H5F3258661B8445C2AD767EBAD98540B3" changed="added" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>Section 12001(d) of the Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2005 (<ref href="/us/pl/108/287">Public Law 108–287</ref>; <ref href="/us/stat/118/1011">118 Stat. 1011</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> “<quotedText>of this section</quotedText>” and all that follows through the period at the end and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> “<quotedText>of this section after September 30, 2021.</quotedText>”.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/b/4/B" id="H0F75237DF3EA449FB2F2D4AD4A4780CC" changed="notChanged" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>Section 514(b)(2)(A) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 (<ref href="/us/usc/t22/s2321h/b/2/A">22 U.S.C. 2321h(b)(2)(A)</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> “<quotedText>and 2020</quotedText>” and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> “<quotedText>2020, and 2021</quotedText>”.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/b/5" id="HA4679F45E37941ACBEE959D883E9C680" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Commercial leasing of defense articles</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding any other provision of law, and subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations, the authority of section 23(a) of the Arms Export Control Act may be used to provide financing to Israel, Egypt, the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO), and major non-NATO allies for the procurement by leasing (including leasing with an option to purchase) of defense articles from United States commercial suppliers, not including Major Defense Equipment (other than helicopters and other types of aircraft having possible civilian application), if the President determines that there are compelling foreign policy or national security reasons for those defense articles being provided by commercial lease rather than by government-to-government sale under such Act.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/b/6" id="H181235E2B6214C4894F5F91640E3C0EC" class="indent1"><num value="6">(6) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Special defense acquisition fund</inline>.—</heading><content>Not to exceed $900,000,000 may be obligated pursuant to section 51(c)(2) of the Arms Export Control Act for the purposes of the Special Defense Acquisition Fund (the Fund), to remain available for obligation until September 30, 2022: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the provision of defense articles and defense services to foreign countries or international organizations from the Fund shall be subject to the concurrence of the Secretary of State.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/c" id="H65B9969F24274900981FD4762A1BA84B" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitations</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/c/1" id="HB00BCC1B686148C8AABE79468859281F" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Child soldiers</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act should not be used to support any military training or operations that include child soldiers.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/c/2" id="H783EF350DE8342E7879686677E504976" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Landmines and cluster munitions</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/c/2/A" id="HC8BBD637E41F4C699C058A3E42611F45" changed="added" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Landmines</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding any other provision of law, demining equipment available to the United States Agency for International Development and the Department of State and used in support of the clearance of landmines and unexploded ordnance for humanitarian purposes may be disposed of on a grant basis in foreign countries, subject to such terms and conditions as the Secretary of State may prescribe.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/c/2/B" id="H83813E8235E94819944438307AA2F062" changed="notChanged" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Cluster munitions</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>No military assistance shall be furnished for cluster munitions, no defense export license for cluster munitions may be issued, and no cluster munitions or cluster munitions technology shall be sold or transferred, unless—</chapeau>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/c/2/B/i" id="HF9B27BEBF01641C69D60F050B741F636" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>the submunitions of the cluster munitions, after arming, do not result in more than 1 percent unexploded ordnance across the range of intended operational environments, and the agreement applicable to the assistance, transfer, or sale of such cluster munitions or cluster munitions technology specifies that the cluster munitions will only be used against clearly defined military targets and will not be used where civilians are known to be present or in areas normally inhabited by civilians; or</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/c/2/B/ii" id="HBA2BFD5FD3BB452F83AD4DC3ABBA9055" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>such assistance, license, sale, or transfer is for the purpose of demilitarizing or permanently disposing of such cluster munitions.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/c/3" id="HAC95F585D18947EA82BB0799AC491E3D" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Crowd control items</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act should not be used for tear gas, small arms, light weapons, ammunition, or other items for crowd control purposes for foreign security forces that use excessive force to repress peaceful expression, association, or assembly in countries that the Secretary of State determines are undemocratic or are undergoing democratic transitions.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/d" id="HF15F321E91204355B934F135757B0BCB" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reports</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/d/1" id="H39D79E4FADB84A36AB7AA5EE26893249" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Security assistance report</inline>.—</heading><content>Not later than 120 days after enactment of this Act, the Secretary of State shall submit to the Committees on Appropriations a report on funds obligated and expended during fiscal year 2019, by country and purpose of assistance, under the headings “Peacekeeping Operations”, “International Military Education and Training”, and “Foreign Military Financing Program”.</content></paragraph>
