<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7035/d/2" id="H4F876D9044EC4169B161D2E1E0162A0B" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Quarterly status report</inline>.—</heading><content>Following the submission of the quarterly report required by <ref href="/us/pl/90/629/s36">section 36 of Public Law 90–629</ref> (<ref href="/us/usc/t22/s2776">22 U.S.C. 2776</ref>), the Secretary of State, in coordination with the Secretary of Defense, shall submit to the Committees on Appropriations a status report that contains the information described under the heading “<headingText>Foreign Military Financing Program</headingText>” in the report accompanying this Act.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" id="HC7BBFE3BA35940ED83E1B88829681600"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">enterprise funds</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7036" id="H1664E0E28D6A43289FA896AC4749A4DA"><num value="7036"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7036. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7036/a" id="H641FFFBBE51C4F03864F7CD4B8DD65FC" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notification</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds made available under titles III through VI of this Act may be made available for Enterprise Funds unless the appropriate congressional committees are notified at least 15 days in advance.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7036/b" id="HDF3CE16D484D494293885AD1E959B092" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Distribution of Assets Plan</inline>.—</heading><content>Prior to the distribution of any assets resulting from any liquidation, dissolution, or winding up of an Enterprise Fund, in whole or in part, the President shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees a plan for the distribution of the assets of the Enterprise Fund.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7036/c" id="H2F7D94C356484FF98757062708DC7972" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Transition or Operating Plan</inline>.—</heading><content>Prior to a transition to and operation of any private equity fund or other parallel investment fund under an existing Enterprise Fund, the President shall submit such transition or operating plan to the appropriate congressional committees.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" id="HF51B47E82ED34C1DB863B217FA99B41F"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">war crimes tribunals</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7037" id="HCF5715E1C5CC470BA1062B97C77281EE"><num value="7037"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7037. </inline></num><content class="inline">If the President determines that doing so will contribute to a just resolution of charges regarding genocide or other violations of international humanitarian law, the President may direct a drawdown pursuant to section 552(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 of up to $30,000,000 of commodities and services for the United Nations War Crimes Tribunal established with regard to the former Yugoslavia by the United Nations Security Council or such other tribunals or commissions as the Council may establish or authorize to deal with such violations, without regard to the ceiling limitation contained in paragraph (2) thereof: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the determination required under this section shall be in lieu of any determinations otherwise required under section 552(c): </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That funds made available pursuant to this section shall be made available subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="HD085F60F750042CF985CA4F6E0360E74"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">palestinian statehood</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038" id="H602CE04F5823471BAA8CF20F9CFA985B" changed="added"><num value="7038"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7038. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/a" id="HF1331BFDA3DD439DA617A591AADBCD2A" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation on Assistance</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>None of the funds appropriated under titles III through VI of this Act may be provided to support a Palestinian state unless the Secretary of State determines and certifies to the appropriate congressional committees that—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/a/1" id="HB1762815CDEF41C293DBC94E2505AE3C" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><chapeau>the governing entity of a new Palestinian state—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/a/1/A" id="HE309E2E2B64B44C48F97635B38D1975F" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>has demonstrated a firm commitment to peaceful co-existence with the State of Israel; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/a/1/B" id="HE7875815688B4F5B938993EA2D026555" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>is taking appropriate measures to counter terrorism and terrorist financing in the West Bank and Gaza, including the dismantling of terrorist infrastructures, and is cooperating with appropriate Israeli and other appropriate security organizations; and</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/a/2" id="H981C2E82BB034ABC8DE60CDC315AB31C" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><chapeau>the Palestinian Authority (or the governing entity of a new Palestinian state) is working with other countries in the region to vigorously pursue efforts to establish a just, lasting, and comprehensive peace in the Middle East that will enable Israel and an independent Palestinian state to exist within the context of full and normal relationships, which should include—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/a/2/A" id="H28C345F38615425E81195ED1DDE34680" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>termination of all claims or states of belligerency;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/a/2/B" id="HAB6731018D6047ECBC676005154C47EF" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>respect for and acknowledgment of the sovereignty, territorial integrity, and political independence of every state in the area through measures including the establishment of demilitarized zones;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/a/2/C" id="H73A72D58E29441C0B79443EAF11ACF1F" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>their right to live in peace within secure and recognized boundaries free from threats or acts of force;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/a/2/D" id="HB6C772958A8E4D22ABDB200E5F77C950" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>freedom of navigation through international waterways in the area; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/a/2/E" id="H1F6B4FA52AFE43E88D4234CAC7A17F7B" class="indent2"><num value="E">(E) </num><content>a framework for achieving a just settlement of the refugee problem.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/a/3" id="H325AEC798CA142BBB6E433E036BB2644" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>the governing entity has enacted a constitution assuring the rule of law, an independent judiciary, and respect for human rights for its citizens, and should enact other laws and regulations assuring transparent and accountable governance.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/b" id="HD6C07F07292F4646BD344DC9CEEF8DA1" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>The President may waive subsection (a) if the President determines that it is important to the national security interest of the United States to do so.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7038/c" id="H9172D48006F34DD593C978B1C655F15E" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exemption</inline>.—</heading><content>The restriction in subsection (a) shall not apply to assistance intended to help reform the Palestinian Authority and affiliated institutions, or the governing entity, in order to help meet the requirements of subsection (a), consistent with the provisions of section 7039 of this Act (“Limitation on Assistance for the Palestinian Authority”).</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H0591C4E522FC4402AC4ED24145A87323"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">limitation on assistance for the palestinian authority</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039" id="HF497CE29813B4365BABAB090832CD028" changed="added"><num value="7039"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7039. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/a" id="H91AACF0FC9E54DA6BDAF0600FC4C285C" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition of Funds</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act to carry out the provisions of chapter 4 of part II of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 may be obligated or expended with respect to providing funds to the Palestinian Authority.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/b" id="HB4AFCA06D00E4DCC83758E3805BF83C9" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>The prohibition included in subsection (a) shall not apply if the President certifies in writing to the Speaker of the House of Representatives, the President pro tempore of the Senate, and the Committees on Appropriations that waiving such prohibition is important to the national security interest of the United States.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/c" id="H6D6DEE41A39C41F4A326EBC06A83CA47" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Period of Application of Waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>Any waiver pursuant to subsection (b) shall be effective for no more than a period of 6 months at a time and shall not apply beyond 12 months after the enactment of this Act.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/d" id="HCFB9BC9FE5F4494DBDC91EF4B41FB3FE" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Report</inline>.—</heading><content>Whenever the waiver authority pursuant to subsection (b) is exercised, the President shall submit a report to the Committees on Appropriations detailing the justification for the waiver, the purposes for which the funds will be spent, and the accounting procedures in place to ensure that the funds are properly disbursed: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the report shall also detail the steps the Palestinian Authority has taken to arrest terrorists, confiscate weapons and dismantle the terrorist infrastructure, and facilitate the settlement of terrorism-related claims of nationals of the United States.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/e" id="H6FD720F0FC014AF5BE0310D45AC97341" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Certification</inline>.—</heading><content>If the President exercises the waiver authority under subsection (b), the Secretary of State must certify and report to the Committees on Appropriations prior to the obligation of funds that the Palestinian Authority has established a single treasury account for all Palestinian Authority financing and all financing mechanisms flow through this account, no parallel financing mechanisms exist outside of the Palestinian Authority treasury account, and there is a single comprehensive civil service roster and payroll, and the Palestinian Authority is acting to counter incitement of violence against Israelis and is supporting activities aimed at promoting peace, coexistence, and security cooperation with Israel.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/f" id="H136D71481AE948D09DBBA4AA002D80B6" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition to Hamas and the Palestine Liberation Organization</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/f/1" id="H8A9AF9B742EE4E51A055CAA2C8F9806C" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>None of the funds appropriated under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” in this Act may be obligated for salaries of personnel of the Palestinian Authority located in Gaza or may be obligated or expended for assistance to Hamas or any entity effectively controlled by Hamas, any power-sharing government of which Hamas is a member, or that results from an agreement with Hamas and over which Hamas exercises undue influence.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/f/2" id="HE8D7935C99AE489E9A5F3C0FBDD0F1FD" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>Notwithstanding the limitation of paragraph (1), assistance may be provided to a power-sharing government only if the President certifies and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that such government, including all of its ministers or such equivalent, has publicly accepted and is complying with the principles contained in section 620K(b)(1) (A) and (B) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, as amended.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/f/3" id="H568DDCEA9D044726B7B87AF571D0D923" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>The President may exercise the authority in section 620K(e) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 with respect to this subsection.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/f/4" id="H555F17BA30354CA6AE6C2C013A2B86C8" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>Whenever the certification pursuant to paragraph (2) is exercised, the Secretary of State shall submit a report to the Committees on Appropriations within 120 days of the certification and every quarter thereafter on whether such government, including all of its ministers or such equivalent are continuing to comply with the principles contained in section 620K(b)(1) (A) and (B) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, as amended: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the report shall also detail the amount, purposes and delivery mechanisms for any assistance provided pursuant to the abovementioned certification and a full accounting of any direct support of such government.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/f/5" id="H8C40B14029BC4B03AE7A19FF9638991D" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><content>None of the funds appropriated under titles III through VI of this Act may be obligated for assistance for the Palestine Liberation Organization.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/g" id="H2A35C51CB99743AFB9C0FD1067DF0009" class="indent0"><num value="g">(g) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Suspension of Assistance</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/g/1" id="H7F7752DD87CE47ADA387248E863879A5" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><chapeau>Funds appropriated under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” in this Act and made available for assistance for the Palestinian Authority pursuant to subsection (b) shall be suspended if after the date of enactment of this Act—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/g/1/A" id="H3016D8FDF67F435686A69823A4A9210A" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>the Palestinians obtain the same standing as member states or full membership as a state in the United Nations or any specialized agency thereof outside an agreement negotiated between Israel and the Palestinians; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/g/1/B" id="HA0B659393A7248CA9681D4C6A51782D7" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>the Palestinians initiate an International Criminal Court (ICC) judicially authorized investigation, or actively support such an investigation, that subjects Israeli nationals to an investigation for alleged crimes against Palestinians.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/g/2" id="H407BCA0F78CB4858A531130C0A1C1104" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>The Secretary of State may waive the restriction in paragraph (1) of this subsection resulting from the application of subparagraph (A) of such paragraph if the Secretary certifies to the Committees on Appropriations that to do so is in the national security interest of the United States, and submits a report to such Committees detailing how the waiver and the continuation of assistance would assist in furthering Middle East peace.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/h" id="H79B6DFC040A444ED82FE0AE5DFF81D50" class="indent0"><num value="h">(h) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reduction</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of State shall reduce the amount of assistance made available by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” for the Palestinian Authority by an amount the Secretary determines is equivalent to the amount expended by the Palestinian Authority, the Palestine Liberation Organization, and any successor or affiliated organizations with such entities as payments for acts of terrorism by individuals who are imprisoned after being fairly tried and convicted for acts of terrorism and by individuals who died committing acts of terrorism during the previous calendar year: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the Secretary shall report to the Committees on Appropriations on the amount reduced for fiscal year 2020 prior to the obligation of funds for the Palestinian Authority.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/i" id="H475A46912A1344FA8A933E62140A0D04" class="indent0"><num value="i">(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Incitement Report</inline>.—</heading><content>Not later than 90 days after enactment of this Act, the Secretary of State shall submit a report to the appropriate congressional committees detailing steps taken by the Palestinian Authority to counter incitement of violence against Israelis and to promote peace and coexistence with Israel.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/j" id="H9C0FD593FB264E009CF52A0561A8B748" class="indent0"><num value="j">(j) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Section 1003</inline>.—</heading><paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/j/1" id="HE3B5B46CF9064AAC958458437A507A5E" class="inline"><num value="1">(1) </num><chapeau>The President may waive the provisions of section 1003 of the Foreign Relations Authorization Act, Fiscal Years 1988 and 1989 (<ref href="/us/pl/100/204">Public Law 100–204</ref>) if the President determines and certifies in writing to the Speaker of the House of Representatives, the President pro tempore of the Senate, and the appropriate congressional committees that the Palestinians have not, after the date of enactment of this Act—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/j/1/A" id="H1086B84B900F4C7DB63CBE5852D9D5F6" class="indent1"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>obtained in the United Nations or any specialized agency thereof the same standing as member states or full membership as a state outside an agreement negotiated between Israel and the Palestinians; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/j/1/B" id="H2BF27F3ED592458AB7220CEE0720C6FC" class="indent1"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>initiated or actively supported an ICC investigation against Israeli nationals for alleged crimes against Palestinians.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/j/2" id="H8094E41C8378454593D0EDBAECD83C1D" class="indent0"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>Not less than 90 days after the President is unable to make the certification pursuant to paragraph (1) of this subsection, the President may waive <ref href="/us/pl/100/204/s1003">section 1003 of Public Law 100–204</ref> if the President determines and certifies in writing to the Speaker of the House of Representatives, the President pro tempore of the Senate, and the Committees on Appropriations that the Palestinians have entered into direct and meaningful negotiations with Israel: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That any waiver of the provisions of <ref href="/us/pl/100/204/s1003">section 1003 of Public Law 100–204</ref> under paragraph (1) of this subsection or under previous provisions of law must expire before the waiver under the preceding sentence may be exercised.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/j/3" id="H48C88B66A32B4730B3B0909C66275E06" class="indent0"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>Any waiver pursuant to this subsection shall be effective for no more than a period of 6 months at a time and shall not apply beyond 12 months after the enactment of this Act.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7039/k" id="H0BE21C1A47AB4BB7BD98BA0904960B32" class="indent0"><num value="k">(k) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Palestinian Broadcasting Corporation</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made available by this Act may be used to provide equipment, technical support, consulting services, or any other form of assistance to the Palestinian Broadcasting Corporation.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" id="HB3275DE79A494EDFB9C56332D9C64B70"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">assistance for the west bank and gaza</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040" id="HF3B61E3E4BE945F186F7D073B823F233" changed="notChanged"><num value="7040"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7040. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/a" id="H6EB8293FA0EE4FD49DCDD33424F4DFA1" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Oversight</inline>.—</heading><content>For fiscal year 2020, 30 days prior to the initial obligation of funds for the bilateral West Bank and Gaza Program, the Secretary of State shall certify to the Committees on Appropriations that procedures have been established to assure the Comptroller General of the United States will have access to appropriate United States financial information in order to review the uses of United States assistance for the Program funded under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” for the West Bank and Gaza.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/b" id="HA231EF5124A14F1E9A737322F102A442" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Vetting</inline>.—</heading><content>Prior to the obligation of funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” for assistance for the West Bank and Gaza, the Secretary of State shall take all appropriate steps to ensure that such assistance is not provided to or through any individual, private or government entity, or educational institution that the Secretary knows or has reason to believe advocates, plans, sponsors, engages in, or has engaged in, terrorist activity nor, with respect to private entities or educational institutions, those that have as a principal officer of the entity’s governing board or governing board of trustees any individual that has been determined to be involved in, or advocating terrorist activity or determined to be a member of a designated foreign terrorist organization: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the Secretary of State shall, as appropriate, establish procedures specifying the steps to be taken in carrying out this subsection and shall terminate assistance to any individual, entity, or educational institution which the Secretary has determined to be involved in or advocating terrorist activity.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/c" id="H4681CA2413F44C178DFAA59F42890173" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/c/1" id="H11E4FC868FC5422EAB8BCDE80AE4CCEC" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Recognition of acts of terrorism</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>None of the funds appropriated under titles III through VI of this Act for assistance under the West Bank and Gaza Program may be made available for—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/c/1/A" id="H4F7B2CD418934785B08768F9A6ACA722" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>the purpose of recognizing or otherwise honoring individuals who commit, or have committed acts of terrorism; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/c/1/B" id="H81DFA60A203B4071AFEAEDB32F2EAC6C" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>any educational institution located in the West Bank or Gaza that is named after an individual who the Secretary of State determines has committed an act of terrorism.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/c/2" id="H0B52E83BFD124DADAAFB4E2C84F738AA" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Security assistance and reporting requirement</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding any other provision of law, none of the funds made available by this or prior appropriations Acts, including funds made available by transfer, may be made available for obligation for security assistance for the West Bank and Gaza until the Secretary of State reports to the Committees on Appropriations on the benchmarks that have been established for security assistance for the West Bank and Gaza and reports on the extent of Palestinian compliance with such benchmarks.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/d" id="H760D6392BB9A4C84AB72CD30E5D21A88" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reporting Requirements</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/d/1" id="HF3EE26CB6BA64C02AB58DDA0E17D95C2" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Economic assistance</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Prior to the initial obligation of funds made available by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” for assistance for the West Bank and Gaza, the Secretary of State shall report to the Committees on Appropriations that the purpose of such assistance is to—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/d/1/A" id="H240E651EA94F43578398F7858BE6BCC6" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>advance Middle East peace;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/d/1/B" id="H78647334C8CE48708D8C99BC20F45AA3" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>improve security in the region;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/d/1/C" id="H4E55A9E4BCE34439BC9F895719CD23C2" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>continue support for transparent and accountable government institutions;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/d/1/D" id="HCC37A77FF19348C3B0244513687A38D6" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>promote a private sector economy; or</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/d/1/E" id="HD2331B0BF4BC43BC93753428A7FD48A3" class="indent2"><num value="E">(E) </num><content>address urgent humanitarian needs.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/d/2" id="H399033C9173F47A094961E4699E42319" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Security assistance</inline>.—</heading><content>The reporting requirements in section 1404 of the Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2008 (<ref href="/us/pl/110/252">Public Law 110–252</ref>) shall apply to funds made available by this Act, including a description of modifications, if any, to the security strategy of the Palestinian Authority.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/e" id="H872CD1347F8B4AF49F76A792D1A2152E" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Private Sector Partnership Programs</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act and prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs may be made available for private sector partnership programs for the West Bank and Gaza if such funds are authorized: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That funds made available pursuant to this subsection shall be subject to prior consultation with the appropriate congressional committees, and the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/f" id="H8462ED0624714C279FC1F72B4C8C7A0F" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Oversight by the United States Agency for International Development</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/f/1" id="H8BB014CFE3254D7BBDC5B13B9A9399C0" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>The Administrator of the United States Agency for International Development shall ensure that Federal or non-Federal audits of all contractors and grantees, and significant subcontractors and sub-grantees, under the West Bank and Gaza Program, are conducted at least on an annual basis to ensure, among other things, compliance with this section.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/f/2" id="H9DCE70C1C9C54BC38E856A005148695E" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act, up to $1,000,000 may be used by the Office of Inspector General of the United States Agency for International Development for audits, investigations, and other activities in furtherance of the requirements of this subsection: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such funds are in addition to funds otherwise available for such purposes.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/g" id="HF9D26F02EC7F4BF78C300674999D6CB6" class="indent0"><num value="g">(g) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Comptroller General of the United States Audit</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Subsequent to the certification specified in subsection (a), the Comptroller General of the United States shall conduct an audit and an investigation of the treatment, handling, and uses of all funds for the bilateral West Bank and Gaza Program, including all funds provided as cash transfer assistance, in fiscal year 2020 under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>”, and such audit shall address—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/g/1" id="H7F9E2A15FA0C4DCFA8179CB38604AA5E" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>the extent to which such Program complies with the requirements of subsections (b) and (c); and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/g/2" id="HF32982107DC74CCEA0C7ECE6041C51CA" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>an examination of all programs, projects, and activities carried out under such Program, including both obligations and expenditures.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7040/h" id="H98DE00AF70A642DB84C1E31D3DFF1503" class="indent0"><num value="h">(h) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Notification Procedures</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds made available in this Act for West Bank and Gaza shall be subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H63472ABDB95A43568A2172EA9C489D57"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">middle east and north africa</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041" id="H1639BDAB8B574B3AB0D2AE4766DF0276" changed="added"><num value="7041"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7041. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/a" id="H90DCA3509344458E980A6EE76D21D5EC" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Arab League Boycott of Israel</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>It is the sense of the Congress that—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/a/1" id="HC70317B7CA6D4BFA806ECD748FE2219D" class="indent0"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>the Arab League boycott of Israel, and the secondary boycott of American firms that have commercial ties with Israel, is an impediment to peace in the region and to United States investment and trade in the Middle East and North Africa;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/a/2" id="H2E628B8A0439468F87FF89F30B93091A" class="indent0"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>the Arab League boycott, which was regrettably reinstated in 1997, should be immediately and publicly terminated, and the Central Office for the Boycott of Israel immediately disbanded;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/a/3" id="H966CD49BD68F453C881EC3A86D75E124" class="indent0"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>all Arab League states should normalize relations with their neighbor Israel;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/a/4" id="HC2EBB24181F44976A1F5EF040FB6FF93" class="indent0"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>the President and the Secretary of State should continue to vigorously oppose the Arab League boycott of Israel and find concrete steps to demonstrate that opposition by, for example, taking into consideration the participation of any recipient country in the boycott when determining to sell weapons to said country; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/a/5" id="H8E746A67CB074E5B96BB38EE1CC40DC3" class="indent0"><num value="5">(5) </num><content>the President should report to Congress annually on specific steps being taken by the United States to encourage Arab League states to normalize their relations with Israel to bring about the termination of the Arab League boycott of Israel, including those to encourage allies and trading partners of the United States to enact laws prohibiting businesses from complying with the boycott and penalizing businesses that do comply.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/b" id="H3D03AA596288472DB6D440D2309B1033" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Egypt</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/b/1" id="HB8DA55BCE5E7493B8A4ADC95D5E21F55" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Certification and report</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Funds appropriated by this Act that are available for assistance for Egypt may be made available notwithstanding any other provision of law restricting assistance for Egypt, except for this subsection and section 620M of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, and may only be made available for assistance for the Government of Egypt if the Secretary of State certifies and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that such government is—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/b/1/A" id="HBC0CFE55D21E49A39A589E824F89D273" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>sustaining the strategic relationship with the United States; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/b/1/B" id="HF45ADBFDB5D94D619D16164FB2BA3259" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>meeting its obligations under the 1979 Egypt-Israel Peace Treaty.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/b/2" id="H497329C7AA1844648278D6990938B137" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Economic support fund</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/b/2/A" id="H15242B42CFE34753A9CB334B5BAADB77" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Funding</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Development Assistance” and “Economic Support Fund”, up to $102,500,000 may be made available for assistance for Egypt, of which not less than $35,000,000 should be made available for higher education programs including not less than $15,000,000 for scholarships for Egyptian students with high financial need to attend not-for-profit institutions of higher education: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such funds shall be made available for democracy programs, and for development programs in the Sinai: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That such funds may not be made available for cash transfer assistance or budget support.</proviso></content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/b/2/B" id="H142E218A37F44160A14C72B6051B0207" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act and prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” may be made available for a contribution, voluntary or otherwise, to the “Civil Associations and Foundations Support Fund”, or any similar fund, established pursuant to Law 70 on Associations and Other Foundations Working in the Field of Civil Work published in the Official Gazette of Egypt on May 29, 2017.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/b/3" id="HF8B98FB791FF4CF589CCAD85E8D80642" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Foreign military financing program</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/b/3/A" id="H91703E348418499C9FB301DF78FF3AAA" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Certification</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Foreign Military Financing Program</headingText>”, up to $1,300,000,000, to remain available until September 30, 2021, may be made available for assistance for Egypt: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such funds may be transferred to an interest bearing account in the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, following consultation with the Committees on Appropriations: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That 20 percent of such funds shall be withheld from obligation until the Secretary of State certifies and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that the Government of Egypt is taking, on a sustained and effective basis, the steps enumerated under this section in the report accompanying this Act: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That the certification requirement of this paragraph shall not apply to funds appropriated by this Act under such heading for counterterrorism, border security, and nonproliferation programs for Egypt.</proviso></content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/b/3/B" id="HA1F0C60775844546B9A41D05E4BCF71A" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Waiver</inline>.—</heading><clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/b/3/B/i" id="HD5548F26F44D4533A83ED907173E1150" class="inline"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>The Secretary of State may waive the certification requirement in subparagraph (A) with respect to 95 percent of the amount withheld from obligation pursuant to such subparagraph if the Secretary determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that to do so is important to the national security interest of the United States, and includes in such report a detailed justification for the use of such waiver and the reasons why any of the certification requirements of subparagraph (A) cannot be met: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the report required by this paragraph shall be submitted in unclassified form, but may be accompanied by a classified annex.</proviso></content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/b/3/B/ii" id="H63BFB4DC337F4D43B3F4491B8AF2E6C0" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>The remaining 5 percent may only be made available for obligation if the Secretary of State determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that the Government of Egypt has completed action to provide fair and commensurate compensation to American citizen April Corley for injuries suffered by Egyptian armed forces on September 13, 2015: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That none of the funds withheld pursuant to subparagraph (A) shall be transferred to the interest bearing account referenced in subparagraph (A) until the determination in the preceding sentence has been provided to the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/c" id="HB63F0AC6FBD84C46BEF7957B70FFAD50" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Iran</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/c/1" id="H001060D58AB8410E9D1F28CE03B8D25F" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Funding</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Diplomatic Programs”, “Economic Support Fund”, and “Nonproliferation, Anti-terrorism, Demining and Related Programs” shall be used by the Secretary of State to support the activities described under this section in the report accompanying this Act.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/c/2" id="HB5EB2B19BAA441A290259BC4879C609A" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reports</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/c/2/A" id="HD7EA199D5FF444288ED900D3A4F275EB" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Semi-annual report</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of State shall submit to the Committees on Appropriations the semi-annual report required by section 135 of the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 (<ref href="/us/usc/t42/s2160e/d/4">42 U.S.C. 2160e(d)(4)</ref>), as added by section 2 of the Iran Nuclear Agreement Review Act of 2015 (<ref href="/us/pl/114/17">Public Law 114–17</ref>).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/c/2/B" id="H45ADF62F8B78454DADA15E66AB7F90D8" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Sanctions report</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of the Treasury, shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees a report on—</chapeau>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/c/2/B/i" id="HFFA8A97844EC48309DDAA996786DDCB1" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>the status of United States bilateral sanctions on Iran;</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/c/2/B/ii" id="HF39146052DE9469F841135C94C36A8E3" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>the reimposition and renewed enforcement of secondary sanctions; and</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/c/2/B/iii" id="H54C4983F6EC549CEAF596AFB6EE37C6E" class="indent3"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><content>the impact such sanctions have had on Iran’s destabilizing activities throughout the Middle East.</content></clause></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/d" id="HE5D85135A1F34AEFB167F2A20F39B92A" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Iraq</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/d/1" id="H2897670FA4584DDBBFB8BF5C7E748E17" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Purposes</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated under titles III and IV of this Act shall be made available for assistance for Iraq for economic, stabilization, and humanitarian programs described under this section in the report accompanying this Act.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/d/2" id="H127A9DFC9FFD4D308659ECC3B967FDC6" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Basing rights agreement</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made available by this Act may be used by the Government of the United States to enter into a permanent basing rights agreement between the United States and Iraq.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/e" id="H8ACD4B13E93E4061B5AAAFFD3CFE0BD5" changed="notChanged" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Jordan</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under titles III and IV, not less than $1,525,000,000 shall be made available for assistance for Jordan, of which not less than $745,100,000 of the funds appropriated under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” shall be for budget support for the Government of Jordan and of which not less than $425,000,000 shall be made available under the heading “<headingText>Foreign Military Financing Program</headingText>”.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/f" id="H3CDE805785994056BC21662E878CC22D" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Lebanon</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Funds appropriated by this Act that are made available for assistance for Lebanon—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/f/1" id="H94E23DBFB4FC4BBA8E6AC0A3B2CF8E18" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>under the headings “International Narcotics Control and Law Enforcement” and “Foreign Military Financing Program” may be made available for the Lebanese Internal Security Forces (ISF) and the Lebanese Armed Forces (LAF) to address security and stability requirements in areas affected by the conflict in Syria, following consultation with the appropriate congressional committees;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/f/2" id="H7090CEC9C12540BC8734ADBD885DC8EC" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>under the heading “<headingText>Foreign Military Financing Program</headingText>” may be used only to professionalize the LAF and to strengthen border security and combat terrorism, including training and equipping the LAF to secure Lebanon’s borders, interdicting arms shipments, preventing the use of Lebanon as a safe haven for terrorist groups, and to implement United Nations Security Council Resolution 1701: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That funds may not be obligated for assistance for the LAF until the Secretary of State submits to the Committees on Appropriations a spend plan, including actions to be taken to ensure equipment provided to the LAF is only used for the intended purposes, except such plan may not be considered as meeting the notification requirements under section 7015 of this Act or under section 634A of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, and shall include any funds specifically intended for lethal military equipment: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That such spend plan shall be submitted not later than September 1, 2020;</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/f/3" id="HF0D3B8E5FD994B458156C82D77040BE2" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>shall not be made available for the ISF or the LAF if these entities fall under control by a foreign terrorist organization, as designated pursuant to section 219 of the Immigration and Nationality Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t8/s1189">8 U.S.C. 1189</ref>); and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/f/4" id="H8FE8E8665070407181CC35B9329917A4" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” may be made available notwithstanding section 1224 of the Foreign Relations Authorization Act, Fiscal Year 2003 (<ref href="/us/pl/107/228">Public Law 107–228</ref>; <ref href="/us/usc/t22/s2346">22 U.S.C. 2346 note</ref>).</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/g" id="HB8B36AE3AB2B4544B3E76D5057434429" changed="notChanged" class="indent0"><num value="g">(g) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Libya</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/g/1" id="H7A31E87F3F354069B57E49FE68001545" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Assistance</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated under titles III and IV of this Act shall be made available for stabilization assistance for Libya, including border security: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the limitation on the uses of funds for certain infrastructure projects in section 7041(f)(2) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2014 (<ref href="/us/pl/113/76/dK">division K of Public Law 113–76</ref>) shall apply to such funds.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/g/2" id="H4E189EEE01C54339807C458EE2A0FE31" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Certification</inline>.—</heading><content>Prior to the initial obligation of funds made available by this Act for assistance for Libya, the Secretary of State shall certify and report to the Committees on Appropriations that all practicable steps have been taken to ensure that mechanisms are in place for monitoring, oversight, and control of such funds.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/g/3" id="HBD8F8EAF033A4DF3A9161A34BF1E8269" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Cooperation on the september 2012 attack on united states personnel and facilities</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act may be made available for assistance for the central Government of Libya unless the Secretary of State certifies and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that such government is cooperating with United States Government efforts to investigate and bring to justice those responsible for the attack on United States personnel and facilities in Benghazi, Libya in September 2012: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the limitation in this paragraph shall not apply to funds made available for the purpose of protecting United States Government personnel or facilities.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/h" id="HD396F7858ECD430F8C8DD2A4D8558E50" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="h">(h) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Morocco</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/h/1" id="HFF10BB19B1554E4E9B1EFC963F7F0ACC" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Availability and consultation requirement</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated under the headings “Development Assistance” and “Economic Support Fund” in this Act shall be made available for assistance for the Western Sahara: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That not later than 90 days after enactment of this Act and prior to the obligation of such funds, the Secretary of State, in consultation with the USAID Administrator, shall consult with the Committees on Appropriations on the proposed uses of such funds.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/h/2" id="HE10DA0FC45994F88945297FBB6662956" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Foreign military financing program</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Foreign Military Financing Program</headingText>” that are available for assistance for Morocco may only be used for the purposes requested in the Congressional Budget Justification, Foreign Operations, Fiscal Year 2017.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/i" id="HDF1F49FBBD314B3CA462859F52734CC7" class="indent0"><num value="i">(i) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Saudi Arabia</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act should be used to support the sale of nuclear technology to Saudi Arabia.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/j" id="H75FA5B8FD81C4570BA7F1E4D7C42E60F" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="j">(j) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Syria</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/j/1" id="HF5A4F1FCF0994B0FBF835DF36E1CA5D3" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Non-lethal assistance</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Economic Support Fund”, “International Narcotics Control and Law Enforcement”, and “Peacekeeping Operations” may be made available, notwithstanding any other provision of law, for non-lethal stabilization assistance for Syria, including for emergency medical and rescue response and chemical weapons use investigations.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/j/2" id="H7936483DA8AD4007A5AEEA4B19C7740D" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitations</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Funds made available pursuant to paragraph (1) of this subsection—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/j/2/A" id="H3EFC264F976A43FE894FDFC7BF20CF7D" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>may not be made available for a project or activity that supports or otherwise legitimizes the Government of Iran, the Government of the Russian Federation, foreign terrorist organizations (as designated pursuant to section 219 of the Immigration and Nationality Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t8/s1189">8 U.S.C. 1189</ref>)), or a proxy of Iran in Syria; and</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/j/2/B" id="H24B18F077BE14C5CA13F46504C5BB3B8" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>should not be used in areas of Syria controlled by a government led by Bashar al-Assad or associated forces.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/j/3" id="H4C1BFDF7A83E469C9A285798A9FF50CB" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Monitoring and oversight</inline>.—</heading><content>Prior to the obligation of any funds appropriated by this Act and made available for assistance for Syria, the Secretary of State shall take all practicable steps to ensure that mechanisms are in place for monitoring, oversight, and control of such assistance inside Syria.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/j/4" id="HB9C8ACBAB7724D34A4B331EF2CAEDE5D" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Consultation and notification</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds made available pursuant to this subsection may only be made available following consultation with the appropriate congressional committees, and shall be subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/k" id="HCC19DDD8186E4422A32D227EC3A6A3C8" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="k">(k) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Tunisia</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated under titles III and IV of this Act, not less than $191,400,000 shall be made available for assistance for Tunisia.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7041/l" id="HDF0E921707BB45EC8EDBCA9E322EED82" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="l">(l) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Yemen</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” shall be made available for stabilization assistance for Yemen.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H6208FFC62B99423885FB1F5FDFB656EF"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">africa</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7042" id="H8FAC71982B7E4479A7F1A3290004F441" changed="added"><num value="7042"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7042. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7042/a" id="HCF7B1E26FA194A83A5C63AC08328DAC6" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">African Great Lakes Region Assistance Restriction</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>International Military Education and Training</headingText>” for the central government of a country in the African Great Lakes region may be made available only for Expanded International Military Education and Training and professional military education until the Secretary of State determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that such government is not facilitating or otherwise participating in destabilizing activities in a neighboring country, including aiding and abetting armed groups.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7042/b" id="HD0A182B6857C4F74AD5E44FB0A92260B" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Central African Republic</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>”, not less than $3,000,000 shall be made available for a contribution to the Special Criminal Court in Central African Republic.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7042/c" id="HD06B720E2D1740FB980D3AB199E22F5A" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Malawi</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Development Assistance</headingText>”, not less than $56,000,000 shall be made available for assistance for Malawi, of which up to $10,000,000 shall be made available for higher education programs.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7042/d" id="H7736519D75344FCC842C584FB228B248" changed="notChanged" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">South Sudan</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act that are made available for assistance for the central Government of South Sudan may only be made available, following consultation with the Committees on Appropriations, for the purposes described under this section in the report accompanying this Act: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That prior to the initial obligation of funds to support South Sudan peace negotiations or to implement a peace agreement, the Secretary of State shall consult with the Committees on Appropriations on the intended uses of such funds and steps taken by such government to advance or implement a peace agreement.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7042/e" id="HC46DC8C0096644998F2F121E8CBA8A1D" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Sudan</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7042/e/1" id="H08424BBFD46D4894870731E72D3C144E" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitations</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7042/e/1/A" id="HDD3F256BDB9B41EDAA2AA289771B8612" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Assistance</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding any other provision of law, none of the funds appropriated by this Act may be made available for assistance for the Government of Sudan.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7042/e/1/B" id="H3CE1503636A04623B439F487281E4652" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Loans</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act may be made available for the cost, as defined in section 502 of the Congressional Budget Act of 1974, of modifying loans and loan guarantees held by the Government of Sudan, including the cost of selling, reducing, or canceling amounts owed to the United States, and modifying concessional loans, guarantees, and credit agreements.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7042/e/2" id="HE7243D39BF4944D4B11CDA548E41167D" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Exclusions</inline>.—</heading><content>The limitations of paragraph (1) shall not apply to funds made available for assistance described under this section in the report accompanying this Act. </content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7042/f" id="H2812CDCA795045829D1259932EC0F2ED" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Zimbabwe</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act shall be made available for assistance for the central Government of Zimbabwe, except for health and education, unless the Secretary of State certifies and reports that the rule of law and freedom of expression, association, and assembly are restored, except that funds may be made available for macroeconomic growth assistance if the Secretary reports to the Committees on Appropriations that such government is implementing transparent fiscal policies, including public disclosure of revenues from the extraction of natural resources.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="HBB3D2DDC71C3485CAFD14A2BCC0D73E5"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">east asia and the pacific</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043" id="HF281288C1AB149F587D8ED12FCF6A843" changed="added"><num value="7043"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7043. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/a" id="H33218D90D6B84F1B83F6E7E93B5F5C37" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Burma</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/a/1" id="H61D1E069CB39412E95DA18C6B4D63B01" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Bilateral economic assistance</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/a/1/A" id="HD5227212460F4945B88371D42BF5799D" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authority</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Development Assistance” and “Economic Support Fund” for assistance for Burma may be made available notwithstanding any other provision of law, except for this subsection, and following consultation with the appropriate congressional committees: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such funds may be made available for ethnic groups and civil society in Burma to help sustain ceasefire agreements and further prospects for reconciliation and peace, which may include support to representatives of ethnic armed groups for this purpose.</proviso></content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/a/1/B" id="H878EA539484A4BAAB5021E7522D6DEB5" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitations</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under titles III and IV to carry out the provisions of part I of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 and made available for assistance for Burma shall be subject to the limitations enumerated under this section in the report accompanying this Act.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/a/2" id="H3C4C1AA974CA4241B6BDCC390D9D539F" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">International security assistance</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “International Military Education and Training” and “Foreign Military Financing Program” may be made available for assistance for Burma: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the Department of State may continue consultations with the armed forces of Burma only on human rights and disaster response in a manner consistent with the prior fiscal year, and following consultation with the appropriate congressional committees.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/b" id="H1A7CEE7241AF4738B45F0176E13A87A9" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Cambodia</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/b/1" id="H2B7D697AB6A34E17A3F7C8231EF67EF9" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act that are made available for assistance for the Government of Cambodia may be obligated or expended unless the Secretary of State certifies and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that such Government is meeting the conditions described under this section in the report accompanying this Act.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/b/2" id="H042F95FBC4E04625B9C5B9FB741D7F82" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Uses</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Development Assistance</headingText>” and made available for assistance for Cambodia shall be made available for the purposes described under this section in the report accompanying this Act.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/c" id="HF9A7EE6DE8B340A9B6E989D9195BE2E3" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Indo-Pacific Strategy</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act, $160,000,000 shall be made available to support the implementation of the Indo-Pacific Strategy.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/d" id="HD60C78E7E3654DCBA566391C2AFADB38" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">North Korea</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/d/1" id="H848140AEC06C410E944BC325F57BF9B4" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act may be made available for assistance for the Government of North Korea: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the Secretary of State may waive the limitation in this paragraph, and the limitation on assistance for North Korea contained in section 7007 of this Act, if the Secretary determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that to do so is important to the national security interest of the United States, and submits in such report a detailed justification.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/d/2" id="H9496B37A8D414F3A88DACCE79E4B70BA" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Human rights</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Democracy Fund” and “Economic Support Fund” shall be made available for the promotion of human rights in North Korea: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the authority of section 7032(b) of this Act shall apply to such funds.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/e" id="HD50FE1C2E9D54DE489BE314DD0AD953B" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">People’s Republic of China</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/e/1" id="H4FAE2FE9A85549FBB0673834D678F457" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation on use of funds</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated under the heading “<headingText>Diplomatic Programs</headingText>” in this Act may be obligated or expended for processing licenses for the export of satellites of United States origin (including commercial satellites and satellite components) to the People’s Republic of China (PRC) unless, at least 15 days in advance, the Committees on Appropriations are notified of such proposed action.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/e/2" id="H991C97EBB8A54B8CA8FD871CEF3995AD" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">People’s liberation army</inline>.—</heading><content>The terms and requirements of section 620(h) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 shall apply to foreign assistance projects or activities of the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) of the PRC, to include such projects or activities by any entity that is owned or controlled by, or an affiliate of, the PLA: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That none of the funds appropriated or otherwise made available pursuant to this Act may be used to finance any grant, contract, or cooperative agreement with the PLA, or any entity that the Secretary of State has reason to believe is owned or controlled by, or an affiliate of, the PLA.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/f" id="H648EEAD66E5F464D83B168E9F3B91BCD" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Philippines</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>International Narcotics Control and Law Enforcement</headingText>” may be made available for counternarcotics assistance for the Philippines, except for drug demand reduction, maritime law enforcement, or transnational interdiction.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/g" id="H3CA4ECBE4ED6427BABE626F25B709E39" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="g">(g) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Tibet</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/g/1" id="H5A878104B30A49688B73E01FF846153E" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Financing of projects in tibet</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of the Treasury should instruct the United States executive director of each international financial institution to use the voice and vote of the United States to support financing of projects in Tibet if such projects do not provide incentives for the migration and settlement of non-Tibetans into Tibet or facilitate the transfer of ownership of Tibetan land and natural resources to non-Tibetans, are based on a thorough needs-assessment, foster self-sufficiency of the Tibetan people and respect Tibetan culture and traditions, and are subject to effective monitoring.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/g/2" id="H9785B654C77241C1A27CFA2F5260A5A5" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Programs for tibetan communities</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Of the funds appropriated under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>”, not less than—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/g/2/A" id="HA2184AFB8215447EAFCF5A95EB885E1A" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Tibet autonomous region</inline>.—</heading><content>$8,000,000 shall be made available to nongovernmental organizations to support activities which preserve cultural traditions and promote sustainable development, education, and environmental conservation in Tibetan communities in the Tibet Autonomous Region and in other Tibetan communities in China, notwithstanding any other provision of law;</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/g/2/B" id="H88899628AAFD4516B0E6927EE563C06D" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">India and nepal</inline>.—</heading><content>$6,000,000 shall be made available for programs to promote and preserve Tibetan culture, development, and the resilience of Tibetan communities in India and Nepal, and to assist in the education and development of the next generation of Tibetan leaders from such communities: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such funds are in addition to amounts made available in subparagraph (A) for programs inside Tibet; and</proviso></content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/g/2/C" id="H69E33C34C81C489BB237AAA330C8EEEE" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Tibetan governance</inline>.—</heading><content>$3,000,000 shall be made available for programs to strengthen the capacity of Tibetan institutions and governance.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7043/h" id="H9B485512671A411D835DD6BA8818EC79" class="indent0"><num value="h">(h) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Vietnam</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding any other provision of law, funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Economic Support Fund</headingText>” shall be made available for remediation of dioxin contaminated sites in Vietnam and may be made available for assistance for the Government of Vietnam, including the military, for such purposes.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="HD5FA606F5FB54D8AB8BC6AE627B9ECED"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">south and central asia </inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044" id="HFA928A7E432A433E8E5A3ECC83E4D227" changed="added"><num value="7044"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7044. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/a" id="H6B1663F543DF4CE49D72EB8242B1BA5E" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Afghanistan</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/a/1" id="H1BD1ADF4E585421D9B21E845E021935E" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authorities</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/a/1/A" id="H780A8CD571094D8AAD7D409CA96CD2E9" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><chapeau>Funds appropriated by this Act under titles III through VI that are made available for assistance for Afghanistan may be made available—</chapeau>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/a/1/A/i" id="HDD9D5F921A2842349EA164E75C60DFB6" class="indent3"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>notwithstanding section 7012 of this Act or any similar provision of law and section 660 of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961;</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/a/1/A/ii" id="H38D5347FEB794D1D9A8EC03B987C4268" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>for reconciliation programs and disarmament, demobilization, and reintegration activities for former combatants who have renounced violence against the Government of Afghanistan, including in accordance with section 7046(a)(2)(B)(ii) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2012 (<ref href="/us/pl/112/74/dI">division I of Public Law 112–74</ref>); and</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/a/1/A/iii" id="H9B85D858B2864B95B3744117D4F937E2" class="indent3"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><content>for an endowment to empower women and girls.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/a/1/B" id="H8E66234E47304252AC25251AF5441CE6" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>Section 7046(a)(2)(A) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2012 (<ref href="/us/pl/112/74/dI">division I of Public Law 112–74</ref>) shall apply to funds appropriated by this Act for assistance for Afghanistan.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/a/2" id="HB9BD21F64D11462B9127BE6CF4AFFE9A" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Basing rights agreement</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds made available by this Act may be used by the United States Government to enter into a permanent basing rights agreement between the United States and Afghanistan.</content></paragraph></subsection>
