<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/b" id="H46002ECA16AD4A58B230D5EBA8512785" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Pakistan</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/b/1" id="H0785B7E6E0774A3CA4396013F4A515E8" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authority and uses of funds</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/b/1/A" id="H9B0B16FBB5C04E9FB035B9BD61E80303" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>Funds appropriated by this Act for assistance for Pakistan may be made available notwithstanding any other provision of law, except for section 620M of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/b/1/B" id="H41E4C1EFCE6148A789148FB01576B5C4" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>Funds appropriated by this Act for assistance for Pakistan that are made available for infrastructure projects shall be implemented in a manner consistent with section 507(6) of the Trade Act of 1974 (<ref href="/us/usc/t19/s2467/6">19 U.S.C. 2467(6)</ref>).</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/b/1/C" id="HA286EBEB2AB04BEEB7130D4D0449E144" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>The authorities and directives of section 7044(d)(4) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2015 (<ref href="/us/pl/113/235/dJ">division J of Public Law 113–235</ref>) regarding scholarships for women shall apply to funds appropriated by this Act for assistance for Pakistan, following consultation with the Committees on Appropriations.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/b/1/D" id="H0442D7452C1B4BD2BA64B9AB3EBA3688" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Economic Support Fund” and “Nonproliferation, Anti-terrorism, Demining and Related Programs” that are made available for assistance for Pakistan shall be made available to interdict precursor materials from Pakistan to Afghanistan that are used to manufacture improvised explosive devices and for agriculture extension programs that encourage alternative fertilizer use among Pakistani farmers to decrease the dual use of fertilizer in the manufacturing of improvised explosive devices.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/b/2" id="H3C87943738944A93BBA7121FF47140BC" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Withholding</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated under titles III and IV of this Act that are made available for assistance for Pakistan, $33,000,000 shall be withheld from obligation until the Secretary of State reports to the Committees on Appropriations that Dr. Shakil Afridi has been released from prison and cleared of all charges relating to the assistance provided to the United States in locating Osama bin Laden.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/c" id="H9B558F13FD674E3B9192D3E6F169BBDC" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Sri Lanka</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/c/1" id="HBCD63B511AC94013BD5B0231201D9933" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Certification</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act for assistance for the central Government of Sri Lanka, except for funds made available for humanitarian assistance and victims of trauma, may be made available only if the Secretary of State certifies and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that the Government of Sri Lanka is taking actions as described under this section in the report accompanying this Act.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/c/2" id="H127090C121A24C29A3381FC81D377D14" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">International security assistance</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Funds appropriated under title IV of this Act that are available for assistance for Sri Lanka shall be subject to the following conditions—</chapeau>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/c/2/A" id="HA5C7B1AF3E9B40898E26BBAA663F84E8" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>not to exceed $500,000 under the heading “<headingText>Foreign Military Financing Program</headingText>” may only be made available for programs to support counterterrorism, humanitarian and disaster response preparedness, and maritime security, including professionalization and training for the navy and coast guard; and </content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7044/c/2/B" id="HAAE2ABF1065A454A911542FB1B03F2F0" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>funds under the heading “<headingText>Peacekeeping Operations</headingText>” may only be made available for training and equipment related to international peacekeeping operations and improvements to peacekeeping-related facilities, and only if the Government of Sri Lanka is taking effective steps to bring to justice Sri Lankan peacekeeping troops who have engaged in sexual exploitation and abuse.</content></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H1E2AE173B80C40FC923B99F6222D6F4D"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">latin america and the caribbean </inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7045" id="HAFF1B75EFE8049D08F44364727A47FAF" changed="added"><num value="7045"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7045. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7045/a" id="HAB19596DD040460A8429FDEB359E10BC" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Central America</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7045/a/1" id="H8C130A16951A41D0B3C37FCD59FB4AB9" class="indent0"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Assistance</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7045/a/1/A" id="HC7B36EC8E1264EAEBCF7BBF7E407A2BA" class="indent1"><num value="A">(A) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Fiscal year 2020</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under titles III and IV, not less than $540,850,000 shall be made available for assistance for the countries of Central America, including to implement the United States Strategy for Engagement in Central America: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such assistance shall be prioritized for programs and activities that addresses the key factors that contribute to the migration of unaccompanied, undocumented minors to the United States: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That not less than $45,000,000 shall be for support of Attorneys General and other activities to combat corruption and impunity in such countries.</proviso></content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7045/a/1/B" id="H97B99404476944BC9E4F388BFF8C33C7" class="indent1"><num value="B">(B) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prior fiscal years</inline>.—</heading>
<clause role="instruction" identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7045/a/1/B/i" id="H597916E1A6AD46499FEE1B1790208B75" class="indent2"><num value="i">(i) </num><content>Section 7045(a) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2017 (<ref href="/us/pl/115/31/dJ">division J of Public Law 115-31</ref>) <amendingAction type="amend">is amended</amendingAction> by <amendingAction type="delete">striking</amendingAction> in paragraph (2), “<quotedText>$655,000,000 should</quotedText>” and <amendingAction type="insert">inserting</amendingAction> in lieu thereof, “<quotedText>not less than $655,000,000 shall</quotedText>”.</content></clause>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046" id="HB093012AF47345F4A162DAED4C0C2B8B" changed="notChanged"><num value="7046"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7046. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/a" id="H2D8198553B544FEEACE65BA69BDCCA4E" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Violations of Sovereignty</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act may be made available for assistance for a government of an Independent State of the former Soviet Union if such government directs any action in violation of the territorial integrity or national sovereignty of any other Independent State of the former Soviet Union, such as those violations included in the Helsinki Final Act: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That except as otherwise provided in subsection (c)(1) of this section, funds may be made available without regard to the restriction in this subsection if the President determines that to do so is in the national security interest of the United States: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That prior to executing the authority contained in the previous proviso, the Secretary of State shall consult with the Committees on Appropriations on how such assistance supports the national security interest of the United States.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/b" id="H48954B04B27F4A458B7983D370689D21" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Section 907 of the Freedom Support Act</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Section 907 of the FREEDOM Support Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t22/s5812">22 U.S.C. 5812 note</ref>) shall not apply to—</chapeau>

<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/b/2" id="H93C7AE7F247E4B2BBC42493EAD407EF6" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>any assistance provided by the Trade and Development Agency under section 661 of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 (<ref href="/us/usc/t22/s2421">22 U.S.C. 2421</ref>);</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/b/3" id="H7D1789D5360E400086BF531EFDA2056B" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>any activity carried out by a member of the United States and Foreign Commercial Service while acting within his or her official capacity;</content></paragraph>

<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/1" id="HECF676AC95CC4BB5A75BD95331653F93" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act may be made available for assistance for the central Government of the Russian Federation.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/2" id="HFAECEC5F8F5D4AF0A2AEB3FA2073F631" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Annexation of crimea</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/2/A" id="HB8FD38CA502444D8951695E26FBE1AD2" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act may be made available for assistance for the central government of a country that the Secretary of State determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations has taken affirmative steps intended to support or be supportive of the Russian Federation annexation of Crimea or other territory in Ukraine: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That except as otherwise provided in subsection (a), the Secretary may waive the restriction on assistance required by this subparagraph if the Secretary determines and reports to such Committees that to do so is in the national interest of the United States, and includes a justification for such interest.</proviso></content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/2/B" id="H30CFECD4C81B4E0C8F8FC7811083343B" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><chapeau>None of the funds appropriated by this Act may be made available for—</chapeau>

<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/2/B/ii" id="H15ACF51E2870463AB55783382D286943" class="indent3"><num value="ii">(ii) </num><content>the facilitation, financing, or guarantee of United States Government investments in Crimea or other territory in Ukraine under the control of Russian-backed separatists, if such activity includes the participation of Russian Government officials, or other Russian owned or controlled financial entities; or</content></clause>
<clause identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/2/B/iii" id="HD20EEA5339924AB29D8FE140AE1C0566" class="indent3"><num value="iii">(iii) </num><content>assistance for Crimea or other territory in Ukraine under the control of Russian-backed separatists, if such assistance includes the participation of Russian Government officials, or other Russian owned or controlled financial entities.</content></clause></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/2/C" id="H2CF5B6E796094375BBCB1825C69C7D33" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>The Secretary of the Treasury shall instruct the United States executive directors of each international financial institution to vote against any assistance by such institution (including any loan, credit, or guarantee) for any program that violates the sovereignty or territorial integrity of Ukraine.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/2/D" id="HB8D0BBAF477E44A89D0F73D51EBA30D0" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>The requirements and limitations of this subsection shall cease to be in effect if the Secretary of State determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that the Government of Ukraine has reestablished sovereignty over Crimea and other territory in Ukraine under the control of Russian-backed separatists.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/3" id="H923D6D84F5D34988845CA1B2E4A685E2" class="indent0"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Occupation of the Georgian Territories of Abkhazia and Tskhinvali Region/South Ossetia</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/3/A" id="H1E53CBCA170B4D9090CC9E30184FD7DF" class="indent1"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act may be made available for assistance for the central government of a country that the Secretary of State determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations has recognized the independence of, or has established diplomatic relations with, the Russian occupied Georgian territories of Abkhazia and Tskhinvali Region/South Ossetia: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the Secretary shall publish on the Department of State website a list of any such central governments in a timely manner: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That the Secretary may waive the restriction on assistance required by this subparagraph if the Secretary determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that to do so is in the national interest of the United States, and includes a justification for such interest.</proviso></content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/3/B" id="H490CFB5F9DC442738825EDD04BA2093D" class="indent1"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act may be made available to support the Russian occupation of the Georgian territories of Abkhazia and Tskhinvali Region/South Ossetia.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/3/C" id="H5ED933C67AA840FC9E1DA04BAB062131" class="indent1"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>The Secretary of the Treasury shall instruct the United States executive directors of each international financial institution to vote against any assistance by such institution (including any loan, credit, or guarantee) for any program that violates the sovereignty and territorial integrity of Georgia.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/4" id="H26F7BCA53D024C07A944183F33314FD0" class="indent0"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Countering Russian Influence Fund</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/4/A" id="H1EDA8DB8ABDF4302816C7C8602627918" class="indent1"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under titles III and IV, not less than $280,000,000 shall be made available to carry out the purposes of the Countering Russian Influence Fund, as authorized by section 254 of the Countering Russian Influence in Europe and Eurasia Act of 2017 (<ref href="/us/pl/115/44">Public Law 115–44</ref>; <ref href="/us/usc/t22/s9543">22 U.S.C. 9543</ref>) and notwithstanding the country limitation in subsection (b) of such section, and programs to enhance the capacity of law enforcement and security forces in countries in Europe and Eurasia and strengthen security cooperation between such countries and the United States and the North Atlantic Treaty Organization, as appropriate.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/4/B" id="H0ECD1B990B4341B8BD29D8DA9492ACB4" class="indent1"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>Funds appropriated by this Act and made available for assistance for the Eastern Partnership countries shall be made available to advance the implementation of Association Agreements and trade agreements with the European Union, and to reduce their vulnerability to external economic and political pressure from the Russian Federation.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/c/5" id="H1FFC107C0A27497691CAA447B8040E7A" class="indent0"><num value="5">(5) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Democracy Programs</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act shall be made available to support democracy programs, as defined in section 7032(c) of this Act, in the Russian Federation, countries along the Russian periphery, and other countries in Europe and Eurasia targeted by, or potentially vulnerable to, the malign influence campaigns of the Russian Federation: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That not later than 90 days after the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of State, in consultation with the Administrator of the United States Agency for International Development, shall submit to the Committees on Appropriations a multi-year strategy for such programs in the manner described under this section in the report accompanying this Act.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7046/d" id="HA25E777C0D0744DA8C088F5763B407F5" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Turkey</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made available by this Act and prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs, may be made available to transfer or deliver, or to facilitate the transfer or delivery of, F-35 aircraft to Turkey, including any defense articles or services related to such aircraft, until the Secretary of State certifies to the appropriate congressional committees that the Government of Turkey is not purchasing the S-400 missile defense system from Russia and will not accept the delivery of such system.</content></subsection></section>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7047" id="H8F75936E16404EA9A6F6DFB4914FB831" changed="added"><num value="7047"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7047. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7047/a" id="H7B492D8B8E7B4580A54EE715AE85426A" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Countering Foreign Fighters and Extremist Organizations</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated under titles III and IV of this Act shall be made available for programs and activities to counter and defeat violent extremism and foreign fighters abroad.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7047/b" id="H352571F0264B4B2DAD5B4935087DAF90" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Relief and Recovery Fund</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7047/b/1" id="HADC1C9B8FB7D43CDB03E9F7B34424323" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Funds and transfer authority</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Economic Support Fund”, “International Narcotics Control and Law Enforcement”, “Nonproliferation, Anti-terrorism, Demining and Related Programs”, “Peacekeeping Operations”, and “Foreign Military Financing Program”, not less than $195,000,000 shall be made available for the Relief and Recovery Fund for assistance for areas liberated or at risk from, or under the control of, the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria, other terrorist organizations, or violent extremist organizations, including for stabilization assistance for vulnerable ethnic and religious minority communities affected by conflict: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such funds are in addition to amounts otherwise made available for such purposes and to amounts specifically designated in this Act or in the report accompanying this Act for assistance for countries: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That such funds appropriated under such headings may be transferred to, and merged with, funds appropriated under such headings: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That such transfer authority is in addition to any other transfer authority provided by this Act or any other Act, and is subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7047/b/2" id="HE1FC73B085EE462B8C72C95D1A020C3A" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Transitional justice</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>International Narcotics Control and Law Enforcement</headingText>” that are made available for the Relief and Recovery Fund, not less than $5,000,000 shall be made available for programs to promote accountability in Iraq and Syria for genocide, crimes against humanity, and war crimes, which shall be in addition to any other funds made available by this Act for such purposes: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such programs shall include components to develop local investigative and judicial skills, and to collect and preserve evidence and maintain the chain of custody of evidence, including for use in prosecutions: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That such funds shall be administered by the Special Coordinator for the Office of Global Criminal Justice, Department of State: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That funds made available by this paragraph shall only be made available on an open and competitive basis.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7047/d" id="HE4691998A13749E7AEB0BD9CD4732A2F" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Fragile States and Extremism</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act shall be made available for the purposes of section 7080 of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2017 (<ref href="/us/pl/115/31/dJ">division J of Public Law 115–31</ref>), subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H118FC841AA9C4EB29B28AF96A9CA7C13"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">united nations</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048" id="H802F2A8D1C204B14983546E3FDC6FC8D" changed="added"><num value="7048"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7048. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/a" id="HF16E6BD813A548F6836843CF24D44E48" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Transparency and Accountability</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/a/1" id="H1E19FDBB4C61487C9629A3E3B7C292C6" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Restrictions</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated under title I and under the heading “<headingText>International Organizations and Programs</headingText>” in title V of this Act that are available for contributions to the United Nations (including the Department of Peacekeeping Operations), any United Nations agency, or the Organization of American States, 15 percent may not be obligated for such organization, department, or agency until the Secretary of State determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that the organization, department, or agency is meeting the transparency and accountability requirements detailed in the report accompanying this Act.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/a/2" id="H59D7F152C8E0489FB70A0231E99E58B8" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>The restrictions imposed by or pursuant to paragraph (1) may be waived on a case-by-case basis if the Secretary of State determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that such waiver is necessary to avert or respond to a humanitarian crisis.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/b" id="HF762CBF9D0684CD3925BCEF6CE0FD2C9" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Restrictions on United Nations Delegations and Organizations</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/b/1" id="HEF0E54339E1B419A987EDA3AAB672B0C" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds made available by this Act may be used to pay expenses for any United States delegation to any specialized agency, body, or commission of the United Nations or may be made available as a contribution to any organization, agency, commission, or program within the United Nations system if such agency, body, commission, program, or organization is chaired or presided over by a country, the government of which the Secretary of State has determined for purposes of section 620A of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, section 40 of the Arms Export Control Act, section 6(j)(1) of the Export Administration Act of 1979 as continued in effect pursuant to the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (<ref href="/us/usc/t50/app24">50 U.S.C. App. 24</ref> 2405(j)(1)), or any other provision of law is a government that has repeatedly provided support for acts of international terrorism.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/b/2" id="H555DD9FED3AA422D9956121E8E8F1539" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of State may waive the restriction in this subsection if the Secretary determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that to do so is important to the national interest of the United States, including a description of the national interest served.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/c" id="HD4975ED34D77441380581EC3E49A1248" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">United Nations Human Rights Council</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act shall be made available in support of the United Nations Human Rights Council unless the Secretary of State determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that participation in the Council does not serve the national interest of the United States and that the Council is not taking significant steps to remove Israel as a permanent agenda item nor taking actions to ensure integrity in the election of members to such Council: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such report shall include a description of how the national interest is better served by our withdrawal from the Council: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That the Secretary of State shall report to the Committees on Appropriations not later than September 30, 2020, on the resolutions considered in the United Nations Human Rights Council during the previous 12 months, and on steps taken to remove Israel as a permanent agenda item and ensure integrity in the election of members to such Council.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/d" id="H19048313662B45E8BDF0A907F84FE051" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">United Nations Relief and Works Agency</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Funds appropriated by this Act under title III shall be made available to the United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA), unless the Secretary of State determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that UNRWA—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/d/1" id="HF202A9B3AF6A46AF8BD8EA4CE1722023" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>inappropriately utilizes Operations Support Officers in the West Bank, Gaza, and other fields of operation to inspect UNRWA installations;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/d/2" id="H94BB3314F40B4F139ADEB0BEFAA16DCD" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>is not promptly acting to address any staff or beneficiary violation of its own policies (including the policies on neutrality and impartiality of employees) and the legal requirements under section 301(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/d/3" id="HC74DB11F50874F6D80D58F2679C35C43" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>is not implementing procedures to maintain the neutrality of its facilities, including implementing a no-weapons policy, and conducting regular inspections of its installations, to ensure they are only used for humanitarian or other appropriate purposes;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/d/4" id="H3C24265A4D77490A8F670968F9E9B7DA" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><content>is not taking necessary and appropriate measures to ensure it is operating in compliance with the conditions of section 301(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 and continuing regular reporting to the Department of State on actions it has taken to ensure conformance with such conditions;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/d/5" id="H5E34672EDDA9444694F427043DDD2723" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><content>is not taking steps to ensure the content of all educational materials currently taught in UNRWA-administered schools and summer camps is consistent with the values of human rights, dignity, and tolerance and does not induce incitement;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/d/6" id="H1DD6821E7084462EB215B132BDCBBFFD" class="indent1"><num value="6">(6) </num><content>is engaging in operations with financial institutions or related entities in violation of relevant United States law, and is not taking steps to improve the financial transparency of the organization; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/d/7" id="H8A840C6EBED8442B8A877FF131F02AD1" class="indent1"><num value="7">(7) </num><content>is not in compliance with the United Nations Board of Auditors’ biennial audit requirements and is not implementing in a timely fashion the Board’s recommendations.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/e" id="H7FC05D845B594189AB9107346B936529" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Report</inline>.—</heading><content>Not later than 45 days after enactment of this Act, the Secretary of State shall submit a report to the Committees on Appropriations detailing the amount of funds available for obligation or expenditure in fiscal year 2020 for contributions to any organization, department, agency, or program within the United Nations system or any international program that are withheld from obligation or expenditure due to any provision of law: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the Secretary shall update such report each time additional funds are withheld by operation of any provision of law: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That the reprogramming of any withheld funds identified in such report, including updates thereof, shall be subject to prior consultation with, and the regular notification procedures of, the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/f" id="H4C39B200E5B04A619299F1C303AE7410" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Sexual Exploitation and Abuse in Peacekeeping Operations</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of State should withhold assistance to any unit of the security forces of a foreign country if the Secretary has credible information that such unit has engaged in sexual exploitation or abuse, including while serving in a United Nations peacekeeping operation, until the Secretary determines that the government of such country is taking effective steps to hold the responsible members of such unit accountable and to prevent future incidents: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the Secretary shall promptly notify the government of each country subject to any withholding of assistance pursuant to this subsection, and shall notify the appropriate congressional committees of such withholding not later than 10 days after a determination to withhold such assistance is made: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That the Secretary shall, to the maximum extent practicable, assist such government in bringing the responsible members of such unit to justice.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7048/g" id="H22F43E955FD84B03989D5C7DDD585BE1" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="g">(g) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Additional Availability</inline>.—</heading><content>Subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations, funds appropriated by this Act which are returned or not made available due to the implementation of subsection (a), the second proviso under the heading “<headingText>Contributions for International Peacekeeping Activities</headingText>” in title I of this Act, or section 307(a) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 (<ref href="/us/usc/t22/s2227/a">22 U.S.C. 2227(a)</ref>), shall remain available for obligation until September 30, 2021: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the requirement to withhold funds for programs in Burma under section 307(a) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 shall not apply to funds appropriated by this Act.</proviso></content></subsection>

<appropriations level="small" id="H28C56380C33A4CE8B8F9EE78B07850C0"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">inspectors general</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7049" id="H03228E62328448A788AF3A68439465A5" changed="added"><num value="7049"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7049. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7049/a" id="HBA7F142D9CDB4B97B37524FFA006069A" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition on Use of Funds</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated by this Act may be used to deny an Inspector General funded under this Act timely access to any records, documents, or other materials available to the department or agency of the United States Government over which such Inspector General has responsibilities under the Inspector General Act of 1978 (<ref href="/us/usc/t5/app">5 U.S.C. App.</ref>), or to prevent or impede the access of such Inspector General to such records, documents, or other materials, under any provision of law, except a provision of law that expressly refers to such Inspector General and expressly limits the right of access of such Inspector General.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7049/b" id="H7CBB62A3554F4F2FA3BD9DBF4792A632" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Report</inline>.—</heading><content>Each Inspector General covered by this section shall report to the Committees on Appropriations within 5 calendar days of any failure by any department or agency of the United States Government to provide its Inspector General access to all requested records, documents, and other materials.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" id="H68DDF1C4045243DE97DABA3D52C51423"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">global internet freedom</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7050" id="H96619908D3554880807A4F57EFE8E54D" changed="added"><num value="7050"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7050. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7050/a" id="H8B136372C9B346BCA36A87A83A691F2F" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Funding</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds available for obligation during fiscal year 2020 under the headings “International Broadcasting Operations”, “Economic Support Fund”, “Democracy Fund”, and “Assistance for Europe, Eurasia and Central Asia”, not less than $60,500,000 shall be made available for programs to promote Internet freedom globally.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7050/b" id="HBE43EEEFA533423A8A947ACC4A580A71" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Coordination and Spend Plans</inline>.—</heading><content>After consultation among the relevant agency heads to coordinate and de-conflict planned activities, but not later than 90 days after enactment of this Act, the Secretary of State and the Chief Executive Officer of the United States Agency for Global Media shall submit to the Committees on Appropriations spend plans for funds made available by this Act for programs to promote Internet freedom globally, which shall include a description of safeguards established by relevant agencies to ensure that such programs are not used for illicit purposes.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7050/c" id="HE1C10402D22840E7B0B8D65FB08CF527" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Security Audits</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds made available pursuant to this section to promote Internet freedom globally may only be made available to support technologies that undergo comprehensive security audits conducted by the Bureau of Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor, Department of State to ensure that such technology is secure and has not been compromised in a manner detrimental to the interest of the United States or to individuals and organizations benefiting from programs supported by such funds.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="HE6E5E23952DF4E4085E86613674CA796"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">torture and other cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment or punishment</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7051" id="HDFD0C4C43BC94D1FA699F9CC14F9FA35" changed="added"><num value="7051"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7051. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7051/a" id="HF5E767C965C64B2A86464C1D777428B4" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds made available by this Act may be used to support or justify the use of torture and other cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment or punishment by any official or contract employee of the United States Government.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7051/b" id="H00298BD8F87444E6AFCE2FC86431AFB4" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Assistance</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated under titles III and IV of this Act shall be made available, notwithstanding section 660 of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 and following consultation with the Committees on Appropriations, for assistance to eliminate torture and other cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment or punishment by foreign police, military or other security forces in countries receiving assistance from funds appropriated by this Act.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" id="H55CB4D5DFAC14A568E07F4023801842A"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">aircraft transfer, coordination, and use</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7052" id="H36B8312CF0DB47ED8F8FD3FD08EF4894" changed="added"><num value="7052"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7052. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7052/a" id="H74B893BEA98E4FB4A45ABD2A0C7DF858" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Transfer Authority</inline>.—</heading><content>Notwithstanding any other provision of law or regulation, aircraft procured with funds appropriated by this Act and prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs under the headings “Diplomatic Programs”, “International Narcotics Control and Law Enforcement”, “Andean Counterdrug Initiative”, and “Andean Counterdrug Programs” may be used for any other program and in any region.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7052/b" id="H02B7DCE196CB4A7491DEBF7F9DF3193B" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Property Disposal</inline>.—</heading><content>The authority provided in subsection (a) shall apply only after the Secretary of State determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that the equipment is no longer required to meet programmatic purposes in the designated country or region: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That any such transfer shall be subject to prior consultation with, and the regular notification procedures of, the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7052/c" id="H902F7A8C2E6E49E8A329EB46003FB394" changed="notChanged" origin="#SSAP00" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Aircraft Coordination</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7052/c/1" id="H4DAB372DB1D94EEDAD43C452ADE0A4D9" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authority</inline>.—</heading><content>The uses of aircraft purchased or leased by the Department of State and the United States Agency for International Development with funds made available in this Act or prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs shall be coordinated under the authority of the appropriate Chief of Mission: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That notwithstanding section 7006(b) of this Act, such aircraft may be used to transport, on a reimbursable or non-reimbursable basis, Federal and non-Federal personnel supporting Department of State and USAID programs and activities: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That official travel for other agencies for other purposes may be supported on a reimbursable basis, or without reimbursement when traveling on a space available basis: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That funds received by the Department of State in connection with the use of aircraft owned, leased, or chartered by the Department of State may be credited to the Working Capital Fund of the Department and shall be available for expenses related to the purchase, lease, maintenance, chartering, or operation of such aircraft.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7052/c/2" id="HFB4646F881F54CFDA723F569E602E8F8" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Scope</inline>.—</heading><content>The requirement and authorities of this subsection shall only apply to aircraft, the primary purpose of which is the transportation of personnel.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7052/d" id="HF9AC6C97B3B14477B354A4DCFB79AB1E" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Aircraft Operations and Maintenance</inline>.—</heading><content>To the maximum extent practicable, the costs of operations and maintenance, including fuel, of aircraft funded by this Act shall be borne by the recipient country.</content></subsection></section>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7054" id="H45B34EC125714C5E95CAD6D1F43BF619" changed="notChanged"><num value="7054"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7054. </inline></num><content class="inline">The terms and conditions of sections 7086(b) (1) and (2) and 7090(a) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2010 (<ref href="/us/pl/111/117/dF">division F of Public Law 111–117</ref>) shall apply to this Act.</content></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H06A9565E25AA46B09C4DD07C721E6EA0"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">extradition</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7055" id="HF66C902EF0BD4CD6B856B7D4C565DF1E" changed="notChanged"><num value="7055"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7055. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7055/a" id="HD777A82327AA4343AF7D476D47F65BE2" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Limitation</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds appropriated in this Act may be used to provide assistance (other than funds provided under the headings “International Disaster Assistance”, “Complex Crises Fund”, “International Narcotics Control and Law Enforcement”, “Migration and Refugee Assistance”, “United States Emergency Refugee and Migration Assistance Fund”, and “Nonproliferation, Anti-terrorism, Demining and Related Assistance”) for the central government of a country which has notified the Department of State of its refusal to extradite to the United States any individual indicted for a criminal offense for which the maximum penalty is life imprisonment without the possibility of parole or for killing a law enforcement officer, as specified in a United States extradition request.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7055/b" id="H146F0F58EFD44D459CC54807B99FB23B" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Clarification</inline>.—</heading><content>Subsection (a) shall only apply to the central government of a country with which the United States maintains diplomatic relations and with which the United States has an extradition treaty and the government of that country is in violation of the terms and conditions of the treaty.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7055/c" id="H818EFC484F61471798476EEB32E93BBB" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Waiver</inline>.—</heading><content>The Secretary of State may waive the restriction in subsection (a) on a case-by-case basis if the Secretary certifies to the Committees on Appropriations that such waiver is important to the national interest of the United States.</content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" id="H051E84FEE26D4DE1B558E5AD52117635"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">impact on jobs in the united states</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7056" id="H81080D2DEC0A4393A8C810FD2754EF4E" changed="notChanged"><num value="7056"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7056. </inline></num><chapeau class="inline">None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made available under titles III through VI of this Act may be obligated or expended to provide—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7056/1" id="H9740334780CD4C0DB22DF1F468534347" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>any financial incentive to a business enterprise currently located in the United States for the purpose of inducing such an enterprise to relocate outside the United States if such incentive or inducement is likely to reduce the number of employees of such business enterprise in the United States because United States production is being replaced by such enterprise outside the United States;</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7056/2" id="HA8C74F3DF934469B8D3FC054FD6F0AE6" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>assistance for any program, project, or activity that contributes to the violation of internationally recognized workers’ rights, as defined in section 507(4) of the Trade Act of 1974, of workers in the recipient country, including any designated zone or area in that country: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the application of section 507(4)(D) and (E) of such Act should be commensurate with the level of development of the recipient country and sector, and shall not preclude assistance for the informal sector in such country, micro and small-scale enterprise, and smallholder agriculture; or</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7056/3" id="H9F28C0E7028F4B1ABC21EB6BC8C46D74" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><content>any assistance to an entity outside the United States if such assistance is for the purpose of directly relocating or transferring jobs from the United States to other countries and adversely impacts the labor force in the United States.</content></paragraph></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H141D10E16D40438B8B7BA15CC3EBAF46"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">united nations population fund</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7057" id="H4430C539DBFC41DCAC3B4F91FC560BFD" changed="added"><num value="7057"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7057. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7057/a" id="HF194899E71144A8A95E9304FFE2C7E70" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Contribution</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds made available under the heading “<headingText>International Organizations and Programs</headingText>” in this Act for fiscal year 2020, $55,500,000 shall be made available for the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA).</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7057/b" id="HD3DD7DAC667440D18A7D61B275C0B155" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Availability of Funds</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act for UNFPA, that are not made available for UNFPA because of the operation of any provision of law, shall be transferred to the “Global Health Programs” account and shall be made available for family planning, maternal, and reproductive health activities, subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7057/c" id="H1201B6DF09314D448FA1EA441D135924" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Prohibition on Use of Funds in China</inline>.—</heading><content>None of the funds made available by this Act may be used by UNFPA for a country program in the People’s Republic of China.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7057/d" id="H8E9DFF97134B4A68819DD7918FDB1D0C" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Conditions on Availability of Funds</inline>.—</heading><chapeau>Funds made available by this Act for UNFPA may not be made available unless—</chapeau>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7057/d/1" id="H1EEA43523FD344929C102245AED3B262" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>UNFPA maintains funds made available by this Act in an account separate from other accounts of UNFPA and does not commingle such funds with other sums; and</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7057/d/2" id="HC379E432800C4895A1668730BAC4D729" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>UNFPA does not fund abortions.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7057/e" id="HF3E903EFBC9040FB87197A4BE699A779" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Report to Congress and Dollar-for-Dollar Withholding of Funds</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7057/e/1" id="HBB73064D84124DE1A3F2F59FBC67C486" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><content>Not later than 4 months after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary of State shall submit a report to the Committees on Appropriations indicating the amount of funds that UNFPA is budgeting for the year in which the report is submitted for a country program in the People’s Republic of China.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7057/e/2" id="HC99DD80FF8B84D7AA5051F23F5AC1929" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><content>If a report under paragraph (1) indicates that UNFPA plans to spend funds for a country program in the People’s Republic of China in the year covered by the report, then the amount of such funds UNFPA plans to spend in the People’s Republic of China shall be deducted from the funds made available to UNFPA after March 1 for obligation for the remainder of the fiscal year in which the report is submitted.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H943A2645CE0A4F99A13ADA3FFBDE9621"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">global health activities</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7058" id="HB232F034D4ED483CBE5BD7C45C808540" changed="added"><num value="7058"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7058. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7058/a" id="H7148D5F2EC604DB5933D4F3C1EBB16A0" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">In General</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by titles III and IV of this Act that are made available for global health programs, including activities relating to research on, and the prevention, treatment and control of, HIV/AIDS, may be made available notwithstanding any other provision of law except for provisions under the heading “<headingText>Global Health Programs</headingText>” and the United States Leadership Against HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria Act of 2003 (<ref href="/us/stat/117/711">117 Stat. 711</ref>; <ref href="/us/usc/t22/s7601/etseq">22 U.S.C. 7601 et seq.</ref>), as amended: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That of the funds appropriated under the heading “<headingText>Global Health Programs</headingText>” in this Act, not less than $750,000,000 shall be made available for family planning/reproductive health, including in areas where population growth threatens biodiversity or endangered species: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That none of the funds made available by this Act or prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs shall be made available to implement the Presidential Memorandum on Mexico City Policy dated January 23, 2017: </proviso><proviso><i>Provided further</i>, That none of the funds made available by this Act may be used in contravention of the conditions of section 7018 of this Act and section 104(f)(1) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7058/b" id="H89A932CCD955411BB05F107596EEB514" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Contagious Infectious Disease Outbreaks</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7058/b/1" id="H54FD46A1FC414E04847031C54AF9E82F" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps"> Extraordinary measures</inline>.—</heading><content>If the Secretary of State determines and reports to the Committees on Appropriations that an international infectious disease outbreak is sustained, severe, and is spreading internationally, or that it is in the national interest to respond to a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Global Health Programs”, “Development Assistance”, “International Disaster Assistance”, “Complex Crises Fund”, “Economic Support Fund”, “Democracy Fund”, “Assistance for Europe, Eurasia and Central Asia”, “Migration and Refugee Assistance”, and “Millennium Challenge Corporation” may be made available to combat such infectious disease or public health emergency, and may be transferred to, and merged with, funds appropriated under such headings for the purposes of this paragraph.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7058/b/2" id="HF55162D005774CA9916D1D5713D0033F" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Emergency reserve fund</inline>.—</heading><content>Up to $10,000,000 of the funds made available under the heading “<headingText>Global Health Programs</headingText>” may be made available for the Emergency Reserve Fund established pursuant to section 7058(c)(1) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2017 (<ref href="/us/pl/115/31/dJ">division J of Public Law 115–31</ref>): <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such funds shall be made available under the same terms and conditions of such section.</proviso></content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7058/b/3" id="H3B247095F55E4F06857F58BA8C928F3C" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Consultation and notification</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds made available by this subsection shall be subject to prior consultation with the appropriate congressional committees, and the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</content></paragraph></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="notChanged" id="HF1DEDB18BDC640CABC1ACC01B5B2999F"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">gender equality</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7059" id="HD6CE95B85C834924BF5FDF10370315CF" changed="added"><num value="7059"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7059. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7059/a" id="HBEE262D4666144EB9275CD6A4FDAF730" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Gender Equality</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act shall be made available to promote gender equality in United States Government diplomatic and development efforts by raising the status, increasing the participation, and protecting the rights of women and girls worldwide.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7059/b" id="H3641AD48B5D847D196AE5A7937511B3B" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Women’s Leadership</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by title III of this Act, not less than $50,000,000 shall be made available for programs specifically designed to increase leadership opportunities for women in countries where women and girls suffer discrimination due to law, policy, or practice, by strengthening protections for women’s political status, expanding women’s participation in political parties and elections, and increasing women’s opportunities for leadership positions in the public and private sectors at the local, provincial, and national levels.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7059/c" id="H68E3821E53E145ACA41798EF0A850582" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Gender-Based Violence</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated under titles III and IV of this Act, not less than $165,000,000 shall be made available to implement a multi-year strategy to prevent and respond to gender-based violence in countries where it is common in conflict and non-conflict settings.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7059/d" id="H01F18F65C97C4FC8AFFCFE6CE7B501A3" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Women and Girls at Risk From Extremism</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Development Assistance</headingText>”, not less than $15,000,000 shall be made available to support women and girls who are at risk from extremism and conflict, and for the activities described in section 7059(e)(1) of the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2018 (<ref href="/us/pl/115/141/dK">division K of Public Law 115–141</ref>): <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such funds are in addition to amounts otherwise made available by this Act for such purposes, and shall be made available following consultation with, and the regular notification procedures of, the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></subsection></section>
<appropriations level="small" changed="added" id="H566A83EC799245E681C7883E2C552B48"><heading><inline class="smallCaps">sector allocations</inline></heading></appropriations>
<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060" id="H2DFB2E648C314E99BBEC42B329327FC1" changed="added"><num value="7060"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 7060. </inline></num><subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/a" id="H53FBE7710C34414D9C8A556E706E1AFD" class="inline"><num value="a">(a) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Basic Education and Higher Education</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/a/1" id="H4C2614CC0C7B47A8A2BDD31F480E0A3F" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Basic education</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/a/1/A" id="H7E8B909015EB49E690FCEE9D5A9178FD" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>Of the funds appropriated under title III of this Act, not less than $925,000,000 shall be made available for assistance for basic education, and such funds may be made available notwithstanding any other provision of law that restricts assistance to foreign countries: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That funds made available under the headings “Development Assistance” and “Economic Support Fund” for the support of non-state schools in this Act and prior Acts shall be subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/a/1/B" id="HA03BF9A90D6A43B5BDECE67497F57854" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>Of the funds appropriated under title III of this Act for assistance for basic education programs, not less than $125,000,000 shall be made available for contributions to multilateral partnerships that support education.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/a/2" id="H57C64E167AFA4918944BC1391452CE34" changed="added" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Higher education</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by title III of this Act, not less than $235,000,000 shall be made available for assistance for higher education: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That such funds may be made available notwithstanding any other provision of law that restricts assistance to foreign countries, and shall be subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/b" id="H894CFCB331A144E69DF05F114CA632D6" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="b">(b) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Environment Programs</inline>.—</heading>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/b/1" id="H8D189C4C108D4DFD9AD66E525F15BE21" class="indent1"><num value="1">(1) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Authority, notification, and limitation</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/b/1/A" id="HF92DCDD26077486FA477F975157BF117" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>Funds appropriated by this Act to carry out the provisions of sections 103 through 106, and chapter 4 of part II, of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 may be used, notwithstanding any other provision of law, except for the provisions of this subsection, to support environment programs.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/b/1/B" id="H3C78CF370B7643318C84CD08F655AE87" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>Funds made available pursuant to this subsection shall be subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/b/1/C" id="H91766ADED48148CABA4C8C72551FBF7D" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>Funds in this Act and prior Acts may be made available for a contribution, grant, or any other payment for the Paris Agreement: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That any such use of funds shall be subject to prior consultation with, and the regular notification procedures of, the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/b/1/D" id="H5D84200385D0487EABCBC9B2333DB419" class="indent2"><num value="D">(D) </num><content>None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made available by this Act, or prior Acts making appropriations for the Department of State, foreign operations, and related programs, may be used to provide formal notification under Article 28 of the Paris Agreement of the withdrawal of the United States from such Agreement.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/b/2" id="HA72CB6325C1B4F6CB36D101155EF423F" class="indent1"><num value="2">(2) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Conservation programs</inline>.—</heading>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/b/2/A" id="H47F1747D032E4722AD4796EEDE33CB46" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>Of the funds appropriated under title III of this Act, not less than $295,000,000 shall be made available for biodiversity conservation programs.</content></subparagraph>
<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/b/2/B" id="H3A297F12950F47668C7645E899785DC0" class="indent2"><num value="B">(B) </num><content>Not less than $100,664,000 of the funds appropriated under titles III and IV of this Act shall be made available to combat the transnational threat of wildlife poaching and trafficking.</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/b/3" id="H01276F8BBD894EFE817B40E247CE9D35" class="indent1"><num value="3">(3) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Sustainable landscapes</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated under title III of this Act, not less than $135,000,000 shall be made available for sustainable landscapes programs.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/b/4" id="H3D5E49BD65BD49BC9777C14F53F723A7" class="indent1"><num value="4">(4) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Adaptation</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated under title III of this Act, not less than $177,000,000 shall be made available for adaptation programs.</content></paragraph>
<paragraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/b/5" id="H48E4A96C6EF04AF6BE7984B04EB1E09E" class="indent1"><num value="5">(5) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Renewable energy</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated under title III of this Act, not less than $179,000,000 shall be made available for renewable energy programs.</content></paragraph></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/c" id="HC1B5F807D8724CE69B4FB001D6A30AFB" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="c">(c) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Food Security and Agricultural Development</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by title III of this Act, not less than $1,005,600,000 shall be made available for food security and agricultural development programs to carry out the purposes of the Global Food Security Act of 2016 (<ref href="/us/pl/114/195">Public Law 114–195</ref>): <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That funds may be made available for a contribution as authorized by section 3202 of the Food, Conservation, and Energy Act of 2008 (<ref href="/us/pl/110/246">Public Law 110–246</ref>), as amended by section 3310 of the Agriculture Improvement Act of 2018 (<ref href="/us/pl/115/334">Public Law 115–334</ref>).</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/d" id="HB8FE039021CA4FEB862B702DEA43A908" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="d">(d) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Micro, Small, and Medium-sized Enterprises</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act, not less than $265,000,000 shall be made available to support the development of, and access to financing for, micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises that benefit the poor, especially women.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/e" id="H7E5CC90E8F2846E6922AC37EEC7AF19E" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="e">(e) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Programs To Combat Trafficking in Persons</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act under the headings “Development Assistance”, “Economic Support Fund”, “Assistance for Europe, Eurasia and Central Asia”, and “International Narcotics Control and Law Enforcement”, not less than $67,000,000 shall be made available for activities to combat trafficking in persons internationally.</content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/f" id="H6270E243F8954650A1E63FE29D8B57B6" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="f">(f) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Reconciliation Programs</inline>.—</heading><content>Funds appropriated by this Act under the heading “<headingText>Development Assistance</headingText>” shall be made available to support people-to-people reconciliation programs which bring together individuals of different ethnic, religious, and political backgrounds from areas of civil strife and war: <proviso><i>Provided</i>, That the USAID Administrator shall consult with the Committees on Appropriations, prior to the initial obligation of funds, on the uses of such funds, and such funds shall be subject to the regular notification procedures of the Committees on Appropriations.</proviso></content></subsection>
<subsection identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/2839/tVII/s7060/g" id="H0EC850A6A1FC425F8E69BA6F16245D90" changed="added" class="indent0"><num value="g">(g) </num><heading><inline class="smallCaps">Water and Sanitation</inline>.—</heading><content>Of the funds appropriated by this Act, not less than $435,000,000 shall be made available for water supply and sanitation projects pursuant to section 136 of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, of which not less than $195,000,000 shall be for programs in sub-Saharan Africa, and of which not less than $15,000,000 shall be made available to support initiatives by local communities in developing countries to build and maintain safe latrines.</content></subsection></section>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3401/tIII/s301" id="H099AE84E126641C783CF2E803A995243"><num value="301"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 301. </inline></num><content class="inline">The Secretary of Health and Human Services (the “Secretary”) shall prioritize use of community-based residential care (including long-term and transitional foster care and small group homes) and shelter care other than large-scale institutional shelter facilities to house unaccompanied alien children in the custody of the Department of Health and Human Services. The Secretary shall prioritize State-licensed, hard-sided dormitories.</content></section>

<section identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3401/tIII/s303" id="H8666F158229849E78AFA608A09BCA0FD"><num value="303"><inline class="smallCaps">Sec. 303. </inline></num><content class="inline">Funds made available in this Act under the heading “<headingText>Department of Health and Human Services—Administration for Children and Families—Refugee and Entrant Assistance</headingText>” shall be subject to the authorities and conditions of section 224 of division A of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2019 (<ref href="/us/pl/116/6">Public Law 116–6</ref>).</content></section>

<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3401/tIII/s304/1/A" id="HDE0A406462BD4441942B2CFE8E709DE0" class="indent2"><num value="A">(A) </num><content>the same requirements as licensed placements, as listed in Exhibit 1 of the Flores Settlement Agreement, regardless of the status of the underlying settlement agreement;</content></subparagraph>

<subparagraph identifier="/us/bill/116/hr/3401/tIII/s304/1/C" id="H2550F388DD18486F8BEEACC68CCDF579" class="indent2"><num value="C">(C) </num><content>access provided to legal services;</content></subparagraph></paragraph>
